## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/cleaning/PlanBuilder.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.cleaning

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningPlan
import com.cleanforge.core.model.RejectedItem
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ScanItem
import com.cleanforge.core.safety.SafetyValidator
import javax.inject.Inject

/** VALIDATE + PLAN. Turns the user's selection into a plan; refused items are kept WITH their reason. */
class PlanBuilder @Inject constructor(private val validator: SafetyValidator) {

    /**
     * @param selected the items the user ticked.
     * @param scanned every item of the current scan. Needed to know the OTHER copies of a duplicate group,
     *   because the copy that stays is whichever one the user did not tick, never one CleanForge guessed.
     */
    fun build(selected: List<ScanItem>, scanned: List<ScanItem>): CleaningPlan {
        val rejected = ArrayList<RejectedItem>()
        val valid = ArrayList<ScanItem>()
        val seen = HashSet<String>()

        // If one path was flagged twice (say as a large file AND as a duplicate), plan the duplicate form:
        // it is the one that carries the "a copy must stay" protection. (sortedBy is stable.)
        val ordered = selected.sortedBy { if (it.category == CleaningCategory.DUPLICATE) 0 else 1 }
        for (item in ordered) {
            val reason = validator.rejectionReason(item)
            when {
                reason != null -> rejected += RejectedItem(item, reason)
                !seen.add(item.path) -> rejected += RejectedItem(item, "Selected twice")
                else -> valid += item
            }
        }

        // Nothing may be deleted both as part of a folder and on its own.
        val folderRoots = valid
            .filter { it.deleteMode == DeleteMode.TREE || it.deleteMode == DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY }
            .map { it.path }
        val afterOverlap = ArrayList<ScanItem>()
        for (item in valid) {
            val parent = folderRoots.firstOrNull { it != item.path && item.path.startsWith("$it/") }
            if (parent != null) rejected += RejectedItem(item, "Already covered by $parent") else afterOverlap += item
        }

        // A duplicate may only be removed while a copy the user did NOT tick is guaranteed to survive.
        // Everything that is a candidate counts as "going away", even if it is refused further down: that can
        // only make the rule stricter, never looser.
        val deleting = afterOverlap.mapTo(HashSet<String>()) { it.path }
        fun insideCleanedFolder(path: String) = folderRoots.any { path.startsWith("$it/") }
        val copiesByGroup: Map<String, List<ScanItem>> = scanned
            .filter { it.category == CleaningCategory.DUPLICATE && it.groupId != null }
            .groupBy { it.groupId ?: "" }

        val planned = ArrayList<ScanItem>()
        for (item in afterOverlap) {
            if (item.category != CleaningCategory.DUPLICATE) {
                planned += item
                continue
            }
            val copies = item.groupId?.let { copiesByGroup[it] }.orEmpty()
            val others = copies.filter { it.path != item.path && it.path !in deleting && it.fingerprint != null }
            // A copy inside a folder that is being emptied in the same run is not a keeper: it goes away too.
            val survivor = others.firstOrNull { !insideCleanedFolder(it.path) }
            if (survivor == null) {
                val why = when {
                    copies.size < 2 -> "The other copies of this file are unknown; scan again"
                    others.isNotEmpty() -> "The only other copy lies in a folder that is also being cleaned; at least one must stay"
                    else -> "Every copy of this file is selected; at least one must stay"
                }
                rejected += RejectedItem(item, why)
                continue
            }
            planned += item.copy(keepPath = survivor.path, keepFingerprint = survivor.fingerprint)
        }

        // The same rule must hold when the copies were ticked through some OTHER category (e.g. large files):
        // never plan the deletion of every copy of the same content.
        val plannedPaths = planned.mapTo(HashSet<String>()) { it.path }
        val wholeGroupPaths = HashSet<String>()
        for (copies in copiesByGroup.values) {
            // "Going away" also covers a copy that lies inside a folder emptied in the same run.
            if (copies.all { it.path in plannedPaths || insideCleanedFolder(it.path) }) {
                copies.mapTo(wholeGroupPaths) { it.path }
            }
        }
        val finalItems = ArrayList<ScanItem>()
        for (item in planned) {
            if (item.path in wholeGroupPaths) {
                rejected += RejectedItem(item, "Every copy of this file is selected; at least one must stay")
            } else {
                finalItems += item
            }
        }
        return CleaningPlan(finalItems, rejected)
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.diagnostics

import com.cleanforge.core.shizuku.ShizukuState
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.Date
import java.util.Locale

object DiagnosticExporter {

    fun toText(r: DiagnosticReport): String = buildString {
        appendLine("CleanForge diagnostic report")
        appendLine("Generated: ${iso(r.generatedAt)}")
        appendLine("App: ${r.appVersion} · Android SDK ${r.androidSdk} · ${r.deviceModel}")
        appendLine()
        appendLine("== Storage ==")
        appendLine("Total: ${fmt(r.totalBytes)}  Free: ${fmt(r.freeBytes)}")
        appendLine()
        appendLine("== Permissions ==")
        appendLine("All-files access: ${if (r.hasAllFilesAccess) "granted" else "MISSING"}")
        appendLine("Shizuku: ${describe(r.shizuku)}")
        r.capabilities?.let { cap ->
            appendLine("  Service uid: ${cap.serviceUid ?: "none"} · api: ${cap.serviceApiVersion ?: "?"}")
            cap.operations.forEach { (op, c) ->
                appendLine("  - ${op.title}: ${c.status} — ${c.reason}")
            }
        }
        appendLine()
        appendLine("== Scanners ==")
        if (r.scanners.isEmpty()) appendLine("(no scan has run in this session)")
        r.scanners.forEach { s ->
            val size = if (s.bytes > 0) " (${fmt(s.bytes)})" else ""
            val reason = s.reason?.let { " — ${redact(it, r.redactPaths)}" } ?: ""
            appendLine("- ${s.name}: ${s.status}${size}${reason}")
        }
        if (r.notices.isNotEmpty()) {
            appendLine()
            appendLine("== Notices ==")
            r.notices.forEach { appendLine("- ${redact(it, r.redactPaths)}") }
        }
    }

    private fun redact(s: String, on: Boolean): String {
        if (!on) return s
        return s.replace(Regex("/storage/emulated/0/(\\S+)")) { m ->
            "/storage/emulated/0/…/${m.groupValues[1].substringAfterLast('/')}"
        }
    }

    private fun describe(s: ShizukuState): String = when (s) {
        is ShizukuState.Authorized ->
            "authorized (uid ${s.uid}${if (s.isRoot) ", root" else ""}, v${s.serverVersion})"
        ShizukuState.NotInstalled -> "not installed"
        ShizukuState.NotRunning -> "not running"
        ShizukuState.PermissionDenied -> "permission denied"
        ShizukuState.PermissionPermanentlyDenied -> "permission permanently denied"
        ShizukuState.Disconnected -> "disconnected"
        ShizukuState.ServerTooOld -> "server too old"
        is ShizukuState.Error -> "error: ${s.message}"
    }

    private fun fmt(b: Long): String = when {
        b >= 1L shl 30 -> String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f GB", b / (1.0 * (1L shl 30)))
        b >= 1L shl 20 -> String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f MB", b / (1.0 * (1L shl 20)))
        b >= 1L shl 10 -> String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f KB", b / 1024.0)
        else -> "$b B"
    }

    private fun iso(ms: Long): String =
        SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", Locale.US).format(Date(ms))
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/fs/AndroidFsOps.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.fs

import android.system.ErrnoException
import android.system.Os
import android.system.OsConstants
import java.io.File

/** Real implementation. Uses lstat(2)/remove(3) via android.system.Os, so symlinks are never followed. */
object AndroidFsOps : FsOps {

    override fun lstat(path: String): FsStat? = try {
        toStat(Os.lstat(path))
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        null
    }

    override fun probe(path: String): FsProbe = try {
        FsProbe.Found(toStat(Os.lstat(path)))
    } catch (e: ErrnoException) {
        when (e.errno) {
            OsConstants.ENOENT, OsConstants.ENOTDIR -> FsProbe.Missing
            OsConstants.EACCES, OsConstants.EPERM -> FsProbe.Denied
            else -> FsProbe.Error
        }
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        FsProbe.Error
    }

    private fun toStat(st: android.system.StructStat): FsStat {
        val type = when {
            OsConstants.S_ISLNK(st.st_mode) -> FsType.SYMLINK
            OsConstants.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode) -> FsType.DIRECTORY
            OsConstants.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) -> FsType.FILE
            else -> FsType.OTHER
        }
        return FsStat(type, st.st_size, st.st_mtime * 1000L, st.st_dev, st.st_ino)
    }

    override fun list(path: String): List<String>? = try {
        File(path).list()?.toList()
    } catch (e: SecurityException) {
        null
    }

    override fun remove(path: String): Boolean = try {
        Os.remove(path)
        true
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        false
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/fs/FsOps.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.fs

enum class FsType(val code: Int) {
    FILE(0), DIRECTORY(1), SYMLINK(2), OTHER(3);

    companion object {
        fun fromCode(code: Int): FsType = entries.firstOrNull { it.code == code } ?: OTHER
    }
}

/**
 * Snapshot of one filesystem object taken WITHOUT following symlinks (lstat).
 * Also used as the "fingerprint" recorded at scan time and compared again right before deletion.
 */
data class FsStat(
    val type: FsType,
    val size: Long,
    val mtimeMs: Long,
    val dev: Long,
    val ino: Long
) {
    /** True if [other] still describes the same object we saw before. */
    fun sameObjectAs(other: FsStat): Boolean {
        if (type != other.type || dev != other.dev || ino != other.ino) return false
        // Directory contents legitimately change (caches); files must be byte-for-byte unchanged by size+mtime.
        return type != FsType.FILE || (size == other.size && mtimeMs == other.mtimeMs)
    }
}

/** lstat that tells "does not exist" apart from "could not be examined". */
sealed interface FsProbe {
    data class Found(val stat: FsStat) : FsProbe

    /** ENOENT / ENOTDIR: a real answer, the entry is not there. */
    data object Missing : FsProbe

    /** EACCES / EPERM: the entry may exist but this process may not look at it. */
    data object Denied : FsProbe

    /** Any other failure. */
    data object Error : FsProbe
}

/**
 * The only filesystem surface the cleaning code is allowed to use.
 * Implementations MUST NOT follow symlinks and MUST NOT recurse.
 */
interface FsOps {
    /** lstat. Null if the entry does not exist or cannot be examined. */
    fun lstat(path: String): FsStat?

    /**
     * Like [lstat] but keeps the failure reason. The default cannot tell the cases apart and reports [FsProbe.Missing];
     * implementations that can (the real one) override it.
     */
    fun probe(path: String): FsProbe = lstat(path)?.let { FsProbe.Found(it) } ?: FsProbe.Missing

    /** Child names (never paths). Null if [path] cannot be listed. */
    fun list(path: String): List<String>?

    /** unlink a file/symlink, or rmdir an EMPTY directory. Never recursive, never follows links. */
    fun remove(path: String): Boolean
}

data class WalkLimits(
    val maxDepth: Int = 32,
    val maxEntries: Int = 200_000
)

/**
 * Measured logical size (sum of st_size of regular files, NOT allocated blocks).
 * [complete] is false when a safety bound cut the walk short; [unreadable] counts directories that could not be
 * listed (their contents are missing from [bytes]). Either one means [bytes] is a lower bound, never an exact figure.
 */
data class SizeResult(val bytes: Long, val complete: Boolean, val unreadable: Int = 0) {
    /** True only if nothing was cut off and nothing was unreadable. */
    val isExact: Boolean get() = complete && unreadable == 0
}

enum class DeleteMode(val code: Int) {
    /** One regular file. */
    FILE(0),

    /** One directory, only if it is already empty. */
    EMPTY_DIR(1),

    /** Everything inside a directory; the directory itself stays. */
    CONTENTS_ONLY(2),

    /** A directory and everything inside it. */
    TREE(3);

    companion object {
        fun fromCode(code: Int): DeleteMode? = entries.firstOrNull { it.code == code }
    }
}

enum class DeleteStatus(val code: Int) {
    OK(0),
    MISSING(1),
    REFUSED(2),
    IDENTITY_CHANGED(3),
    WRONG_TYPE(4),
    FAILED(5),
    PARTIAL(6),
    LIMIT_EXCEEDED(7),

    /** The user (or a timeout policy) stopped the operation between entries. Some entries may already be gone. */
    CANCELLED(8),

    /** Produced on the app side only: the privileged channel was not usable, so nothing is known to have happened. */
    UNAVAILABLE(9),

    /** Produced on the app side only: the call did not return in time; the outcome is unknown. */
    TIMED_OUT(10);

    companion object {
        fun fromCode(code: Int): DeleteStatus = entries.firstOrNull { it.code == code } ?: FAILED
    }
}

data class DeleteResult(
    val status: DeleteStatus,
    val entriesRemoved: Int = 0,
    val bytesFreed: Long = 0L,
    val detail: String = ""
)
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/fs/PathRules.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.fs

class PathException(message: String) : Exception(message)

/**
 * Pure, lexical path policy. Shared by the app-side SafetyValidator and the Shizuku service guard.
 *
 * Shared storage on Android is CASE-INSENSITIVE (FUSE/sdcardfs), so every structural comparison
 * (DCIM, Android, data, cache ...) is done case-insensitively.
 */
object PathRules {
    /** The only accepted spelling of the primary shared-storage root. Aliases (/sdcard, /storage/self/primary) are rejected. */
    const val ROOT = "/storage/emulated/0"
    const val MAX_PATH = 4096

    private val PACKAGE_REGEX = Regex("^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*(\\.[A-Za-z0-9_]+)+$")

    private val PROTECTED_TOP_LEVEL = setOf(
        "dcim", "pictures", "movies", "music", "documents", "download", "downloads",
        "recordings", "audiobooks", "podcasts", "ringtones", "alarms", "notifications",
        "whatsapp", "telegram"
    )

    fun isValidPackageName(name: String): Boolean = name.length <= 255 && PACKAGE_REGEX.matches(name)

    /**
     * Components of [path] below [ROOT]. Throws [PathException] for anything not already canonical:
     * relative, empty/".."/"." segments, trailing slash, NUL/control characters, over-long, or outside ROOT.
     */
    fun componentsBelowRoot(path: String): List<String> {
        if (path.isEmpty()) throw PathException("Empty path")
        if (path.length > MAX_PATH) throw PathException("Path is too long")
        for (ch in path) {
            if (ch.code < 0x20 || ch.code == 0x7f) throw PathException("Control character in path")
        }
        if (!path.startsWith("/")) throw PathException("Path is not absolute")
        if (path.endsWith("/")) throw PathException("Path has a trailing slash")
        val parts = path.substring(1).split('/')
        for (p in parts) {
            if (p.isEmpty()) throw PathException("Empty path segment")
            if (p == "." || p == "..") throw PathException("Relative path segment '$p'")
        }
        val rootParts = ROOT.substring(1).split('/')
        if (parts.size <= rootParts.size || parts.subList(0, rootParts.size) != rootParts) {
            throw PathException("Path is not below the canonical storage root $ROOT")
        }
        return parts.subList(rootParts.size, parts.size)
    }

    private fun String.eq(other: String) = this.equals(other, ignoreCase = true)

    /** Android/data/<pkg>/cache */
    fun isExternalAppCacheDir(c: List<String>): Boolean =
        c.size == 4 && c[0].eq("Android") && c[1].eq("data") && isValidPackageName(c[2]) && c[3].eq("cache")

    /** Android/data/<pkg> or Android/obb/<pkg> */
    fun isExternalAppDataRoot(c: List<String>): Boolean =
        c.size == 3 && c[0].eq("Android") && (c[1].eq("data") || c[1].eq("obb")) && isValidPackageName(c[2])

    /** DCIM/.thumbnails */
    fun isThumbnailDir(c: List<String>): Boolean =
        c.size == 2 && c[0].eq("DCIM") && c[1].eq(".thumbnails")

    /** Personal-data zones: only ever touched through explicit review of individual files. */
    fun isProtectedZone(c: List<String>): Boolean {
        if (c.isEmpty()) return false
        if (c[0].lowercase() in PROTECTED_TOP_LEVEL) return true
        return c[0].eq("Android") && c.size > 1 && c[1].eq("media")
    }

    // ---- Shizuku service guard (runs in the privileged process) ----

    /** Read access: Android/data, Android/obb and anything below them. */
    fun isServiceReadable(path: String): Boolean = try {
        val c = componentsBelowRoot(path)
        c.size >= 2 && c[0].eq("Android") && (c[1].eq("data") || c[1].eq("obb"))
    } catch (e: PathException) {
        false
    }

    /** Delete access: exactly the two recursive patterns, nothing else. */
    fun isServiceDeletable(path: String, mode: DeleteMode): Boolean = try {
        val c = componentsBelowRoot(path)
        when (mode) {
            DeleteMode.TREE -> isExternalAppDataRoot(c)
            DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY -> isExternalAppCacheDir(c)
            else -> false
        }
    } catch (e: PathException) {
        false
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/fs/SafeDeleter.kt`

```kotlin
// core/fs/SafeDeleter.kt
package com.cleanforge.core.fs

/**
 * The single implementation of deletion. Used by the app process AND by the Shizuku service.
 * Guarantees:
 * - symlinks are never followed; a symlink target/root is refused, a symlink child is unlinked as a link only;
 * - recursion is explicit-depth-bounded and entry-bounded;
 * - a different st_dev (mount point) below the root is never entered or deleted;
 * - the root's (dev, ino) must match what the scan saw, and each directory is re-checked
 *   immediately before its entries are removed;
 * - every entry (file, link, sub-folder, the root itself) is lstat'ed AGAIN immediately before remove() and is
 *   left alone, with a recorded problem, unless it is still the same object (type, device, inode) that was
 *   inspected a moment earlier;
 * - no shell, no command line, no path concatenation outside "<dir>/<plain name>".
 * Residual risk (documented in SECURITY.md): the re-check and remove() are still two separate path-based
 * calls, so an attacker with write access to the same directory who wins that microsecond race can swap an entry
 * in between. Android offers no unlinkat/openat from Kotlin. A swap can never make remove() follow a symlink:
 * the worst case is that the swapped-in entry itself (or the empty directory it replaced) is unlinked.
 */
class SafeDeleter(
    private val fs: FsOps,
    private val limits: WalkLimits = WalkLimits(maxDepth = 48, maxEntries = 200_000),
    /*
     Polled between entries. When it returns true the walk stops BEFORE touching the next entry and the result is
     [DeleteStatus.CANCELLED] (or [DeleteStatus.PARTIAL]-like counts in the result). Never interrupts a single
     remove() call, and never changes deletion order or identity checks.
     */
    private val isCancelled: () -> Boolean = { false },
    /**
     * The system-owned storage root. Only folders BELOW it are inspected as ancestors of the target; the system's own
     * directories above it are not ours to judge (see [ancestorsAreSafe]).
     */
    private val trustedRoot: String = PathRules.ROOT
) {
    fun delete(path: String, mode: DeleteMode, expected: FsStat?): DeleteResult {
        // 1. Initial check on the target itself
        val st = fs.lstat(path) ?: return DeleteResult(DeleteStatus.MISSING, detail = "Path does not exist")
        
        if (st.type == FsType.SYMLINK) {
            return DeleteResult(DeleteStatus.WRONG_TYPE, detail = "Refusing to act on a symbolic link")
        }
        
        if (expected != null && !st.sameObjectAs(expected)) {
            return DeleteResult(DeleteStatus.IDENTITY_CHANGED, detail = "Object changed since it was scanned")
        }

        // 2. Every folder between the storage root and the target must still be a real directory (not a link).
        // This closes the TOCTOU gap between FileServiceCore's check and this execution.
        if (!ancestorsAreSafe(path)) {
            return DeleteResult(DeleteStatus.REFUSED, detail = "One or more parent directories are unsafe (symlink/non-dir)")
        }

        return when (mode) {
            DeleteMode.FILE -> removeLeaf(path, st, FsType.FILE)
            DeleteMode.EMPTY_DIR -> removeLeaf(path, st, FsType.DIRECTORY)
            DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY -> removeDirectory(path, st, removeRoot = false)
            DeleteMode.TREE -> removeDirectory(path, st, removeRoot = true)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Every folder between [trustedRoot] and [path] must be a real directory, never a symlink or a file.
     *
     * Only the part BELOW [trustedRoot] is inspected. The directories above it belong to the system: on Android
     * "/storage" is a tmpfs, a different device than the shared-storage mount, so comparing device numbers up there
     * made every real deletion come back REFUSED. Device numbers of ancestors are deliberately not compared at all:
     * a mount point among the ancestors cannot redirect the deletion, and mounts INSIDE the tree are handled in
     * [purge]. A path that is not under [trustedRoot] (only tests; the validators confine production paths to
     * PathRules.ROOT) has all of its ancestors inspected.
     */
    private fun ancestorsAreSafe(path: String): Boolean {
        val parts = path.split('/').filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
        if (parts.size < 2) return true
        val rootParts = trustedRoot.split('/').filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
        val underRoot = parts.size > rootParts.size && parts.subList(0, rootParts.size) == rootParts
        val firstInspected = if (underRoot) rootParts.size else 0
        var current = ""
        for (i in 0 until parts.size - 1) { // the last part is the target itself, already inspected
            current += "/" + parts[i]
            if (i < firstInspected) continue
            val stat = fs.lstat(current) ?: return false // a missing parent is fatal
            if (stat.type != FsType.DIRECTORY) return false // lstat reports a link as SYMLINK, so links land here
        }
        return true
    }

    private fun removeLeaf(path: String, st: FsStat, expectedType: FsType): DeleteResult {
        if (st.type != expectedType) {
            return DeleteResult(DeleteStatus.WRONG_TYPE, detail = "Expected $expectedType but found ${st.type}")
        }
        // Narrow the check-to-remove window: the object must still be the one inspected a moment ago.
        val cur = fs.lstat(path) ?: return DeleteResult(DeleteStatus.MISSING, detail = "Vanished before removal")
        if (!cur.sameIdentityAs(st)) {
            return DeleteResult(DeleteStatus.IDENTITY_CHANGED, detail = "Object was replaced just before removal")
        }
        if (!fs.remove(path)) {
            return DeleteResult(
                DeleteStatus.FAILED,
                detail = if (expectedType == FsType.DIRECTORY) "Directory is not empty or not removable" else "Could not remove file"
            )
        }
        if (fs.lstat(path) != null) return DeleteResult(DeleteStatus.FAILED, detail = "Still present after removal")
        return DeleteResult(DeleteStatus.OK, 1, if (expectedType == FsType.FILE) st.size else 0L)
    }

    private class Ctx(val rootDev: Long) {
        var entries = 0
        var bytes = 0L
        var failed = 0
        var visited = 0
        var limit = false
        var cancelled = false
        var firstProblem = ""
    }

    private fun removeDirectory(root: String, rootStat: FsStat, removeRoot: Boolean): DeleteResult {
        if (rootStat.type != FsType.DIRECTORY) {
            return DeleteResult(DeleteStatus.WRONG_TYPE, detail = "Expected a directory but found ${rootStat.type}")
        }
        val ctx = Ctx(rootStat.dev)
        val clean = purge(root, rootStat, 0, ctx)
        if (clean && removeRoot) {
            removeIfUnchanged(root, rootStat, ctx, "Could not remove the folder itself")
        }
        val status = when {
            ctx.cancelled -> DeleteStatus.CANCELLED
            ctx.limit -> DeleteStatus.LIMIT_EXCEEDED
            ctx.failed == 0 -> DeleteStatus.OK
            ctx.entries > 0 -> DeleteStatus.PARTIAL
            else -> DeleteStatus.FAILED
        }
        return DeleteResult(status, ctx.entries, ctx.bytes, ctx.firstProblem)
    }

    private fun problem(ctx: Ctx, message: String) {
        ctx.failed++
        if (ctx.firstProblem.isEmpty()) ctx.firstProblem = message
    }

    /**
     * Removes [path] only if it is still the object [seen] described (same type, device and inode).
     * Returns true if the entry is gone afterwards (removed by us, or already vanished); false if it was replaced
     * or could not be removed, in which case a problem is recorded and the entry is left untouched.
     */
    private fun removeIfUnchanged(path: String, seen: FsStat, ctx: Ctx, failure: String): Boolean {
        val cur = fs.lstat(path) ?: return true // vanished meanwhile: nothing left to do
        if (!cur.sameIdentityAs(seen)) {
            problem(ctx, "An entry was replaced while cleaning; it was left untouched")
            return false
        }
        if (!fs.remove(path)) {
            problem(ctx, failure)
            return false
        }
        ctx.entries++
        if (seen.type == FsType.FILE) ctx.bytes += seen.size
        return true
    }

    private fun FsStat.sameIdentityAs(other: FsStat): Boolean =
        type == other.type && dev == other.dev && ino == other.ino

    /** Empties [dir]. Returns true only if every entry was removed. */
    private fun purge(dir: String, dirStat: FsStat, depth: Int, ctx: Ctx): Boolean {
        if (depth >= limits.maxDepth) {
            ctx.limit = true
            ctx.firstProblem = "Folder nesting is deeper than ${limits.maxDepth}"
            return false
        }
        val names = fs.list(dir)
        if (names == null) {
            problem(ctx, "Cannot list a folder")
            return false
        }
        // Re-verify identity right before mutating this directory (narrows the swap window).
        val again = fs.lstat(dir)
        if (again == null || again.type != FsType.DIRECTORY || again.dev != dirStat.dev || again.ino != dirStat.ino) {
            problem(ctx, "A folder was replaced while cleaning")
            return false
        }

        var clean = true
        for (name in names) {
            if (isCancelled()) {
                ctx.cancelled = true
                if (ctx.firstProblem.isEmpty()) ctx.firstProblem = "Stopped before finishing"
                return false
            }
            if (!StorageWalker.isPlainName(name)) {
                problem(ctx, "Skipped an entry with an unsafe name")
                clean = false
                continue
            }
            ctx.visited++
            if (ctx.visited > limits.maxEntries) {
                ctx.limit = true
                ctx.firstProblem = "More than ${limits.maxEntries} entries"
                return false
            }
            val child = "$dir/$name"
            val cs = fs.lstat(child) ?: continue // vanished: fine
            if (cs.dev != ctx.rootDev) {
                problem(ctx, "Skipped a different filesystem (mount point)")
                clean = false
                continue
            }
            when (cs.type) {
                FsType.DIRECTORY -> {
                    if (!purge(child, cs, depth + 1, ctx) ||
                        !removeIfUnchanged(child, cs, ctx, "Could not remove a sub-folder")
                    ) {
                        clean = false
                    }
                }
                else -> {
                    // FILE, SYMLINK (the link itself, never its target) or OTHER (socket, fifo...).
                    if (!removeIfUnchanged(child, cs, ctx, "Could not remove an entry")) clean = false
                }
            }
            if (ctx.limit || ctx.cancelled) return false
        }
        return clean
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/fs/StorageWalker.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.fs

/**
 * Bounded, non-recursive (explicit stack) directory walker.
 *  - never follows symlinks (uses lstat);
 *  - never crosses a mount point (st_dev must equal the root's);
 *  - stops at maxDepth / maxEntries instead of running away.
 */
class StorageWalker(private val fs: FsOps) {

    data class Entry(val path: String, val name: String, val stat: FsStat, val depth: Int)

    fun walk(
        root: String,
        limits: WalkLimits = WalkLimits(),
        skipDir: (String) -> Boolean = { false },
        onTruncated: () -> Unit = {},
        /** Called once per entry that exists but could not be examined or listed, or that is a mount point (its contents are NOT part of the walk). */
        onUnreadable: () -> Unit = {}
    ): Sequence<Entry> = sequence {
        val rootStat = fs.lstat(root)
        if (rootStat == null || rootStat.type != FsType.DIRECTORY) return@sequence

        val stack = ArrayDeque<Pair<String, Int>>()
        stack.addLast(root to 0)
        var count = 0

        while (stack.isNotEmpty()) {
            val (dir, depth) = stack.removeLast()
            val names = fs.list(dir)
            if (names == null) {
                onUnreadable()
                continue
            }
            for (name in names) {
                if (!isPlainName(name)) continue
                count++
                if (count > limits.maxEntries) {
                    onTruncated()
                    return@sequence
                }
                val path = "$dir/$name"
                val st = when (val probe = fs.probe(path)) {
                    is FsProbe.Found -> probe.stat
                    FsProbe.Missing -> continue // vanished between list and stat: nothing to count
                    FsProbe.Denied, FsProbe.Error -> {
                        onUnreadable() // it exists but cannot be examined: its bytes are unknown, never "zero"
                        continue
                    }
                }
                if (st.dev != rootStat.dev) { // mount boundary: not entered, so whatever is below it is not counted
                    onUnreadable()
                    continue
                }
                yield(Entry(path, name, st, depth + 1))
                if (st.type == FsType.DIRECTORY && !skipDir(path)) {
                    if (depth + 1 < limits.maxDepth) {
                        stack.addLast(path to depth + 1)
                    } else {
                        onTruncated()
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Sum of regular-file sizes below [root]. Null if [root] is not a readable directory/file.
     * Unreadable sub-directories are counted in [SizeResult.unreadable] instead of being skipped silently.
     */
    fun sizeOf(root: String, limits: WalkLimits = WalkLimits()): SizeResult? {
        val st = fs.lstat(root) ?: return null
        if (st.type == FsType.FILE) return SizeResult(st.size, true)
        if (st.type != FsType.DIRECTORY) return null
        var total = 0L
        var complete = true
        var unreadable = 0
        for (e in walk(root, limits, onTruncated = { complete = false }, onUnreadable = { unreadable++ })) {
            if (e.stat.type == FsType.FILE) total += e.stat.size
        }
        return SizeResult(total, complete, unreadable)
    }

    companion object {
        /** A directory-entry name that cannot escape its parent. */
        fun isPlainName(name: String): Boolean =
            name.isNotEmpty() && name != "." && name != ".." && name.none { it == '/' || it == '\u0000' }
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/history/GrowthAnalyzer.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.history

import com.cleanforge.core.inventory.TypeClassifier

data class GrowthRow(
    val path: String,
    val name: String,
    val previousBytes: Long,
    val currentBytes: Long,
    val deltaBytes: Long,
    val percentChange: Float?
)

data class GrowthReport(
    val from: Snapshot,
    val to: Snapshot,
    val categories: List<GrowthRow>,
    val directories: List<GrowthRow>,
    val lowerBound: Boolean
)

object GrowthAnalyzer {
    fun compare(from: Snapshot, to: Snapshot, topDirs: Int = 50): GrowthReport {
        val fromDirs = from.dirs.associateBy { it.path }
        val toDirs = to.dirs.associateBy { it.path }
        val dirRows = (fromDirs.keys + toDirs.keys).map { path ->
            val p = fromDirs[path]
            val c = toDirs[path]
            val ref = c ?: p!!
            val prev = p?.bytes ?: 0L
            val cur = c?.bytes ?: 0L
            GrowthRow(path, ref.name, prev, cur, cur - prev,
                if (prev > 0) (cur - prev).toFloat() / prev else null)
        }.sortedByDescending { it.deltaBytes }.take(topDirs)

        val fromCats = from.categoryBytes
        val toCats = to.categoryBytes
        val catRows = (fromCats.keys + toCats.keys).map { k ->
            val prev = fromCats[k] ?: 0L
            val cur = toCats[k] ?: 0L
            GrowthRow(k, TypeClassifier.label(k), prev, cur, cur - prev,
                if (prev > 0) (cur - prev).toFloat() / prev else null)
        }.sortedByDescending { it.deltaBytes }

        return GrowthReport(from, to, catRows, dirRows, from.incomplete || to.incomplete)
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/history/SnapshotCodec.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.history

object SnapshotCodec {
    private const val MAGIC = "CleanForge-snapshot v1"

    fun encode(s: Snapshot): String = buildString {
        append(MAGIC).append('\n')
        append("meta\ttimestamp\t").append(s.timestamp).append('\n')
        append("meta\trootPath\t").append(sanitize(s.rootPath)).append('\n')
        append("meta\ttotalBytes\t").append(s.totalBytes).append('\n')
        append("meta\tfreeBytes\t").append(s.freeBytes).append('\n')
        append("meta\tincomplete\t").append(if (s.incomplete) "1" else "0").append('\n')
        s.categoryBytes.forEach { (k, v) -> append("cat\t").append(sanitize(k)).append('\t').append(v).append('\n') }
        s.dirs.forEach { d ->
            append("dir\t").append(sanitize(d.path)).append('\t')
                .append(sanitize(d.parentPath)).append('\t')
                .append(sanitize(d.name)).append('\t')
                .append(d.depth).append('\t')
                .append(d.bytes).append('\t')
                .append(d.fileCount).append('\n')
        }
    }

    fun decode(text: String): Snapshot? {
        val lines = text.lineSequence().toList()
        if (lines.isEmpty() || lines[0] != MAGIC) return null
        var ts = 0L; var root = ""; var total = 0L; var free = 0L; var incomplete = false
        val cats = LinkedHashMap<String, Long>()
        val dirs = ArrayList<SnapshotEntry>()
        for (line in lines.drop(1)) {
            if (line.isEmpty()) continue
            val p = line.split('\t')
            when (p.getOrNull(0)) {
                "meta" -> {
                    val k = p.getOrNull(1) ?: return null
                    val v = p.getOrNull(2) ?: return null
                    when (k) {
                        "timestamp" -> ts = v.toLongOrNull() ?: return null
                        "rootPath" -> root = v
                        "totalBytes" -> total = v.toLongOrNull() ?: return null
                        "freeBytes" -> free = v.toLongOrNull() ?: return null
                        "incomplete" -> incomplete = v == "1"
                        else -> return null
                    }
                }
                "cat" -> {
                    val k = p.getOrNull(1) ?: return null
                    val v = p.getOrNull(2)?.toLongOrNull() ?: return null
                    cats[k] = v
                }
                "dir" -> {
                    if (p.size < 7) return null
                    val depth = p[4].toIntOrNull() ?: return null
                    val bytes = p[5].toLongOrNull() ?: return null
                    val count = p[6].toIntOrNull() ?: return null
                    dirs += SnapshotEntry(p[1], p[2], p[3], depth, bytes, count)
                }
                else -> return null
            }
        }
        return Snapshot(ts, root, total, free, dirs, cats, incomplete)
    }

    private fun sanitize(s: String): String =
        s.replace('\t', ' ').replace('\n', ' ').replace('\r', ' ')
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/history/SnapshotStore.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.history

import java.io.File

interface SnapshotStore {
    fun loadAll(): List<Snapshot>
    fun save(snapshot: Snapshot)
    fun prune(maxCount: Int = 20, maxAgeMs: Long = 90L * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
}

class FileSnapshotStore(
    private val dir: File,
    private val maxFileBytes: Long = 2L * 1024 * 1024
) : SnapshotStore {
    override fun loadAll(): List<Snapshot> {
        if (!dir.isDirectory) return emptyList()
        return dir.listFiles { f -> f.isFile && f.name.endsWith(".snapshot") }
            ?.sortedBy { it.name }
            ?.mapNotNull { f -> runCatching { SnapshotCodec.decode(f.readText()) }.getOrNull() }
            ?: emptyList()
    }

    override fun save(snapshot: Snapshot) {
        dir.mkdirs()
        val text = SnapshotCodec.encode(snapshot)
        if (text.length > maxFileBytes) return
        runCatching { File(dir, "${snapshot.timestamp}.snapshot").writeText(text) }
    }

    override fun prune(maxCount: Int, maxAgeMs: Long) {
        val files = dir.listFiles { f -> f.isFile && f.name.endsWith(".snapshot") }?.sortedBy { it.name } ?: return
        val cutoff = System.currentTimeMillis() - maxAgeMs
        val keep = files.takeLast(maxCount.coerceAtLeast(1)).toHashSet()
        for (f in files) {
            val ts = f.name.removeSuffix(".snapshot").toLongOrNull() ?: Long.MAX_VALUE
            if (f !in keep || ts < cutoff) runCatching { f.delete() }
        }
    }
}

class InMemorySnapshotStore(private var snapshots: List<Snapshot> = emptyList()) : SnapshotStore {
    override fun loadAll(): List<Snapshot> = snapshots.sortedBy { it.timestamp }
    override fun save(snapshot: Snapshot) {
        snapshots = snapshots.filter { it.timestamp != snapshot.timestamp } + snapshot
    }
    override fun prune(maxCount: Int, maxAgeMs: Long) {
        val cutoff = System.currentTimeMillis() - maxAgeMs
        snapshots = snapshots.filter { it.timestamp >= cutoff }.takeLast(maxCount.coerceAtLeast(1))
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.inventory

data class CategoryTotal(
    val key: String,
    val label: String,
    val bytes: Long,
    val fileCount: Int,
    val complete: Boolean
)

data class FileEntry(
    val path: String,
    val name: String,
    val bytes: Long,
    val mtime: Long,
    val category: String
)

data class StorageIndex(
    val timestamp: Long,
    val rootPath: String,
    val totalBytes: Long,
    val freeBytes: Long,
    val directories: List<DirNode>,
    val largestFiles: List<FileEntry>,
    val categoryTotals: List<CategoryTotal>,
    val incomplete: Boolean
) {
    fun childrenOf(parentPath: String): List<DirNode> =
        directories.filter { it.parentPath == parentPath }.sortedByDescending { it.bytes }

    fun byPath(path: String): DirNode? = directories.firstOrNull { it.path == path }

    companion object {
        val EMPTY = StorageIndex(0L, "", 0L, 0L, emptyList(), emptyList(), emptyList(), true)
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/inventory/StorageIndexer.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.inventory

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsOps
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsProbe
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsType
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.StorageWalker
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.WalkLimits
import kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.ensureActive
import java.util.PriorityQueue

class StorageIndexer(
    private val fs: FsOps,
    private val maxDepth: Int = 3,
    private val maxDirs: Int = 20_000,
    private val topFiles: Int = 100,
    private val limits: WalkLimits = WalkLimits(maxDepth = 32, maxEntries = 200_000)
) {
    private class Agg(
        val path: String,
        val parentPath: String,
        val name: String,
        val depth: Int,
        var newestMtime: Long
    ) {
        var bytes: Long = 0L
        var fileCount: Int = 0
    }

    suspend fun index(
        rootPath: String,
        roots: List<String>,
        totalBytes: Long,
        freeBytes: Long,
        now: () -> Long = { System.currentTimeMillis() }
    ): StorageIndex {
        val rootLevel = rootPath.count { it == '/' }
        val aggs = HashMap<String, Agg>()
        val categoryBytes = HashMap<String, LongArray>()
        val heap = PriorityQueue<FileEntry>(compareBy { it.bytes })
        var truncated = false
        var dirsCapped = false
        var scanned = 0L

        for (rel in roots) {
            currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
            val dir = if (rel.startsWith("/")) rel else "$rootPath/$rel"
            when (val p = fs.probe(dir)) {
                is FsProbe.Found ->
                    if (p.stat.type == FsType.DIRECTORY) {
                        ensureDir(aggs, rootPath, dir, p.stat.mtimeMs, maxDirs) { dirsCapped = true }
                    }
                else -> Unit
            }
            for (e in StorageWalker(fs).walk(
                dir,
                limits,
                onTruncated = { truncated = true },
                onUnreadable = { truncated = true }
            )) {
                if (++scanned % 256L == 0L) currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
                if (e.stat.type != FsType.FILE) {
                    if (e.path.count { it == '/' } - rootLevel <= maxDepth) {
                        ensureDir(aggs, rootPath, e.path, e.stat.mtimeMs, maxDirs) { dirsCapped = true }
                    } else {
                        truncated = true
                    }
                    continue
                }
                var parent = e.path.substringBeforeLast('/')
                var parentDepth = e.path.count { it == '/' } - rootLevel - 1
                while (parentDepth >= 1) {
                    if (parentDepth <= maxDepth) {
                        ensureDir(aggs, rootPath, parent, e.stat.mtimeMs, maxDirs) { dirsCapped = true }?.let { a ->
                            a.bytes += e.stat.size
                            a.fileCount += 1
                            if (e.stat.mtimeMs > a.newestMtime) a.newestMtime = e.stat.mtimeMs
                        }
                    } else {
                        truncated = true
                    }
                    parent = parent.substringBeforeLast('/')
                    parentDepth--
                }
                val cat = TypeClassifier.classify(e.name)
                val arr = categoryBytes.getOrPut(cat) { LongArray(2) }
                arr[0] += e.stat.size
                arr[1] += 1
                heap.add(FileEntry(e.path, e.name, e.stat.size, e.stat.mtimeMs, cat))
                if (heap.size > topFiles) heap.poll()
            }
        }

        val dirs = aggs.values.map { a ->
            DirNode(
                path = a.path,
                parentPath = a.parentPath,
                name = a.name,
                depth = a.depth,
                bytes = a.bytes,
                fileCount = a.fileCount,
                newestMtime = a.newestMtime,
                complete = !truncated,
                unreadable = 0
            )
        }.sortedWith(compareBy({ it.depth }, { it.path }))

        val cats = categoryBytes.map { (k, v) ->
            CategoryTotal(k, TypeClassifier.label(k), v[0], v[1].toInt(), complete = !truncated)
        }.sortedByDescending { it.bytes }

        return StorageIndex(
            timestamp = now(),
            rootPath = rootPath,
            totalBytes = totalBytes,
            freeBytes = freeBytes,
            directories = dirs,
            largestFiles = heap.sortedByDescending { it.bytes },
            categoryTotals = cats,
            incomplete = truncated || dirsCapped
        )
    }

    private fun ensureDir(
        aggs: HashMap<String, Agg>,
        rootPath: String,
        path: String,
        mtime: Long,
        maxDirs: Int,
        onCap: () -> Unit
    ): Agg? {
        aggs[path]?.let { return it }
        if (aggs.size >= maxDirs) { onCap(); return null }
        val name = path.substringAfterLast('/')
        val parent = path.substringBeforeLast('/', "")
        val depth = path.count { it == '/' } - rootPath.count { it == '/' }
        val a = Agg(path, parent, name, depth, mtime)
        aggs[path] = a
        return a
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/inventory/TypeClassifier.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.inventory

object TypeClassifier {
    private val IMAGE = setOf("jpg","jpeg","png","gif","webp","bmp","heic","heif","avif","dng","raw","svg")
    private val VIDEO = setOf("mp4","mkv","webm","mov","avi","flv","m4v","3gp","ts","mts","wmv")
    private val AUDIO = setOf("mp3","m4a","aac","flac","wav","ogg","opus","wma","amr","mid","midi")
    private val DOCUMENT = setOf("pdf","doc","docx","xls","xlsx","ppt","pptx","txt","md","rtf","odt","ods","epub","csv")
    private val APK = setOf("apk","apks","xapk")
    private val ARCHIVE = setOf("zip","rar","7z","tar","gz","bz2","xz","iso","img")

    fun classify(fileName: String): String {
        val ext = fileName.substringAfterLast('.', "").lowercase()
        return when (ext) {
            in IMAGE -> "image"
            in VIDEO -> "video"
            in AUDIO -> "audio"
            in DOCUMENT -> "document"
            in APK -> "apk"
            in ARCHIVE -> "archive"
            else -> "other"
        }
    }

    fun label(key: String): String = when (key) {
        "image" -> "Images"
        "video" -> "Videos"
        "audio" -> "Audio"
        "document" -> "Documents"
        "apk" -> "Installers"
        "archive" -> "Archives"
        else -> "Other files"
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/memory/BackgroundProcessKiller.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.memory

import android.app.ActivityManager
import android.content.Context
import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo
import android.content.pm.PackageManager

/**
 * The one place that asks Android to stop background processes.
 * A seam so the use case is testable without the framework.
 */
fun interface BackgroundProcessKiller {

    /**
     * Asks Android to stop the BACKGROUND processes of [packageName].
     * This is the same kind of trim Android does under memory pressure; it is not a force-stop.
     *
     * Returns true if a request was sent.
     * Returns false if the package was deliberately skipped or the OS refused the request.
     */
    fun kill(packageName: String): Boolean
}

/**
 * Skips CleanForge itself and every system app.
 * Stopping system components usually only makes Android reload them.
 * If the app type cannot be determined, it is skipped fail-closed.
 */
class AndroidBackgroundProcessKiller(context: Context) : BackgroundProcessKiller {

    private val appContext = context.applicationContext
    private val activityManager: ActivityManager? =
        appContext.getSystemService(ActivityManager::class.java)
    private val packageManager: PackageManager = appContext.packageManager

    override fun kill(packageName: String): Boolean {
        val am = activityManager ?: return false

        if (packageName == appContext.packageName) return false
        if (isSystemOrUnknown(packageName)) return false

        return try {
            am.killBackgroundProcesses(packageName)
            true
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            false
        }
    }

    private fun isSystemOrUnknown(packageName: String): Boolean = try {
        val flags = packageManager.getApplicationInfo(packageName, 0).flags
        (flags and ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM) != 0
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        true
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/memory/MemInfoParser.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.memory

/**
 * Pure parser for /proc/meminfo. No I/O here so it is trivially testable.
 *
 * Format reminder:
 *   MemTotal:        3925568 kB
 *   MemAvailable:    1456784 kB
 *   ...
 * Values are in kB. HugePages_* are counts (no kB) and are ignored.
 */
object MemInfoParser {

    private const val PROC_MEMINFO = "/proc/meminfo"

    fun parse(content: String, timestamp: Long): RamSnapshot? {
        val bytes = mutableMapOf<String, Long>()

        for (line in content.lineSequence()) {
            val colon = line.indexOf(':')
            if (colon <= 0) continue

            val key = line.substring(0, colon).trim()
            var value = line.substring(colon + 1).trim()

            // Strip the trailing "kB" if present.
            val multiplier = if (value.endsWith("kB")) {
                value = value.removeSuffix("kB").trim()
                1024L
            } else {
                1L
            }

            val number = value.toLongOrNull() ?: continue
            bytes[key] = number * multiplier
        }

        val total = bytes["MemTotal"] ?: return null
        if (total <= 0L) return null // a zero-byte "snapshot" would read as real data; unknown is not zero

        val free = bytes["MemFree"] ?: 0L
        val buffers = bytes["Buffers"] ?: 0L
        val cached = bytes["Cached"] ?: 0L

        // MemAvailable exists on every kernel Android 11 ships with, but fall back
        // to a conservative estimate if a device omits it.
        val available = bytes["MemAvailable"] ?: (free + buffers + cached)

        return RamSnapshot(
            totalBytes = total,
            availableBytes = available.coerceAtMost(total),
            freeBytes = free,
            buffersBytes = buffers,
            cachedBytes = cached,
            swapTotalBytes = bytes["SwapTotal"] ?: 0L,
            swapFreeBytes = bytes["SwapFree"] ?: 0L,
            timestamp = timestamp
        )
    }

    val path: String get() = PROC_MEMINFO
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/memory/MemInfoProvider.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.memory

import java.io.File

/** Abstraction so tests can inject fake content and the UI can fake pressure states. */
interface MemoryInfoProvider {
    /** Null if memory info could not be read. Callers must treat this as "unknown", never zero. */
    fun snapshot(): RamSnapshot?
}

/**
 * Reads /proc/meminfo directly. No permission required; the file is world-readable.
 * Deliberately NOT routed through FsOps (that surface is scoped to shared storage).
 */
class ProcMemInfoProvider(
    private val reader: () -> String? = DEFAULT_READER,
    private val timeProvider: () -> Long = { System.currentTimeMillis() }
) : MemoryInfoProvider {

    override fun snapshot(): RamSnapshot? {
        val content = reader() ?: return null
        return MemInfoParser.parse(content, timeProvider())
    }

    companion object {
        private val DEFAULT_READER: () -> String? = {
            try {
                File(MemInfoParser.path).readText()
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                null
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/memory/RamSnapshot.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.memory

/** Coarse signal for the UI. Based on AVAILABLE memory, not "used", because Android caches intentionally. */
enum class MemoryPressure { LOW, NORMAL, HIGH, CRITICAL }

/**
 * One honest reading of system memory. Source of truth is /proc/meminfo.
 * Nothing here claims that "high usage" is bad by itself.
 */
data class RamSnapshot(
    val totalBytes: Long,
    val availableBytes: Long,
    val freeBytes: Long,
    val buffersBytes: Long,
    val cachedBytes: Long,
    val swapTotalBytes: Long,
    val swapFreeBytes: Long,
    val timestamp: Long
) {
    /** Memory the system cannot hand out right now. */
    val usedBytes: Long get() = (totalBytes - availableBytes).coerceAtLeast(0L)

    val usedFraction: Float get() = if (totalBytes > 0) usedBytes.toFloat() / totalBytes else 0f
    val availableFraction: Float get() = if (totalBytes > 0) availableBytes.toFloat() / totalBytes else 0f

    val pressure: MemoryPressure
        get() = when {
            availableFraction <= 0.05f -> MemoryPressure.CRITICAL
            availableFraction <= 0.12f -> MemoryPressure.HIGH
            availableFraction <= 0.30f -> MemoryPressure.NORMAL
            else -> MemoryPressure.LOW
        }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.model

data class RejectedItem(val item: ScanItem, val reason: String)

data class CleaningPlan(
    val items: List<ScanItem>,
    val rejected: List<RejectedItem>,
    val permissionNotes: Map<String, PermissionNote> = emptyMap(),
    val hasBlockingPermissions: Boolean = false
) {
    val totalBytes: Long get() = items.sumOf { it.sizeBytes }
    val needsShizuku: Boolean get() = items.any { it.requiresShizuku }
    val hasNonSafeItems: Boolean get() = items.any { it.risk != RiskLevel.SAFE }
    val hasLowerBoundSizes: Boolean get() = items.any { it.sizeQuality == SizeQuality.LOWER_BOUND }
    val isEmpty: Boolean get() = items.isEmpty()
    val allItemsBlocked: Boolean
        get() = items.isNotEmpty() && items.all { permissionNotes[it.path]?.blocking == true }
}

class ConfirmedPlan internal constructor(val plan: CleaningPlan)

fun CleaningPlan.confirmedByUser(): ConfirmedPlan = ConfirmedPlan(this)

enum class ItemStatus { DELETED, PARTIAL, UNVERIFIED, SKIPPED, FAILED }

data class ItemOutcome(
    val item: ScanItem,
    val status: ItemStatus,
    val message: String,
    val bytesFreed: Long = 0L
)

data class CleaningReport(val outcomes: List<ItemOutcome>) {
    val attempted: Int get() = outcomes.size
    val deleted: Int get() = outcomes.count { it.status == ItemStatus.DELETED }
    val skipped: Int get() = outcomes.count { it.status == ItemStatus.SKIPPED }
    val failed: Int get() = outcomes.count { it.status == ItemStatus.FAILED }
    val partial: Int get() = outcomes.count { it.status == ItemStatus.PARTIAL }
    val unverified: Int get() = outcomes.count { it.status == ItemStatus.UNVERIFIED }
    val bytesFreed: Long get() = outcomes.sumOf { it.bytesFreed }
    val unconfirmedBytes: Long get() = outcomes.filter { it.status == ItemStatus.UNVERIFIED }.sumOf { it.bytesFreed }
    val fullySuccessful: Boolean get() = outcomes.all { it.status == ItemStatus.DELETED }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.model

/** How sure the scanner is that the item is safe to delete, based on the evidence it gathered. */
enum class ConfidenceLevel { HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, UNKNOWN }

enum class RiskLevel {
    SAFE,       // re-created automatically (app caches, thumbnails)
    ELEVATED,   // could lose something the user may want (leftover app data, installers, logs)
    DANGEROUS   // possibly irreplaceable user data (large files, duplicates in personal folders)
}

enum class CleaningCategory(val label: String, val isQuick: Boolean) {
    APP_CACHE("App caches", true),
    THUMBNAIL("Thumbnail cache", true),
    TEMP_FILE("Incomplete downloads", true),
    APK_FILE("APK installers", true),
    CORPSE_LEFTOVER("Leftovers of uninstalled apps", true),
    LARGE_FILE("Large files", false),
    DUPLICATE("Duplicate files", false),
    LOG_FILE("Old log files", false),
    EMPTY_DIRECTORY("Empty folders", false),
    FORENSIC_MEDIA("App-specific media & caches", false)
}

enum class Reversibility {
    TRIVIALLY_RECREATABLE,  // caches
    RE_DOWNLOADABLE,        // installers, partial downloads
    NOT_REVERSIBLE          // deleted for good: CleanForge has no recycle bin
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/model/ScanItem.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.model

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsStat

/** Apps whose data is personal by nature: their items are never pre-selected. */
object ProtectedApps {
    val MESSAGING: Set<String> = setOf(
        "com.whatsapp", "com.whatsapp.w4b", "org.telegram.messenger", "org.telegram.messenger.web",
        "org.telegram.plus", "org.thoughtcrime.securesms", "com.facebook.orca", "com.instagram.android",
        "com.snapchat.android", "com.viber.voip", "com.google.android.apps.messaging"
    )
}

/** How much to trust [ScanItem.sizeBytes]. A size is never an estimate: it is measured, or a measured lower bound. */
enum class SizeQuality {
    /** Complete walk, nothing unreadable. Logical bytes (sum of file sizes), not disk blocks. */
    MEASURED,

    /** At least this much: the walk hit a safety bound or some sub-folders could not be read. */
    LOWER_BOUND
}

/**
 * Result of CLASSIFY. A ScanItem is a *proposal with evidence*, never a deletion command:
 * it only becomes a deletion after VALIDATE -> PLAN -> USER CONFIRMATION -> REVALIDATE.
 */
data class ScanItem(
    val path: String,
    val sizeBytes: Long,
    val category: CleaningCategory,
    /** Evidence-based explanation shown to the user: WHY this is considered removable. */
    val reasonForFlagging: String,
    val confidence: ConfidenceLevel,
    val risk: RiskLevel,
    val owningPackage: String? = null,
    val requiresShizuku: Boolean = false,
    val deleteMode: DeleteMode = DeleteMode.FILE,
    val reversibility: Reversibility = Reversibility.NOT_REVERSIBLE,
    val lastModified: Long = 0L,
    /** Group identifier (duplicate sets). */
    val groupId: String? = null,
    /** lstat snapshot taken during the scan; compared again immediately before deletion. */
    val fingerprint: FsStat? = null,
    /** For duplicates: the copy that stays. It must still exist, unchanged, at deletion time. */
    val keepPath: String? = null,
    val keepFingerprint: FsStat? = null,
    val sizeQuality: SizeQuality = SizeQuality.MEASURED,
    /** Directories inside the item that could not be listed while measuring (their bytes are not in [sizeBytes]). */
    val unreadableCount: Int = 0
) {
    val displayName: String get() = path.substringAfterLast('/')

    /**
     * Pre-ticked in the review list. Deliberately narrow: only well-evidenced app caches
     * that are not messaging apps. Everything else must be ticked by the user.
     */
    val isPreselected: Boolean
        get() = category == CleaningCategory.APP_CACHE &&
            confidence == ConfidenceLevel.HIGH &&
            risk == RiskLevel.SAFE &&
            owningPackage !in ProtectedApps.MESSAGING
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/privileged/BlockingCall.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.privileged

import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.TimeoutCancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.async
import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeout

/** A blocking call did not finish before its deadline. The call itself may still be running somewhere. */
class DeadlineExceeded(val timeoutMs: Long) : Exception("No answer within ${timeoutMs} ms")

/**
 * Runs the BLOCKING [block] on [this] scope's dispatcher and waits for it with a deadline.
 *
 * Blocking binder calls cannot be interrupted, and `withContext` would not return until they do. So the work runs in a
 * separate `async` on a long-lived scope and only the waiting is cancellable: when the deadline passes, or the caller
 * is cancelled, the caller is released immediately. The worker thread stays occupied until the call returns on its own
 * or the service process is stopped, which is what the callers do after a [DeadlineExceeded].
 *
 * Exceptions thrown by [block] (for example [TransportException]) are rethrown unchanged.
 */
suspend fun <T> CoroutineScope.runWithDeadline(timeoutMs: Long, block: () -> T): T {
    val job = async { block() }
    try {
        return withTimeout(timeoutMs) { job.await() }
    } catch (e: TimeoutCancellationException) {
        job.cancel()
        throw DeadlineExceeded(timeoutMs)
    } catch (e: CancellationException) {
        job.cancel()
        throw e
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/privileged/CapabilityModel.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.privileged

import com.cleanforge.core.shizuku.ShizukuState

/**
 * How far we can vouch for an operation RIGHT NOW. A live Shizuku binder is only one prerequisite; it never proves
 * that a particular operation works on this device.
 */
enum class CapabilityStatus {
    /** Demonstrated in this session by a probe or by a real operation result. */
    VERIFIED,

    /**
     * Every prerequisite that can be checked without side effects is met (Shizuku running and authorized, service
     * bound, Android/data readable), but the operation itself has not been demonstrated yet. For deletions this is
     * the best a read-only probe can say: we never delete anything just to test.
     */
    PREREQUISITES_MET,

    /** The user must act (allow CleanForge inside Shizuku). */
    NEEDS_AUTHORIZATION,

    /** Not usable right now, but may be later (Shizuku missing or stopped, service not bindable, probe failed). */
    UNAVAILABLE,

    /** This device or Shizuku version cannot do it, as probed (too-old Shizuku, OS refuses the shell). */
    UNSUPPORTED,

    /** Not checked yet. */
    UNKNOWN
}

data class OperationCapability(
    val operation: PrivilegedOperation,
    val status: CapabilityStatus,
    /** Plain-language, actionable explanation. Always set. */
    val reason: String,
    /** Honest limits of the operation even when it works. */
    val limitations: List<String> = emptyList(),
    /** Epoch millis of the probe or operation that produced [status]; null when derived without a probe. */
    val checkedAtMs: Long? = null
) {
    /** True if the operation may be attempted. It does not promise success. */
    val canAttempt: Boolean
        get() = status == CapabilityStatus.VERIFIED || status == CapabilityStatus.PREREQUISITES_MET
}

data class CapabilityReport(
    val shizuku: ShizukuState,
    /** uid the user service reported (2000 = shell, 0 = root). Null if no probe bound the service. */
    val serviceUid: Int?,
    val serviceApiVersion: Int?,
    val operations: Map<PrivilegedOperation, OperationCapability>,
    /** When the last probe finished. Null: never probed. */
    val probedAtMs: Long?
) {
    fun of(op: PrivilegedOperation): OperationCapability = operations[op] ?: OperationCapability(
        op, CapabilityStatus.UNKNOWN, "Not checked yet"
    )

    companion object {
        fun unknown(shizuku: ShizukuState): CapabilityReport = CapabilityReport(
            shizuku = shizuku,
            serviceUid = null,
            serviceApiVersion = null,
            operations = PrivilegedOperation.entries.associateWith {
                OperationCapability(it, CapabilityStatus.UNKNOWN, "Not checked yet", Limitations.of(it))
            },
            probedAtMs = null
        )
    }
}

/** Static, honest limits per operation. Shown in the UI and in docs/SHIZUKU_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md. */
object Limitations {
    private val READ = listOf(
        "Sizes are logical bytes (sum of file sizes), not disk blocks.",
        "The walk stops at 200,000 entries or 32 levels; unreadable sub-folders are skipped. Either makes the size a lower bound."
    )

    fun of(op: PrivilegedOperation): List<String> = when (op) {
        PrivilegedOperation.LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA -> listOf(
            "Only folder names in Android/data and Android/obb of the primary user; other users and work profiles are not covered.",
            "Very long listings are cut off and reported as incomplete."
        )
        PrivilegedOperation.MEASURE_EXTERNAL_APP_DIR -> READ
        PrivilegedOperation.CLEAR_EXTERNAL_APP_CACHE -> listOf(
            "External cache only (Android/data/<package>/cache). An app's internal cache under /data/data is out of reach.",
            "A running app may recreate files right away.",
            "Not proven until a deletion has succeeded in this session."
        )
        PrivilegedOperation.REMOVE_UNINSTALLED_APP_DATA -> listOf(
            "Only Android/data/<package> and Android/obb/<package>; never an app's internal data.",
            "Cannot be undone. May contain saves the user still wants.",
            "Not proven until a deletion has succeeded in this session."
        )
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/privileged/CapabilityRegistry.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.privileged

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.PathRules
import com.cleanforge.core.shizuku.ShizukuState
import com.cleanforge.core.shizuku.ShizukuStateSource
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineDispatcher
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.update
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

/**
 * Tracks, per operation, whether it is supported, what it needs, whether the user has authorized it, whether it is
 * available right now, and what its limits are. A connected binder proves none of that for a particular operation,
 * so the registry only says VERIFIED for something a probe or a real result demonstrated.
 *
 * [probe] is READ-ONLY: it binds the service, asks for uid/apiVersion and lists Android/data and Android/obb. It never
 * deletes anything to test deletion, so deletions top out at PREREQUISITES_MET until one succeeds.
 */
class CapabilityRegistry(
    private val shizuku: ShizukuStateSource,
    private val provider: PrivilegedSessionProvider,
    private val clock: () -> Long = { System.currentTimeMillis() },
    /** A probe younger than this is reused unless forced or the Shizuku state changed. */
    private val minProbeIntervalMs: Long = 3_000L,
    /** Bound for the blocking calls a probe makes, so a hung service cannot hang a scan. */
    private val probeCallTimeoutMs: Long = 15_000L,
    /** Worker scope for the blocking probe calls. */
    private val scope: CoroutineScope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO),
    /** A probe makes binder calls, so it never runs on the caller's (possibly main) thread. */
    private val dispatcher: CoroutineDispatcher = Dispatchers.IO
) {
    private val probeMutex = Mutex()
    private val _report = MutableStateFlow(CapabilityReport.unknown(shizuku.state.value))
    val report: StateFlow<CapabilityReport> = _report.asStateFlow()

    /**
     * Cheap and I/O-free; safe to call from anywhere. Combines the LIVE Shizuku state (so a stale VERIFIED can never
     * outlive a stopped Shizuku) with the last probe or operation result.
     */
    fun current(op: PrivilegedOperation): OperationCapability {
        val derived = describeState(shizuku.state.value)
        if (derived != null) {
            return OperationCapability(op, derived.first, derived.second, Limitations.of(op), null)
        }
        return _report.value.operations[op]
            ?: OperationCapability(op, CapabilityStatus.UNKNOWN, "Not checked yet", Limitations.of(op))
    }

    /** Records that a real operation worked. Upgrades the operation to VERIFIED. */
    fun markVerified(op: PrivilegedOperation) {
        val now = clock()
        _report.update { r ->
            val old = r.of(op)
            r.copy(operations = r.operations + (op to old.copy(
                status = CapabilityStatus.VERIFIED,
                reason = "Worked at the last attempt",
                limitations = Limitations.of(op),
                checkedAtMs = now
            )))
        }
    }

    /** Records that a transport failure just made [op] unusable. A later probe can restore it. */
    fun markUnavailable(op: PrivilegedOperation, reason: String) {
        val now = clock()
        _report.update { r ->
            val old = r.of(op)
            r.copy(operations = r.operations + (op to old.copy(
                status = CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
                reason = reason,
                limitations = Limitations.of(op),
                checkedAtMs = now
            )))
        }
    }

    /** Fresh, read-only probe of everything. Never throws. */
    suspend fun probe(force: Boolean = false): CapabilityReport = withContext(dispatcher) { probeLocked(force) }

    private suspend fun probeLocked(force: Boolean): CapabilityReport = probeMutex.withLock {
        val last = _report.value
        val lastAt = last.probedAtMs
        if (!force && lastAt != null && clock() - lastAt < minProbeIntervalMs && last.shizuku == shizuku.state.value) {
            return@withLock last
        }
        shizuku.refresh()
        val state = shizuku.state.value
        val report = try {
            probeNow(state)
        } catch (e: CancellationException) {
            throw e
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            allOperations(state, null, null, CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE, "The capability check failed: ${e.message ?: e.javaClass.simpleName}")
        }
        val merged = keepDemonstrated(last, report)
        _report.value = merged
        merged
    }

    /**
     * A read-only probe can only say "ready" for a deletion. If a real deletion already succeeded and nothing since has
     * made the operation unavailable (that would have replaced VERIFIED), the probe must not downgrade it.
     */
    private fun keepDemonstrated(old: CapabilityReport, fresh: CapabilityReport): CapabilityReport = fresh.copy(
        operations = fresh.operations.mapValues { (op, cap) ->
            val before = old.operations[op]
            if (cap.status == CapabilityStatus.PREREQUISITES_MET &&
                before != null && before.status == CapabilityStatus.VERIFIED && before.checkedAtMs != null
            ) before else cap
        }
    )

    private suspend fun probeNow(state: ShizukuState): CapabilityReport {
        val derived = describeState(state)
        if (derived != null) {
            return allOperations(state, null, null, derived.first, derived.second)
        }
        return when (val session = provider.acquire()) {
            is SessionResult.NotReady ->
                allOperations(state, null, null, session.reason.toCapabilityStatus(), session.message)
            is SessionResult.Ready -> probeReady(state, session.api)
        }
    }

    private suspend fun probeReady(state: ShizukuState, api: PrivilegedFileApi): CapabilityReport {
        val now = clock()
        val dataPath = "${PathRules.ROOT}/Android/data"
        val obbPath = "${PathRules.ROOT}/Android/obb"
        val probe = try {
            scope.runWithDeadline(probeCallTimeoutMs) {
                Probed(api.uid(), api.apiVersion(), api.list(dataPath), api.list(obbPath))
            }
        } catch (e: TransportException) {
            provider.invalidate()
            return allOperations(state, null, null, CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
                "The Shizuku service stopped while it was being checked. Try again.")
        } catch (e: DeadlineExceeded) {
            provider.restart()
            return allOperations(state, null, null, CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
                "The Shizuku service did not answer in time. Try again.")
        }

        val dataOk = probe.data.status == ReplyStatus.OK
        val obbOk = probe.obb.status == ReplyStatus.OK
        val unreadable = !dataOk && !obbOk
        val readReason = when {
            unreadable -> "The Shizuku shell cannot read Android/data on this device (${describe(probe.data.status)}). " +
                "This depends on the Android version and manufacturer."
            dataOk && obbOk -> "Android/data and Android/obb are readable through Shizuku."
            dataOk -> "Android/data is readable; Android/obb is not (${describe(probe.obb.status)})."
            else -> "Android/obb is readable; Android/data is not (${describe(probe.data.status)})."
        }
        val ops = LinkedHashMap<PrivilegedOperation, OperationCapability>()
        fun put(op: PrivilegedOperation, status: CapabilityStatus, reason: String) {
            ops[op] = OperationCapability(op, status, reason, Limitations.of(op), now)
        }
        if (unreadable) {
            for (op in PrivilegedOperation.entries) put(op, CapabilityStatus.UNSUPPORTED, readReason)
        } else {
            put(PrivilegedOperation.LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA, CapabilityStatus.VERIFIED, readReason)
            put(PrivilegedOperation.MEASURE_EXTERNAL_APP_DIR, CapabilityStatus.PREREQUISITES_MET,
                "Listing works; measuring has not been demonstrated yet.")
            if (dataOk) {
                put(PrivilegedOperation.CLEAR_EXTERNAL_APP_CACHE, CapabilityStatus.PREREQUISITES_MET,
                    "Everything that can be checked without deleting is in place; clearing has not been demonstrated yet.")
            } else {
                put(PrivilegedOperation.CLEAR_EXTERNAL_APP_CACHE, CapabilityStatus.UNSUPPORTED,
                    "App caches live in Android/data, which the Shizuku shell cannot read here (${describe(probe.data.status)}).")
            }
            put(PrivilegedOperation.REMOVE_UNINSTALLED_APP_DATA, CapabilityStatus.PREREQUISITES_MET,
                "Everything that can be checked without deleting is in place; removal has not been demonstrated yet.")
        }
        return CapabilityReport(state, probe.uid, probe.apiVersion, ops, now)
    }

    private fun allOperations(
        state: ShizukuState,
        uid: Int?,
        apiVersion: Int?,
        status: CapabilityStatus,
        reason: String
    ): CapabilityReport {
        val now = clock()
        return CapabilityReport(
            shizuku = state,
            serviceUid = uid,
            serviceApiVersion = apiVersion,
            operations = PrivilegedOperation.entries.associateWith {
                OperationCapability(it, status, reason, Limitations.of(it), now)
            },
            probedAtMs = now
        )
    }

    private class Probed(val uid: Int, val apiVersion: Int, val data: ListReply, val obb: ListReply)

    private fun describe(status: ReplyStatus): String = when (status) {
        ReplyStatus.OK -> "readable"
        ReplyStatus.NOT_FOUND -> "folder not found"
        ReplyStatus.REFUSED -> "blocked by CleanForge's own rules"
        ReplyStatus.OS_DENIED -> "the system refused access"
        ReplyStatus.FAILED -> "the check failed"
    }

    companion object {
        /** Actionable text for a Shizuku state that blocks everything, or null if Shizuku is authorized. */
        fun describeState(state: ShizukuState): Pair<CapabilityStatus, String>? = when (state) {
            is ShizukuState.Authorized -> null
            ShizukuState.NotInstalled -> CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE to
                "Shizuku is not installed. Install it from its official page, start it, then come back."
            ShizukuState.NotRunning -> CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE to
                "Shizuku is installed but not running. Start it (Wireless debugging or adb), then come back."
            ShizukuState.Disconnected -> CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE to
                "The Shizuku service stopped. Start it again, then come back."
            ShizukuState.ServerTooOld -> CapabilityStatus.UNSUPPORTED to
                "The running Shizuku is too old (version 11 or newer is required). Update the Shizuku app."
            ShizukuState.PermissionDenied -> CapabilityStatus.NEEDS_AUTHORIZATION to
                "Allow CleanForge in the Shizuku permission dialog."
            ShizukuState.PermissionPermanentlyDenied -> CapabilityStatus.NEEDS_AUTHORIZATION to
                "Permission was denied with \"don't ask again\". Open the Shizuku app and allow CleanForge there."
            is ShizukuState.Error -> CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE to "Shizuku reported a problem: ${state.message}"
        }
    }
}
```
