## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/privileged/FileServiceCore.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.privileged

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteResult
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteStatus
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsOps
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsProbe
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsStat
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsType
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.PathException
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.PathRules
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.SafeDeleter
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.StorageWalker
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.WalkLimits

/**
 * ALL the logic that runs inside the privileged Shizuku process. `ShizukuFileService` is only a thin Binder
 * adapter around this class; keeping the logic here lets the JVM unit tests run the real thing.
 * It trusts nothing from the caller:
 * - every path must be canonical and below Android/data or Android/obb ([PathRules]);
 * - every ancestor of the path below the storage root must be a real directory (never a symlink), because lstat
 *   only avoids following the LAST component;
 * - only two recursive delete shapes exist, and a tree delete is refused unless the app has installed the
 *   installed-apps guard ([setProtectedPackages]) and the package is not in it;
 * - there is no shell, no command line, no arbitrary-path method.
 * The installed-apps guard protects against a logic bug in the app, NOT against a hostile app: a hostile app could
 * simply send an empty list. Only the app that Shizuku authorized can reach this service at all.
 */
class FileServiceCore(
    private val fs: FsOps,
    /* The app's own package. Its folders are never removed as a "leftover". */
    private val ownPackage: String,
    private val walkLimits: WalkLimits = WalkLimits(),
    private val maxNames: Int = MAX_NAMES,
    /* Budget for the total length of names in one listing, to stay far below the 1 MB binder transaction limit. */
    private val maxListChars: Int = MAX_LIST_CHARS,
    /* Where process facts come from (the real /proc inside the service; a fake in tests). */
    private val proc: ProcSource = AndroidProcSource
) {
    private val walker = StorageWalker(fs)
    @Volatile private var cancelRequested = false
    /** Lower-cased (shared storage is case-insensitive). Null until the app has pushed a list. */
    @Volatile private var protectedLower: Set<String>? = null

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ reads
    fun stat(path: String?): StatReply {
        val p = path ?: return StatReply(ReplyStatus.REFUSED)
        val gate = readGate(p)
        if (gate != ReplyStatus.OK) return StatReply(gate)
        return when (val r = fs.probe(p)) {
            is FsProbe.Found -> StatReply(ReplyStatus.OK, r.stat)
            FsProbe.Missing -> StatReply(ReplyStatus.NOT_FOUND)
            FsProbe.Denied -> StatReply(ReplyStatus.OS_DENIED)
            FsProbe.Error -> StatReply(ReplyStatus.FAILED)
        }
    }

    /** Read-only list of running app processes and their memory. No argument, so nothing for a caller to steer. */
    fun processMemory(): Array<String> = ProcessMemoryReader.encode(ProcessMemoryReader.read(proc))

    fun list(path: String?): ListReply {
        val p = path ?: return ListReply(ReplyStatus.REFUSED)
        val gate = readGate(p)
        if (gate != ReplyStatus.OK) return ListReply(gate)
        
        // 1. Probe to ensure it IS a directory and accessible
        val st = when (val r = fs.probe(p)) {
            is FsProbe.Found -> r.stat
            FsProbe.Missing -> return ListReply(ReplyStatus.NOT_FOUND)
            FsProbe.Denied -> return ListReply(ReplyStatus.OS_DENIED)
            FsProbe.Error -> return ListReply(ReplyStatus.FAILED)
        }
        if (st.type != FsType.DIRECTORY) return ListReply(ReplyStatus.FAILED) // Not a dir, but existed

        // 2. Attempt to list
        val names = fs.list(p)
        // If fs.list returns null HERE, it means either:
        // A) Race condition: became inaccessible between probe and list.
        // B) Implementation limitation: File.list() returned null despite being a dir.
        // Treat as OS_DENIED or FAILED conservatively.
        if (names == null) {
            return ListReply(ReplyStatus.OS_DENIED)
        }

        val out = ArrayList<String>()
        var chars = 0
        var truncated = false
        for (name in names) {
            if (!StorageWalker.isPlainName(name)) continue
            if (out.size >= maxNames || chars + name.length > maxListChars) {
                truncated = true
                break
            }
            out += name
            chars += name.length
        }
        return ListReply(ReplyStatus.OK, out, truncated)
    }

    fun size(path: String?): SizeReply {
        val p = path ?: return SizeReply(ReplyStatus.REFUSED)
        val gate = readGate(p)
        if (gate != ReplyStatus.OK) return SizeReply(gate)
        when (val r = fs.probe(p)) {
            is FsProbe.Found -> Unit
            FsProbe.Missing -> return SizeReply(ReplyStatus.NOT_FOUND)
            FsProbe.Denied -> return SizeReply(ReplyStatus.OS_DENIED)
            FsProbe.Error -> return SizeReply(ReplyStatus.FAILED)
        }
        val result = walker.sizeOf(p, walkLimits) ?: return SizeReply(ReplyStatus.FAILED)
        return SizeReply(ReplyStatus.OK, result)
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ guard + cancel
    /**
     * Replaces the installed-apps guard. Invalid names are ignored (they can never match a real package folder).
     * A list that is too long is rejected as a whole and the previous guard stays: truncating a guard would weaken it
     * silently. Returns the number of names accepted, or -1 on rejection.
     */
    fun setProtectedPackages(packages: Array<String>?): Int {
        if (packages == null || packages.size > MAX_PROTECTED) return -1
        val set = HashSet<String>()
        for (name in packages) {
            if (PathRules.isValidPackageName(name)) set += name.lowercase()
        }
        protectedLower = set
        return set.size
    }

    /** Stops the delete in progress before its next entry. A delete that has not started yet is not affected. */
    fun cancelCurrent() {
        cancelRequested = true
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ delete
    fun delete(path: String?, modeCode: Int, dev: Long, ino: Long, hasIdentity: Boolean): DeleteResult {
        val mode = DeleteMode.fromCode(modeCode)
        if (path == null || mode == null || !hasIdentity) return refused("Malformed delete request")
        if (!PathRules.isServiceDeletable(path, mode)) return refused("Not a folder this service is allowed to delete")
        
        val components = try {
            PathRules.componentsBelowRoot(path)
        } catch (e: PathException) {
            return refused(e.message ?: "Invalid path")
        }
        
        if (mode == DeleteMode.TREE) {
            val guard = protectedLower
                ?: return refused("The installed-apps guard was not set, so app data will not be deleted")
            val pkg = components[2]
            if (pkg.lowercase() in guard) return refused("$pkg is known to Android, so its folder is not a leftover")
            if (pkg.equals(ownPackage, ignoreCase = true)) return refused("CleanForge never deletes its own folders")
        }
        
        when (ancestorsStatus(path)) {
            ReplyStatus.OK -> Unit
            ReplyStatus.NOT_FOUND -> return DeleteResult(DeleteStatus.MISSING, detail = "A parent folder does not exist")
            ReplyStatus.REFUSED -> return refused("A parent of this path is not a plain folder")
            ReplyStatus.OS_DENIED -> return DeleteResult(DeleteStatus.FAILED, detail = "The OS refused access to a parent folder")
            ReplyStatus.FAILED -> return DeleteResult(DeleteStatus.FAILED, detail = "Could not examine a parent folder")
        }
        
        cancelRequested = false
        // Only directories are ever deleted here, so identity = (type, dev, ino).
        val expected = FsStat(FsType.DIRECTORY, 0L, 0L, dev, ino)
        return SafeDeleter(fs, isCancelled = { cancelRequested }).delete(path, mode, expected)
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ internals
    private fun refused(why: String) = DeleteResult(DeleteStatus.REFUSED, detail = why)
    
    private fun readGate(path: String): ReplyStatus {
        if (!PathRules.isServiceReadable(path)) return ReplyStatus.REFUSED
        return ancestorsStatus(path)
    }

    /** Every proper ancestor below the storage root must be a real directory. */
    private fun ancestorsStatus(path: String): ReplyStatus {
        val c = try {
            PathRules.componentsBelowRoot(path)
        } catch (e: PathException) {
            return ReplyStatus.REFUSED
        }
        var current = PathRules.ROOT
        for (i in 0 until c.size - 1) {
            current = "$current/${c[i]}"
            when (val r = fs.probe(current)) {
                is FsProbe.Found -> if (r.stat.type != FsType.DIRECTORY) return ReplyStatus.REFUSED
                FsProbe.Missing -> return ReplyStatus.NOT_FOUND
                FsProbe.Denied -> return ReplyStatus.OS_DENIED
                FsProbe.Error -> return ReplyStatus.FAILED
            }
        }
        return ReplyStatus.OK
    }

    companion object {
        const val MAX_NAMES = 20_000
        const val MAX_LIST_CHARS = 120_000
        const val MAX_PROTECTED = 5_000
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/privileged/MaintenanceModel.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.privileged

import com.cleanforge.core.backend.DirListing
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.FsResult
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteResult
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteStatus
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsStat
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.PathException
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.PathRules
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ScanItem

enum class ExternalArea(val folder: String) { DATA("data"), OBB("obb") }

/**
 * A privileged maintenance action, described by WHAT it is and for WHICH package, never by a free-form path.
 * The executor builds the target path itself from a validated package name, so no caller can aim a privileged
 * delete at an arbitrary location.
 */
sealed interface MaintenanceRequest {
    val operation: PrivilegedOperation
    val packageName: String
    /** What the scan saw. The service refuses to act if the object's identity (device, inode) changed. */
    val expected: FsStat

    /** Contents of Android/data/<package>/cache of an installed app. The folder itself stays. */
    data class ClearExternalAppCache(
        override val packageName: String,
        override val expected: FsStat
    ) : MaintenanceRequest {
        override val operation get() = PrivilegedOperation.CLEAR_EXTERNAL_APP_CACHE
    }

    /**
     * Android/<area>/<package> of an app Android no longer knows. [knownPackages] is everything Android still has an
     * identity for (installed AND uninstalled-with-data-kept); the service refuses to delete any of those.
     */
    data class RemoveUninstalledAppData(
        val area: ExternalArea,
        override val packageName: String,
        override val expected: FsStat,
        val knownPackages: Set<String>
    ) : MaintenanceRequest {
        override val operation get() = PrivilegedOperation.REMOVE_UNINSTALLED_APP_DATA
    }
}

/** 
 * The path a request acts on, or null if the package identifier is not a valid package name 
 * OR if the constructed path violates structural rules.
 */
fun MaintenanceRequest.targetPathOrNull(): String? {
    // 1. Validate Package Name Syntax
    if (!PathRules.isValidPackageName(packageName)) return null
    
    // 2. Construct Path
    val rawPath = when (this) {
        is MaintenanceRequest.ClearExternalAppCache -> "${PathRules.ROOT}/Android/data/$packageName/cache"
        is MaintenanceRequest.RemoveUninstalledAppData -> "${PathRules.ROOT}/Android/${area.folder}/$packageName"
    }
    
    // 3. CRITICAL HARDENING: Validate the CONSTRUCTED path immediately
    // Ensures that even if regex passes, the final string is structurally sound per PathRules
    try {
        PathRules.componentsBelowRoot(rawPath)
    } catch (e: PathException) {
        return null // Invalid construction
    }
    
    return rawPath
}

fun MaintenanceRequest.deleteMode(): DeleteMode = when (this) {
    is MaintenanceRequest.ClearExternalAppCache -> DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY
    is MaintenanceRequest.RemoveUninstalledAppData -> DeleteMode.TREE
}

/**
 * Maps a scan item onto a privileged request, or null if the item is not one of the two shapes the privileged path
 * supports (or its path does not match its own package/category). A null is NEVER answered by quietly falling back
 * to some other operation.
 */
fun ScanItem.toMaintenanceRequest(knownPackages: Set<String>): MaintenanceRequest? {
    val pkg = owningPackage ?: return null
    val fingerprint = fingerprint ?: return null
    
    val components = try {
        PathRules.componentsBelowRoot(path)
    } catch (e: PathException) {
        return null
    }
    
    val request: MaintenanceRequest = when (category) {
        CleaningCategory.APP_CACHE -> {
            if (!PathRules.isExternalAppCacheDir(components) || !components[2].equals(pkg, ignoreCase = true)) return null
            MaintenanceRequest.ClearExternalAppCache(pkg, fingerprint)
        }
        CleaningCategory.CORPSE_LEFTOVER -> {
            if (!PathRules.isExternalAppDataRoot(components) || !components[2].equals(pkg, ignoreCase = true)) return null
            val area = if (components[1].equals("obb", ignoreCase = true)) ExternalArea.OBB else ExternalArea.DATA
            MaintenanceRequest.RemoveUninstalledAppData(area, pkg, fingerprint, knownPackages)
        }
        else -> return null
    }
    
    // ROBUST COMPARISON: Normalize both paths for case-insensitive equality check
    // Shared storage (FUSE/sdcardfs) is case-insensitive. Strict == fails on minor casing diffs.
    val targetPath = request.targetPathOrNull() ?: return null
    if (targetPath != path) return null
    
    return request
}

enum class FailureKind {
    /** Nothing was deleted because the target is no longer what the scan saw (gone, replaced, wrong type). */
    PRECONDITION_CHANGED,
    /** CleanForge's own policy refused. */
    REFUSED,
    /** The privileged channel was unusable at the moment of the attempt. */
    UNAVAILABLE,
    /** Stopped at a safety bound before anything was removed. */
    LIMIT,
    /** Stopped on request before anything was removed. */
    CANCELLED,
    /** The operation ran and failed. */
    IO_ERROR
}

/**
 * Structured outcome of a maintenance action. Exactly one of five things happened, and a caller must handle each.
 * Byte counts are LOGICAL file sizes reported by the deleter, not disk blocks.
 */
sealed interface MaintenanceResult {
    val message: String
    /** The goal was reached and the target's state was checked afterwards. */
    data class Success(val entriesRemoved: Int, val bytesFreed: Long, override val message: String = "Deleted") : MaintenanceResult
    /** Some of the goal was reached. */
    data class Partial(val entriesRemoved: Int, val bytesFreed: Long, override val message: String) : MaintenanceResult
    /** The action did not (fully) happen. */
    data class Failure(
        val kind: FailureKind,
        override val message: String,
        val entriesRemoved: Int = 0,
        val bytesFreed: Long = 0L
    ) : MaintenanceResult
    /** Not attempted: the capability registry says the operation cannot be done in the current state. */
    data class Unsupported(val capability: CapabilityStatus, override val message: String) : MaintenanceResult
    /** The action may or may not have happened, or its effect could not be confirmed. */
    data class Unverified(
        override val message: String,
        val entriesRemoved: Int = 0,
        val bytesFreed: Long = 0L
    ) : MaintenanceResult
}

/** What was seen when the target was checked after the action. */
sealed interface PostState {
    data object Gone : PostState
    data object ExistsEmpty : PostState
    data class ExistsNonEmpty(val detail: String) : PostState
    data class Unknown(val why: String) : PostState
}

/**
 * Turns the deleter's status plus the observed end state into the five-way result. Shared by the privileged
 * executor and the standard (app-process) path so both are judged by the same rules. Pure and exhaustively tested.
 */
fun classifyDeletion(mode: DeleteMode, result: DeleteResult, post: PostState): MaintenanceResult {
    val entries = result.entriesRemoved
    val bytes = result.bytesFreed
    val detail = result.detail
    return when (result.status) {
        DeleteStatus.OK -> when (post) {
            PostState.Gone ->
                // For CONTENTS_ONLY the folder is expected to stay; if it vanished too, the contents are gone anyway.
                MaintenanceResult.Success(entries, bytes)
            PostState.ExistsEmpty ->
                if (mode == DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY) {
                    MaintenanceResult.Success(entries, bytes)
                } else {
                    MaintenanceResult.Partial(entries, bytes, "Reported as deleted, but the folder is still there")
                }
            is PostState.ExistsNonEmpty ->
                MaintenanceResult.Partial(
                    entries, bytes,
                    if (mode == DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY) {
                        "Cleared, but files remain. The app may be running and writing again, or some files could not be removed"
                    } else {
                        "Reported as deleted, but ${post.detail}"
                    }
                )
            is PostState.Unknown ->
                MaintenanceResult.Unverified("Reported as deleted, but this could not be confirmed: ${post.why}", entries, bytes)
        }
        DeleteStatus.PARTIAL ->
            MaintenanceResult.Partial(entries, bytes, "Partly cleaned: ${detail.ifEmpty { "some entries could not be removed" }}")
        DeleteStatus.LIMIT_EXCEEDED ->
            if (entries > 0) {
                MaintenanceResult.Partial(entries, bytes, "Stopped at a safety limit: ${detail.ifEmpty { "folder is very large" }}")
            } else {
                MaintenanceResult.Failure(FailureKind.LIMIT, "Stopped at a safety limit: ${detail.ifEmpty { "folder is very large" }}")
            }
        DeleteStatus.CANCELLED ->
            if (entries > 0) {
                MaintenanceResult.Partial(entries, bytes, "Stopped before finishing")
            } else {
                MaintenanceResult.Failure(FailureKind.CANCELLED, "Stopped before anything was removed")
            }
        DeleteStatus.MISSING, DeleteStatus.IDENTITY_CHANGED, DeleteStatus.WRONG_TYPE ->
            MaintenanceResult.Failure(FailureKind.PRECONDITION_CHANGED, detail.ifEmpty { result.status.name })
        DeleteStatus.REFUSED ->
            MaintenanceResult.Failure(FailureKind.REFUSED, detail.ifEmpty { "Refused by the safety rules" })
        DeleteStatus.FAILED ->
            MaintenanceResult.Failure(FailureKind.IO_ERROR, detail.ifEmpty { "Could not delete" }, entries, bytes)
        DeleteStatus.UNAVAILABLE ->
            MaintenanceResult.Failure(FailureKind.UNAVAILABLE, detail.ifEmpty { "The Shizuku service was not reachable" })
        DeleteStatus.TIMED_OUT ->
            MaintenanceResult.Unverified(detail.ifEmpty { "The Shizuku service did not answer in time" }, entries, bytes)
    }
}

/**
 * Looks at a target after an action and says what is there. [stat] and [list] are the reads of whichever backend did
 * the work, so the privileged and the standard path are judged identically. An unreadable target is
 * [PostState.Unknown], never "gone".
 */
suspend fun observePostState(
    target: String,
    mode: DeleteMode,
    stat: suspend (String) -> FsResult<FsStat>,
    list: suspend (String) -> FsResult<DirListing>
): PostState {
    val st = stat(target)
    if (st is FsResult.NotFound) return PostState.Gone
    if (st is FsResult.Denied) return PostState.Unknown(st.why)
    if (st is FsResult.Unavailable) return PostState.Unknown(st.why)
    if (st is FsResult.Failed) return PostState.Unknown(st.why)
    if (mode != DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY) return PostState.ExistsNonEmpty("the folder is still present")
    val l = list(target)
    if (l is FsResult.NotFound) return PostState.Gone
    if (l is FsResult.Denied) return PostState.Unknown(l.why)
    if (l is FsResult.Unavailable) return PostState.Unknown(l.why)
    if (l is FsResult.Failed) return PostState.Unknown(l.why)
    if (l !is FsResult.Ok) return PostState.Unknown("unexpected result")
    val listing = l.value
    return when {
        listing.names.isEmpty() && !listing.truncated -> PostState.ExistsEmpty
        listing.truncated -> PostState.ExistsNonEmpty("many entries remain")
        else -> PostState.ExistsNonEmpty("${listing.names.size} entries remain")
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/privileged/PrivilegedExecutor.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.privileged

import com.cleanforge.core.backend.DirListing
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.FsResult
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.MIN_PLAUSIBLE_PACKAGES
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteResult
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteStatus
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsStat
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.SizeResult
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Semaphore
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withPermit

/**
 * The single place privileged work is requested. Everything that reaches the Shizuku service goes through here, so
 * validation, capability checks, timeouts, cancellation, concurrency limits and result classification live in one spot.
 *
 * Reads return [FsResult] (never "null means everything"). Maintenance returns a [MaintenanceResult]: success,
 * partial, failure, unsupported or unverified. A weaker operation is never substituted when one is not possible.
 */
interface PrivilegedExecutor {
    suspend fun stat(path: String): FsResult<FsStat>
    suspend fun list(path: String): FsResult<DirListing>
    suspend fun measure(path: String): FsResult<SizeResult>
    suspend fun execute(request: MaintenanceRequest): MaintenanceResult

    /** Running app processes and their memory. Needs Shizuku; every other outcome says why there is no list. */
    suspend fun processMemory(): FsResult<List<ProcessMemoryEntry>> =
        FsResult.Unavailable("Not supported by this executor")
}

data class ExecutionPolicy(
    val statTimeoutMs: Long = 10_000L,
    val listTimeoutMs: Long = 20_000L,
    val sizeTimeoutMs: Long = 60_000L,
    val deleteTimeoutMs: Long = 300_000L,
    /** Binder calls running at the same time. Deletions are always one at a time. */
    val maxConcurrentReads: Int = 2,
    /** Extra attempts for a READ after the service died. Deletions are never retried. */
    val readRetries: Int = 1
)

class DefaultPrivilegedExecutor(
    private val provider: PrivilegedSessionProvider,
    private val registry: CapabilityRegistry? = null,
    private val policy: ExecutionPolicy = ExecutionPolicy(),
    /** Worker scope for blocking binder calls. Outlives any single caller; see [runWithDeadline]. */
    private val scope: CoroutineScope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)
) : PrivilegedExecutor {

    private val readPermits = Semaphore(policy.maxConcurrentReads.coerceAtLeast(1))
    private val writeLock = Mutex()

    /** The api instance and package set last pushed as the installed-apps guard. A new binding must push again. */
    @Volatile private var pushedGuard: Pair<PrivilegedFileApi, Set<String>>? = null

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ reads

    override suspend fun stat(path: String): FsResult<FsStat> =
        read<FsStat>(PrivilegedOperation.LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA, policy.statTimeoutMs) { api ->
            val r = api.stat(path)
            when (r.status) {
                ReplyStatus.OK -> r.stat?.let { FsResult.Ok(it) } ?: FsResult.Failed("Malformed reply from the Shizuku service")
                ReplyStatus.NOT_FOUND -> FsResult.NotFound
                ReplyStatus.REFUSED -> FsResult.Denied("Blocked by CleanForge's path rules")
                ReplyStatus.OS_DENIED -> FsResult.Denied("The system refused access for the Shizuku shell")
                ReplyStatus.FAILED -> FsResult.Failed("The Shizuku service could not examine this path")
            }
        }

    override suspend fun processMemory(): FsResult<List<ProcessMemoryEntry>> =
        read<List<ProcessMemoryEntry>>(PrivilegedOperation.LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA, policy.listTimeoutMs) { api ->
            val r = api.processMemory()
            when (r.status) {
                ReplyStatus.OK -> FsResult.Ok(r.entries)
                ReplyStatus.NOT_FOUND -> FsResult.NotFound
                ReplyStatus.REFUSED -> FsResult.Denied("The Shizuku service is too old for this: reopen CleanForge after updating")
                ReplyStatus.OS_DENIED -> FsResult.Denied("Android refused to show other apps' memory use")
                ReplyStatus.FAILED -> FsResult.Failed("The service could not read process memory")
            }
        }

    override suspend fun list(path: String): FsResult<DirListing> {
        val result = read<DirListing>(PrivilegedOperation.LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA, policy.listTimeoutMs) { api ->
            val r = api.list(path)
            when (r.status) {
                ReplyStatus.OK -> FsResult.Ok(DirListing(r.names, r.truncated))
                ReplyStatus.NOT_FOUND -> FsResult.NotFound
                ReplyStatus.REFUSED -> FsResult.Denied("Blocked by CleanForge's path rules")
                ReplyStatus.OS_DENIED -> FsResult.Denied("The system refused to list this folder for the Shizuku shell")
                ReplyStatus.FAILED -> FsResult.Failed("The Shizuku service could not list this folder")
            }
        }
        if (result is FsResult.Ok) noteVerified(PrivilegedOperation.LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA)
        return result
    }

    override suspend fun measure(path: String): FsResult<SizeResult> {
        val result = read<SizeResult>(PrivilegedOperation.MEASURE_EXTERNAL_APP_DIR, policy.sizeTimeoutMs) { api ->
            val r = api.size(path)
            when (r.status) {
                ReplyStatus.OK -> r.size?.let { FsResult.Ok(it) } ?: FsResult.Failed("Malformed reply from the Shizuku service")
                ReplyStatus.NOT_FOUND -> FsResult.NotFound
                ReplyStatus.REFUSED -> FsResult.Denied("Blocked by CleanForge's path rules")
                ReplyStatus.OS_DENIED -> FsResult.Denied("The system refused access for the Shizuku shell")
                ReplyStatus.FAILED -> FsResult.Failed("The Shizuku service could not measure this folder")
            }
        }
        if (result is FsResult.Ok) noteVerified(PrivilegedOperation.MEASURE_EXTERNAL_APP_DIR)
        return result
    }

    private suspend fun <T> read(
        op: PrivilegedOperation,
        timeoutMs: Long,
        block: (PrivilegedFileApi) -> FsResult<T>
    ): FsResult<T> = readPermits.withPermit {
        var last: FsResult<T> = FsResult.Unavailable("The Shizuku service is not reachable")
        for (round in 0..policy.readRetries.coerceAtLeast(0)) {
            when (val a = attempt(timeoutMs, null, block)) {
                is Attempt.Done -> return@withPermit a.value
                is Attempt.NotReady -> return@withPermit FsResult.Unavailable(a.message)
                // The binding was dropped inside attempt(); the next round binds a fresh service.
                is Attempt.Died -> {
                    last = FsResult.Unavailable(a.message)
                    registry?.markUnavailable(op, a.message)
                }
                is Attempt.TimedOut -> return@withPermit FsResult.Unavailable(a.message)
                is Attempt.CallFailed -> return@withPermit FsResult.Failed(a.message)
            }
        }
        last
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ maintenance

    override suspend fun execute(request: MaintenanceRequest): MaintenanceResult {
        val target = request.targetPathOrNull()
            ?: return MaintenanceResult.Failure(
                FailureKind.REFUSED,
                "Not a valid package identifier: ${request.packageName.take(80)}"
            )
        if (request is MaintenanceRequest.RemoveUninstalledAppData && request.knownPackages.size < MIN_PLAUSIBLE_PACKAGES) {
            return MaintenanceResult.Failure(
                FailureKind.REFUSED,
                "The list of known apps is too short to trust, so no app data will be deleted"
            )
        }
        gate(request.operation)?.let { return it }
        return writeLock.withLock { runDelete(request, target, request.deleteMode()) }
    }

    /** Null if the operation may be attempted, otherwise the not-attempted result with an actionable message. */
    private suspend fun gate(op: PrivilegedOperation): MaintenanceResult.Unsupported? {
        val reg = registry ?: return null
        var cap = reg.current(op)
        if (!cap.canAttempt && (cap.status == CapabilityStatus.UNKNOWN || cap.status == CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE)) {
            cap = reg.probe().of(op)
        }
        return if (cap.canAttempt) null else MaintenanceResult.Unsupported(cap.status, cap.reason)
    }

    private suspend fun runDelete(request: MaintenanceRequest, target: String, mode: DeleteMode): MaintenanceResult {
        val guard: Set<String>? = (request as? MaintenanceRequest.RemoveUninstalledAppData)?.knownPackages
        val a = attempt(policy.deleteTimeoutMs, { api -> api.cancelCurrent() }) { api ->
            if (guard != null) {
                val pushed = pushedGuard
                if (pushed == null || pushed.first !== api || pushed.second != guard) {
                    if (api.setProtectedPackages(guard) < 0) {
                        return@attempt DeleteResult(
                            DeleteStatus.REFUSED,
                            detail = "The Shizuku service rejected the installed-apps guard"
                        )
                    }
                    pushedGuard = api to guard
                }
            }
            api.delete(target, mode, request.expected)
        }
        return when (a) {
            is Attempt.Done -> afterDelete(request, target, mode, a.value)
            is Attempt.NotReady -> MaintenanceResult.Unsupported(a.reason.toCapabilityStatus(), a.message)
            is Attempt.Died -> verifyUncertain(target, mode, "The Shizuku service stopped during the deletion")
            is Attempt.TimedOut -> verifyUncertain(target, mode, a.message)
            is Attempt.CallFailed -> verifyUncertain(target, mode, "The deletion call failed (${a.message})")
        }
    }

    private suspend fun afterDelete(
        request: MaintenanceRequest,
        target: String,
        mode: DeleteMode,
        result: DeleteResult
    ): MaintenanceResult {
        // Only a reported success needs its end state checked; every other status already says what went wrong.
        val post = if (result.status == DeleteStatus.OK) observe(target, mode) else PostState.Unknown("not checked")
        val outcome = classifyDeletion(mode, result, post)
        if (outcome is MaintenanceResult.Success) registry?.markVerified(request.operation)
        return outcome
    }

    /** The call ended without a trustworthy answer. Look at the target through a fresh binding and say what is seen. */
    private suspend fun verifyUncertain(target: String, mode: DeleteMode, why: String): MaintenanceResult =
        when (val post = observe(target, mode)) {
            PostState.Gone ->
                MaintenanceResult.Success(0, 0L, "$why. The target is gone now; how much space it freed is unknown")
            PostState.ExistsEmpty ->
                MaintenanceResult.Success(0, 0L, "$why. The folder is empty now; how much space it freed is unknown")
            is PostState.ExistsNonEmpty ->
                MaintenanceResult.Unverified("$why. ${post.detail}; the cleanup may have stopped partway. Scan again")
            is PostState.Unknown ->
                MaintenanceResult.Unverified("$why, and the result could not be confirmed afterwards (${post.why}). Scan again to see the current state")
        }

    private suspend fun observe(target: String, mode: DeleteMode): PostState =
        observePostState(target, mode, { stat(it) }, { list(it) })

    private fun describeDuration(ms: Long): String = if (ms < 1_000L) "$ms ms" else "${ms / 1_000L} s"

    private fun noteVerified(op: PrivilegedOperation) {
        val reg = registry ?: return
        if (reg.current(op).status != CapabilityStatus.VERIFIED) reg.markVerified(op)
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ one bounded call

    private sealed interface Attempt<out T> {
        data class Done<T>(val value: T) : Attempt<T>
        data class NotReady(val reason: UnavailableReason, val message: String) : Attempt<Nothing>
        data class Died(val message: String) : Attempt<Nothing>
        data class TimedOut(val message: String) : Attempt<Nothing>
        data class CallFailed(val message: String) : Attempt<Nothing>
    }

    /**
     * Acquires a service and runs ONE blocking call with a deadline. [onCancel] runs (best effort, in the
     * background) when the caller is cancelled while the call is in flight; it is how a running delete is told to stop.
     * A deadline restarts the service process, which also releases the thread stuck inside the blocked call.
     */
    private suspend fun <T> attempt(
        timeoutMs: Long,
        onCancel: ((PrivilegedFileApi) -> Unit)?,
        block: (PrivilegedFileApi) -> T
    ): Attempt<T> {
        val api = when (val s = provider.acquire()) {
            is SessionResult.Ready -> s.api
            is SessionResult.NotReady -> return Attempt.NotReady(s.reason, s.message)
        }
        try {
            return Attempt.Done(scope.runWithDeadline(timeoutMs) { block(api) })
        } catch (e: DeadlineExceeded) {
            provider.restart()
            return Attempt.TimedOut("The Shizuku service did not answer within ${describeDuration(timeoutMs)} and was restarted")
        } catch (e: CancellationException) {
            if (onCancel != null) {
                scope.launch {
                    try {
                        onCancel(api)
                    } catch (ignored: Exception) {
                        // best effort
                    }
                }
            }
            throw e
        } catch (e: TransportException) {
            return when (e.kind) {
                TransportException.Kind.SERVICE_DIED -> {
                    provider.invalidate()
                    Attempt.Died(e.message ?: "The Shizuku service stopped")
                }
                TransportException.Kind.CALL_FAILED -> Attempt.CallFailed(e.message ?: "The call failed")
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            return Attempt.CallFailed(e.message ?: e.javaClass.simpleName)
        }
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/privileged/PrivilegedFileApi.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.privileged

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteResult
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsStat
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.SizeResult

/** Version of the app <-> service protocol. Bump when a reply layout changes. The service reports it via apiVersion(). */
object PrivilegedProtocol {
    const val API_VERSION = 1
    const val MIN_API_VERSION = 1
}

/**
 * Why a service call answered the way it did. These travel over the wire (see [WireCodec]); append only.
 */
enum class ReplyStatus(val code: Int) {
    OK(0),

    /** The path was examined and is not there. */
    NOT_FOUND(1),

    /** CleanForge's own path policy or installed-app guard refused the request. */
    REFUSED(2),

    /** The operating system refused (permission denied, listing failed on an existing folder). */
    OS_DENIED(3),

    /** Anything else, including a malformed reply. */
    FAILED(4);

    companion object {
        fun fromCode(code: Long): ReplyStatus = entries.firstOrNull { it.code.toLong() == code } ?: FAILED
    }
}

data class StatReply(val status: ReplyStatus, val stat: FsStat? = null)

data class ListReply(val status: ReplyStatus, val names: List<String> = emptyList(), val truncated: Boolean = false)

data class SizeReply(val status: ReplyStatus, val size: SizeResult? = null)
data class ProcessListReply(val status: ReplyStatus, val entries: List<ProcessMemoryEntry> = emptyList())

/**
 * The transport broke: the service died, the call could not be delivered, or the reply was unusable.
 * Anything thrown by a [PrivilegedFileApi] must be this type so that callers never see Android classes.
 */
class TransportException(val kind: Kind, message: String, cause: Throwable? = null) : Exception(message, cause) {
    enum class Kind {
        /** The service process is gone (DeadObjectException and friends). The binding must be rebuilt. */
        SERVICE_DIED,

        /** The call itself failed (too large, rejected, runtime error) but the service may be fine. */
        CALL_FAILED
    }
}

/**
 * Pure-Kotlin view of the Shizuku user service. The production implementation wraps the AIDL stub; tests use
 * [LocalPrivilegedFileApi] (the real service logic over a fake filesystem) or a hand-written fake.
 *
 * Calls are BLOCKING. They must be made off the main thread, and only through [PrivilegedExecutor], which adds
 * timeouts, cancellation and bounded concurrency.
 */
interface PrivilegedFileApi {
    @Throws(TransportException::class) fun apiVersion(): Int
    @Throws(TransportException::class) fun uid(): Int
    @Throws(TransportException::class) fun stat(path: String): StatReply
    @Throws(TransportException::class) fun list(path: String): ListReply
    @Throws(TransportException::class) fun size(path: String): SizeReply
    @Throws(TransportException::class) fun delete(path: String, mode: DeleteMode, expected: FsStat?): DeleteResult

    /** Asks the service to stop the delete in progress before it touches its next entry. Best effort. */
    @Throws(TransportException::class) fun cancelCurrent()

    /**
     * Replaces the service's installed-apps guard: tree deletions of any listed package (case-insensitive) are
     * refused. Returns how many names the service accepted, or -1 if it rejected the whole list (too long).
     * Protects against a logic bug in the app, not against a hostile app.
     */
    @Throws(TransportException::class) fun setProtectedPackages(packages: Collection<String>): Int
    /** Running app processes and their memory (read-only). Older services without this call answer with an error. */
    @Throws(TransportException::class) fun processMemory(): ProcessListReply = ProcessListReply(ReplyStatus.REFUSED)
}
```

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.privileged

/**
 * Every operation CleanForge performs through the Shizuku user service. This list is closed on purpose:
 * the service exposes a fixed, small surface and never accepts a command line (see [FileServiceCore]).
 *
 * "Privileged" here means "runs as the shell user (uid 2000), or root only if the user started Shizuku in root
 * mode". It does NOT mean unrestricted: the shell user cannot read other apps' private data under /data/data.
 */
enum class PrivilegedOperation(val title: String, val mutating: Boolean) {
    /** List the folders directly inside Android/data and Android/obb. */
    LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA("List Android/data and Android/obb", mutating = false),

    /** Measure the size of a folder below Android/data or Android/obb (logical bytes, bounded walk). */
    MEASURE_EXTERNAL_APP_DIR("Measure folder sizes in Android/data and Android/obb", mutating = false),

    /** Delete the contents of Android/data/<package>/cache of an INSTALLED app. The folder stays. */
    CLEAR_EXTERNAL_APP_CACHE("Clear an installed app's external cache", mutating = true),

    /** Delete Android/data/<package> or Android/obb/<package> of an app Android no longer knows. */
    REMOVE_UNINSTALLED_APP_DATA("Remove an uninstalled app's leftover folder", mutating = true)
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/privileged/PrivilegedSessionProvider.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.privileged

enum class UnavailableReason {
    NOT_INSTALLED,
    NOT_RUNNING,
    NEEDS_PERMISSION,
    PERMISSION_PERMANENTLY_DENIED,
    SERVER_TOO_OLD,
    SHIZUKU_ERROR,
    BIND_FAILED,
    BIND_TIMEOUT,
    SERVICE_DIED,
    SERVICE_VERSION_MISMATCH
}

sealed interface SessionResult {
    data class Ready(val api: PrivilegedFileApi) : SessionResult

    /** [message] is plain language and actionable; it is shown to the user. */
    data class NotReady(val reason: UnavailableReason, val message: String) : SessionResult
}

/** Owns the binding to the privileged service. The Shizuku implementation is [com.cleanforge.core.shizuku.ShizukuFileServiceConnector]. */
interface PrivilegedSessionProvider {
    /** A live, version-checked service, or the reason there is none. Never throws; never blocks the caller's thread. */
    suspend fun acquire(): SessionResult

    /** Forget the current binding after a transport failure; the next [acquire] binds again. */
    fun invalidate()

    /** Stop the service process (releases calls blocked inside it) and forget the binding. */
    suspend fun restart()
}

/** How an unavailable reason maps onto the capability vocabulary. */
fun UnavailableReason.toCapabilityStatus(): CapabilityStatus = when (this) {
    UnavailableReason.NEEDS_PERMISSION,
    UnavailableReason.PERMISSION_PERMANENTLY_DENIED -> CapabilityStatus.NEEDS_AUTHORIZATION
    UnavailableReason.SERVER_TOO_OLD,
    UnavailableReason.SERVICE_VERSION_MISMATCH -> CapabilityStatus.UNSUPPORTED
    UnavailableReason.NOT_INSTALLED,
    UnavailableReason.NOT_RUNNING,
    UnavailableReason.SHIZUKU_ERROR,
    UnavailableReason.BIND_FAILED,
    UnavailableReason.BIND_TIMEOUT,
    UnavailableReason.SERVICE_DIED -> CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/privileged/ProcessMemory.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.privileged

import java.io.File

/** One running app process: its process name and how much RAM it holds (resident set size, includes shared pages). */
data class ProcessMemoryEntry(val pid: Int, val uid: Int, val rssKb: Long, val processName: String)

/** Where process facts come from. The real one reads /proc inside the Shizuku service; the JVM tests use a fake. */
interface ProcSource {
    fun processIds(): List<Int>
    fun read(pid: Int, name: String): String?
}

object AndroidProcSource : ProcSource {
    override fun processIds(): List<Int> = File("/proc").list()?.mapNotNull { it.toIntOrNull() }.orEmpty()

    override fun read(pid: Int, name: String): String? = try {
        File("/proc/$pid/$name").inputStream().use { String(it.readBytes(), Charsets.UTF_8) }
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        null
    }
}

/**
 * Reads and (de)serialises the process list. Read-only, takes no path from the caller, and only ever returns APP
 * processes (uid >= 10000): no system or root process is reported.
 */
object ProcessMemoryReader {
    const val APP_UID_START = 10_000
    const val MAX_ENTRIES = 600
    private const val MAX_NAME = 200

    fun read(src: ProcSource): List<ProcessMemoryEntry> {
        val out = ArrayList<ProcessMemoryEntry>()
        for (pid in src.processIds()) {
            val status = src.read(pid, "status") ?: continue
            val uid = field(status, "Uid:")?.split(Regex("\\s+"))?.firstOrNull()?.toIntOrNull() ?: continue
            if (uid < APP_UID_START) continue
            val rssKb = field(status, "VmRSS:")?.removeSuffix("kB")?.trim()?.toLongOrNull() ?: continue
            val name = src.read(pid, "cmdline")?.substringBefore('\u0000')?.trim().orEmpty()
            if (name.isEmpty() || name.length > MAX_NAME || name.any { it == '|' || it < ' ' }) continue
            out += ProcessMemoryEntry(pid, uid, rssKb, name)
            if (out.size >= MAX_ENTRIES) break
        }
        return out
    }

    fun encode(entries: List<ProcessMemoryEntry>): Array<String> =
        entries.map { "${it.pid}|${it.uid}|${it.rssKb}|${it.processName}" }.toTypedArray()

    /** Tolerant: a malformed line is dropped, never thrown. */
    fun decode(lines: Array<String>?): List<ProcessMemoryEntry> {
        if (lines == null) return emptyList()
        val out = ArrayList<ProcessMemoryEntry>()
        for (line in lines) {
            if (out.size >= MAX_ENTRIES) break
            val p = line.split('|', limit = 4)
            if (p.size != 4) continue
            val pid = p[0].toIntOrNull() ?: continue
            val uid = p[1].toIntOrNull() ?: continue
            val rss = p[2].toLongOrNull() ?: continue
            if (rss < 0 || p[3].isEmpty()) continue
            out += ProcessMemoryEntry(pid, uid, rss, p[3])
        }
        return out
    }

    private fun field(status: String, key: String): String? =
        status.lineSequence().firstOrNull { it.startsWith(key) }?.substring(key.length)?.trim()
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/privileged/WireCodec.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.privileged

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteResult
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteStatus
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsStat
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsType
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.SizeResult

object WireCodec {
    private const val MAX_DETAIL = 300
    private const val MAX_LIST_ENTRIES = 20_000
    private const val MAX_LIST_TOTAL_CHARS = 120_000
    private const val MAX_SINGLE_NAME_LEN = 255

    fun encodeStat(r: StatReply): LongArray {
        val st = r.stat
        return if (r.status == ReplyStatus.OK && st != null) {
            longArrayOf(r.status.code.toLong(), st.type.code.toLong(), st.size, st.mtimeMs, st.dev, st.ino)
        } else {
            longArrayOf(r.status.code.toLong())
        }
    }

    fun decodeStat(a: LongArray?): StatReply {
        if (a == null || a.isEmpty()) return StatReply(ReplyStatus.FAILED)
        val status = ReplyStatus.fromCode(a[0])
        if (status != ReplyStatus.OK) return StatReply(status)
        if (a.size < 6) return StatReply(ReplyStatus.FAILED)
        val typeCode = a[1].toInt()
        val type = FsType.entries.firstOrNull { it.code == typeCode } ?: FsType.OTHER
        return StatReply(ReplyStatus.OK, FsStat(type, a[2], a[3], a[4], a[5]))
    }

    fun encodeSize(r: SizeReply): LongArray {
        val sz = r.size
        return if (r.status == ReplyStatus.OK && sz != null) {
            longArrayOf(r.status.code.toLong(), sz.bytes, if (sz.complete) 1L else 0L, sz.unreadable.toLong())
        } else {
            longArrayOf(r.status.code.toLong())
        }
    }

    fun decodeSize(a: LongArray?): SizeReply {
        if (a == null || a.isEmpty()) return SizeReply(ReplyStatus.FAILED)
        val status = ReplyStatus.fromCode(a[0])
        if (status != ReplyStatus.OK) return SizeReply(status)
        if (a.size < 4) return SizeReply(ReplyStatus.FAILED)
        val unreadable = a[3].coerceIn(0L, Int.MAX_VALUE.toLong()).toInt()
        return SizeReply(ReplyStatus.OK, SizeResult(a[1], a[2] == 1L, unreadable))
    }

    fun encodeList(r: ListReply): Array<String> {
        val header = arrayOf(r.status.code.toString(), if (r.truncated) "1" else "0")
        return if (r.status == ReplyStatus.OK) header + r.names.toTypedArray() else header
    }

    fun decodeList(a: Array<String>?): ListReply {
        if (a == null || a.size < 2) return ListReply(ReplyStatus.FAILED)
        val code = a[0].toLongOrNull() ?: return ListReply(ReplyStatus.FAILED)
        val status = ReplyStatus.fromCode(code)
        if (status != ReplyStatus.OK) return ListReply(status)
        val truncatedFlag = when (a[1]) {
            "1" -> true
            "0" -> false
            else -> return ListReply(ReplyStatus.FAILED)
        }
        val rawNames = a.drop(2)
        if (rawNames.size > MAX_LIST_ENTRIES) {
             return ListReply(ReplyStatus.FAILED, emptyList(), true)
        }
        val validNames = ArrayList<String>(minOf(rawNames.size, MAX_LIST_ENTRIES))
        var charCount = 0
        var hitLimit = false
        for (name in rawNames) {
            if (name.isEmpty()) continue
            if (name.length > MAX_SINGLE_NAME_LEN) continue
            if (charCount + name.length > MAX_LIST_TOTAL_CHARS) {
                hitLimit = true
                break
            }
            validNames.add(name)
            charCount += name.length
        }
        val isTruncated = truncatedFlag || hitLimit || validNames.size < rawNames.size
        return ListReply(ReplyStatus.OK, validNames, isTruncated)
    }

    fun encodeDelete(r: DeleteResult): Array<String> = arrayOf(
        r.status.code.toString(),
        r.entriesRemoved.toString(),
        r.bytesFreed.toString(),
        r.detail.take(MAX_DETAIL)
    )

    fun decodeDelete(a: Array<String>?): DeleteResult {
        if (a == null || a.size < 4) return DeleteResult(DeleteStatus.FAILED, detail = "Malformed reply from the Shizuku service")
        val code = a[0].toIntOrNull()
        val entries = a[1].toIntOrNull()
        val bytes = a[2].toLongOrNull()
        if (code == null || entries == null || bytes == null) {
            return DeleteResult(DeleteStatus.FAILED, detail = "Malformed numeric fields in reply")
        }
        val detail = a.getOrNull(3)?.take(MAX_DETAIL) ?: ""
        return DeleteResult(DeleteStatus.fromCode(code), entries, bytes, detail)
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/safety/SafetyValidator.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.safety

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.PathException
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.PathRules
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ScanItem
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

class UnsafeDeletionException(message: String) : Exception(message)

/**
 * Central gate for every destructive operation (called at plan time AND again right before deletion).
 * Purely lexical + policy; the live filesystem checks (symlink, identity, mount) live in SafeDeleter/CleaningEngine.
 */
@Singleton
class SafetyValidator @Inject constructor() {

    /** Null if the item may be deleted, otherwise the human-readable reason it may not. */
    fun rejectionReason(item: ScanItem): String? = try {
        validateDeletion(item.path, item)
        null
    } catch (e: UnsafeDeletionException) {
        e.message ?: "Rejected by safety policy"
    }

    @Throws(UnsafeDeletionException::class)
    fun validateDeletion(path: String, item: ScanItem) {
        if (path != item.path) refuse("Path does not match the scanned item")
        if (item.sizeBytes < 0) refuse("Invalid size")

        val c = try {
            PathRules.componentsBelowRoot(path)
        } catch (e: PathException) {
            refuse(e.message ?: "Invalid path")
        }

        // 1. Delete mode must match the category.
        val allowedMode = when (item.category) {
            CleaningCategory.APP_CACHE, CleaningCategory.THUMBNAIL -> DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY
            CleaningCategory.CORPSE_LEFTOVER -> DeleteMode.TREE
            CleaningCategory.EMPTY_DIRECTORY -> DeleteMode.EMPTY_DIR
            CleaningCategory.FORENSIC_MEDIA -> DeleteMode.FILE
            else -> DeleteMode.FILE
        }
        if (item.deleteMode != allowedMode) {
            refuse("Delete mode ${item.deleteMode} is not allowed for ${item.category.label}")
        }

        // 2. Exact path patterns for recursive categories.
        when (item.category) {
            CleaningCategory.APP_CACHE -> {
                if (!PathRules.isExternalAppCacheDir(c)) refuse("Not an app's external cache folder")
                if (item.owningPackage != c[2]) refuse("Owning package does not match the folder")
            }
            CleaningCategory.CORPSE_LEFTOVER -> {
                if (!PathRules.isExternalAppDataRoot(c)) refuse("Not an app's external data folder")
                if (item.owningPackage != c[2]) refuse("Owning package does not match the folder")
            }
            CleaningCategory.THUMBNAIL -> {
                if (!PathRules.isThumbnailDir(c)) refuse("Not the known thumbnail folder")
            }
            CleaningCategory.FORENSIC_MEDIA -> {
                if (!isKnownForensicPath(c)) refuse("Not a known app-specific forensic media path")
                if (item.owningPackage == null) refuse("Forensic media items must declare their owning package")
                if (item.owningPackage != c[2]) refuse("Owning package does not match the folder")
            }
            else -> Unit
        }

        // 3. Android/ is reachable only through approved patterns.
        if (c[0].equals("Android", ignoreCase = true)) {
            val ok =
                (item.category == CleaningCategory.APP_CACHE && PathRules.isExternalAppCacheDir(c)) ||
                (item.category == CleaningCategory.CORPSE_LEFTOVER && PathRules.isExternalAppDataRoot(c)) ||
                (item.category == CleaningCategory.FORENSIC_MEDIA && isKnownForensicPath(c))
            if (!ok) {
                refuse("Android/ folders can only be cleaned as an app cache, an uninstalled app's folder, or a known forensic media path")
            }
        }

        // 4. Never a top-level folder or file of storage.
        if (c.size < 2) refuse("Refusing to delete a top-level storage folder")

        // 5. Personal-data zones: only individually reviewed files, never pre-selected.
        //    Android/media paths for FORENSIC_MEDIA are already validated by step 3.
        //    This step protects top-level personal folders (DCIM, Pictures, WhatsApp, etc.)
        if (PathRules.isProtectedZone(c) && item.category != CleaningCategory.THUMBNAIL) {
            val isAndroidMedia = c.size >= 2 &&
                c[0].equals("Android", ignoreCase = true) &&
                c[1].equals("media", ignoreCase = true)

            if (!isAndroidMedia) {
                if (
                    item.category == CleaningCategory.APP_CACHE ||
                    item.category == CleaningCategory.CORPSE_LEFTOVER ||
                    item.category == CleaningCategory.FORENSIC_MEDIA
                ) {
                    refuse("Cache/leftover/forensic rules do not apply inside personal folders")
                }
            }
            if (item.isPreselected) refuse("Personal data can never be pre-selected")
        }
    }

    /**
     * Very strict allowlist for FORENSIC_MEDIA.
     * This does NOT allow arbitrary Android/data or Android/media cleanup.
     * It only allows the exact app-specific forensic paths produced by the forensic scanners.
     */
    private fun isKnownForensicPath(c: List<String>): Boolean {
        // Need at least: Android / area / package / subfolder / file
        if (c.size < 5) return false
        if (!c[0].equals("Android", ignoreCase = true)) return false

        val area = c[1]
        val pkg = c[2] // exact match: the folder name must be the package's real name
        val tail = c.drop(3)
        val lowerTail = tail.map { it.lowercase() }

        // Android/media/<pkg>/...
        if (area.equals("media", ignoreCase = true)) {
            return when (pkg) {
                "com.whatsapp", "com.whatsapp.w4b" -> {
                    lowerTail.hasPrefix("whatsapp", "media", ".statuses") ||
                    lowerTail.hasPrefix("whatsapp", "media", "whatsapp video", "sent") ||
                    lowerTail.hasPrefix("whatsapp", "media", "whatsapp images", "sent") ||
                    lowerTail.hasPrefix("whatsapp", "media", "whatsapp animated gifs", "sent") ||
                    (
                        lowerTail.hasPrefix("whatsapp", "databases") &&
                        tail.last().lowercase().startsWith("msgstore-")
                    )
                }
                "org.telegram.messenger",
                "org.telegram.messenger.web",
                "org.telegram.plus" -> {
                    lowerTail.hasPrefix("telegram", "telegram video") ||
                    lowerTail.hasPrefix("telegram", "telegram audio") ||
                    lowerTail.hasPrefix("telegram", "telegram images") ||
                    lowerTail.hasPrefix("telegram", "telegram documents")
                }
                else -> false
            }
        }

        // Android/data/<pkg>/...
        if (area.equals("data", ignoreCase = true)) {
            return when (pkg) {
                "com.zhiliaoapp.musically",
                "com.zhiliaoapp.musically.go" -> {
                    lowerTail.hasPrefix("cache") ||
                    lowerTail.hasPrefix("files", ".music")
                }
                "com.twitter.android",
                "com.twitter.android.lite" -> {
                    lowerTail.hasPrefix("cache")
                }
                "com.instagram.android",
                "com.instagram.lite" -> {
                    lowerTail.hasPrefix("cache")
                }
                else -> false
            }
        }

        return false
    }

    /**
     * The list must contain the full prefix AND at least one extra component after it.
     * Example:
     *   [telegram, telegram video, file.mp4] hasPrefix("telegram", "telegram video") = true
     *   [telegram, telegram video] hasPrefix("telegram", "telegram video") = false
     */
    private fun List<String>.hasPrefix(vararg prefix: String): Boolean {
        if (size != prefix.size + 1) return false
        return prefix.indices.all { index ->
            this[index].equals(prefix[index], ignoreCase = true)
        }
    }

    private fun refuse(message: String): Nothing = throw UnsafeDeletionException(message)
}
```

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.scanner

import com.cleanforge.core.backend.PackageInventory
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsOps
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsType
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.PathRules
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.StorageWalker
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ConfidenceLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.Reversibility
import com.cleanforge.core.model.RiskLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ScanItem
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.ensureActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flowOn

/**
 * Installer files. The platform parser (not a regex over binary XML, as the old code did) reads the real
 * package name and version. Evidence for MEDIUM: that package is installed at the same or a NEWER version.
 * Otherwise LOW (you may still want the installer). Unreadable APKs are skipped (could be mid-download).
 * Never pre-selected.
 */
class ApkScanner(
    private val fs: FsOps,
    private val inventory: PackageInventory,
    private val root: String = PathRules.ROOT
) : Scanner {
    override val id = "apk"
    override val displayName = "APK installers"
    override val requirement = Requirement.ALL_FILES_ACCESS
    override val mode = ScanMode.QUICK

    @Volatile private var incomplete: List<String> = emptyList()

    override fun incompleteReasons(): List<String> = incomplete

    override fun scan(): Flow<List<ScanItem>> = flow {
        incomplete = emptyList()
        val notes = WalkNotes()
        val batch = ArrayList<ScanItem>()
        var n = 0
        for (dir in listOf("Download", "Documents")) {
            for (e in StorageWalker(fs).walkNoting("$root/$dir", notes)) {
                if (++n % 128 == 0) currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
                if (e.stat.type != FsType.FILE) continue
                if (!e.name.endsWith(".apk", ignoreCase = true)) continue
                currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive() // parsing an APK is slow; stay responsive to cancellation
                val info = inventory.archiveInfo(e.path) ?: continue
                val installed = inventory.installedVersionCode(info.packageName)
                val sameOrNewerInstalled = installed != null && installed >= info.versionCode
                batch += ScanItem(
                    path = e.path,
                    sizeBytes = e.stat.size,
                    category = CleaningCategory.APK_FILE,
                    reasonForFlagging = if (sameOrNewerInstalled)
                        "Installer for ${info.packageName} v${info.versionCode}; the installed version " +
                            "(v$installed) is the same or newer."
                    else
                        "Installer for ${info.packageName} v${info.versionCode}. " +
                            (if (installed == null) "That app is not installed" else "Installed version is older (v$installed)") +
                            ", so you may still want this file.",
                    confidence = if (sameOrNewerInstalled) ConfidenceLevel.MEDIUM else ConfidenceLevel.LOW,
                    risk = RiskLevel.ELEVATED,
                    owningPackage = info.packageName,
                    deleteMode = DeleteMode.FILE,
                    reversibility = Reversibility.RE_DOWNLOADABLE,
                    lastModified = e.stat.mtimeMs,
                    fingerprint = e.stat
                )
                if (batch.size >= BATCH_SIZE) {
                    emit(batch.toList())
                    batch.clear()
                }
            }
        }
        incomplete = notes.reasons()
        if (batch.isNotEmpty()) emit(batch.toList())
    }.flowOn(Dispatchers.IO)
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/scanner/CacheScanner.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.scanner

import com.cleanforge.core.backend.FileReadBackend
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.FsResult
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.InstallState
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.MIN_PLAUSIBLE_PACKAGES
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.PackageInventory
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.reasonOrNull
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsType
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.PathRules
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ConfidenceLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ProtectedApps
import com.cleanforge.core.model.Reversibility
import com.cleanforge.core.model.RiskLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ScanItem
import com.cleanforge.core.model.SizeQuality
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.PrivilegedOperation
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.ensureActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flowOn

/**
 * Evidence for "safe to clear" (all of): the OS names Android/data/<pkg>/cache as that app's disposable external
 * cache (Context.getExternalCacheDir), AND <pkg> is CURRENTLY INSTALLED for this user. "Known to Android" is not
 * enough: a package uninstalled with its data kept is still known, but its folder is retained data, not a cache
 * of a running app, so it is never offered here (and CorpseScanner does not call it a leftover either).
 * Clears CONTENTS only; the folder stays.
 * Needs Shizuku because Android 11+ hides Android/data from normal apps, even with All-files access.
 *
 * Sizes are MEASURED logical bytes. If the walk was cut short or a sub-folder was unreadable the item says so
 * ([SizeQuality.LOWER_BOUND]). Anything that could not be checked is reported through [incompleteReasons]; an empty
 * result with reasons means "could not check", not "nothing to clean".
 */
class CacheScanner(
    private val backend: FileReadBackend,
    private val inventory: PackageInventory,
    private val root: String = PathRules.ROOT
) : Scanner {
    override val id = "cache"
    override val displayName = "App caches"
    override val requirement = Requirement.SHIZUKU
    override val mode = ScanMode.QUICK
    override val privilegedOperations = setOf(
        PrivilegedOperation.LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA,
        PrivilegedOperation.MEASURE_EXTERNAL_APP_DIR
    )

    @Volatile private var incomplete: List<String> = emptyList()

    override fun incompleteReasons(): List<String> = incomplete

    override fun scan(): Flow<List<ScanItem>> = flow {
        incomplete = emptyList()
        val known = inventory.knownPackageNames()
        if (known == null || known.size < MIN_PLAUSIBLE_PACKAGES) {
            incomplete = listOf("Android's list of installed apps could not be read or looks incomplete, so no app cache could be verified")
            return@flow
        }

        val dataRoot = "$root/Android/data"
        val listing = when (val r = backend.list(dataRoot)) {
            is FsResult.Ok -> r.value
            else -> {
                incomplete = listOf("Android/data could not be listed (${r.reasonOrNull() ?: "folder not found"})")
                return@flow
            }
        }

        var unclassified = 0
        var unmeasured = 0
        var stoppedBecause: String? = null
        val batch = ArrayList<ScanItem>()
        for (pkg in listing.names) {
            currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
            if (!PathRules.isValidPackageName(pkg) || pkg !in known) continue
            // `known` includes data-kept uninstalls (MATCH_UNINSTALLED_PACKAGES). Installed-ness is a separate question,
            // and a failed query is UNKNOWN, which must never be read as "installed".
            val state = inventory.installState(pkg)
            if (state == InstallState.UNKNOWN) {
                unclassified++
                continue
            }
            if (state != InstallState.INSTALLED) continue

            val cacheDir = "$dataRoot/$pkg/cache"
            val stat = backend.lstat(cacheDir)
            if (stat is FsResult.Unavailable) {
                stoppedBecause = stat.why
                break
            }
            if (stat !is FsResult.Ok) {
                if (stat !is FsResult.NotFound) unmeasured++ // NotFound: this app simply has no cache folder
                continue
            }
            val st = stat.value
            if (st.type != FsType.DIRECTORY) continue

            val sizeRes = backend.directorySize(cacheDir)
            if (sizeRes is FsResult.Unavailable) {
                stoppedBecause = sizeRes.why
                break
            }
            if (sizeRes !is FsResult.Ok) {
                unmeasured++
                continue
            }
            val size = sizeRes.value
            if (size.bytes <= 0L) {
                if (!size.isExact) unmeasured++ // could not see inside: unknown, not "empty"
                continue
            }
            val messaging = pkg in ProtectedApps.MESSAGING
            batch += ScanItem(
                path = cacheDir,
                sizeBytes = size.bytes,
                category = CleaningCategory.APP_CACHE,
                reasonForFlagging = "Android designates this as the disposable cache of $pkg, which is installed; the app rebuilds it " +
                    "and the system may clear it when space runs low." +
                    (if (messaging) " Messaging app: not pre-selected." else "") +
                    (if (size.isExact) "" else " The size is a lower bound: part of the folder could not be read or is very large."),
                confidence = if (messaging) ConfidenceLevel.MEDIUM else ConfidenceLevel.HIGH,
                risk = RiskLevel.SAFE,
                owningPackage = pkg,
                requiresShizuku = true,
                deleteMode = DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY,
                reversibility = Reversibility.TRIVIALLY_RECREATABLE,
                lastModified = st.mtimeMs,
                fingerprint = st,
                sizeQuality = if (size.isExact) SizeQuality.MEASURED else SizeQuality.LOWER_BOUND,
                unreadableCount = size.unreadable
            )
            if (batch.size >= BATCH_SIZE) {
                emit(batch.toList())
                batch.clear()
            }
        }

        val notes = ArrayList<String>()
        if (listing.truncated) notes += "Android/data has more folders than could be listed; some apps were not checked"
        if (unclassified > 0) notes += "$unclassified app(s) could not be classified as installed or not and were skipped"
        if (unmeasured > 0) notes += "$unmeasured cache folder(s) could not be examined or measured and were skipped"
        stoppedBecause?.let { notes += "The scan stopped early: $it" }
        incomplete = notes

        if (batch.isNotEmpty()) emit(batch.toList())
    }.flowOn(Dispatchers.IO)
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/scanner/CorpseScanner.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.scanner

import com.cleanforge.core.backend.FileReadBackend
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.FsResult
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.InstallState
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.MIN_PLAUSIBLE_PACKAGES
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.PackageInventory
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.reasonOrNull
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsType
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.PathRules
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ConfidenceLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.Reversibility
import com.cleanforge.core.model.RiskLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ScanItem
import com.cleanforge.core.model.SizeQuality
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.PrivilegedOperation
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.ensureActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flowOn

/**
 * Leftover folders of uninstalled apps. This can destroy game saves, so it is NEVER pre-selected and is
 * ELEVATED risk. Evidence required (all of): valid package-name folder, package unknown to the OS for the current
 * user/profile (a package uninstalled with its data kept is still "known", so it is NOT flagged) and not installed,
 * real directory (not a link), untouched for at least [minAgeDays].
 * The folder's existence is never evidence that the app is or is not installed; only the package manager decides,
 * and a failed package-manager query ([InstallState.UNKNOWN]) skips the folder instead of calling it a leftover.
 * If the package list cannot be read or looks implausibly small, NOTHING is flagged and the reason is reported.
 */
class CorpseScanner(
    private val backend: FileReadBackend,
    private val inventory: PackageInventory,
    private val root: String = PathRules.ROOT,
    private val nowMs: () -> Long = { System.currentTimeMillis() },
    private val minAgeDays: Int = 14
) : Scanner {
    override val id = "corpse"
    override val displayName = "Uninstalled-app leftovers"
    override val requirement = Requirement.SHIZUKU
    override val mode = ScanMode.QUICK
    override val privilegedOperations = setOf(
        PrivilegedOperation.LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA,
        PrivilegedOperation.MEASURE_EXTERNAL_APP_DIR
    )

    @Volatile private var incomplete: List<String> = emptyList()

    override fun incompleteReasons(): List<String> = incomplete

    override fun scan(): Flow<List<ScanItem>> = flow {
        incomplete = emptyList()
        val known = inventory.knownPackageNames()
        if (known == null || known.size < MIN_PLAUSIBLE_PACKAGES) {
            incomplete = listOf("Android's list of installed apps could not be read or looks incomplete, so no leftover could be verified")
            return@flow
        }
        // Shared storage is case-insensitive: a folder spelled differently from a known package is still that package.
        val knownLower = known.mapTo(HashSet<String>()) { it.lowercase() }

        val notes = ArrayList<String>()
        var unclassified = 0
        var unmeasured = 0
        var stoppedBecause: String? = null
        val batch = ArrayList<ScanItem>()
        areas@ for (area in listOf("data", "obb")) {
            val areaRoot = "$root/Android/$area"
            val listing = when (val r = backend.list(areaRoot)) {
                is FsResult.Ok -> r.value
                else -> {
                    notes += "Android/$area could not be listed (${r.reasonOrNull() ?: "folder not found"})"
                    continue@areas
                }
            }
            if (listing.truncated) notes += "Android/$area has more folders than could be listed; some were not checked"
            for (pkg in listing.names) {
                currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
                if (!PathRules.isValidPackageName(pkg) || pkg in known || pkg.lowercase() in knownLower) continue
                // Only an authoritative NOT_KNOWN may become a leftover. INSTALLED / data-kept are never leftovers and
                // UNKNOWN (query failed) must not be read as "not installed".
                val state = inventory.installState(pkg)
                if (state == InstallState.UNKNOWN) {
                    unclassified++
                    continue
                }
                if (state != InstallState.NOT_KNOWN) continue

                val dir = "$areaRoot/$pkg"
                val stat = backend.lstat(dir)
                if (stat is FsResult.Unavailable) {
                    stoppedBecause = stat.why
                    break@areas
                }
                if (stat !is FsResult.Ok) {
                    if (stat !is FsResult.NotFound) unmeasured++
                    continue
                }
                val st = stat.value
                if (st.type != FsType.DIRECTORY) continue
                val ageDays = (nowMs() - st.mtimeMs) / DAY_MS
                if (ageDays < minAgeDays) continue

                val sizeRes = backend.directorySize(dir)
                if (sizeRes is FsResult.Unavailable) {
                    stoppedBecause = sizeRes.why
                    break@areas
                }
                if (sizeRes !is FsResult.Ok) {
                    unmeasured++
                    continue
                }
                val size = sizeRes.value
                if (size.bytes <= 0L) {
                    if (!size.isExact) unmeasured++
                    continue
                }
                batch += ScanItem(
                    path = dir,
                    sizeBytes = size.bytes,
                    category = CleaningCategory.CORPSE_LEFTOVER,
                    reasonForFlagging = "Android lists no app named $pkg for this user profile, neither installed nor uninstalled with data kept; " +
                        "this Android/$area folder was last changed $ageDays days ago. " +
                        "It may still hold game saves or downloads you could want if you reinstall." +
                        (if (size.isExact) "" else " The size is a lower bound: part of the folder could not be read or is very large."),
                    confidence = ConfidenceLevel.MEDIUM,
                    risk = RiskLevel.ELEVATED,
                    owningPackage = pkg,
                    requiresShizuku = true,
                    deleteMode = DeleteMode.TREE,
                    reversibility = Reversibility.NOT_REVERSIBLE,
                    lastModified = st.mtimeMs,
                    fingerprint = st,
                    sizeQuality = if (size.isExact) SizeQuality.MEASURED else SizeQuality.LOWER_BOUND,
                    unreadableCount = size.unreadable
                )
                if (batch.size >= BATCH_SIZE) {
                    emit(batch.toList())
                    batch.clear()
                }
            }
        }

        if (unclassified > 0) notes += "$unclassified folder(s) could not be matched against installed apps and were skipped"
        if (unmeasured > 0) notes += "$unmeasured folder(s) could not be examined or measured and were skipped"
        stoppedBecause?.let { notes += "The scan stopped early: $it" }
        incomplete = notes

        if (batch.isNotEmpty()) emit(batch.toList())
    }.flowOn(Dispatchers.IO)
}
```
