## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/scanner/DuplicateScanner.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.scanner

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsOps
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsType
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.PathRules
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.StorageWalker
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.WalkLimits
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ConfidenceLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.Reversibility
import com.cleanforge.core.model.RiskLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ScanItem
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.ensureActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flowOn
import java.io.FileInputStream
import java.io.IOException
import java.security.MessageDigest

/**
 * Staged and bounded: (1) group by exact size, files >= [minBytes] only; (2) SHA-256 of the first 64 KB;
 * (3) full SHA-256 only for the survivors. Hard links to the same inode are not "duplicates" (deleting one
 * frees nothing).
 *
 * EVERY copy of a group is listed (oldest first, purely so the list reads the same on each scan; age says
 * nothing about which copy the user values). The scanner never decides which copy stays. The user ticks the copies
 * to delete; PlanBuilder then pins one copy the user left UNTICKED as the keeper (with its scan-time fingerprint),
 * refuses to plan a group whose every copy is ticked, and CleaningEngine refuses to delete a duplicate unless that
 * kept copy is still intact.
 * On demand only (hashing is the heaviest work in the app). Never pre-selected.
 */
class DuplicateScanner(
    private val fs: FsOps,
    private val root: String = PathRules.ROOT,
    private val minBytes: Long = 1024L * 1024L
) : Scanner {
    override val id = "duplicates"
    override val displayName = "Duplicate files"
    override val requirement = Requirement.ALL_FILES_ACCESS
    override val mode = ScanMode.ON_DEMAND

    private val limits = WalkLimits(maxDepth = 32, maxEntries = 100_000)

    @Volatile private var incomplete: List<String> = emptyList()

    override fun incompleteReasons(): List<String> = incomplete

    override fun scan(): Flow<List<ScanItem>> = flow {
        incomplete = emptyList()
        val notes = WalkNotes()
        // Pass 1: size groups.
        val bySize = HashMap<Long, MutableList<StorageWalker.Entry>>()
        var n = 0
        for (dir in LargeFileScanner.ROOTS) {
            for (e in StorageWalker(fs).walkNoting("$root/$dir", notes, limits = limits)) {
                if (++n % 256 == 0) currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
                if (e.stat.type != FsType.FILE || e.stat.size < minBytes) continue
                bySize.getOrPut(e.stat.size) { ArrayList() } += e
            }
        }

        incomplete = notes.reasons() // the walking is done; hashing below cannot add to it

        // Pass 2: partial hash among same-size files that are not the same inode.
        val byPartial = HashMap<String, MutableList<StorageWalker.Entry>>()
        for ((size, group) in bySize) {
            if (group.size < 2) continue
            if (group.map { it.stat.dev to it.stat.ino }.toSet().size < 2) continue
            for (e in group) {
                val h = sha256(e.path, PARTIAL_BYTES) ?: continue
                byPartial.getOrPut("$size:$h") { ArrayList() } += e
            }
        }

        // Pass 3: full hash.
        val byFull = HashMap<String, MutableList<StorageWalker.Entry>>()
        for ((key, group) in byPartial) {
            if (group.size < 2) continue
            for (e in group) {
                val h = sha256(e.path, Long.MAX_VALUE) ?: continue
                byFull.getOrPut("${key.substringBefore(':')}:$h") { ArrayList() } += e
            }
        }

        val batch = ArrayList<ScanItem>()
        var groupIdx = 0
        for (group in byFull.values) {
            if (group.size < 2) continue
            // Distinct inodes only. Oldest first only for a stable display order, NOT a preference.
            val distinct = group.distinctBy { it.stat.dev to it.stat.ino }
            if (distinct.size < 2) continue
            val ordered = distinct.sortedWith(
                compareBy<StorageWalker.Entry> { it.stat.mtimeMs }.thenBy { it.path.length }.thenBy { it.path }
            )
            val groupId = "dup_${groupIdx++}"
            for (copy in ordered) {
                val others = ordered.filter { it.path != copy.path }
                val shown = others.take(MAX_SHOWN_OTHERS).joinToString("; ") { it.path.removePrefix(root) }
                val more = if (others.size > MAX_SHOWN_OTHERS) " (+${others.size - MAX_SHOWN_OTHERS} more)" else ""
                batch += ScanItem(
                    path = copy.path,
                    sizeBytes = copy.stat.size,
                    category = CleaningCategory.DUPLICATE,
                    reasonForFlagging = "Byte-identical (SHA-256) to ${others.size} other " +
                        (if (others.size == 1) "copy" else "copies") + ": $shown$more. " +
                        "CleanForge does not guess which copy you want: tick the one(s) to delete. " +
                        "At least one copy always stays.",
                    confidence = ConfidenceLevel.MEDIUM,
                    risk = RiskLevel.ELEVATED,
                    deleteMode = DeleteMode.FILE,
                    reversibility = Reversibility.NOT_REVERSIBLE,
                    lastModified = copy.stat.mtimeMs,
                    groupId = groupId,
                    fingerprint = copy.stat
                    // keepPath / keepFingerprint stay null on purpose: the survivor is chosen at PLAN time
                    // from the copies the user did not tick.
                )
                if (batch.size >= BATCH_SIZE) {
                    emit(batch.toList())
                    batch.clear()
                }
            }
        }
        if (batch.isNotEmpty()) emit(batch.toList())
    }.flowOn(Dispatchers.IO)

    private suspend fun sha256(path: String, limitBytes: Long): String? {
        return try {
            val md = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
            FileInputStream(path).use { ins ->
                val buf = ByteArray(64 * 1024)
                var remaining = limitBytes
                while (remaining > 0) {
                    val want = if (remaining < buf.size) remaining.toInt() else buf.size
                    val r = ins.read(buf, 0, want)
                    if (r < 0) break
                    md.update(buf, 0, r)
                    remaining -= r
                    currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
                }
            }
            md.digest().joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
        } catch (e: IOException) {
            null
        } catch (e: SecurityException) {
            null
        }
    }

    private companion object {
        const val PARTIAL_BYTES = 64L * 1024L
        const val MAX_SHOWN_OTHERS = 3
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/scanner/EmptyDirectoryScanner.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.scanner

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsOps
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsType
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.PathRules
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.StorageWalker
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ConfidenceLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.Reversibility
import com.cleanforge.core.model.RiskLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ScanItem
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.ensureActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flowOn

/**
 * Folders that are verifiably empty RIGHT NOW (zero entries, hidden files such as .nomedia count as entries).
 * Only NESTED folders are listed (never Download/DCIM/Pictures/... themselves) and hidden folders are skipped.
 * Frees 0 bytes: tidy-up only. Deletion uses rmdir, which the OS refuses if anything appeared meanwhile.
 */
class EmptyDirectoryScanner(
    private val fs: FsOps,
    private val root: String = PathRules.ROOT
) : Scanner {
    override val id = "empty_dirs"
    override val displayName = "Empty folders"
    override val requirement = Requirement.ALL_FILES_ACCESS
    override val mode = ScanMode.ON_DEMAND

    @Volatile private var incomplete: List<String> = emptyList()

    override fun incompleteReasons(): List<String> = incomplete

    override fun scan(): Flow<List<ScanItem>> = flow {
        incomplete = emptyList()
        val notes = WalkNotes()
        val batch = ArrayList<ScanItem>()
        var n = 0
        for (dir in listOf("Download", "Documents", "Pictures", "Movies")) {
            val walker = StorageWalker(fs)
            for (e in walker.walkNoting("$root/$dir", notes, skipDir = { it.substringAfterLast('/').startsWith(".") })) {
                if (++n % 256 == 0) currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
                if (e.stat.type != FsType.DIRECTORY || e.name.startsWith(".")) continue
                val children = fs.list(e.path)
                if (children == null) { // cannot look inside: unknown, not "empty"
                    notes.onUnreadable()
                    continue
                }
                if (children.isNotEmpty()) continue
                batch += ScanItem(
                    path = e.path,
                    sizeBytes = 0L,
                    category = CleaningCategory.EMPTY_DIRECTORY,
                    reasonForFlagging = "Contains nothing at all. Removing it frees no space; apps recreate folders they need.",
                    confidence = ConfidenceLevel.MEDIUM,
                    risk = RiskLevel.SAFE,
                    deleteMode = DeleteMode.EMPTY_DIR,
                    reversibility = Reversibility.TRIVIALLY_RECREATABLE,
                    lastModified = e.stat.mtimeMs,
                    fingerprint = e.stat
                )
                if (batch.size >= BATCH_SIZE) {
                    emit(batch.toList())
                    batch.clear()
                }
            }
        }
        incomplete = notes.reasons()
        if (batch.isNotEmpty()) emit(batch.toList())
    }.flowOn(Dispatchers.IO)
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/scanner/ForensicFolderScanner.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.scanner

import com.cleanforge.core.backend.FileReadBackend
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.FsResult
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.InstallState
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.PackageInventory
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsStat
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsType
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ConfidenceLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ProtectedApps
import com.cleanforge.core.model.Reversibility
import com.cleanforge.core.model.RiskLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ScanItem
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.ensureActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flowOn

/**
 * Shared engine of the Part 3 forensic scanners. A subclass only declares WHICH packages and WHICH exact folders;
 * everything that can go wrong (install state, unreadable folders, cancellation, batching) is handled here once.
 *
 * Evidence for an item (all of): the owning package is INSTALLED right now (tri-state [InstallState], never a bare
 * boolean), the file is a direct child of one allowlisted folder, and it is older than that folder's threshold.
 * Only regular files are ever proposed (DeleteMode.FILE); sub-folders are counted and reported, never proposed.
 *
 * Anything that could not be checked is reported through [incompleteReasons]: an empty result with reasons means
 * "could not check", not "nothing to clean". Nothing here is ever pre-selected ([ScanItem.isPreselected] is derived
 * and is false for FORENSIC_MEDIA).
 */
abstract class ForensicFolderScanner(
    private val backend: FileReadBackend,
    private val inventory: PackageInventory,
    private val timeProvider: () -> Long
) : Scanner {

    /** One allowlisted folder. Only its direct child FILES are considered. */
    protected class Target(
        val dir: String,
        val reason: String,
        val minAgeMs: Long,
        val confidence: ConfidenceLevel,
        val risk: RiskLevel,
        /** Only names that pass are considered at all. */
        val nameFilter: (String) -> Boolean = { true },
        /** The newest N files that pass [nameFilter] are never proposed, whatever their age. */
        val keepNewest: Int = 0
    )

    /** Packages to look at, in order. Each one is scanned only if it is installed. */
    protected abstract val packages: List<String>

    /** Absolute folders to inspect for [pkg]. */
    protected abstract fun targets(pkg: String): List<Target>

    @Volatile private var incomplete: List<String> = emptyList()

    override fun incompleteReasons(): List<String> = incomplete

    private val needsShizuku: Boolean get() = requirement == Requirement.SHIZUKU

    override fun scan(): Flow<List<ScanItem>> = flow {
        incomplete = emptyList()
        val now = timeProvider()
        val batch = ArrayList<ScanItem>()
        val notes = ArrayList<String>()
        var unclassified = 0
        var unreadable = 0
        var skippedNonFiles = 0
        var truncated = false
        var stoppedBecause: String? = null

        packageLoop@ for (pkg in packages) {
            currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
            when (inventory.installState(pkg)) {
                InstallState.INSTALLED -> Unit
                InstallState.UNKNOWN -> {
                    unclassified++
                    continue@packageLoop
                }
                else -> continue@packageLoop // not installed: nothing of this app is ours to look at
            }

            for (target in targets(pkg)) {
                currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
                val listing = when (val r = backend.list(target.dir)) {
                    is FsResult.Ok -> r.value
                    FsResult.NotFound -> continue // this app simply has no such folder
                    is FsResult.Unavailable -> {
                        stoppedBecause = r.why
                        break@packageLoop
                    }
                    else -> {
                        unreadable++
                        continue
                    }
                }
                if (listing.truncated) truncated = true

                val candidates = ArrayList<Pair<String, FsStat>>()
                for (name in listing.names) {
                    currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
                    if (!target.nameFilter(name)) continue
                    val path = "${target.dir}/$name"
                    when (val s = backend.lstat(path)) {
                        is FsResult.Ok ->
                            if (s.value.type == FsType.FILE) candidates += path to s.value else skippedNonFiles++
                        FsResult.NotFound -> Unit // vanished between list and stat
                        is FsResult.Unavailable -> {
                            stoppedBecause = s.why
                            break@packageLoop
                        }
                        else -> unreadable++
                    }
                }

                val proposable = candidates
                    .sortedByDescending { (_, st) -> st.mtimeMs }
                    .drop(target.keepNewest)

                for ((path, st) in proposable) {
                    val age = now - st.mtimeMs
                    if (age < target.minAgeMs) continue // also drops files dated in the future
                    batch += ScanItem(
                        path = path,
                        sizeBytes = st.size,
                        category = CleaningCategory.FORENSIC_MEDIA,
                        reasonForFlagging = reasonFor(target, pkg, age),
                        confidence = target.confidence,
                        risk = target.risk,
                        owningPackage = pkg,
                        requiresShizuku = needsShizuku,
                        deleteMode = DeleteMode.FILE,
                        reversibility = Reversibility.NOT_REVERSIBLE,
                        lastModified = st.mtimeMs,
                        fingerprint = st
                    )
                    if (batch.size >= BATCH_SIZE) {
                        emit(batch.toList())
                        batch.clear()
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (unclassified > 0) notes += "$unclassified app(s) could not be classified as installed or not and were skipped"
        if (unreadable > 0) notes += "$unreadable folder(s) or file(s) could not be read and were skipped"
        if (skippedNonFiles > 0) notes += "$skippedNonFiles sub-folder(s) were not examined (only single files are offered)"
        if (truncated) notes += "A folder has more entries than could be listed; some files were not checked"
        stoppedBecause?.let { notes += "The scan stopped early: $it" }
        incomplete = notes

        if (batch.isNotEmpty()) emit(batch.toList())
    }.flowOn(Dispatchers.IO)

    private fun reasonFor(target: Target, pkg: String, ageMs: Long): String = buildString {
        append(target.reason)
        if (target.minAgeMs > 0) append(" Last changed ${ageMs / DAY_MS} day(s) ago.")
        if (pkg in ProtectedApps.MESSAGING) append(" Messaging app: never pre-selected.")
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/scanner/LargeFileScanner.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.scanner

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsOps
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsType
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.PathRules
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.StorageWalker
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ConfidenceLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.Reversibility
import com.cleanforge.core.model.RiskLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ScanItem
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.ensureActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flowOn
import java.util.PriorityQueue

/**
 * Finds big files so YOU can decide. Large does not mean junk: confidence UNKNOWN, risk DANGEROUS,
 * never pre-selected. Keeps only the [topN] largest in a bounded heap, so memory stays flat.
 */
class LargeFileScanner(
    private val fs: FsOps,
    private val root: String = PathRules.ROOT,
    private val thresholdBytes: Long = 100L * 1024 * 1024,
    private val topN: Int = 200
) : Scanner {
    override val id = "large_files"
    override val displayName = "Large files"
    override val requirement = Requirement.ALL_FILES_ACCESS
    override val mode = ScanMode.ON_DEMAND

    @Volatile private var incomplete: List<String> = emptyList()

    override fun incompleteReasons(): List<String> = incomplete

    override fun scan(): Flow<List<ScanItem>> = flow {
        incomplete = emptyList()
        val notes = WalkNotes()
        val heap = PriorityQueue<ScanItem>(compareBy<ScanItem> { it.sizeBytes })
        var n = 0
        for (dir in ROOTS) {
            for (e in StorageWalker(fs).walkNoting("$root/$dir", notes)) {
                if (++n % 256 == 0) currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
                if (e.stat.type != FsType.FILE || e.stat.size < thresholdBytes) continue
                heap.add(
                    ScanItem(
                        path = e.path,
                        sizeBytes = e.stat.size,
                        category = CleaningCategory.LARGE_FILE,
                        reasonForFlagging = "Large file. Size alone does not mean it is unneeded; " +
                            "open it and decide for yourself.",
                        confidence = ConfidenceLevel.UNKNOWN,
                        risk = RiskLevel.DANGEROUS,
                        deleteMode = DeleteMode.FILE,
                        reversibility = Reversibility.NOT_REVERSIBLE,
                        lastModified = e.stat.mtimeMs,
                        fingerprint = e.stat
                    )
                )
                if (heap.size > topN) heap.poll()
            }
        }
        incomplete = notes.reasons()
        if (heap.isNotEmpty()) emit(heap.sortedByDescending { it.sizeBytes })
    }.flowOn(Dispatchers.IO)

    companion object {
        val ROOTS = listOf("Download", "DCIM", "Pictures", "Movies", "Documents", "Music")
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/scanner/LogScanner.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.scanner

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsOps
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsType
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.PathRules
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.StorageWalker
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ConfidenceLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.Reversibility
import com.cleanforge.core.model.RiskLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ScanItem
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.ensureActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flowOn
import java.io.FileInputStream
import java.io.IOException

/**
 * ".log" alone proves nothing. Evidence required (all): .log extension, real file, not modified for
 * [minAgeDays] days, and the first bytes actually look like line-oriented text. Only Download/ is scanned
 * (Documents is personal). Confidence is capped at LOW; always manual review, never pre-selected.
 */
class LogScanner(
    private val fs: FsOps,
    private val root: String = PathRules.ROOT,
    private val nowMs: () -> Long = { System.currentTimeMillis() },
    private val minAgeDays: Int = 30
) : Scanner {
    override val id = "logs"
    override val displayName = "Old log files"
    override val requirement = Requirement.ALL_FILES_ACCESS
    override val mode = ScanMode.ON_DEMAND

    @Volatile private var incomplete: List<String> = emptyList()

    override fun incompleteReasons(): List<String> = incomplete

    override fun scan(): Flow<List<ScanItem>> = flow {
        incomplete = emptyList()
        val notes = WalkNotes()
        val batch = ArrayList<ScanItem>()
        var n = 0
        for (e in StorageWalker(fs).walkNoting("$root/Download", notes)) {
            if (++n % 256 == 0) currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
            if (e.stat.type != FsType.FILE || e.stat.size <= 0L) continue
            if (!e.name.endsWith(".log", ignoreCase = true)) continue
            val ageDays = (nowMs() - e.stat.mtimeMs) / DAY_MS
            if (ageDays < minAgeDays) continue
            val head = readHead(e.path)
            if (head == null) { // unreadable: could not be checked, so it is not proposed
                notes.onUnreadable()
                continue
            }
            if (!looksLikeText(head)) continue
            batch += ScanItem(
                path = e.path,
                sizeBytes = e.stat.size,
                category = CleaningCategory.LOG_FILE,
                reasonForFlagging = "Text log file, not modified for $ageDays days. " +
                    "It may still contain something you want to keep.",
                confidence = ConfidenceLevel.LOW,
                risk = RiskLevel.ELEVATED,
                deleteMode = DeleteMode.FILE,
                reversibility = Reversibility.NOT_REVERSIBLE,
                lastModified = e.stat.mtimeMs,
                fingerprint = e.stat
            )
            if (batch.size >= BATCH_SIZE) {
                emit(batch.toList())
                batch.clear()
            }
        }
        incomplete = notes.reasons()
        if (batch.isNotEmpty()) emit(batch.toList())
    }.flowOn(Dispatchers.IO)

    private fun readHead(path: String): ByteArray? = try {
        FileInputStream(path).use { ins ->
            val buf = ByteArray(HEAD_BYTES)
            var off = 0
            while (off < buf.size) {
                val r = ins.read(buf, off, buf.size - off)
                if (r < 0) break
                off += r
            }
            buf.copyOf(off)
        }
    } catch (e: IOException) {
        null
    } catch (e: SecurityException) {
        null
    }

    companion object {
        const val HEAD_BYTES = 2048

        /** >= 95% printable/whitespace/UTF-8 bytes, no NUL, and at least one line break. */
        fun looksLikeText(head: ByteArray): Boolean {
            if (head.isEmpty()) return false
            var ok = 0
            var newline = false
            for (b in head) {
                val v = b.toInt() and 0xff
                if (v == 0) return false
                if (v == 0x0a) newline = true
                if (v == 0x09 || v == 0x0a || v == 0x0d || (v in 0x20..0x7e) || v >= 0x80) ok++
            }
            return newline && ok * 100 >= head.size * 95
        }
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/scanner/Scanner.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.scanner

import com.cleanforge.core.model.ScanItem
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.PrivilegedOperation
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow

enum class Requirement { NONE, ALL_FILES_ACCESS, SHIZUKU }

/** QUICK scanners run on "Scan"; ON_DEMAND ones are heavier and only run when the user asks. */
enum class ScanMode { QUICK, ON_DEMAND }

/**
 * A scanner CLASSIFIES: every item it emits must carry the evidence that justifies it.
 * Filename, extension, or directory name alone is never accepted as evidence.
 */
interface Scanner {
    val id: String
    val displayName: String
    val requirement: Requirement
    val mode: ScanMode

    /** Privileged operations this scanner needs when [requirement] is [Requirement.SHIZUKU]. */
    val privilegedOperations: Set<PrivilegedOperation> get() = emptySet()

    /** Emits batches so memory stays bounded on low-end devices. */
    fun scan(): Flow<List<ScanItem>>

    /**
     * Why the result of the LAST completed [scan] may be incomplete: a failed listing, skipped items, a lower-bound
     * size. Empty means nothing was left out. An empty result with a non-empty reason list is "could not check", never
     * "nothing found". Read it after the flow has completed.
     */
    fun incompleteReasons(): List<String> = emptyList()
}

internal const val BATCH_SIZE = 50
internal const val DAY_MS = 24L * 60L * 60L * 1000L
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/scanner/TempScanner.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.scanner

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsOps
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsType
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.PathRules
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.StorageWalker
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ConfidenceLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.Reversibility
import com.cleanforge.core.model.RiskLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ScanItem
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.ensureActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flowOn

/**
 * Abandoned partial downloads in Download/. Evidence = a browser/downloader partial-file extension
 * AND not modified for [minAgeDays] days. A bare ".tmp"/".bak" is NOT enough and ".bak" is never flagged
 * (backups are user data). DCIM/Pictures are never scanned. Never pre-selected.
 */
class TempScanner(
    private val fs: FsOps,
    private val root: String = PathRules.ROOT,
    private val nowMs: () -> Long = { System.currentTimeMillis() },
    private val minAgeDays: Int = 7
) : Scanner {
    override val id = "partial_downloads"
    override val displayName = "Incomplete downloads"
    override val requirement = Requirement.ALL_FILES_ACCESS
    override val mode = ScanMode.QUICK

    @Volatile private var incomplete: List<String> = emptyList()

    override fun incompleteReasons(): List<String> = incomplete

    override fun scan(): Flow<List<ScanItem>> = flow {
        incomplete = emptyList()
        val notes = WalkNotes()
        val batch = ArrayList<ScanItem>()
        var n = 0
        for (e in StorageWalker(fs).walkNoting("$root/Download", notes)) {
            if (++n % 256 == 0) currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
            if (e.stat.type != FsType.FILE || e.stat.size <= 0L) continue
            val ext = e.name.substringAfterLast('.', "").lowercase()
            val strong = ext in STRONG_PARTIAL_EXT
            if (!strong && ext !in WEAK_PARTIAL_EXT) continue
            val ageDays = (nowMs() - e.stat.mtimeMs) / DAY_MS
            if (ageDays < minAgeDays) continue
            batch += ScanItem(
                path = e.path,
                sizeBytes = e.stat.size,
                category = CleaningCategory.TEMP_FILE,
                reasonForFlagging = (if (strong) "Partial-download file (.$ext)" else "Temporary-style file (.$ext)") +
                    " in Downloads, untouched for $ageDays days. Contents were not inspected.",
                confidence = if (strong) ConfidenceLevel.MEDIUM else ConfidenceLevel.LOW,
                risk = RiskLevel.ELEVATED,
                deleteMode = DeleteMode.FILE,
                reversibility = Reversibility.RE_DOWNLOADABLE,
                lastModified = e.stat.mtimeMs,
                fingerprint = e.stat
            )
            if (batch.size >= BATCH_SIZE) {
                emit(batch.toList())
                batch.clear()
            }
        }
        incomplete = notes.reasons()
        if (batch.isNotEmpty()) emit(batch.toList())
    }.flowOn(Dispatchers.IO)

    companion object {
        val STRONG_PARTIAL_EXT = setOf("crdownload", "part", "partial")
        val WEAK_PARTIAL_EXT = setOf("tmp", "download")
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/scanner/ThumbnailScanner.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.scanner

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsOps
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsProbe
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsType
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.PathRules
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.StorageWalker
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ConfidenceLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.Reversibility
import com.cleanforge.core.model.RiskLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ScanItem
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.ensureActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flowOn

/**
 * The folder NAME alone is not evidence. Flagged only if the folder is a real directory that contains
 * only small regular files (<= 2 MB each) and no sub-folders, i.e. it looks like a thumbnail cache and
 * not like someone's album. Never pre-selected.
 */
class ThumbnailScanner(
    private val fs: FsOps,
    private val root: String = PathRules.ROOT
) : Scanner {
    override val id = "thumbnails"
    override val displayName = "Thumbnail cache"
    override val requirement = Requirement.ALL_FILES_ACCESS
    override val mode = ScanMode.QUICK

    @Volatile private var incomplete: List<String> = emptyList()

    override fun incompleteReasons(): List<String> = incomplete

    override fun scan(): Flow<List<ScanItem>> = flow {
        incomplete = emptyList()
        val dir = "$root/DCIM/.thumbnails"
        val st = when (val p = fs.probe(dir)) {
            is FsProbe.Found -> p.stat
            FsProbe.Missing -> return@flow // no such folder: nothing to report
            FsProbe.Denied, FsProbe.Error -> {
                incomplete = listOf("The thumbnail folder could not be examined")
                return@flow
            }
        }
        if (st.type != FsType.DIRECTORY) return@flow

        var files = 0
        var bytes = 0L
        var looksLikeCache = true
        val notes = WalkNotes()
        val walker = StorageWalker(fs)
        // "Only small files, no sub-folders" must be KNOWN to hold: a part that was cut off or could not be read is
        // unknown, so the folder is not called a cache.
        val entries = walker.walk(
            dir,
            onTruncated = { looksLikeCache = false; notes.onTruncated() },
            onUnreadable = { looksLikeCache = false; notes.onUnreadable() }
        )
        for (e in entries) {
            if ((files + 1) % 256 == 0) currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
            if (e.stat.type != FsType.FILE || e.stat.size > MAX_THUMB_BYTES) {
                looksLikeCache = false
                break
            }
            files++
            bytes += e.stat.size
        }
        incomplete = notes.reasons()
        if (!looksLikeCache || files == 0 || bytes <= 0L) return@flow

        emit(
            listOf(
                ScanItem(
                    path = dir,
                    sizeBytes = bytes,
                    category = CleaningCategory.THUMBNAIL,
                    reasonForFlagging = "Legacy gallery thumbnail folder: $files small files (none over 2 MB), " +
                        "no sub-folders. Gallery apps rebuild thumbnails when needed.",
                    confidence = ConfidenceLevel.MEDIUM,
                    risk = RiskLevel.SAFE,
                    deleteMode = DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY,
                    reversibility = Reversibility.TRIVIALLY_RECREATABLE,
                    lastModified = st.mtimeMs,
                    fingerprint = st
                )
            )
        )
    }.flowOn(Dispatchers.IO)

    private companion object {
        const val MAX_THUMB_BYTES = 2L * 1024 * 1024
    }
}
```

```kotlin
/**

 * DORMANT: not registered in the scanner set. These items live in Android/data, so the Shizuku service would have to delete

 * FORENSIC_MEDIA). Registering this scanner before that exists would list items that can only ever be skipped.

class TikTokScanner(

    inventory: PackageInventory,

    override val mode = ScanMode.ON_DEMAND

    override val packages = listOf("com.zhiliaoapp.musically", "com.zhiliaoapp.musically.go")

    override fun targets(pkg: String): List<Target> = listOf(

            dir = "$storage/Android/data/$pkg/files/.music",
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/scanner/WalkNotes.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.scanner

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.StorageWalker
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.WalkLimits

/**
 * Collects why a filesystem walk may have missed something, for [Scanner.incompleteReasons]. An empty result with
 * reasons means "could not check everything", never "nothing found".
 */
internal class WalkNotes {
    private var wasTruncated = false
    private var unreadable = 0

    fun onTruncated() {
        wasTruncated = true
    }

    fun onUnreadable() {
        unreadable++
    }

    fun reasons(): List<String> = buildList {
        if (wasTruncated) add("A folder is deeper or larger than the scan limit; some files were not checked")
        if (unreadable > 0) {
            add("$unreadable item(s) could not be read, or sit on another storage volume, and were skipped")
        }
    }
}

/** [StorageWalker.walk] that records truncation and unreadable entries in [notes]. */
internal fun StorageWalker.walkNoting(
    root: String,
    notes: WalkNotes,
    skipDir: (String) -> Boolean = { false },
    limits: WalkLimits = WalkLimits()
): Sequence<StorageWalker.Entry> = walk(root, limits, skipDir, notes::onTruncated, notes::onUnreadable)
```

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.scanner

import com.cleanforge.core.backend.FileReadBackend
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.PackageInventory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ConfidenceLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.RiskLevel
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

/**
 * WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business, whichever is installed (both, if both are). Only the exact folders below are looked
 * at, and only single files in them; everything else in WhatsApp's folders is the user's chat data and is left alone.
 * The same allowlist is enforced a second time by SafetyValidator, so a scanner bug cannot widen it.
 */
class WhatsAppScanner(
    backend: FileReadBackend,
    inventory: PackageInventory,
    private val storage: String,
    timeProvider: () -> Long = { System.currentTimeMillis() }
) : ForensicFolderScanner(backend, inventory, timeProvider) {

    override val id = "whatsapp_forensics"
    override val displayName = "WhatsApp Forensics"

    // Android/media is reachable with All-files access; no Shizuku needed.
    override val requirement = Requirement.ALL_FILES_ACCESS
    override val mode = ScanMode.ON_DEMAND

    override val packages = listOf("com.whatsapp", "com.whatsapp.w4b")

    override fun targets(pkg: String): List<Target> {
        val whatsapp = "$storage/Android/media/$pkg/WhatsApp"
        val media = "$whatsapp/Media"

        // Sent media is a copy WhatsApp kept; it is the only copy if the user never saved it to the Gallery.
        fun sent(folder: String, what: String) = Target(
            dir = "$media/$folder/Sent",
            reason = "$what that WhatsApp kept when you sent it. It may be the only copy if it is not in your Gallery.",
            minAgeMs = 0L,
            confidence = ConfidenceLevel.MEDIUM,
            risk = RiskLevel.ELEVATED
        )

        return listOf(
            Target(
                dir = "$media/.Statuses",
                reason = "A WhatsApp Status that expired more than 24 hours ago.",
                minAgeMs = TimeUnit.HOURS.toMillis(24),
                confidence = ConfidenceLevel.HIGH,
                risk = RiskLevel.SAFE
            ),
            sent("WhatsApp Video", "A video"),
            sent("WhatsApp Images", "An image"),
            sent("WhatsApp Animated Gifs", "An animated GIF"),
            Target(
                dir = "$whatsapp/Databases",
                reason = "An old WhatsApp chat backup. The newest backup is always kept.",
                minAgeMs = TimeUnit.DAYS.toMillis(7),
                confidence = ConfidenceLevel.MEDIUM,
                risk = RiskLevel.ELEVATED,
                // Dated backups only ("msgstore-2026-08-01..."): never the live "msgstore.db.crypt14" or wa.db.
                nameFilter = { it.startsWith("msgstore-") },
                keepNewest = 1
            )
        )
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/shizuku/AidlPrivilegedFileApi.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.shizuku

import android.os.DeadObjectException
import android.os.RemoteException
import android.os.TransactionTooLargeException
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteResult
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsStat
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.ListReply
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.PrivilegedFileApi
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.SizeReply
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.StatReply
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.TransportException
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.WireCodec
import com.cleanforge.shizuku.IFileService

/**
 * The thin, device-only layer between the AIDL stub and the pure-Kotlin [PrivilegedFileApi]. It does two things:
 * decode replies with [WireCodec], and turn Android's remote-call exceptions into [TransportException] so nothing
 * above it ever sees an Android class. It cannot be exercised on the JVM; see the device test checklist.
 */
class AidlPrivilegedFileApi(private val service: IFileService) : PrivilegedFileApi {

    private inline fun <T> guarded(block: () -> T): T = try {
        block()
    } catch (e: DeadObjectException) {
        throw TransportException(TransportException.Kind.SERVICE_DIED, "The Shizuku service stopped", e)
    } catch (e: TransactionTooLargeException) {
        throw TransportException(TransportException.Kind.CALL_FAILED, "The reply was too large", e)
    } catch (e: RemoteException) {
        throw TransportException(TransportException.Kind.SERVICE_DIED, "The Shizuku service could not be reached", e)
    } catch (e: RuntimeException) {
        throw TransportException(TransportException.Kind.CALL_FAILED, e.message ?: "The call failed", e)
    }

    override fun apiVersion(): Int = guarded { service.apiVersion() }

    override fun uid(): Int = guarded { service.uid() }

    override fun stat(path: String): StatReply = WireCodec.decodeStat(guarded { service.statEx(path) })

    override fun list(path: String): ListReply = WireCodec.decodeList(guarded { service.listEx(path) })

    override fun size(path: String): SizeReply = WireCodec.decodeSize(guarded { service.sizeEx(path) })

    override fun delete(path: String, mode: DeleteMode, expected: FsStat?): DeleteResult =
        WireCodec.decodeDelete(
            guarded { service.deleteEx(path, mode.code, expected?.dev ?: 0L, expected?.ino ?: 0L, expected != null) }
        )

    override fun cancelCurrent() = guarded { service.cancelCurrent() }

    override fun setProtectedPackages(packages: Collection<String>): Int =
        guarded { service.setProtectedPackages(packages.toTypedArray()) }

    override fun processMemory(): com.cleanforge.core.privileged.ProcessListReply =
        com.cleanforge.core.privileged.ProcessListReply(
            com.cleanforge.core.privileged.ReplyStatus.OK,
            com.cleanforge.core.privileged.ProcessMemoryReader.decode(guarded { service.processMemoryEx() })
        )
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/shizuku/ShizukuFileService.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.shizuku

import android.os.Process
import com.cleanforge.BuildConfig
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.AndroidFsOps
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.FileServiceCore
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.PrivilegedProtocol
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.ReplyStatus
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.WireCodec
import com.cleanforge.shizuku.IFileService
import kotlin.system.exitProcess

/**
 * Runs in the Shizuku-started process (shell UID, or root if the user chose root mode).
 * Public no-arg constructor is required by Shizuku. This class is only a Binder adapter: all logic, and all
 * validation, is in [FileServiceCore], which trusts nothing from the caller (path rules, symlink-free ancestors,
 * exactly two recursive delete shapes, installed-apps guard).
 */
class ShizukuFileService : IFileService.Stub() {

    private val core = FileServiceCore(AndroidFsOps, BuildConfig.APPLICATION_ID)

    override fun destroy() {
        exitProcess(0)
    }

    override fun uid(): Int = Process.myUid()

    override fun apiVersion(): Int = PrivilegedProtocol.API_VERSION

    override fun statEx(path: String?): LongArray = WireCodec.encodeStat(core.stat(path))

    override fun listEx(path: String?): Array<String> = WireCodec.encodeList(core.list(path))

    override fun sizeEx(path: String?): LongArray = WireCodec.encodeSize(core.size(path))

    override fun deleteEx(path: String?, mode: Int, dev: Long, ino: Long, hasIdentity: Boolean): Array<String> =
        WireCodec.encodeDelete(core.delete(path, mode, dev, ino, hasIdentity))

    override fun cancelCurrent() = core.cancelCurrent()

    override fun setProtectedPackages(packages: Array<String>?): Int = core.setProtectedPackages(packages)

    override fun processMemoryEx(): Array<String> = core.processMemory()

    // ---- original methods, kept so an older app build still works; they cannot say WHY there is no value ----

    override fun lstat(path: String?): LongArray? {
        val r = core.stat(path)
        val st = r.stat
        if (r.status != ReplyStatus.OK || st == null) return null
        return longArrayOf(st.type.code.toLong(), st.size, st.mtimeMs, st.dev, st.ino)
    }

    override fun list(path: String?): Array<String>? {
        val r = core.list(path)
        return if (r.status == ReplyStatus.OK) r.names.toTypedArray() else null
    }

    override fun directorySize(path: String?): LongArray? {
        val r = core.size(path)
        val size = r.size
        if (r.status != ReplyStatus.OK || size == null) return null
        return longArrayOf(size.bytes, if (size.complete) 1L else 0L)
    }

    override fun delete(path: String?, mode: Int, dev: Long, ino: Long, hasIdentity: Boolean): LongArray {
        val r = core.delete(path, mode, dev, ino, hasIdentity)
        return longArrayOf(r.status.code.toLong(), r.entriesRemoved.toLong(), r.bytesFreed)
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/shizuku/ShizukuFileServiceConnector.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.shizuku

import android.content.ComponentName
import android.content.Context
import android.content.ServiceConnection
import android.os.IBinder
import com.cleanforge.BuildConfig
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.PrivilegedFileApi
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.PrivilegedProtocol
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.PrivilegedSessionProvider
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.SessionResult
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.TransportException
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.UnavailableReason
import com.cleanforge.shizuku.IFileService
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeoutOrNull
import rikka.shizuku.Shizuku
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

/**
 * Owns the lifecycle of the Shizuku user-service binding: bind on demand with a deadline, version-check the service,
 * detect process death, rebind after Shizuku restarts, and say precisely why there is no service when there is none.
 *
 * Every bind attempt uses its OWN [ServiceConnection] and its own result holder, so a late callback from an
 * abandoned attempt can never be mistaken for the current one. After a bind timeout the half-started service is
 * removed instead of being left behind.
 *
 * NOT unit-testable (it talks to Shizuku's static API). See the device test checklist in
 * docs/SHIZUKU_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md; whether bindUserService re-delivers onServiceConnected for a reused connection
 * is unknown, which is why a fresh connection object is used each time.
 */
@Singleton
class ShizukuFileServiceConnector @Inject constructor(
    @ApplicationContext private val context: Context,
    private val manager: ShizukuManager
) : PrivilegedSessionProvider {
    private val mutex = Mutex()

    private class Binding(val connection: ServiceConnection, val binder: IBinder, val api: PrivilegedFileApi)

    private val current = AtomicReference<Binding?>(null)

    private val args: Shizuku.UserServiceArgs by lazy {
        Shizuku.UserServiceArgs(ComponentName(context.packageName, ShizukuFileService::class.java.name))
            .daemon(false)
            .processNameSuffix("fs")
            .debuggable(BuildConfig.DEBUG)
            .version(BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE)
    }

    // Shizuku status checks and bind/unbind are binder calls: always off the caller's (possibly main) thread.
    override suspend fun acquire(): SessionResult = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { acquireLocked() }

    private suspend fun acquireLocked(): SessionResult = mutex.withLock {
        manager.refresh()
        val blocked = notReadyFor(manager.state.value)
        if (blocked != null) {
            dropBinding(removeService = false) // never keep a service reference across a dead or revoked Shizuku
            return@withLock blocked
        }
        val existing = current.get()
        if (existing != null && existing.binder.pingBinder()) return@withLock SessionResult.Ready(existing.api)
        dropBinding(removeService = false)
        bind()
    }

    override fun invalidate() {
        dropBinding(removeService = false)
    }

    override suspend fun restart() {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { mutex.withLock { dropBinding(removeService = true) } }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ internals

    private fun notReadyFor(state: ShizukuState): SessionResult.NotReady? = when (state) {
        is ShizukuState.Authorized -> null
        ShizukuState.NotInstalled -> SessionResult.NotReady(UnavailableReason.NOT_INSTALLED, "Shizuku is not installed")
        ShizukuState.NotRunning -> SessionResult.NotReady(UnavailableReason.NOT_RUNNING, "Shizuku is not running")
        ShizukuState.Disconnected -> SessionResult.NotReady(UnavailableReason.NOT_RUNNING, "The Shizuku service stopped")
        ShizukuState.PermissionDenied ->
            SessionResult.NotReady(UnavailableReason.NEEDS_PERMISSION, "CleanForge has not been allowed in Shizuku")
        ShizukuState.PermissionPermanentlyDenied ->
            SessionResult.NotReady(
                UnavailableReason.PERMISSION_PERMANENTLY_DENIED,
                "Permission was denied with \"don't ask again\"; allow CleanForge inside the Shizuku app"
            )
        ShizukuState.ServerTooOld ->
            SessionResult.NotReady(UnavailableReason.SERVER_TOO_OLD, "The running Shizuku is too old (version 11 or newer is required)")
        is ShizukuState.Error -> SessionResult.NotReady(UnavailableReason.SHIZUKU_ERROR, state.message)
    }

    private suspend fun bind(): SessionResult {
        val result = CompletableDeferred<IBinder?>() // null = the service went away before it connected
        val connection = object : ServiceConnection {
            override fun onServiceConnected(name: ComponentName, binder: IBinder) {
                result.complete(binder)
            }

            override fun onServiceDisconnected(name: ComponentName) {
                // Process death, or unbind. Forget this binding if it is the live one; release a pending bind.
                val live = current.get()
                if (live != null && live.connection === this) current.compareAndSet(live, null)
                result.complete(null)
            }
        }

        try {
            Shizuku.bindUserService(args, connection)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            return SessionResult.NotReady(
                UnavailableReason.BIND_FAILED,
                "Shizuku refused to start the service: ${e.message ?: e.javaClass.simpleName}"
            )
        }

        val binder = withTimeoutOrNull(BIND_TIMEOUT_MS) { result.await() }
        if (binder == null) {
            val died = result.isCompleted // completed with null: the service went away; otherwise: no answer in time
            unbindQuietly(connection, removeService = true)
            return if (died) {
                SessionResult.NotReady(UnavailableReason.SERVICE_DIED, "The Shizuku service stopped while starting")
            } else {
                SessionResult.NotReady(UnavailableReason.BIND_TIMEOUT, "The Shizuku service did not start within ${BIND_TIMEOUT_MS / 1000} s")
            }
        }
        if (!binder.pingBinder()) {
            unbindQuietly(connection, removeService = true)
            return SessionResult.NotReady(UnavailableReason.SERVICE_DIED, "The Shizuku service stopped while starting")
        }

        val api = AidlPrivilegedFileApi(IFileService.Stub.asInterface(binder))
        val version = try {
            api.apiVersion()
        } catch (e: TransportException) {
            unbindQuietly(connection, removeService = true)
            return SessionResult.NotReady(
                UnavailableReason.SERVICE_VERSION_MISMATCH,
                "The running Shizuku service does not speak this version of CleanForge's protocol; restart Shizuku and the app"
            )
        }
        if (version < PrivilegedProtocol.MIN_API_VERSION) {
            unbindQuietly(connection, removeService = true)
            return SessionResult.NotReady(
                UnavailableReason.SERVICE_VERSION_MISMATCH,
                "The running service is outdated (protocol $version); restart Shizuku and the app"
            )
        }

        current.set(Binding(connection, binder, api))
        return SessionResult.Ready(api)
    }

    private fun dropBinding(removeService: Boolean) {
        val old = current.getAndSet(null) ?: return
        unbindQuietly(old.connection, removeService)
    }

    private fun unbindQuietly(connection: ServiceConnection, removeService: Boolean) {
        try {
            Shizuku.unbindUserService(args, connection, removeService)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            // Shizuku may already be gone; nothing left to release.
        }
    }

    private companion object {
        const val BIND_TIMEOUT_MS = 6_000L
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core/shizuku/ShizukuManager.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.shizuku

import android.content.Context
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import rikka.shizuku.Shizuku
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

/**
 * Tracks the real Shizuku situation: installed? running? permission? Shizuku is NOT root (unless the user
 * deliberately started it in root mode, which is surfaced via [ShizukuState.Authorized.isRoot]).
 */
@Singleton
class ShizukuManager @Inject constructor(
    @ApplicationContext private val context: Context
) : ShizukuStateSource {
    private val _state = MutableStateFlow<ShizukuState>(ShizukuState.NotRunning)
    override val state: StateFlow<ShizukuState> = _state

    // Shizuku calls its listeners on the main thread, and refresh() makes binder calls: hand them to a worker.
    private val io = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)

    private val binderReceived = Shizuku.OnBinderReceivedListener { io.launch { refresh() } }
    private val binderDead = Shizuku.OnBinderDeadListener { _state.value = ShizukuState.Disconnected }
    // The connector re-checks liveness on every acquire(), so a dead binder never leaves a stale service behind.
    private val permissionResult = Shizuku.OnRequestPermissionResultListener { _, _ -> io.launch { refresh() } }

    /** Call once from Application.onCreate. Listeners live as long as the process. */
    fun register() {
        Shizuku.addBinderReceivedListenerSticky(binderReceived)
        Shizuku.addBinderDeadListener(binderDead)
        Shizuku.addRequestPermissionResultListener(permissionResult)
        io.launch { refresh() }
    }

    fun unregister() {
        runCatching { Shizuku.removeBinderReceivedListener(binderReceived) }
        runCatching { Shizuku.removeBinderDeadListener(binderDead) }
        runCatching { Shizuku.removeRequestPermissionResultListener(permissionResult) }
    }

    /** Synchronized so two overlapping refreshes cannot publish an older reading after a newer one. */
    @Synchronized
    override fun refresh() {
        _state.value = currentState()
    }

    private fun currentState(): ShizukuState = try {
        when {
            !Shizuku.pingBinder() ->
                if (isShizukuAppInstalled()) ShizukuState.NotRunning else ShizukuState.NotInstalled
            Shizuku.isPreV11() -> ShizukuState.ServerTooOld
            Shizuku.checkSelfPermission() == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED ->
                ShizukuState.Authorized(Shizuku.getUid(), Shizuku.getVersion())
            // Per the Shizuku API demo: true means the user chose "Deny and don't ask again".
            Shizuku.shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale() -> ShizukuState.PermissionPermanentlyDenied
            else -> ShizukuState.PermissionDenied
        }
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        ShizukuState.Error(e.message ?: "Unknown Shizuku error")
    }

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    private fun isShizukuAppInstalled(): Boolean = try {
        context.packageManager.getPackageInfo(SHIZUKU_PACKAGE, 0)
        true
    } catch (e: PackageManager.NameNotFoundException) {
        false
    }

    fun requestPermission(requestCode: Int = REQUEST_CODE) {
        try {
            if (!Shizuku.pingBinder() || Shizuku.isPreV11()) {
                refresh()
                return
            }
            if (Shizuku.checkSelfPermission() == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                refresh()
                return
            }
            if (Shizuku.shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale()) {
                // "Don't ask again": requesting would show nothing. The UI tells the user to open Shizuku instead.
                refresh()
                return
            }
            Shizuku.requestPermission(requestCode)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            _state.value = ShizukuState.Error(e.message ?: "Permission request failed")
        }
    }

    companion object {
        const val SHIZUKU_PACKAGE = "moe.shizuku.privileged.api"
        const val REQUEST_CODE = 4201
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.shizuku

sealed interface ShizukuState {
    data object NotInstalled : ShizukuState
    data object NotRunning : ShizukuState

    /** Running, but CleanForge has not been allowed yet. The permission dialog can still be shown. */
    data object PermissionDenied : ShizukuState

    /**
     * The user chose "deny and don't ask again" (Shizuku API: shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale() is true).
     * Asking again shows nothing; the user must allow CleanForge inside the Shizuku app.
     */
    data object PermissionPermanentlyDenied : ShizukuState

    data object Disconnected : ShizukuState

    /** The running Shizuku server predates version 11 and cannot host user services. */
    data object ServerTooOld : ShizukuState

    /**
     * [uid] is 2000 for adb/shell mode, 0 if the user started Shizuku with root. This only says the binder is alive and
     * CleanForge may use it; it does NOT prove any operation works (see CapabilityRegistry).
     */
    data class Authorized(val uid: Int, val serverVersion: Int = 0) : ShizukuState {
        val isRoot: Boolean get() = uid == 0
    }

    data class Error(val message: String) : ShizukuState
}
```

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.data

import android.content.Context
import androidx.datastore.preferences.core.booleanPreferencesKey

import androidx.datastore.preferences.core.intPreferencesKey
import androidx.datastore.preferences.preferencesDataStore
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map

private val Context.dataStore by preferencesDataStore(name = "cleanforge.prefs")

/** System = follow the phone (the default). Light and Dark are explicit choices made in About. */
enum class ThemeMode {
    System, Light, Dark;

    fun next(): ThemeMode = entries[(ordinal + 1) % entries.size]
}

class Preferences(private val context: Context) {
    private object Keys {
        val Verses = booleanPreferencesKey("verses")
        val Theme = intPreferencesKey("theme_mode")
    }

    /** Defaults: verses ON, theme follows the system. */
    val verses: Flow<Boolean> = context.dataStore.data.map { it[Keys.Verses] ?: true }
    val themeMode: Flow<ThemeMode> = context.dataStore.data.map {
        ThemeMode.entries.getOrElse(it[Keys.Theme] ?: 0) { ThemeMode.System }
    }

    suspend fun setVerses(enabled: Boolean) {
        context.dataStore.edit { it[Keys.Verses] = enabled }
    }

    suspend fun setThemeMode(mode: ThemeMode) {
        context.dataStore.edit { it[Keys.Theme] = mode.ordinal }
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/data/repository/ScanRepository.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.data.repository

import com.cleanforge.core.backend.Capabilities
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ScanItem
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.OperationCapability
import com.cleanforge.core.scanner.Requirement
import com.cleanforge.core.scanner.ScanMode
import com.cleanforge.core.scanner.Scanner
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.update
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

/** What a finished scanner found, so "nothing found" can be told apart from "did not run". */
data class ScannerSummary(val name: String, val count: Int, val bytes: Long)

sealed interface ScanProgress {
    data class Started(val totalScanners: Int) : ScanProgress
    data class ScannerStarted(val name: String, val index: Int, val total: Int) : ScanProgress
    data class ScannerSkipped(val name: String, val reason: String) : ScanProgress
    data class ScannerFailed(val name: String, val reason: String) : ScanProgress
    /** The scanner ran, but its result is incomplete (see [Scanner.incompleteReasons]). Not the same as "found nothing". */
    data class ScannerIncomplete(val name: String, val reasons: List<String>) : ScanProgress
    /** [summaries]: one entry per scanner that RAN (skipped and failed ones are reported by their own events). */
    data class Finished(val totalItems: Int, val summaries: List<ScannerSummary> = emptyList()) : ScanProgress
}

@Singleton
class ScanRepository @Inject constructor(
    private val scanners: Set<@JvmSuppressWildcards Scanner>,
    private val capabilities: Capabilities
) {
    private val results = MutableStateFlow<Map<String, List<ScanItem>>>(emptyMap())
    private val _items = MutableStateFlow<List<ScanItem>>(emptyList())
    private val scanMutex = Mutex()

    /** Everything found so far, from every scanner that has run. */
    val items: StateFlow<List<ScanItem>> = _items.asStateFlow()

    private fun publish() {
        _items.value = results.value.values.flatten().sortedWith(
            compareBy<ScanItem> { it.category.ordinal }.thenByDescending { it.sizeBytes }
        )
    }

    fun scan(mode: ScanMode): Flow<ScanProgress> = flow {
        // Single-flight guard: only one scan runs at a time.
        // A second caller waits until the first finishes or is cancelled.
        scanMutex.withLock {
            val selected = scanners.filter { it.mode == mode }
            emit(ScanProgress.Started(selected.size))
            val summaries = ArrayList<ScannerSummary>()

            for ((index, scanner) in selected.withIndex()) {
                val missing = missing(scanner)
                if (missing != null) {
                    results.update { it - scanner.id }
                    publish()
                    emit(ScanProgress.ScannerSkipped(scanner.displayName, missing))
                    continue
                }

                emit(ScanProgress.ScannerStarted(scanner.displayName, index + 1, selected.size))

                val found = ArrayList<ScanItem>()
                var reasons: List<String> = emptyList()

                try {
                    scanner.scan().collect { batch ->
                        found += batch
                        // Show results as they arrive: a slow scanner must not look like an empty one.
                        results.update { it + (scanner.id to found.toList()) }
                        publish()
                    }
                    results.update { it + (scanner.id to found.toList()) } // also replaces old results with "none"
                    reasons = scanner.incompleteReasons()
                    summaries += ScannerSummary(scanner.displayName, found.size, found.sumOf { it.sizeBytes })
                } catch (ce: CancellationException) {
                    throw ce
                } catch (t: Throwable) {
                    results.update { it - scanner.id }
                    emit(ScanProgress.ScannerFailed(scanner.displayName, t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName))
                }

                publish()
                if (reasons.isNotEmpty()) emit(ScanProgress.ScannerIncomplete(scanner.displayName, reasons))
            }

            emit(ScanProgress.Finished(_items.value.size, summaries))
        }
    }

    /** Drop items that no longer exist (after cleaning) without rescanning. */
    fun forget(paths: Set<String>) {
        results.update { map -> map.mapValues { (_, list) -> list.filter { it.path !in paths } } }
        publish()
    }

    /** Null if the scanner may run; otherwise the actionable reason it cannot. */
    private suspend fun missing(scanner: Scanner): String? = when (scanner.requirement) {
        Requirement.NONE -> null
        Requirement.ALL_FILES_ACCESS ->
            if (capabilities.hasAllFilesAccess()) null else "needs All-files access"
        Requirement.SHIZUKU -> {
            // Ask per operation: a live Shizuku binder does not prove that listing or measuring works.
            var blocked: OperationCapability? = null
            for (op in scanner.privilegedOperations) {
                val readiness = capabilities.readiness(op)
                if (!readiness.canAttempt) {
                    blocked = readiness
                    break
                }
            }
            when {
                blocked != null -> blocked.reason
                scanner.privilegedOperations.isEmpty() && !capabilities.shizukuAuthorized() -> "needs Shizuku"
                else -> null
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/data/repository/SnapshotRepository.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.data.repository

import com.cleanforge.core.history.GrowthAnalyzer
import com.cleanforge.core.history.GrowthReport
import com.cleanforge.core.history.Snapshot
import com.cleanforge.core.history.SnapshotEntry
import com.cleanforge.core.history.SnapshotStore
import com.cleanforge.core.inventory.StorageIndex
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Singleton
class SnapshotRepository @Inject constructor(private val store: SnapshotStore) {

    fun all(): List<Snapshot> = store.loadAll()
    fun latest(): Snapshot? = store.loadAll().lastOrNull()

    fun saveFrom(index: StorageIndex) {
        if (index.rootPath.isEmpty()) return
        val entries = index.directories.map { d ->
            SnapshotEntry(d.path, d.parentPath, d.name, d.depth, d.bytes, d.fileCount)
        }
        val cats = index.categoryTotals.associate { it.key to it.bytes }
        store.save(
            Snapshot(
                timestamp = index.timestamp,
                rootPath = index.rootPath,
                totalBytes = index.totalBytes,
                freeBytes = index.freeBytes,
                dirs = entries,
                categoryBytes = cats,
                incomplete = index.incomplete
            )
        )
        store.prune()
    }

    fun growth(fromTs: Long, toTs: Long, topDirs: Int = 50): GrowthReport? {
        val snapshots = store.loadAll()
        val from = snapshots.firstOrNull { it.timestamp == fromTs } ?: return null
        val to = snapshots.firstOrNull { it.timestamp == toTs } ?: return null
        return GrowthAnalyzer.compare(from, to, topDirs)
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/domain/usecase/ClearMemoryUseCase.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.domain.usecase

import com.cleanforge.core.backend.PackageInventory
import com.cleanforge.core.memory.BackgroundProcessKiller
import com.cleanforge.core.memory.ClearMemoryResult
import com.cleanforge.core.memory.MemoryInfoProvider
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.ensureActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import javax.inject.Inject

/**
 * The real, limited, honest RAM-clear.
 *
 * It delegates the actual trim request to [BackgroundProcessKiller], which skips
 * CleanForge itself, system apps, and unknown app types.
 *
 * It then MEASURES the actual change in available memory instead of inventing a number.
 */
class ClearMemoryUseCase @Inject constructor(
    private val killer: BackgroundProcessKiller,
    private val inventory: PackageInventory,
    private val provider: MemoryInfoProvider
) {

    suspend operator fun invoke(): ClearMemoryResult = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val before = provider.snapshot()
        var requested = 0

        val installed: Iterable<String> = inventory.knownPackageNames()
            ?.filter { inventory.isCurrentlyInstalled(it) }
            ?: emptySet()

        var count = 0
        for (pkg in installed) {
            // Periodic cancellation check for large package lists.
            if (count++ % 64 == 0) {
                currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
            }

            if (killer.kill(pkg)) {
                requested++
            }
        }

        // Give the kernel a beat to actually reclaim the pages.
        delay(600L)

        val after = provider.snapshot()

        val freed = if (before != null && after != null) {
            (after.availableBytes - before.availableBytes).coerceAtLeast(0L)
        } else {
            0L
        }

        val note = if (before == null || after == null) {
            "Memory info was unavailable, so no measured change could be calculated."
        } else {
            "Freed ${freed / (1024 * 1024)} MB for now. Android may reload these apps, which can use more battery."
        }

        ClearMemoryResult(
            processesTouched = requested,
            freedBytes = freed,
            before = before,
            after = after,
            note = note
        )
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.domain.usecase

import com.cleanforge.core.memory.MemoryInfoProvider
import com.cleanforge.core.memory.RamSnapshot
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flowOn
import kotlinx.coroutines.isActive
import javax.inject.Inject

/** Emits live RAM snapshots every [intervalMs] while collected; stops on cancellation. */
class ObserveRamUseCase @Inject constructor(
    private val provider: MemoryInfoProvider
) {
    operator fun invoke(intervalMs: Long = 2_000L): Flow<RamSnapshot> = flow {
        while (currentCoroutineContext().isActive) {
            provider.snapshot()?.let { emit(it) }
            delay(intervalMs)
        }
    }.flowOn(Dispatchers.IO)
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/cleanforge/domain/usecase/StorageBreakdownUseCase.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.domain.usecase

import android.content.Context
import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo
import android.provider.MediaStore
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ScanItem
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.io.File
import javax.inject.Inject

data class StorageSlice(val label: String, val bytes: Long)

data class StorageCategory(
    val key: String,
    val label: String,
    val bytes: Long,
    /** An honest caveat about what this number does and does not include. */
    val note: String?,
    val slices: List<StorageSlice>
)

data class StorageBreakdown(val categories: List<StorageCategory>, val otherBytes: Long)

/**
 * Where the used storage goes. Photos, videos, audio and documents come from Android's media index (needs All-files
 * access); apps are measured by their installed code (Android hides each app's private data from other apps); caches
 * come from the last scan. Whatever these cannot see is reported as "System and other", never hidden.
 */
class StorageBreakdownUseCase @Inject constructor(
    @ApplicationContext private val context: Context
) {
    private val labels = HashMap<String, String>()

    suspend operator fun invoke(usedBytes: Long, scanItems: List<ScanItem>): StorageBreakdown =
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val categories = readMedia() + readApps() + junkFrom(scanItems)
            val seen = categories.sumOf { it.bytes }
            StorageBreakdown(categories, (usedBytes - seen).coerceAtLeast(0L))
        }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- media (images, videos, audio, other files)
    private fun readMedia(): List<StorageCategory> {
        val names = listOf("Images", "Videos", "Audio", "Documents and other files")
        val totals = LongArray(4)
        val folders = List(4) { HashMap<String, Long>() }
        var failure: String? = null
        try {
            val files = MediaStore.Files.getContentUri("external")
            val projection = arrayOf(
                MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.SIZE,
                MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.MEDIA_TYPE,
                MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.RELATIVE_PATH
            )
            context.contentResolver.query(files, projection, null, null, null)?.use { c ->
                val iSize = c.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.SIZE)
                val iType = c.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.MEDIA_TYPE)
                val iPath = c.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.RELATIVE_PATH)
                while (c.moveToNext()) {
                    val size = c.getLong(iSize)
                    if (size <= 0L) continue
                    val bucket = when (c.getInt(iType)) {
                        MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.MEDIA_TYPE_IMAGE -> 0
                        MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.MEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO -> 1
                        MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.MEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO -> 2
                        else -> 3
                    }
                    totals[bucket] += size
                    folders[bucket].merge(folderLabel(c.getString(iPath)), size, Long::plus)
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            failure = "Android would not share its media index. Allow All-files access to see this."
        }
        return names.indices.map { i ->
            StorageCategory(
                key = "media$i",
                label = names[i],
                bytes = totals[i],
                note = failure ?: if (i == 3) "Only files Android has indexed; folders it skips are counted under System and other." else null,
                slices = topSlices(folders[i], 6)
            )
        }
    }

    private fun folderLabel(relativePath: String?): String {
        val parts = relativePath.orEmpty().trim('/').split('/').filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
        if (parts.isEmpty()) return "Storage root"
        if (parts[0].equals("Android", ignoreCase = true) && parts.size >= 3) return appLabel(parts[2]) + " (app media)"
        return parts[0]
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- installed apps
    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    private fun readApps(): StorageCategory {
        val pm = context.packageManager
        val sizes = HashMap<String, Long>()
        for (ai in pm.getInstalledApplications(0)) {
            if ((ai.flags and ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM) != 0) continue
            val base = ai.sourceDir ?: continue
            var size = File(base).length()
            ai.splitSourceDirs?.forEach { size += File(it).length() }
            sizes[pm.getApplicationLabel(ai).toString()] = size
        }
        return StorageCategory(
            key = "apps",
            label = "Apps you installed",
            bytes = sizes.values.sum(),
            note = "Installed app code only. Android hides each app's private data and downloads from other apps.",
            slices = topSlices(sizes, 8)
        )
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- caches and junk from the last scan
    private fun junkFrom(items: List<ScanItem>): StorageCategory {
        val junk = items.filter {
            it.category.isQuick || it.category == CleaningCategory.LOG_FILE || it.category == CleaningCategory.TEMP_FILE
        }
        val byCategory = HashMap<String, Long>()
        for (i in junk) byCategory.merge(i.category.label, i.sizeBytes, Long::plus)
        return StorageCategory(
            key = "junk",
            label = "Caches and junk",
            bytes = byCategory.values.sum(),
            note = if (items.isEmpty()) "Run a scan on the Clean tab to measure this." else "From your last scan.",
            slices = topSlices(byCategory, 6)
        )
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
    private fun topSlices(map: Map<String, Long>, n: Int): List<StorageSlice> {
        val sorted = map.entries.filter { it.value > 0 }.sortedByDescending { it.value }
        val top = sorted.take(n).map { StorageSlice(it.key, it.value) }
        val rest = sorted.drop(n).sumOf { it.value }
        return if (rest > 0) top + StorageSlice("Everything else", rest) else top
    }

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    private fun appLabel(pkg: String): String = labels.getOrPut(pkg) {
        try {
            val pm = context.packageManager
            pm.getApplicationLabel(pm.getApplicationInfo(pkg, 0)).toString()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            pkg
        }
    }
}
```
