## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/core/CapabilityRegistryTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core

import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.CapabilityRegistry
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.CapabilityStatus
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.FileServiceCore
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.PrivilegedOperation
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.SessionResult
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.TransportException
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.UnavailableReason
import com.cleanforge.core.shizuku.ShizukuState
import com.cleanforge.testutil.FakeSessionProvider
import com.cleanforge.testutil.FakeShizukuState
import com.cleanforge.testutil.FaultyFs
import com.cleanforge.testutil.InMemoryFs
import com.cleanforge.testutil.LocalPrivilegedFileApi
import com.cleanforge.testutil.ROOT
import com.cleanforge.testutil.ScriptedApi
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Test
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

/** What the app says it can do, per operation, as Shizuku and the device change underneath it. */
class CapabilityRegistryTest {

    private class Rig(state: ShizukuState = ShizukuState.Authorized(2000, 13), serviceVersion: Int = 1) {
        val mem = InMemoryFs()
        val faulty = FaultyFs(mem)
        val core = FileServiceCore(faulty, "com.cleanforge")
        val calls: MutableList<String> = java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList()
        @Volatile var before: (String) -> Unit = {}
        val api = ScriptedApi(LocalPrivilegedFileApi(core, uidValue = 2000, version = serviceVersion), calls).also { a ->
            a.before = { name -> before(name) }
        }
        val provider = FakeSessionProvider { api }
        val shizuku = FakeShizukuState(state)
        @Volatile var now = 1_000_000L
        val registry = CapabilityRegistry(
            shizuku, provider,
            clock = { now },
            minProbeIntervalMs = 3_000L,
            probeCallTimeoutMs = 750L
        )

        init {
            mem.mkdirs("$ROOT/Android/data/com.example/cache")
            mem.mkdirs("$ROOT/Android/obb/com.example")
        }
    }

    private fun CapabilityRegistry.statuses() = PrivilegedOperation.entries.associateWith { current(it).status }

    @Test fun `before any check nothing is claimed`() {
        val rig = Rig()
        assertThat(rig.registry.statuses().values.toSet()).containsExactly(CapabilityStatus.UNKNOWN)
        assertThat(rig.registry.report.value.probedAtMs).isNull()
    }

    @Test fun `each Shizuku state blocks every operation with the right status and an actionable reason`() {
        val expected = mapOf(
            ShizukuState.NotInstalled to CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
            ShizukuState.NotRunning to CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
            ShizukuState.Disconnected to CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
            ShizukuState.PermissionDenied to CapabilityStatus.NEEDS_AUTHORIZATION,
            ShizukuState.PermissionPermanentlyDenied to CapabilityStatus.NEEDS_AUTHORIZATION,
            ShizukuState.ServerTooOld to CapabilityStatus.UNSUPPORTED,
            ShizukuState.Error("boom") to CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE
        )
        for ((state, status) in expected) {
            val rig = Rig(state)
            for (op in PrivilegedOperation.entries) {
                val c = rig.registry.current(op)
                assertThat(c.status).isEqualTo(status)
                assertThat(c.canAttempt).isFalse()
                assertThat(c.reason).isNotEmpty()
                assertThat(c.limitations).isNotEmpty()
            }
        }
        val blocked = Rig(ShizukuState.PermissionPermanentlyDenied).registry.current(PrivilegedOperation.LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA)
        assertThat(blocked.reason).contains("Shizuku app") // tells the user where to go, not to press a dead button
    }

    @Test fun `with Shizuku authorized and everything readable, reads are verified and deletions are only ready`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        val report = rig.registry.probe()
        assertThat(report.serviceUid).isEqualTo(2000)
        assertThat(report.serviceApiVersion).isEqualTo(1)
        assertThat(report.probedAtMs).isEqualTo(1_000_000L)
        assertThat(report.of(PrivilegedOperation.LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA).status).isEqualTo(CapabilityStatus.VERIFIED)
        assertThat(report.of(PrivilegedOperation.MEASURE_EXTERNAL_APP_DIR).status).isEqualTo(CapabilityStatus.PREREQUISITES_MET)
        // A read-only probe never deletes to test deleting, so these cannot be VERIFIED yet.
        assertThat(report.of(PrivilegedOperation.CLEAR_EXTERNAL_APP_CACHE).status).isEqualTo(CapabilityStatus.PREREQUISITES_MET)
        assertThat(report.of(PrivilegedOperation.REMOVE_UNINSTALLED_APP_DATA).status).isEqualTo(CapabilityStatus.PREREQUISITES_MET)
        assertThat(rig.calls).doesNotContain("delete")
        assertThat(rig.calls).doesNotContain("setProtectedPackages")
        assertThat(rig.mem.exists("$ROOT/Android/data/com.example/cache")).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `a connected service that cannot read Android data and obb supports nothing`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.faulty.denyList += "$ROOT/Android/data"
        rig.faulty.denyList += "$ROOT/Android/obb"
        val report = rig.registry.probe()
        for (op in PrivilegedOperation.entries) {
            val c = report.of(op)
            assertThat(c.status).isEqualTo(CapabilityStatus.UNSUPPORTED)
            assertThat(c.canAttempt).isFalse()
            assertThat(c.reason).contains("Android/data")
        }
    }

    @Test fun `app caches need Android data, leftover removal can still work through obb alone`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.faulty.denyList += "$ROOT/Android/data"
        val report = rig.registry.probe()
        assertThat(report.of(PrivilegedOperation.CLEAR_EXTERNAL_APP_CACHE).status).isEqualTo(CapabilityStatus.UNSUPPORTED)
        assertThat(report.of(PrivilegedOperation.LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA).status).isEqualTo(CapabilityStatus.VERIFIED)
        assertThat(report.of(PrivilegedOperation.REMOVE_UNINSTALLED_APP_DATA).status).isEqualTo(CapabilityStatus.PREREQUISITES_MET)
    }

    @Test fun `when only obb is unreadable the reason says which folder`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.faulty.denyList += "$ROOT/Android/obb"
        val c = rig.registry.probe().of(PrivilegedOperation.LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA)
        assertThat(c.status).isEqualTo(CapabilityStatus.VERIFIED)
        assertThat(c.reason).contains("obb")
    }

    @Test fun `a service that cannot be started maps its reason onto the capability vocabulary`() = runBlocking {
        val table = mapOf(
            UnavailableReason.BIND_TIMEOUT to CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
            UnavailableReason.BIND_FAILED to CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
            UnavailableReason.SERVICE_DIED to CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
            UnavailableReason.NEEDS_PERMISSION to CapabilityStatus.NEEDS_AUTHORIZATION,
            UnavailableReason.PERMISSION_PERMANENTLY_DENIED to CapabilityStatus.NEEDS_AUTHORIZATION,
            UnavailableReason.SERVICE_VERSION_MISMATCH to CapabilityStatus.UNSUPPORTED,
            UnavailableReason.SERVER_TOO_OLD to CapabilityStatus.UNSUPPORTED
        )
        for ((reason, status) in table) {
            val rig = Rig()
            rig.provider.notReady = SessionResult.NotReady(reason, "because $reason")
            val report = rig.registry.probe()
            for (op in PrivilegedOperation.entries) {
                assertThat(report.of(op).status).isEqualTo(status)
                assertThat(report.of(op).reason).isEqualTo("because $reason")
            }
        }
    }

    @Test fun `a service that dies during the check is Unavailable and its binding is dropped`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.before = { name -> if (name == "list") throw TransportException(TransportException.Kind.SERVICE_DIED, "gone") }
        val report = rig.registry.probe()
        assertThat(report.of(PrivilegedOperation.LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA).status).isEqualTo(CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE)
        assertThat(rig.provider.invalidations.get()).isEqualTo(1)
    }

    @Test fun `a service that hangs during the check is Unavailable, restarted, and the check returns`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        val release = CountDownLatch(1)
        rig.provider.onRestart = { release.countDown() }
        rig.before = { name ->
            if (name == "list") {
                release.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                throw TransportException(TransportException.Kind.SERVICE_DIED, "killed")
            }
        }
        val report = rig.registry.probe()
        assertThat(report.of(PrivilegedOperation.LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA).status).isEqualTo(CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE)
        assertThat(rig.provider.restarts.get()).isEqualTo(1)
    }

    @Test fun `a stale verified status never outlives Shizuku`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.registry.probe()
        assertThat(rig.registry.current(PrivilegedOperation.LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA).status).isEqualTo(CapabilityStatus.VERIFIED)
        rig.shizuku.set(ShizukuState.NotRunning)
        assertThat(rig.registry.current(PrivilegedOperation.LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA).status).isEqualTo(CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE)
        rig.shizuku.set(ShizukuState.PermissionDenied)
        assertThat(rig.registry.current(PrivilegedOperation.LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA).status).isEqualTo(CapabilityStatus.NEEDS_AUTHORIZATION)
    }

    @Test fun `a recent check is reused, a forced one or a changed Shizuku state is not`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.registry.probe()
        val first = rig.provider.acquires.get()
        rig.now += 1_000
        rig.registry.probe()
        assertThat(rig.provider.acquires.get()).isEqualTo(first)
        rig.registry.probe(force = true)
        assertThat(rig.provider.acquires.get()).isGreaterThan(first)

        val second = rig.provider.acquires.get()
        rig.now += 10_000
        rig.registry.probe()
        assertThat(rig.provider.acquires.get()).isGreaterThan(second) // interval passed
    }

    @Test fun `operation results move a capability between verified and unavailable`() {
        val rig = Rig()
        val reg = rig.registry
        reg.markVerified(PrivilegedOperation.CLEAR_EXTERNAL_APP_CACHE)
        assertThat(reg.current(PrivilegedOperation.CLEAR_EXTERNAL_APP_CACHE).status).isEqualTo(CapabilityStatus.VERIFIED)
        assertThat(reg.report.value.of(PrivilegedOperation.CLEAR_EXTERNAL_APP_CACHE).checkedAtMs).isEqualTo(1_000_000L)
        reg.markUnavailable(PrivilegedOperation.CLEAR_EXTERNAL_APP_CACHE, "service stopped")
        assertThat(reg.current(PrivilegedOperation.CLEAR_EXTERNAL_APP_CACHE).status).isEqualTo(CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE)
        assertThat(reg.current(PrivilegedOperation.CLEAR_EXTERNAL_APP_CACHE).reason).isEqualTo("service stopped")
        // Other operations are untouched.
        assertThat(reg.current(PrivilegedOperation.LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA).status).isEqualTo(CapabilityStatus.UNKNOWN)
    }

    @Test fun `the report flow publishes the probe result`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.registry.probe()
        assertThat(rig.registry.report.value.of(PrivilegedOperation.LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA).status).isEqualTo(CapabilityStatus.VERIFIED)
        assertThat(rig.registry.report.value.shizuku).isEqualTo(ShizukuState.Authorized(2000, 13))
    }

    @Test fun `every operation carries honest limitations`() {
        for (op in PrivilegedOperation.entries) {
            assertThat(Rig().registry.current(op).limitations).isNotEmpty()
        }
        val clear = Rig().registry.current(PrivilegedOperation.CLEAR_EXTERNAL_APP_CACHE).limitations.joinToString(" ")
        assertThat(clear).contains("/data/data")
        assertThat(clear).contains("Not proven")
    }

    @Test fun `a later read-only check does not downgrade an operation that really worked`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.registry.probe(force = true)
        rig.registry.markVerified(PrivilegedOperation.CLEAR_EXTERNAL_APP_CACHE)
        rig.registry.probe(force = true)
        assertThat(rig.registry.current(PrivilegedOperation.CLEAR_EXTERNAL_APP_CACHE).status).isEqualTo(CapabilityStatus.VERIFIED)
        // ...but once Shizuku goes away the demonstration no longer counts, and it is not resurrected by the next probe.
        rig.shizuku.set(ShizukuState.NotRunning)
        rig.registry.probe(force = true)
        rig.shizuku.set(ShizukuState.Authorized(2000, 13))
        rig.registry.probe(force = true)
        assertThat(rig.registry.current(PrivilegedOperation.CLEAR_EXTERNAL_APP_CACHE).status).isEqualTo(CapabilityStatus.PREREQUISITES_MET)
    }
}
```

## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/core/CleaningEngineTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core

import com.cleanforge.core.backend.InstallState
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.PackageInventory
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.StandardFileBackend
import com.cleanforge.core.cleaning.CleaningEngine
import com.cleanforge.core.cleaning.CleaningProgress
import com.cleanforge.core.cleaning.PlanBuilder
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningPlan
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningReport
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ConfidenceLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ItemStatus
import com.cleanforge.core.model.RiskLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ScanItem
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.CapabilityStatus
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.DefaultPrivilegedExecutor
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.FileServiceCore
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.OperationCapability
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.PrivilegedExecutor
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.PrivilegedOperation
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.TransportException
import com.cleanforge.core.model.confirmedByUser
import com.cleanforge.core.safety.SafetyValidator
import com.cleanforge.testutil.FakeCapabilities
import com.cleanforge.testutil.FakeInventory
import com.cleanforge.testutil.FakeSessionProvider
import com.cleanforge.testutil.InMemoryFs
import com.cleanforge.testutil.LocalPrivilegedFileApi
import com.cleanforge.testutil.ScriptedApi
import com.cleanforge.testutil.ROOT
import com.cleanforge.testutil.scanItem
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.filterIsInstance
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.toList
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import org.junit.Test

class CleaningEngineTest {
    private val fs = InMemoryFs()
    private val caps = FakeCapabilities()
    private val inventory = FakeInventory(FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.example"))

    /** Privileged work runs the REAL service logic over the same in-memory filesystem. */
    private val apiHooks = ApiHooks()
    private val provider = FakeSessionProvider {
        ScriptedApi(LocalPrivilegedFileApi(FileServiceCore(fs, "com.cleanforge"))).also { api ->
            api.before = { name -> apiHooks.before(name) }
            api.after = { name -> apiHooks.after(name) }
        }
    }

    private class ApiHooks {
        @Volatile var before: (String) -> Unit = {}
        @Volatile var after: (String) -> Unit = {}
    }

    private fun privileged(): PrivilegedExecutor = DefaultPrivilegedExecutor(provider)

    private fun engine(capabilities: com.cleanforge.core.backend.Capabilities = caps, inv: PackageInventory = inventory): CleaningEngine =
        CleaningEngine(SafetyValidator(), StandardFileBackend(fs), privileged(), inv, capabilities)

    private suspend fun clean(vararg items: ScanItem): CleaningReport =
        engine().execute(CleaningPlan(items.toList(), emptyList()).confirmedByUser())
            .filterIsInstance<CleaningProgress.Completed>().first().report

    private suspend fun cleanWith(engine: CleaningEngine, vararg items: ScanItem): CleaningReport =
        engine.execute(CleaningPlan(items.toList(), emptyList()).confirmedByUser())
            .filterIsInstance<CleaningProgress.Completed>().first().report

    /** A scan-time snapshot, like the scanners record. */
    private fun scanned(item: ScanItem) = item.copy(fingerprint = fs.lstat(item.path))

    private val cachePath = "$ROOT/Android/data/com.example/cache"
    private fun cacheItem() = scanned(
        scanItem(cachePath, CleaningCategory.APP_CACHE, ConfidenceLevel.HIGH, RiskLevel.SAFE, "com.example", shizuku = true)
    )

    @Test fun `cache contents are cleared, the folder stays, and bytes are reported from reality`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$cachePath/a.bin", size = 40)
        fs.file("$cachePath/sub/b.bin", size = 60)
        val item = cacheItem()
        val r = clean(item)
        assertThat(r.deleted).isEqualTo(1)
        assertThat(r.bytesFreed).isEqualTo(100L)
        assertThat(fs.exists(cachePath)).isTrue()
        assertThat(fs.list(cachePath)).isEmpty()
    }

    @Test fun `item without a scan snapshot is skipped`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$cachePath/a.bin")
        val r = clean(scanItem(cachePath, CleaningCategory.APP_CACHE, ConfidenceLevel.HIGH, RiskLevel.SAFE, "com.example", shizuku = true))
        assertThat(r.outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.SKIPPED)
        assertThat(fs.exists("$cachePath/a.bin")).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `file changed since the scan is skipped and survives`() = runTest {
        val p = "$ROOT/Download/video.mp4"
        fs.file(p, size = 500)
        val item = scanned(scanItem(p))
        fs.resize(p, 900) // user kept writing to it
        val r = clean(item)
        assertThat(r.outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.SKIPPED)
        assertThat(fs.exists(p)).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `file swapped for a symlink after the scan is skipped`() = runTest {
        val p = "$ROOT/Download/doc.pdf"
        fs.file(p)
        val item = scanned(scanItem(p))
        fs.replaceWithSymlink(p)
        val r = clean(item)
        assertThat(r.outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.SKIPPED)
        assertThat(fs.exists(p)).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `file that vanished is reported not crashed`() = runTest {
        val p = "$ROOT/Download/gone.bin"
        fs.file(p)
        val item = scanned(scanItem(p))
        fs.remove(p)
        val r = clean(item)
        assertThat(r.outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.SKIPPED)
    }

    @Test fun `partial failure is reported honestly`() = runTest {
        val a = "$ROOT/Download/a.bin"
        val b = "$ROOT/Download/b.bin"
        fs.file(a); fs.file(b)
        val items = listOf(scanned(scanItem(a)), scanned(scanItem(b)))
        fs.denyRemove += b
        val r = clean(*items.toTypedArray())
        assertThat(r.deleted).isEqualTo(1)
        assertThat(r.failed).isEqualTo(1)
        assertThat(r.fullySuccessful).isFalse()
        assertThat(fs.exists(b)).isTrue()

    @Test fun `leftover whose app got reinstalled is skipped`() = runTest {
        val dir = "$ROOT/Android/data/com.gone.game"
        fs.file("$dir/save.dat")
        val item = scanned(scanItem(dir, CleaningCategory.CORPSE_LEFTOVER, pkg = "com.gone.game", shizuku = true))
        inventory.known = FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.gone.game")
        val r = clean(item)
        assertThat(r.outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.SKIPPED)
        assertThat(fs.exists("$dir/save.dat")).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `leftover is skipped when the package list cannot be trusted`() = runTest {
        val dir = "$ROOT/Android/data/com.gone.game"
        fs.file("$dir/save.dat")
        val item = scanned(scanItem(dir, CleaningCategory.CORPSE_LEFTOVER, pkg = "com.gone.game", shizuku = true))
        inventory.known = null
        assertThat(clean(item).outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.SKIPPED)
        inventory.known = setOf("only.one")
        assertThat(clean(item).outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.SKIPPED)
        assertThat(fs.exists("$dir/save.dat")).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `true leftover is removed completely`() = runTest {
        val dir = "$ROOT/Android/data/com.gone.game"
        fs.file("$dir/files/save.dat")
        val item = scanned(scanItem(dir, CleaningCategory.CORPSE_LEFTOVER, pkg = "com.gone.game", shizuku = true))
        assertThat(clean(item).outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.DELETED)
        assertThat(fs.exists(dir)).isFalse()
    }

    @Test fun `duplicate is skipped when the kept copy changed or vanished and deleted when intact`() = runTest {
        val keep = "$ROOT/Pictures/a.jpg"
        val dup = "$ROOT/Download/a.jpg"
        fs.file(keep, 50, 1); fs.file(dup, 50, 2)
        val item = scanned(scanItem(dup, CleaningCategory.DUPLICATE, keepPath = keep, keepFingerprint = fs.lstat(keep)))
        fs.resize(keep, 51)
        assertThat(clean(item).outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.SKIPPED)
        assertThat(fs.exists(dup)).isTrue()
        fs.resize(keep, 50)
        assertThat(clean(item).outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.DELETED)
        assertThat(fs.exists(keep)).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `shizuku items are skipped when shizuku is gone and file items when access is revoked`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$cachePath/a.bin")
        val cache = cacheItem()
        caps.shizuku = false
        assertThat(clean(cache).outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.SKIPPED)
        val p = "$ROOT/Download/a.bin"
        fs.file(p)
        val file = scanned(scanItem(p))
        caps.allFiles = false
        assertThat(clean(file).outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.SKIPPED)
        assertThat(fs.exists(p)).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `policy is re-applied at execution time even for a hand-built plan`() = runTest {
        // A plan assembled without PlanBuilder must still be stopped by the engine's own revalidation.
        fs.file("$ROOT/DCIM/Camera/IMG.jpg")
        val evil = scanned(scanItem("$ROOT/DCIM/Camera", CleaningCategory.APP_CACHE, ConfidenceLevel.HIGH, RiskLevel.SAFE, "com.example"))
        assertThat(clean(evil).outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.SKIPPED)
        assertThat(fs.exists("$ROOT/DCIM/Camera/IMG.jpg")).isTrue()
    }

    // ---------- package state at deletion time (H1) ----------

    @Test fun `app cache is refused when the app was uninstalled after the scan even though Android still knows the package`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$cachePath/a.bin", 40)
        val item = cacheItem()
        // The user uninstalls the app but keeps its data: still in the MATCH_UNINSTALLED_PACKAGES list, no longer installed.
        inventory.known = FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.example")
        inventory.installed = FakeInventory.defaultPackages()
        val r = clean(item)
        assertThat(r.outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.SKIPPED)
        assertThat(fs.exists("$cachePath/a.bin")).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `app cache is refused when Android no longer knows the package at all`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$cachePath/a.bin", 40)
        val item = cacheItem()
        inventory.known = FakeInventory.defaultPackages()
        assertThat(clean(item).outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.SKIPPED)
        assertThat(fs.exists("$cachePath/a.bin")).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `app cache of a package that is installed is still cleaned`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$cachePath/a.bin", 40)
        inventory.known = FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.example", "com.other.kept")
        inventory.installed = FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.example")
        assertThat(clean(cacheItem()).outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.DELETED)
    }

    @Test fun `leftover is refused when the package reports installed even if the known list lacks it`() = runTest {
        val dir = "$ROOT/Android/data/com.gone.game"
        fs.file("$dir/save.dat")
        val item = scanned(scanItem(dir, CleaningCategory.CORPSE_LEFTOVER, pkg = "com.gone.game", shizuku = true))
        inventory.installed = FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.gone.game")
        assertThat(clean(item).outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.SKIPPED)
        assertThat(fs.exists("$dir/save.dat")).isTrue()
    }

    // ---------- duplicates: the user, not the scanner, decides which copy goes (M2) ----------

    @Test fun `the user may delete the OLDEST copy and the copy they left alone survives`() = runTest {
        val oldest = "$ROOT/Pictures/family-photo.jpg"
        val newer = "$ROOT/Download/family-photo.jpg"
        fs.file(oldest, 50, mtime = 1)
        fs.file(newer, 50, mtime = 2)
        val a = scanned(scanItem(oldest, CleaningCategory.DUPLICATE, ConfidenceLevel.MEDIUM, RiskLevel.ELEVATED, groupId = "g"))
        val b = scanned(scanItem(newer, CleaningCategory.DUPLICATE, ConfidenceLevel.MEDIUM, RiskLevel.ELEVATED, groupId = "g"))

        val plan = PlanBuilder(SafetyValidator()).build(selected = listOf(a), scanned = listOf(a, b))
        assertThat(plan.items.map { it.path }).containsExactly(oldest)
        assertThat(plan.items[0].keepPath).isEqualTo(newer)

        val report = engine().execute(plan.confirmedByUser())
            .filterIsInstance<CleaningProgress.Completed>().first().report
        assertThat(report.deleted).isEqualTo(1)
        assertThat(fs.exists(oldest)).isFalse()
        assertThat(fs.exists(newer)).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `a duplicate whose kept copy is the very same file is refused`() = runTest {
        val p = "$ROOT/Download/a.jpg"
        fs.file(p)
        val item = scanned(scanItem(p, CleaningCategory.DUPLICATE, keepPath = p, keepFingerprint = fs.lstat(p)))
        assertThat(clean(item).outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.SKIPPED)
        assertThat(fs.exists(p)).isTrue()
    }

    // ---------- the privileged channel misbehaving (Part 2) ----------

    @Test fun `an unreachable Shizuku service is a failure never the harmless already gone`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$cachePath/a.bin", 40)
        val item = cacheItem()
        provider.notReady = com.cleanforge.core.privileged.SessionResult.NotReady(
            com.cleanforge.core.privileged.UnavailableReason.BIND_TIMEOUT, "The Shizuku service did not start"
        )
        val r = clean(item)
        assertThat(r.outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.FAILED)
        assertThat(r.outcomes[0].message).contains("could not be reached")
        assertThat(fs.exists("$cachePath/a.bin")).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `a genuinely missing folder is still reported as already gone`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$cachePath/a.bin", 40)
        val item = cacheItem()
        fs.remove("$cachePath/a.bin")
        fs.remove(cachePath)
        val r = clean(item)
        assertThat(r.outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.SKIPPED)
        assertThat(r.outcomes[0].message).isEqualTo("Already gone")
    }

    @Test fun `an operation the capability check rejects is skipped with its reason and nothing is deleted`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$cachePath/a.bin", 40)
        val item = cacheItem()
        val unsupported = object : com.cleanforge.core.backend.Capabilities {
            override fun hasAllFilesAccess() = true
            override fun shizukuAuthorized() = true
            override suspend fun readiness(op: PrivilegedOperation) = OperationCapability(
                op, CapabilityStatus.UNSUPPORTED, "The shell cannot read Android/data on this device"
            )
        }
        val r = cleanWith(engine(capabilities = unsupported), item)
        assertThat(r.outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.SKIPPED)
        assertThat(r.outcomes[0].message).contains("cannot read Android/data")
        assertThat(fs.exists("$cachePath/a.bin")).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `a failed install-state query skips both the cache and the leftover instead of guessing`() = runTest {
        val unknownState = object : PackageInventory by inventory {
            override fun installState(packageName: String) = InstallState.UNKNOWN
        }
        fs.file("$cachePath/a.bin", 40)
        val leftover = "$ROOT/Android/data/com.gone.game"
        fs.file("$leftover/save.dat", 10)
        val cache = cacheItem()
        val corpse = scanned(scanItem(leftover, CleaningCategory.CORPSE_LEFTOVER, pkg = "com.gone.game", shizuku = true))
        val r = cleanWith(engine(inv = unknownState), cache, corpse)
        assertThat(r.outcomes.map { it.status }).containsExactly(ItemStatus.SKIPPED, ItemStatus.SKIPPED)
        assertThat(fs.exists("$cachePath/a.bin")).isTrue()
        assertThat(fs.exists("$leftover/save.dat")).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `a folder that exists is never taken as proof the app is gone`() = runTest {
        // The package manager says the app is installed; a leftover-looking folder must not change that.
        val leftover = "$ROOT/Android/data/com.example.game"
        fs.file("$leftover/save.dat", 10)
        val corpse = scanned(scanItem(leftover, CleaningCategory.CORPSE_LEFTOVER, pkg = "com.example.game", shizuku = true))
        inventory.known = FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.example.game")
        assertThat(clean(corpse).outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.SKIPPED)
        assertThat(fs.exists("$leftover/save.dat")).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `a partly failed privileged cleanup is PARTIAL with the bytes that really went`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$cachePath/a.bin", 10)
        fs.file("$cachePath/b.bin", 20)
        fs.file("$cachePath/c.bin", 30)
        val item = cacheItem()
        fs.denyRemove += "$cachePath/b.bin"
        val r = clean(item)
        assertThat(r.outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.PARTIAL)
        assertThat(r.partial).isEqualTo(1)
        assertThat(r.bytesFreed).isEqualTo(40L)
        assertThat(r.fullySuccessful).isFalse()
    }

    @Test fun `a service that dies mid-delete leaves the item UNVERIFIED and never DELETED`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$cachePath/a.bin", 10)
        val item = cacheItem()
        apiHooks.before = { name ->
            if (name == "delete") throw TransportException(TransportException.Kind.SERVICE_DIED, "The Shizuku service stopped")
        }
        val r = clean(item)
        assertThat(r.outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.UNVERIFIED)
        assertThat(r.deleted).isEqualTo(0)
        assertThat(r.fullySuccessful).isFalse()
    }

    @Test fun `a deletion whose end state cannot be read is UNVERIFIED and its bytes are reported as unconfirmed`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$cachePath/a.bin", 10)
        val item = cacheItem()
        val deleted = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean(false)
        // The delete works; afterwards the check of the folder fails, so the outcome cannot be confirmed.
        apiHooks.after = { name -> if (name == "delete") deleted.set(true) }
        apiHooks.before = { name ->
            if (name == "stat" && deleted.get()) throw TransportException(TransportException.Kind.CALL_FAILED, "reply lost")
        }
        val r = clean(item)
        assertThat(r.outcomes[0].status).isEqualTo(ItemStatus.UNVERIFIED)
        assertThat(r.unverified).isEqualTo(1)
        assertThat(r.bytesFreed).isEqualTo(10L)
        assertThat(r.unconfirmedBytes).isEqualTo(10L)
        assertThat(r.fullySuccessful).isFalse()
    }

    @Test fun `progress says which item is in flight before touching it and carries each finished outcome`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$ROOT/Download/a.bin", 10)
        fs.file("$ROOT/Download/b.bin", 20)
        val a = scanned(scanItem("$ROOT/Download/a.bin"))
        val b = scanned(scanItem("$ROOT/Download/b.bin"))
        val events = engine().execute(CleaningPlan(listOf(a, b), emptyList()).confirmedByUser()).toList()
        val kinds = events.map { it::class.simpleName }
        assertThat(kinds).containsExactly(
            "Started", "ItemStarted", "Progress", "ItemStarted", "Progress", "Completed"
        ).inOrder()
        val progress = events.filterIsInstance<CleaningProgress.Progress>()
        assertThat(progress.map { it.outcome!!.status }).containsExactly(ItemStatus.DELETED, ItemStatus.DELETED)
        assertThat(progress.last().freedBytes).isEqualTo(30L)
        assertThat((events[1] as CleaningProgress.ItemStarted).item.path).isEqualTo(a.path)
    }

    @Test fun `an_unexpected_exception_costs_one_item_not_the_whole_run_and_its_report`() = runTest {
        val p1 = "$ROOT/Download/a.bin"
        val p2 = "$ROOT/Download/b.bin"
        fs.file(p1, size = 10)
        fs.file(p2, size = 10)
        val flaky = object : com.cleanforge.core.backend.Capabilities {
            var calls = 0
            override fun hasAllFilesAccess(): Boolean {
                if (calls++ == 0) throw IllegalStateException("binder died")
                return true
            }
            override fun shizukuAuthorized() = true
        }
        val r = cleanWith(engine(capabilities = flaky), scanned(scanItem(p1)), scanned(scanItem(p2)))
        assertThat(r.outcomes.map { it.status }).containsExactly(ItemStatus.FAILED, ItemStatus.DELETED).inOrder()
        assertThat(fs.exists(p1)).isTrue()
        assertThat(fs.exists(p2)).isFalse()
    }

    /** Counts how often the full package list is requested; everything else is the real fake. */
    private class CountingInventory(private val delegate: PackageInventory) : PackageInventory by delegate {
        var queries = 0
        override fun knownPackageNames(): Set<String>? {
            queries++
            return delegate.knownPackageNames()
        }
    }

    @Test fun `the package list is requested once per run, not once per item`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$cachePath/a.bin", size = 40)
        val counting = CountingInventory(inventory)
        cleanWith(engine(inv = counting), cacheItem(), cacheItem(), cacheItem())
        assertThat(counting.queries).isEqualTo(1)
    }
}
```

## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/core/ClearMemoryUseCaseTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core

import com.cleanforge.core.backend.InstallState
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.PackageInventory
import com.cleanforge.core.memory.BackgroundProcessKiller
import com.cleanforge.core.memory.MemoryInfoProvider
import com.cleanforge.core.memory.RamSnapshot
import com.cleanforge.domain.usecase.ClearMemoryUseCase
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.lang.reflect.Proxy

class ClearMemoryUseCaseTest {

    private fun snapshot(availableBytes: Long) = RamSnapshot(
        totalBytes = 4_000_000_000L,
        availableBytes = availableBytes,
        freeBytes = 0L,
        buffersBytes = 0L,
        cachedBytes = 0L,
        swapTotalBytes = 0L,
        swapFreeBytes = 0L,
        timestamp = 0L
    )

    /**
     * Hand-written test double for [BackgroundProcessKiller].
     * It records what the use case asked for and lets each test decide which packages are allowed.
     */
    private class RecordingBackgroundProcessKiller(
        private val allow: (String) -> Boolean
    ) : BackgroundProcessKiller {

        val killRequestsSent = mutableListOf<String>()
        val deliberatelySkipped = mutableListOf<String>()

        override fun kill(packageName: String): Boolean {
            return if (allow(packageName)) {
                killRequestsSent += packageName
                true
            } else {
                deliberatelySkipped += packageName
                false
            }
        }
    }

    private class ScriptedMemoryProvider(
        vararg snapshots: RamSnapshot?
    ) : MemoryInfoProvider {

        private val queue = ArrayDeque<RamSnapshot?>(snapshots.toList())

        override fun snapshot(): RamSnapshot? = queue.removeFirstOrNull()
    }

    /**
     * Proxy-based fake for [PackageInventory].
     *
     * This avoids requiring Mockito and avoids depending on the full shape of PackageInventory.
     * It handles the members used by ClearMemoryUseCase and common Object methods.
     */
    private fun fakeInventory(
        known: Set<String>?,
        installed: Set<String>,
        unknown: Set<String> = emptySet()
    ): PackageInventory {
        return Proxy.newProxyInstance(
            PackageInventory::class.java.classLoader,
            arrayOf(PackageInventory::class.java)
        ) { _, method, args ->
            val pkg = args?.firstOrNull() as? String

            when (method.name) {
                "knownPackageNames" -> known

                "isCurrentlyInstalled" -> pkg != null && pkg in installed

                "installState" -> when {
                    pkg == null -> InstallState.NOT_KNOWN
                    pkg in installed -> InstallState.INSTALLED
                    pkg in unknown -> InstallState.UNKNOWN
                    else -> InstallState.NOT_KNOWN
                }

                "toString" -> "FakePackageInventory"
                "hashCode" -> 0
                "equals" -> false

                else -> throw UnsupportedOperationException(
                    "Unexpected PackageInventory call in ClearMemoryUseCaseTest: ${method.name}"
                )
            }
        } as PackageInventory
    }

    @Test
    fun `freed bytes are measured honestly from MemAvailable delta, never estimated`() = runTest {
        val killer = RecordingBackgroundProcessKiller { true }
        val inventory = fakeInventory(
            known = setOf("com.test.app"),
            installed = setOf("com.test.app")
        )
        val provider = ScriptedMemoryProvider(
            snapshot(availableBytes = 1_000_000_000L),
            snapshot(availableBytes = 1_500_000_000L)
        )

        val useCase = ClearMemoryUseCase(killer, inventory, provider)
        val result = useCase()

        assertEquals(500_000_000L, result.freedBytes)
        assertEquals(1, result.processesTouched)
        assertTrue(killer.killRequestsSent.contains("com.test.app"))
        assertTrue(result.note.contains("Freed", ignoreCase = true))
    }

    @Test
    fun `if memory available drops after clear, freed bytes is zero, never negative`() = runTest {
        val killer = RecordingBackgroundProcessKiller { true }
        val inventory = fakeInventory(
            known = setOf("com.test.app"),
            installed = setOf("com.test.app")
        )
        val provider = ScriptedMemoryProvider(
            snapshot(availableBytes = 1_000_000_000L),
            snapshot(availableBytes = 900_000_000L)
        )

        val useCase = ClearMemoryUseCase(killer, inventory, provider)
        val result = useCase()

        assertEquals(0L, result.freedBytes)
        assertEquals(1, result.processesTouched)
    }

    @Test
    fun `packages skipped by BackgroundProcessKiller are not counted as touched`() = runTest {
        val killer = RecordingBackgroundProcessKiller { false }
        val inventory = fakeInventory(
            known = setOf("com.system.app"),
            installed = setOf("com.system.app")
        )
        val provider = ScriptedMemoryProvider(
            snapshot(availableBytes = 1_000_000_000L),
            snapshot(availableBytes = 1_000_000_000L)
        )

        val useCase = ClearMemoryUseCase(killer, inventory, provider)
        val result = useCase()

        assertEquals(0, result.processesTouched)
        assertTrue(killer.killRequestsSent.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(killer.deliberatelySkipped.contains("com.system.app"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `packages not currently installed are never passed to the killer`() = runTest {
        val killer = RecordingBackgroundProcessKiller { true }
        val inventory = fakeInventory(
            known = setOf("com.not.installed.app"),
            installed = emptySet()
        )
        val provider = ScriptedMemoryProvider(
            snapshot(availableBytes = 1_000_000_000L),
            snapshot(availableBytes = 1_000_000_000L)
        )

        val useCase = ClearMemoryUseCase(killer, inventory, provider)
        val result = useCase()

        assertEquals(0, result.processesTouched)
        assertTrue(killer.killRequestsSent.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun `packages whose install state cannot be determined are never killed`() = runTest {
        val killer = RecordingBackgroundProcessKiller { true }
        val inventory = fakeInventory(
            known = setOf("com.unknown.app"),
            installed = emptySet(),
            unknown = setOf("com.unknown.app")
        )
        val provider = ScriptedMemoryProvider(
            snapshot(availableBytes = 1_000_000_000L),
            snapshot(availableBytes = 1_000_000_000L)
        )

        val useCase = ClearMemoryUseCase(killer, inventory, provider)
        val result = useCase()

        assertEquals(0, result.processesTouched)
        assertTrue(killer.killRequestsSent.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun `if memory info is unavailable, result says so instead of inventing a number`() = runTest {
        val killer = RecordingBackgroundProcessKiller { true }
        val inventory = fakeInventory(
            known = setOf("com.test.app"),
            installed = setOf("com.test.app")
        )
        val provider = ScriptedMemoryProvider(null, null)

        val useCase = ClearMemoryUseCase(killer, inventory, provider)
        val result = useCase()

        assertEquals(0L, result.freedBytes)
        assertTrue(result.note.contains("unavailable", ignoreCase = true))
    }
}
```

## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/core/FileServiceCoreTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteStatus
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsType
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.WalkLimits
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.FileServiceCore
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.ReplyStatus
import com.cleanforge.testutil.FaultyFs
import com.cleanforge.testutil.InMemoryFs
import com.cleanforge.testutil.ROOT
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import org.junit.Test

/** The code that runs inside the privileged process, driven over an in-memory filesystem. */
class FileServiceCoreTest {
    private val mem = InMemoryFs()
    private val fs = FaultyFs(mem)
    private val core = FileServiceCore(fs, ownPackage = "com.cleanforge")
    private val data = "$ROOT/Android/data"

    private fun guard(vararg packages: String) = core.setProtectedPackages(arrayOf(*packages))

    private fun deleteTree(path: String): com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteResult {
        val st = mem.lstat(path)!!
        return core.delete(path, DeleteMode.TREE.code, st.dev, st.ino, true)
    }

    private fun clearCache(path: String): com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteResult {
        val st = mem.lstat(path)!!
        return core.delete(path, DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY.code, st.dev, st.ino, true)
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ path policy

    @Test fun `reads outside Android data and obb are refused, whatever the spelling`() {
        mem.file("$ROOT/DCIM/Camera/IMG.jpg")
        val bad = listOf(
            "$ROOT/DCIM",
            "$ROOT/Android",
            "$ROOT/Android/media/com.a",
            "/data/data/com.example",
            "$ROOT/Android/data/../../DCIM",
            "$ROOT/Android/data/./com.a",
            "$ROOT/Android/data/com.a/",
            "relative/Android/data",
            "$ROOT/Android/data/com.a\u0000/x",
            ""
        )
        for (p in bad) {
            assertThat(core.stat(p).status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.REFUSED)
            assertThat(core.list(p).status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.REFUSED)
            assertThat(core.size(p).status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.REFUSED)
        }
        assertThat(core.stat(null).status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.REFUSED)
        assertThat(core.list(null).status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.REFUSED)
        assertThat(core.size(null).status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.REFUSED)
    }

    @Test fun `a symlink anywhere above the target refuses the call instead of following it`() {
        mem.file("$ROOT/DCIM/cache/photo.jpg")
        mem.symlink("$data/com.x")
        assertThat(core.stat("$data/com.x/cache").status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.REFUSED)
        assertThat(core.list("$data/com.x/cache").status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.REFUSED)
        assertThat(core.size("$data/com.x/cache").status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.REFUSED)
        val r = core.delete("$data/com.x/cache", DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY.code, 1L, 1L, true)
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.REFUSED)
        assertThat(mem.exists("$ROOT/DCIM/cache/photo.jpg")).isTrue()
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ reads say why

    @Test fun `stat tells found, missing, denied and failed apart`() {
        mem.file("$data/com.a/cache/x.bin", 10)
        val found = core.stat("$data/com.a/cache/x.bin")
        assertThat(found.status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.OK)
        assertThat(found.stat!!.type).isEqualTo(FsType.FILE)
        assertThat(found.stat!!.size).isEqualTo(10L)

        assertThat(core.stat("$data/com.nope").status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.NOT_FOUND)
        assertThat(core.stat("$data/com.nope/cache").status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.NOT_FOUND) // missing parent

        fs.denyProbe += "$data/com.a"
        assertThat(core.stat("$data/com.a").status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.OS_DENIED)
        fs.denyProbe.clear()
        fs.errorProbe += "$data/com.a"
        assertThat(core.stat("$data/com.a").status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.FAILED)
    }

    @Test fun `listing keeps names with spaces and unicode exactly as they are`() {
        mem.mkdirs("$data/my app")
        mem.file("$data/com.a/cache/\u0394 file (1).txt")
        mem.file("$data/com.a/cache/two  spaces.bin")
        val top = core.list(data)
        assertThat(top.status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.OK)
        assertThat(top.names).containsExactly("my app", "com.a")
        val cache = core.list("$data/com.a/cache")
        assertThat(cache.names).containsExactly("\u0394 file (1).txt", "two  spaces.bin")
    }

    @Test fun `a folder the OS refuses to list is reported as denied, not as empty`() {
        mem.mkdirs("$data/com.a")
        fs.denyList += "$data/com.a"
        val r = core.list("$data/com.a")
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.OS_DENIED)
        assertThat(r.names).isEmpty()
    }

    @Test fun `listing a file or a missing folder does not pretend to be an empty folder`() {
        mem.file("$data/com.a/file.txt")
        assertThat(core.list("$data/com.a/file.txt").status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.FAILED)
        assertThat(core.list("$data/com.zzz").status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.NOT_FOUND)
    }

    @Test fun `a long listing is cut by count and by total name length and says so`() {
        for (i in 1..5) mem.mkdirs("$data/com.aaaa$i")
        val byCount = FileServiceCore(fs, "x", maxNames = 3).list(data)
        assertThat(byCount.names).hasSize(3)
        assertThat(byCount.truncated).isTrue()

        val byChars = FileServiceCore(fs, "x", maxListChars = 20).list(data) // each name is 9 characters
        assertThat(byChars.names).hasSize(2)
        assertThat(byChars.truncated).isTrue()

        val all = core.list(data)
        assertThat(all.names).hasSize(5)
        assertThat(all.truncated).isFalse()
    }

    @Test fun `size counts unreadable sub-folders so the figure is never presented as exact`() {
        mem.file("$data/com.a/cache/ok.bin", 50)
        mem.file("$data/com.a/cache/locked/hidden.bin", 70)
        fs.denyList += "$data/com.a/cache/locked"
        val r = core.size("$data/com.a/cache")
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.OK)
        assertThat(r.size!!.bytes).isEqualTo(50L)
        assertThat(r.size!!.unreadable).isEqualTo(1)
        assertThat(r.size!!.complete).isTrue()
        assertThat(r.size!!.isExact).isFalse()
    }

    @Test fun `size of a folder walked to its safety bound is incomplete`() {
        for (i in 1..10) mem.file("$data/com.a/cache/f$i.bin", 10)
        val bounded = FileServiceCore(fs, "x", walkLimits = WalkLimits(maxDepth = 32, maxEntries = 3))
        val r = bounded.size("$data/com.a/cache")
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.OK)
        assertThat(r.size!!.complete).isFalse()
        assertThat(r.size!!.isExact).isFalse()
    }

    @Test fun `a complete measurement of a readable folder is exact`() {
        mem.file("$data/com.a/cache/a.bin", 40)
        mem.file("$data/com.a/cache/sub/b.bin", 60)
        val r = core.size("$data/com.a/cache")
        assertThat(r.size!!.bytes).isEqualTo(100L)
        assertThat(r.size!!.isExact).isTrue()
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ the installed-apps guard

    @Test fun `a tree delete is refused until the app has installed the guard`() {
        mem.file("$data/com.gone/files/save.dat")
        val r = deleteTree("$data/com.gone")
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.REFUSED)
        assertThat(mem.exists("$data/com.gone/files/save.dat")).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `a tree delete is refused for a package Android knows, in any letter case`() {
        mem.file("$data/COM.Known.APP/files/save.dat")
        assertThat(guard("com.known.app", "com.other")).isEqualTo(2)
        val r = deleteTree("$data/COM.Known.APP")
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.REFUSED)
        assertThat(mem.exists("$data/COM.Known.APP/files/save.dat")).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `a tree delete never removes the app's own folder`() {
        mem.file("$data/com.cleanforge/files/x")
        guard("com.other")
        assertThat(deleteTree("$data/com.cleanforge").status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.REFUSED)
        mem.file("$data/Com.CleanForge2/files/x") // a different package that merely starts the same way
        assertThat(deleteTree("$data/Com.CleanForge2").status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.OK)
    }

    @Test fun `with the guard installed a real leftover is removed completely`() {
        mem.file("$data/com.gone/files/save.dat", 30)
        mem.file("$ROOT/Android/obb/com.gone/main.obb", 70)
        guard("com.other")
        val a = deleteTree("$data/com.gone")
        assertThat(a.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.OK)
        assertThat(a.bytesFreed).isEqualTo(30L)
        assertThat(mem.exists("$data/com.gone")).isFalse()
        assertThat(deleteTree("$ROOT/Android/obb/com.gone").status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.OK)
    }

    @Test fun `an oversized or null guard list is rejected and the previous guard stays`() {
        mem.file("$data/com.keep/files/save.dat")
        assertThat(guard("com.keep")).isEqualTo(1)
        assertThat(core.setProtectedPackages(Array(5_001) { "com.p$it" })).isEqualTo(-1)
        assertThat(core.setProtectedPackages(null)).isEqualTo(-1)
        assertThat(deleteTree("$data/com.keep").status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.REFUSED)
    }

    @Test fun `names that cannot be a package are ignored by the guard, not stored`() {
        assertThat(guard("com.ok", "not a package", "../x", "", "a;b.c")).isEqualTo(1)
    }

    @Test fun `clearing an app cache needs no guard and leaves the folder in place`() {
        mem.file("$data/com.example/cache/a.bin", 40)
        mem.file("$data/com.example/cache/sub/b.bin", 60)
        val r = clearCache("$data/com.example/cache")
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.OK)
        assertThat(r.bytesFreed).isEqualTo(100L)
        assertThat(mem.exists("$data/com.example/cache")).isTrue()
        assertThat(mem.list("$data/com.example/cache")).isEmpty()
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ what may be deleted at all

    @Test fun `delete refuses every shape except the two it exists for`() {
        mem.file("$data/com.a/cache/sub/x.bin")
        mem.file("$ROOT/DCIM/Camera/IMG.jpg")
        guard("com.other")
        val dcim = mem.lstat("$ROOT/DCIM/Camera")!!
        val st = mem.lstat("$data/com.a")!!
        val cases = listOf(
            Triple("$data/com.a/cache/sub", DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY.code, st),
            Triple(data, DeleteMode.TREE.code, st),
            Triple("$ROOT/DCIM/Camera", DeleteMode.TREE.code, dcim),
            Triple("$data/com.a", DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY.code, st),
            Triple("$data/com.a/cache", DeleteMode.FILE.code, st),
            Triple("$data/com.a/cache", DeleteMode.EMPTY_DIR.code, st),
            Triple("$data/com.a/cache", 99, st)
        )
        for ((path, mode, stat) in cases) {
            val r = core.delete(path, mode, stat.dev, stat.ino, true)
            assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.REFUSED)
        }
        assertThat(core.delete(null, DeleteMode.TREE.code, 1L, 1L, true).status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.REFUSED)
        assertThat(core.delete("$data/com.a", DeleteMode.TREE.code, st.dev, st.ino, false).status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.REFUSED)
        assertThat(mem.exists("$ROOT/DCIM/Camera/IMG.jpg")).isTrue()
        assertThat(mem.exists("$data/com.a/cache/sub/x.bin")).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `a replaced or missing target is reported as such and nothing is touched`() {
        mem.file("$data/com.a/cache/x.bin")
        val st = mem.lstat("$data/com.a/cache")!!
        val changed = core.delete("$data/com.a/cache", DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY.code, st.dev, st.ino + 999, true)
        assertThat(changed.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.IDENTITY_CHANGED)
        assertThat(mem.exists("$data/com.a/cache/x.bin")).isTrue()

        val missing = core.delete("$data/com.nope/cache", DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY.code, 1L, 1L, true)
        assertThat(missing.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.MISSING)
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ cancellation

    @Test fun `a cancel request stops the delete between entries and reports what was already removed`() {
        for (name in listOf("a", "b", "c", "d", "e")) mem.file("$data/com.a/cache/$name.bin", 10)
        fs.afterRemove = { core.cancelCurrent() } // the user presses Stop right after the first removal
        val r = clearCache("$data/com.a/cache")
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.CANCELLED)
        assertThat(r.entriesRemoved).isEqualTo(1)
        assertThat(r.bytesFreed).isEqualTo(10L)
        assertThat(mem.list("$data/com.a/cache")).hasSize(4)
        assertThat(mem.exists("$data/com.a/cache")).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `a cancel that arrived before the delete started is not remembered`() {
        mem.file("$data/com.a/cache/a.bin", 10)
        core.cancelCurrent()
        val r = clearCache("$data/com.a/cache")
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.OK) // documented limitation: the app-side wait is what ends early
        assertThat(mem.list("$data/com.a/cache")).isEmpty()
    }

    @Test fun `a cancelled tree delete never removes the folder itself`() {
        for (name in listOf("a", "b", "c")) mem.file("$data/com.gone/files/$name.dat", 10)
        guard("com.other")
        fs.afterRemove = { core.cancelCurrent() }
        val r = deleteTree("$data/com.gone")
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.CANCELLED)
        assertThat(mem.exists("$data/com.gone")).isTrue()
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core

import com.cleanforge.core.scanner.InstagramScanner
import com.cleanforge.core.scanner.Requirement
import com.cleanforge.core.scanner.Scanner

import com.cleanforge.testutil.InMemoryFs
import com.cleanforge.testutil.ROOT
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.toList
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import org.junit.Test

/** Part 3: each forensic scanner flags only its allowlisted folders, respects age, and its output survives the validator. */
class ForensicScannersTest {
    private val day = 24L * 60 * 60 * 1000
    private val hour = 60L * 60 * 1000
    private val now = 100 * day
    private val validator = SafetyValidator()

    private suspend fun Scanner.found(): List<ScanItem> = scan().toList().flatten()

    private fun backend(fs: InMemoryFs) = StandardFileBackend(fs)

    private fun wa(fs: InMemoryFs, rel: String, ageMs: Long, pkg: String = "com.whatsapp"): String {
        val path = "$ROOT/Android/media/$pkg/WhatsApp/$rel"
        fs.file(path, size = 10, mtime = now - ageMs)
        return path
    }

    private fun assertAllValid(items: List<ScanItem>) {
        for (item in items) assertThat(validator.rejectionReason(item)).isNull()
    }

    // ---------- WhatsApp ----------

    @Test fun `whatsapp statuses need 24 hours, sent folders need no age, and everything else is ignored`() = runTest {
        val fs = InMemoryFs()
        val oldStatus = wa(fs, "Media/.Statuses/old.mp4", 25 * hour)
        wa(fs, "Media/.Statuses/new.mp4", 2 * hour)
        val sentVideo = wa(fs, "Media/WhatsApp Video/Sent/v.mp4", 1 * hour)
        val sentImage = wa(fs, "Media/WhatsApp Images/Sent/i.jpg", 30 * day)
        wa(fs, "Media/WhatsApp Images/IMG-received.jpg", 90 * day)       // received media: not ours
        wa(fs, "Media/WhatsApp Documents/Sent/d.pdf", 90 * day)          // folder not on the allowlist
        wa(fs, "Backups/other.bin", 90 * day)

        val scanner = WhatsAppScanner(backend(fs), FakeInventory(known = FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.whatsapp")), ROOT, { now })
        val items = scanner.found()

        assertThat(items.map { it.path }).containsExactly(oldStatus, sentVideo, sentImage)
        assertAllValid(items)
        assertThat(items.all { it.category == CleaningCategory.FORENSIC_MEDIA }).isTrue()
        assertThat(items.all { it.deleteMode == DeleteMode.FILE }).isTrue()
        assertThat(items.none { it.requiresShizuku }).isTrue()
        assertThat(items.none { it.isPreselected }).isTrue()
        assertThat(items.all { it.owningPackage == "com.whatsapp" }).isTrue()
        assertThat(scanner.requirement).isEqualTo(Requirement.ALL_FILES_ACCESS)
    }

    @Test fun `sent media is not claimed to be safe because it may be the only copy`() = runTest {
        val fs = InMemoryFs()
        wa(fs, "Media/WhatsApp Images/Sent/i.jpg", 5 * day)
        val item = WhatsAppScanner(backend(fs), FakeInventory(known = FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.whatsapp")), ROOT, { now }).found().single()

        assertThat(item.risk).isEqualTo(RiskLevel.ELEVATED)
        assertThat(item.confidence).isEqualTo(ConfidenceLevel.MEDIUM)
        assertThat(item.reasonForFlagging).doesNotContain("Already in Gallery")
    }

    @Test fun `old chat backups keep the newest msgstore backup whatever its age`() = runTest {
        val fs = InMemoryFs()

        val older = wa(fs, "Databases/msgstore-2026-08-01.1.db.crypt14", 30 * day)
        val oldest = wa(fs, "Databases/msgstore-2026-07-01.1.db.crypt14", 40 * day)
        wa(fs, "Databases/msgstore.db.crypt14", 90 * day)   // live backup: no dash, never proposed
        wa(fs, "Databases/wa.db", 90 * day)

        val items = WhatsAppScanner(backend(fs), FakeInventory(known = FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.whatsapp")), ROOT, { now }).found()

        assertThat(items.map { it.path }).containsExactly(older, oldest)
        assertThat(items.map { it.path }).doesNotContain(newest)

        assertAllValid(items)
    }

        "$ROOT/Android/data/com.instagram.android/cache/a.bin".also { fs.file(it, 10, now - 13 * day) }
        val igOld = "$ROOT/Android/data/com.instagram.lite/cache/b.bin".also { fs.file(it, 10, now - 15 * day) }

        val inv = FakeInventory(known = FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.twitter.android", "com.instagram.android", "com.instagram.lite"))
        assertThat(TwitterXScanner(backend(fs), inv, ROOT, { now }).found().map { it.path }).containsExactly(x)
        assertThat(InstagramScanner(backend(fs), inv, ROOT, { now }).found().map { it.path }).containsExactly(igOld)
    }
}
```

## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/core/ForensicValidatorTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.safety.SafetyValidator
import com.cleanforge.testutil.ROOT
import com.cleanforge.testutil.scanItem
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import org.junit.Test

/** The FORENSIC_MEDIA allowlist: exact per-package folders, single direct-child files, never anything else. */
class ForensicValidatorTest {
    private val validator = SafetyValidator()
    private val wa = "$ROOT/Android/media/com.whatsapp/WhatsApp"

    private fun reason(path: String, pkg: String? = "com.whatsapp", mode: DeleteMode? = null) =
        validator.rejectionReason(scanItem(path, CleaningCategory.FORENSIC_MEDIA, pkg = pkg, mode = mode))

    @Test fun `allowlisted whatsapp files under Android media are accepted`() {
        assertThat(reason("$wa/Media/.Statuses/a.mp4")).isNull()
        assertThat(reason("$wa/Media/WhatsApp Video/Sent/v.mp4")).isNull()
        assertThat(reason("$wa/Media/WhatsApp Images/Sent/i.jpg")).isNull()
        assertThat(reason("$wa/Media/WhatsApp Animated Gifs/Sent/g.mp4")).isNull()
        assertThat(reason("$wa/Databases/msgstore-2026-08-01.1.db.crypt14")).isNull()
        assertThat(reason("$ROOT/Android/media/com.whatsapp.w4b/WhatsApp/Media/.Statuses/a.mp4", pkg = "com.whatsapp.w4b")).isNull()
        assertThat(reason("$ROOT/Android/media/org.telegram.messenger/Telegram/Telegram Video/v.mp4", pkg = "org.telegram.messenger")).isNull()
    }

    @Test fun `received media, other folders and the live backup are refused`() {
        assertThat(reason("$wa/Media/WhatsApp Images/IMG-1.jpg")).isNotNull()
        assertThat(reason("$wa/Media/WhatsApp Images/Private/i.jpg")).isNotNull()
        assertThat(reason("$wa/Media/WhatsApp Documents/Sent/d.pdf")).isNotNull()
        assertThat(reason("$wa/Databases/msgstore.db.crypt14")).isNotNull()
        assertThat(reason("$wa/Databases/wa.db")).isNotNull()
        assertThat(reason("$ROOT/Android/media/org.telegram.messenger/Telegram/Telegram Stories/s.mp4", pkg = "org.telegram.messenger")).isNotNull()
    }

    @Test fun `the folder itself and anything nested deeper are refused`() {
        assertThat(reason("$wa/Media/.Statuses")).isNotNull()
        assertThat(reason("$wa/Media/.Statuses/nested/a.mp4")).isNotNull()
        assertThat(reason("$wa/Databases/sub/msgstore-2026.db.crypt14")).isNotNull()
    }

    @Test fun `an item without a package, or with a different package than its folder, is refused`() {
        assertThat(reason("$wa/Media/.Statuses/a.mp4", pkg = null)).isNotNull()
        assertThat(reason("$wa/Media/.Statuses/a.mp4", pkg = "com.other.app")).isNotNull()
    }

    @Test fun `unknown packages and other Android folders are refused`() {
        assertThat(reason("$ROOT/Android/media/com.example.app/WhatsApp/Media/.Statuses/a.mp4", pkg = "com.example.app")).isNotNull()
        assertThat(reason("$ROOT/Android/data/com.whatsapp/files/x.bin")).isNotNull()
        assertThat(reason("$ROOT/Android/obb/com.whatsapp/main.obb")).isNotNull()
    }

    @Test fun `forensic items are refused inside personal folders`() {
        assertThat(reason("$ROOT/DCIM/Camera/a.jpg")).isNotNull()
        assertThat(reason("$ROOT/Download/a.mp4")).isNotNull()
    }

    @Test fun `forensic items are single files only`() {
        assertThat(reason("$wa/Media/.Statuses/a.mp4", mode = DeleteMode.TREE)).isNotNull()
        assertThat(reason("$wa/Media/.Statuses/a.mp4", mode = DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY)).isNotNull()
    }

    @Test fun `matching is case-insensitive like shared storage but the package must match exactly`() {
        assertThat(reason("$ROOT/android/MEDIA/com.whatsapp/whatsapp/media/.statuses/a.mp4")).isNull()
    }

    @Test fun `tiktok twitter and instagram files under Android data are accepted only in their exact folders`() {
        assertThat(reason("$ROOT/Android/data/com.zhiliaoapp.musically/cache/a.bin", pkg = "com.zhiliaoapp.musically")).isNull()
        assertThat(reason("$ROOT/Android/data/com.zhiliaoapp.musically/files/.music/a.mp3", pkg = "com.zhiliaoapp.musically")).isNull()
        assertThat(reason("$ROOT/Android/data/com.zhiliaoapp.musically/files/other/a.bin", pkg = "com.zhiliaoapp.musically")).isNotNull()
        assertThat(reason("$ROOT/Android/data/com.twitter.android/cache/a.bin", pkg = "com.twitter.android")).isNull()
        assertThat(reason("$ROOT/Android/data/com.instagram.android/databases/a.db", pkg = "com.instagram.android")).isNotNull()
    }

    @Test fun `a differently cased package folder is not the allowlisted package`() {
        assertThat(reason("$ROOT/Android/media/com.WhatsApp/WhatsApp/Media/.Statuses/a.mp4", pkg = "com.WhatsApp")).isNotNull()
    }
}
```

## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/core/MaintenanceModelTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core

import com.cleanforge.core.backend.DirListing
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.FsResult
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteResult
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteStatus
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsStat
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsType
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ConfidenceLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.RiskLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.ExternalArea
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.FailureKind
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.MaintenanceRequest
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.MaintenanceResult
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.PostState
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.PrivilegedOperation
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.classifyDeletion
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.deleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.observePostState
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.targetPathOrNull
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.toMaintenanceRequest
import com.cleanforge.testutil.FakeInventory
import com.cleanforge.testutil.ROOT
import com.cleanforge.testutil.scanItem
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import org.junit.Test

class MaintenanceModelTest {
    private val fp = FsStat(FsType.DIRECTORY, 0, 1_000, 1L, 42L)
    private val known = FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.other")

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ request building

    @Test fun `a request derives its path itself from a validated package name`() {
        assertThat(MaintenanceRequest.ClearExternalAppCache("com.example", fp).targetPathOrNull())
            .isEqualTo("$ROOT/Android/data/com.example/cache")
        assertThat(MaintenanceRequest.RemoveUninstalledAppData(ExternalArea.DATA, "com.gone", fp, known).targetPathOrNull())
            .isEqualTo("$ROOT/Android/data/com.gone")
        assertThat(MaintenanceRequest.RemoveUninstalledAppData(ExternalArea.OBB, "com.gone", fp, known).targetPathOrNull())
            .isEqualTo("$ROOT/Android/obb/com.gone")
    }

    @Test fun `package identifiers that could steer a path or a command have no target`() {
        val evil = listOf("../etc", "com.example/../../DCIM", "com.example; rm -rf /", "com.example && reboot", "my app", "", ".", "..", "a/b.c", "com.example\n", "\$(id).x.y", "com.exa`mple`.x")
        for (bad in evil) {
            assertThat(MaintenanceRequest.ClearExternalAppCache(bad, fp).targetPathOrNull()).isNull()
            assertThat(MaintenanceRequest.RemoveUninstalledAppData(ExternalArea.DATA, bad, fp, known).targetPathOrNull()).isNull()
        }
    }

    @Test fun `each request knows its operation and its delete mode`() {
        val cache = MaintenanceRequest.ClearExternalAppCache("com.example", fp)
        val tree = MaintenanceRequest.RemoveUninstalledAppData(ExternalArea.DATA, "com.gone", fp, known)
        assertThat(cache.operation).isEqualTo(PrivilegedOperation.CLEAR_EXTERNAL_APP_CACHE)
        assertThat(cache.deleteMode()).isEqualTo(DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY)
        assertThat(tree.operation).isEqualTo(PrivilegedOperation.REMOVE_UNINSTALLED_APP_DATA)
        assertThat(tree.deleteMode()).isEqualTo(DeleteMode.TREE)
    }

    private fun cacheItem(path: String = "$ROOT/Android/data/com.example/cache", pkg: String = "com.example", fingerprint: FsStat? = fp) =
        scanItem(path, CleaningCategory.APP_CACHE, ConfidenceLevel.HIGH, RiskLevel.SAFE, pkg, shizuku = true, fingerprint = fingerprint)

    private fun corpseItem(path: String = "$ROOT/Android/data/com.gone", pkg: String = "com.gone", fingerprint: FsStat? = fp) =
        scanItem(path, CleaningCategory.CORPSE_LEFTOVER, pkg = pkg, shizuku = true, fingerprint = fingerprint)

    @Test fun `scan items map to the two supported requests`() {
        val cache = cacheItem().toMaintenanceRequest(known)
        assertThat(cache).isEqualTo(MaintenanceRequest.ClearExternalAppCache("com.example", fp))

        val data = corpseItem().toMaintenanceRequest(known) as MaintenanceRequest.RemoveUninstalledAppData
        assertThat(data.area).isEqualTo(ExternalArea.DATA)
        assertThat(data.knownPackages).isEqualTo(known)

        val obb = corpseItem("$ROOT/Android/obb/com.gone").toMaintenanceRequest(known) as MaintenanceRequest.RemoveUninstalledAppData
        assertThat(obb.area).isEqualTo(ExternalArea.OBB)
    }

    @Test fun `an item that is not exactly one of those shapes maps to nothing, so nothing weaker is run`() {
        assertThat(cacheItem(fingerprint = null).toMaintenanceRequest(known)).isNull()
        assertThat(cacheItem(pkg = "com.other").toMaintenanceRequest(known)).isNull() // folder belongs to another package
        assertThat(cacheItem(path = "$ROOT/Android/data/com.example/cache/sub").toMaintenanceRequest(known)).isNull()
        assertThat(cacheItem(path = "$ROOT/Android/data/com.example").toMaintenanceRequest(known)).isNull()
        assertThat(cacheItem(path = "$ROOT/android/DATA/com.example/cache").toMaintenanceRequest(known)).isNull() // not the canonical spelling
        assertThat(corpseItem(path = "$ROOT/Android/data/com.gone/files").toMaintenanceRequest(known)).isNull()
        assertThat(corpseItem(path = "$ROOT/Android/media/com.gone").toMaintenanceRequest(known)).isNull()
        assertThat(corpseItem(pkg = "com.not.matching").toMaintenanceRequest(known)).isNull()
        assertThat(corpseItem(path = "$ROOT/Android/data/com.gone/").toMaintenanceRequest(known)).isNull() // trailing slash
        assertThat(scanItem("$ROOT/Download/x.bin", shizuku = true, fingerprint = fp).toMaintenanceRequest(known)).isNull()
        assertThat(scanItem("$ROOT/Android/data/com.example/cache", CleaningCategory.LARGE_FILE, pkg = "com.example", shizuku = true, fingerprint = fp)
            .toMaintenanceRequest(known)).isNull()
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ classification

    private fun classify(mode: DeleteMode, status: DeleteStatus, post: PostState = PostState.Gone, entries: Int = 0, bytes: Long = 0, detail: String = "") =
        classifyDeletion(mode, DeleteResult(status, entries, bytes, detail), post)

    @Test fun `OK plus the expected end state is a verified success`() {
        val tree = classify(DeleteMode.TREE, DeleteStatus.OK, PostState.Gone, 3, 90)
        assertThat(tree).isEqualTo(MaintenanceResult.Success(3, 90))
        val cache = classify(DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY, DeleteStatus.OK, PostState.ExistsEmpty, 2, 50)
        assertThat(cache).isEqualTo(MaintenanceResult.Success(2, 50))
        assertThat(classify(DeleteMode.FILE, DeleteStatus.OK, PostState.Gone, 1, 10)).isInstanceOf(MaintenanceResult.Success::class.java)
    }

    @Test fun `OK that the end state contradicts is Partial, never Success`() {
        assertThat(classify(DeleteMode.TREE, DeleteStatus.OK, PostState.ExistsNonEmpty("the folder is still present"), 2, 20))
            .isInstanceOf(MaintenanceResult.Partial::class.java)
        assertThat(classify(DeleteMode.TREE, DeleteStatus.OK, PostState.ExistsEmpty, 2, 20))
            .isInstanceOf(MaintenanceResult.Partial::class.java)
        val cache = classify(DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY, DeleteStatus.OK, PostState.ExistsNonEmpty("3 entries remain"), 2, 20)
        assertThat(cache).isInstanceOf(MaintenanceResult.Partial::class.java)
        assertThat((cache as MaintenanceResult.Partial).bytesFreed).isEqualTo(20L)
    }

    @Test fun `OK that cannot be checked afterwards is Unverified and keeps the reported bytes`() {
        val r = classify(DeleteMode.TREE, DeleteStatus.OK, PostState.Unknown("service stopped"), 2, 20) as MaintenanceResult.Unverified
        assertThat(r.bytesFreed).isEqualTo(20L)
        assertThat(r.message).contains("service stopped")
    }

    @Test fun `a cache folder that vanished with its contents still counts as cleared`() {
        assertThat(classify(DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY, DeleteStatus.OK, PostState.Gone, 1, 5)).isInstanceOf(MaintenanceResult.Success::class.java)
    }

    @Test fun `partial, limit and cancel results keep the work that was really done`() {
        val partial = classify(DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY, DeleteStatus.PARTIAL, entries = 4, bytes = 400, detail = "Could not remove an entry") as MaintenanceResult.Partial
        assertThat(partial.bytesFreed).isEqualTo(400L)
        assertThat(partial.message).contains("Could not remove an entry")

        assertThat(classify(DeleteMode.TREE, DeleteStatus.LIMIT_EXCEEDED, entries = 9, bytes = 90)).isInstanceOf(MaintenanceResult.Partial::class.java)
        val limit0 = classify(DeleteMode.TREE, DeleteStatus.LIMIT_EXCEEDED) as MaintenanceResult.Failure
        assertThat(limit0.kind).isEqualTo(FailureKind.LIMIT)

        assertThat(classify(DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY, DeleteStatus.CANCELLED, entries = 1, bytes = 10)).isInstanceOf(MaintenanceResult.Partial::class.java)
        val cancel0 = classify(DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY, DeleteStatus.CANCELLED) as MaintenanceResult.Failure
        assertThat(cancel0.kind).isEqualTo(FailureKind.CANCELLED)
    }

    @Test fun `statuses that mean nothing was deleted become precondition, refusal or failure`() {
        for (s in listOf(DeleteStatus.MISSING, DeleteStatus.IDENTITY_CHANGED, DeleteStatus.WRONG_TYPE)) {
            assertThat((classify(DeleteMode.TREE, s) as MaintenanceResult.Failure).kind).isEqualTo(FailureKind.PRECONDITION_CHANGED)
        }
        assertThat((classify(DeleteMode.TREE, DeleteStatus.REFUSED) as MaintenanceResult.Failure).kind).isEqualTo(FailureKind.REFUSED)
        val failed = classify(DeleteMode.FILE, DeleteStatus.FAILED, detail = "Could not remove file") as MaintenanceResult.Failure
        assertThat(failed.kind).isEqualTo(FailureKind.IO_ERROR)
        assertThat(failed.message).isEqualTo("Could not remove file")
        assertThat((classify(DeleteMode.FILE, DeleteStatus.UNAVAILABLE) as MaintenanceResult.Failure).kind).isEqualTo(FailureKind.UNAVAILABLE)
    }

    @Test fun `a timeout is Unverified, never a failure that implies nothing happened`() {
        assertThat(classify(DeleteMode.TREE, DeleteStatus.TIMED_OUT)).isInstanceOf(MaintenanceResult.Unverified::class.java)
    }

    @Test fun `every delete status is classified`() {
        for (s in DeleteStatus.entries) {
            for (mode in DeleteMode.entries) {
                for (post in listOf(PostState.Gone, PostState.ExistsEmpty, PostState.ExistsNonEmpty("x"), PostState.Unknown("y"))) {
                    assertThat(classify(mode, s, post, 1, 1).message).isNotNull()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ observing the end state

    private suspend fun observe(
        mode: DeleteMode,
        stat: FsResult<FsStat>,
        list: FsResult<DirListing> = FsResult.Ok(DirListing(emptyList()))
    ) = observePostState("/x", mode, { stat }, { list })

    @Test fun `end state is read from stat and list without ever treating a failure as gone`() = runTest {
        assertThat(observe(DeleteMode.TREE, FsResult.NotFound)).isEqualTo(PostState.Gone)
        assertThat(observe(DeleteMode.TREE, FsResult.Ok(fp))).isInstanceOf(PostState.ExistsNonEmpty::class.java)
        assertThat(observe(DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY, FsResult.Ok(fp))).isEqualTo(PostState.ExistsEmpty)
        assertThat(observe(DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY, FsResult.Ok(fp), FsResult.Ok(DirListing(listOf("a", "b")))))
            .isEqualTo(PostState.ExistsNonEmpty("2 entries remain"))
        assertThat(observe(DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY, FsResult.Ok(fp), FsResult.Ok(DirListing(listOf("a"), truncated = true))))
            .isEqualTo(PostState.ExistsNonEmpty("many entries remain"))
        assertThat(observe(DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY, FsResult.Ok(fp), FsResult.NotFound)).isEqualTo(PostState.Gone)

        for (bad in listOf(FsResult.Unavailable("u"), FsResult.Denied("d"), FsResult.Failed("f"))) {
            assertThat(observe(DeleteMode.TREE, bad)).isInstanceOf(PostState.Unknown::class.java)
            assertThat(observe(DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY, FsResult.Ok(fp), bad)).isInstanceOf(PostState.Unknown::class.java)
        }
    }
}
```
