## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/core/MemInfoParserTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core

import com.cleanforge.core.memory.MemInfoParser
import com.cleanforge.core.memory.MemoryPressure
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import org.junit.Test

class MemInfoParserTest {

    private val REALISTIC = """
        MemTotal:        3925568 kB
        MemFree:          234560 kB
        MemAvailable:    1456784 kB
        Buffers:           45632 kB
        Cached:          1234560 kB
        SwapCached:            0 kB
        SwapTotal:       2097148 kB
        SwapFree:        2097148 kB
        HugePages_Total:       0
    """.trimIndent()

    @Test fun `parses a realistic meminfo with kB units into bytes`() {
        val s = MemInfoParser.parse(REALISTIC, timestamp = 1000L)!!
        assertThat(s.totalBytes).isEqualTo(3925568L * 1024)
        assertThat(s.availableBytes).isEqualTo(1456784L * 1024)
        assertThat(s.freeBytes).isEqualTo(234560L * 1024)
        assertThat(s.cachedBytes).isEqualTo(1234560L * 1024)
        assertThat(s.swapTotalBytes).isEqualTo(2097148L * 1024)
        assertThat(s.timestamp).isEqualTo(1000L)
    }

    @Test fun `used is total minus available and never negative`() {
        val s = MemInfoParser.parse(REALISTIC, 0)!!
        assertThat(s.usedBytes).isEqualTo((3925568L - 1456784L) * 1024)
        assertThat(s.usedBytes).isAtLeast(0L)
    }

    @Test fun `missing MemTotal returns null, not a fake zero snapshot`() {
        val noTotal = "MemFree: 100 kB\nMemAvailable: 50 kB"
        assertThat(MemInfoParser.parse(noTotal, 0)).isNull()
    }

    @Test fun `missing MemAvailable falls back to free plus buffers plus cached`() {
        val content = """
            MemTotal: 1000 kB
            MemFree: 200 kB
            Buffers: 100 kB
            Cached: 300 kB
        """.trimIndent()
        val s = MemInfoParser.parse(content, 0)!!
        assertThat(s.availableBytes).isEqualTo((200L + 100L + 300L) * 1024)
    }

    @Test fun `available is clamped to total on corrupted input`() {
        val content = "MemTotal: 100 kB\nMemAvailable: 999999 kB"
        val s = MemInfoParser.parse(content, 0)!!
        assertThat(s.availableBytes).isEqualTo(100L * 1024)
        assertThat(s.usedBytes).isEqualTo(0L)
    }

    @Test fun `garbage lines are skipped without crashing`() {
        val content = "MemTotal: 1024 kB\nnot-a-real-line\n::::\nMemFree: 512 kB"
        val s = MemInfoParser.parse(content, 0)!!
        assertThat(s.totalBytes).isEqualTo(1024L * 1024)
        assertThat(s.freeBytes).isEqualTo(512L * 1024)
    }

    @Test fun `pressure reflects available fraction not used fraction`() {
        // 30% available -> NORMAL, even though 70% is "used" (which is normal on Android).
        val s = MemInfoParser.parse("MemTotal: 1000 kB\nMemAvailable: 300 kB", 0)!!
        assertThat(s.pressure).isEqualTo(MemoryPressure.NORMAL)

        val critical = MemInfoParser.parse("MemTotal: 1000 kB\nMemAvailable: 30 kB", 0)!!
        assertThat(critical.pressure).isEqualTo(MemoryPressure.CRITICAL)
    }

    @Test fun `empty content returns null`() {
        assertThat(MemInfoParser.parse("", 0)).isNull()
    }

    @Test fun `a zero MemTotal returns null, not a zero-byte snapshot`() {
        assertThat(MemInfoParser.parse("MemTotal: 0 kB\nMemAvailable: 0 kB", 0)).isNull()
    }
}
```

## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/core/PlanBuilderTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core

import com.cleanforge.core.cleaning.PlanBuilder
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsStat
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsType
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ConfidenceLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.RiskLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.safety.SafetyValidator
import com.cleanforge.testutil.ROOT
import com.cleanforge.testutil.scanItem
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import org.junit.Test

class PlanBuilderTest {
    private val builder = PlanBuilder(SafetyValidator())
    private val stat = FsStat(FsType.FILE, 10, 1, 1, 1)

    @Test fun `refused items are kept with their reason and never planned`() {
        val bad = scanItem("$ROOT/Download/../../etc/passwd")
        val good = scanItem("$ROOT/Download/a.bin")
        val plan = builder.build(listOf(bad, good), listOf(bad, good))
        assertThat(plan.items).containsExactly(good)
        assertThat(plan.rejected).hasSize(1)
        assertThat(plan.rejected[0].reason).isNotEmpty()
    }

    @Test fun `an item inside a folder that is also selected is dropped as covered`() {
        // Both are individually valid; the second lies inside the first folder's contents-only clean.
        val folder = scanItem("$ROOT/DCIM/.thumbnails", CleaningCategory.THUMBNAIL)
        val inner = scanItem("$ROOT/DCIM/.thumbnails/t1.jpg", CleaningCategory.LARGE_FILE)
        val plan = builder.build(listOf(folder, inner), listOf(folder, inner))
        assertThat(plan.items).containsExactly(folder)
        assertThat(plan.rejected.map { it.item }).containsExactly(inner)
        assertThat(plan.rejected[0].reason).contains("covered")
    }

    @Test fun `same path selected twice is planned once`() {
        val a = scanItem("$ROOT/Download/a.bin")
        val plan = builder.build(listOf(a, a), listOf(a))
        assertThat(plan.items).hasSize(1)
        assertThat(plan.rejected).hasSize(1)
    }

    // ---------- duplicates: the copy that stays is whichever one the user did NOT tick ----------

    private fun copy(path: String, ino: Long, group: String = "g1") = scanItem(
        path, CleaningCategory.DUPLICATE, ConfidenceLevel.MEDIUM, RiskLevel.ELEVATED,
        fingerprint = FsStat(FsType.FILE, 10, 1, 1, ino), groupId = group
    )

    @Test fun `deleting the OLDEST copy is allowed and the unticked copy is pinned as the keeper`() {
        val oldest = copy("$ROOT/Pictures/family-photo.jpg", ino = 1)   // scanner lists the oldest first
        val newer = copy("$ROOT/Download/family-photo.jpg", ino = 2)
        val plan = builder.build(selected = listOf(oldest), scanned = listOf(oldest, newer))
        assertThat(plan.items.map { it.path }).containsExactly(oldest.path)
        assertThat(plan.items[0].keepPath).isEqualTo(newer.path)
        assertThat(plan.items[0].keepFingerprint).isEqualTo(newer.fingerprint)
        assertThat(plan.rejected).isEmpty()
    }

    @Test fun `deleting the newer copy instead pins the oldest as the keeper`() {
        val oldest = copy("$ROOT/Pictures/a.jpg", ino = 1)
        val newer = copy("$ROOT/Download/a.jpg", ino = 2)
        val plan = builder.build(selected = listOf(newer), scanned = listOf(oldest, newer))
        assertThat(plan.items.map { it.path }).containsExactly(newer.path)
        assertThat(plan.items[0].keepPath).isEqualTo(oldest.path)
    }

    @Test fun `every copy of a group selected means every one is refused`() {
        val a = copy("$ROOT/Pictures/a.jpg", ino = 1)
        val b = copy("$ROOT/Download/a.jpg", ino = 2)
        val plan = builder.build(selected = listOf(a, b), scanned = listOf(a, b))
        assertThat(plan.items).isEmpty()
        assertThat(plan.rejected.map { it.item.path }).containsExactly(a.path, b.path)
        assertThat(plan.rejected.all { it.reason.contains("at least one must stay") }).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `in a group of three, ticking two leaves the third as keeper for both`() {
        val a = copy("$ROOT/Pictures/a.jpg", ino = 1)
        val b = copy("$ROOT/Download/a.jpg", ino = 2)
        val c = copy("$ROOT/Movies/a.jpg", ino = 3)
        val plan = builder.build(selected = listOf(a, b), scanned = listOf(a, b, c))
        assertThat(plan.items.map { it.path }).containsExactly(a.path, b.path)
        assertThat(plan.items.map { it.keepPath }.toSet()).containsExactly(c.path)
    }

    @Test fun `a duplicate whose other copies are unknown is refused`() {
        val a = copy("$ROOT/Pictures/a.jpg", ino = 1)
        val plan = builder.build(selected = listOf(a), scanned = listOf(a))
        assertThat(plan.items).isEmpty()
        assertThat(plan.rejected).hasSize(1)
    }

    @Test fun `a duplicate without a group is refused`() {
        val lone = scanItem("$ROOT/Download/a.jpg", CleaningCategory.DUPLICATE, fingerprint = stat)
        assertThat(builder.build(listOf(lone), listOf(lone)).items).isEmpty()
    }

    @Test fun `another category cannot be used to delete every copy of the same content`() {
        val a = copy("$ROOT/Pictures/a.mp4", ino = 1)
        val b = copy("$ROOT/Download/a.mp4", ino = 2)
        // The user ticked both files through the "large files" list.
        val bigA = scanItem(a.path, CleaningCategory.LARGE_FILE, fingerprint = a.fingerprint)
        val bigB = scanItem(b.path, CleaningCategory.LARGE_FILE, fingerprint = b.fingerprint)
        val plan = builder.build(selected = listOf(bigA, bigB), scanned = listOf(bigA, bigB, a, b))
        assertThat(plan.items).isEmpty()
        assertThat(plan.rejected.map { it.item.path }).containsExactly(a.path, b.path)
    }

    @Test fun `a path flagged as both large file and duplicate is planned as the duplicate, keeper protection included`() {
        val a = copy("$ROOT/Pictures/a.mp4", ino = 1)
        val b = copy("$ROOT/Download/a.mp4", ino = 2)
        val bigA = scanItem(a.path, CleaningCategory.LARGE_FILE, fingerprint = a.fingerprint)
        val plan = builder.build(selected = listOf(bigA, a), scanned = listOf(bigA, a, b))
        assertThat(plan.items).hasSize(1)
        assertThat(plan.items[0].category).isEqualTo(CleaningCategory.DUPLICATE)
        assertThat(plan.items[0].keepPath).isEqualTo(b.path)
    }

    @Test fun `a copy inside a folder that is cleaned in the same run is not a keeper`() {
        val folder = scanItem("$ROOT/DCIM/.thumbnails", CleaningCategory.THUMBNAIL)
        val outside = copy("$ROOT/Download/a.jpg", ino = 1)
        val inside = copy("$ROOT/DCIM/.thumbnails/a.jpg", ino = 2)
        val plan = builder.build(selected = listOf(folder, outside), scanned = listOf(folder, outside, inside))
        assertThat(plan.items).containsExactly(folder)
        assertThat(plan.rejected.map { it.item.path }).containsExactly(outside.path)
        assertThat(plan.rejected[0].reason).contains("at least one must stay")
    }

    @Test fun `another category cannot delete one copy while the other is wiped with its folder`() {
        val folder = scanItem("$ROOT/DCIM/.thumbnails", CleaningCategory.THUMBNAIL)
        val a = copy("$ROOT/Download/a.mp4", ino = 1)
        val b = copy("$ROOT/DCIM/.thumbnails/a.mp4", ino = 2)
        val bigA = scanItem(a.path, CleaningCategory.LARGE_FILE, fingerprint = a.fingerprint)
        val plan = builder.build(selected = listOf(folder, bigA), scanned = listOf(folder, bigA, a, b))
        assertThat(plan.items).containsExactly(folder)
        assertThat(plan.rejected.map { it.item.path }).containsExactly(a.path)
    }
}
```

## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/core/PolicyGuardTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core

import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.File

/** Source/manifest-level guards: they fail the build if someone reintroduces a shell call or a network path. */
class PolicyGuardTest {

    private val moduleDir: File? = listOf(File("."), File("app")).firstOrNull { File(it, "src/main/AndroidManifest.xml").exists() }

    @Test fun `no source file builds or runs shell commands`() {
        assumeTrue(moduleDir != null)
        val forbidden = listOf(
            Regex("""Runtime\s*\.\s*getRuntime"""),
            Regex("""\bProcessBuilder\b"""),
            Regex("""\.exec\s*\("""),
            Regex("""Shizuku\s*\.\s*newProcess"""),
            Regex("""\bsh\s+-c\b""")
        )
        val offenders = File(moduleDir, "src/main/java").walkTopDown()
            .filter { it.isFile && it.extension == "kt" }
            .flatMap { f -> forbidden.filter { it.containsMatchIn(f.readText()) }.map { "${f.name}: ${it.pattern}" } }
            .toList()
        assertThat(offenders).isEmpty()
    }

   @Test fun `manifest declares exactly the permissions the app needs and no network access`() {
    assumeTrue(moduleDir != null)
    val manifest = File(moduleDir, "src/main/AndroidManifest.xml").readText()
    val declared = Regex("""<uses-permission[^>]*android:name="([^"]+)"""").findAll(manifest).map { it.groupValues[1] }.toSet()
    // KILL_BACKGROUND_PROCESSES is Part 4's HONEST RAM clear. It only trims processes Android
    // already considers reclaimable. It is NOT root and NOT a "boost". Deliberate and documented,
    // not permission creep.
    assertThat(declared).containsExactly(
        "android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE",
        "android.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES",
        "android.permission.KILL_BACKGROUND_PROCESSES",
        // Tap feedback only (Haptics.kt). A normal permission: no data access, no network.
        "android.permission.VIBRATE"
    )
    assertThat(manifest).doesNotContain("android.permission.INTERNET")
    assertThat(manifest).doesNotContain("ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE")
    assertThat(manifest).contains("android:allowBackup=\"false\"")
    }

    @Test fun `build files contain no analytics ads crash-reporting or unvetted repositories`() {
        assumeTrue(moduleDir != null)
        val files = listOf(
            File(moduleDir, "build.gradle.kts"),
            File(moduleDir, "../build.gradle.kts"),
            File(moduleDir, "../settings.gradle.kts"),
            File(moduleDir, "../gradle/libs.versions.toml")
        ).filter { it.exists() }
        val banned = listOf("firebase", "crashlytics", "admob", "play-services-ads", "sentry", "appcenter",
            "mixpanel", "amplitude", "analytics", "xposed", "jitpack")
        val hits = files.flatMap { f -> banned.filter { f.readText().lowercase().contains(it) }.map { "${f.name}: $it" } }
        assertThat(hits).isEmpty()
    }

    @Test fun `the confirmation dialog renders full evidence and never a bare file name`() {
        assumeTrue(moduleDir != null)
        val dialogs = File(moduleDir, "src/main/java/com/cleanforge/ui/components/Dialogs.kt").readText()
        assertThat(dialogs).contains("confirmationEvidence()")
        assertThat(dialogs).doesNotContain("displayName")
        assertThat(dialogs).doesNotContain("and \${plan.items.size - ")
    }

    @Test fun `installed and known packages stay two separate questions`() {
        assumeTrue(moduleDir != null)
        val main = File(moduleDir, "src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core")
        // Every decision about a package's install state goes through the tri-state answer, never a bare boolean:
        // a failed query is UNKNOWN, and "not installed" is only ever an authoritative answer.
        assertThat(File(main, "scanner/CacheScanner.kt").readText()).contains("installState(")
        assertThat(File(main, "scanner/CorpseScanner.kt").readText()).contains("installState(")
        assertThat(File(main, "cleaning/CleaningEngine.kt").readText()).contains("installState(")
        for (f in listOf("scanner/CacheScanner.kt", "scanner/CorpseScanner.kt", "cleaning/CleaningEngine.kt")) {
            assertThat(File(main, f).readText()).doesNotContain("isCurrentlyInstalled(")
        }
        val inventory = File(main, "backend/PackageInventory.kt").readText()
        // "Installed" must never be answered from the list that includes data-kept uninstalls.
        val installedBody = inventory.substringAfter("override fun isCurrentlyInstalled").substringBefore("override fun installedVersionCode")
        assertThat(installedBody).doesNotContain("MATCH_UNINSTALLED_PACKAGES")
        // The authoritative lookup: INSTALLED requires FLAG_INSTALLED, a missing package is told apart from a failed query.
        val stateBody = inventory.substringAfter("override fun installState").substringBefore("override fun archiveInfo")
        assertThat(stateBody).contains("FLAG_INSTALLED")
        assertThat(stateBody).contains("NameNotFoundException")
        assertThat(stateBody).contains("InstallState.UNKNOWN")
        assertThat(stateBody.indexOf("NameNotFoundException")).isLessThan(stateBody.indexOf("catch (e: Exception)"))
    }

    // ---------- Part 2: the privileged surface stays small and shell-free ----------

    @Test fun `the privileged service has no shell, no process spawning and no generic delete`() {
        assumeTrue(moduleDir != null)
        val core = File(moduleDir, "src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core")
        val privilegedSources = listOf(
            "privileged/FileServiceCore.kt", "privileged/WireCodec.kt", "shizuku/ShizukuFileService.kt",
            "shizuku/AidlPrivilegedFileApi.kt", "privileged/PrivilegedExecutor.kt"
        ).map { File(core, it).readText() }
        for (text in privilegedSources) {
            assertThat(text).doesNotContain("Runtime.getRuntime")
            assertThat(text).doesNotContain("ProcessBuilder")
            assertThat(text).doesNotContain(".exec(")
            assertThat(text).doesNotContain("Shizuku.newProcess")
            assertThat(text).doesNotContain("deleteRecursively")
        }
    }

    @Test fun `the Shizuku read backend has no delete and the executor accepts requests, not paths`() {
        assumeTrue(moduleDir != null)
        val core = File(moduleDir, "src/main/java/com/cleanforge/core")
        assertThat(File(core, "backend/ShizukuFileBackend.kt").readText()).doesNotContain("fun delete")
        val executor = File(core, "privileged/PrivilegedExecutor.kt").readText()
        val iface = executor.substringAfter("interface PrivilegedExecutor").substringBefore("data class ExecutionPolicy")
        assertThat(iface).contains("suspend fun execute(request: MaintenanceRequest)")
        assertThat(iface).doesNotContain("fun delete")
        assertThat(iface).doesNotContain("mode: DeleteMode")
    }

    @Test fun `the AIDL contract only grows, and existing transaction ids keep their meaning`() {
        assumeTrue(moduleDir != null)
        val aidl = File(moduleDir, "src/main/aidl/com/cleanforge/shizuku/IFileService.aidl").readText()
        val ids = Regex("""(\w+)\s*\([^)]*\)\s*=\s*(\d+)\s*;""").findAll(aidl).associate { it.groupValues[1] to it.groupValues[2].toInt() }
        assertThat(ids).containsEntry("destroy", 16777114)
        assertThat(ids).containsEntry("uid", 1)
        assertThat(ids).containsEntry("lstat", 2)
        assertThat(ids).containsEntry("list", 3)
        assertThat(ids).containsEntry("directorySize", 4)
        assertThat(ids).containsEntry("delete", 5)
        assertThat(ids).containsEntry("apiVersion", 6)
        assertThat(ids).containsEntry("statEx", 7)
        assertThat(ids).containsEntry("listEx", 8)
        assertThat(ids).containsEntry("sizeEx", 9)
        assertThat(ids).containsEntry("deleteEx", 10)
        assertThat(ids).containsEntry("cancelCurrent", 11)
        assertThat(ids).containsEntry("setProtectedPackages", 12)
        // No two methods share an id.
        assertThat(ids.values.toSet()).hasSize(ids.size)
        // Array arguments need an explicit direction.
        assertThat(aidl).contains("in String[] packages")
    }

    @Test fun `no UI or ViewModel code calls the Shizuku API directly or blocks the main thread on it`() {
        assumeTrue(moduleDir != null)
        val ui = File(moduleDir, "src/main/java/com/cleanforge/ui")
        val offenders = ui.walkTopDown().filter { it.isFile && it.extension == "kt" }
            .filter { it.readText().contains("rikka.shizuku.Shizuku") }
            .map { it.name }.toList()
        // The only UI file allowed to touch the Shizuku package is the card that opens the Shizuku app by package name.
        assertThat(offenders).isEmpty()
        val vm = File(ui, "CleanViewModel.kt").readText()
        // refresh() makes binder calls, so it may only run inside an IO coroutine.
        assertThat(Regex("""viewModelScope\.launch\(Dispatchers\.IO\)\s*\{\s*shizuku\.refresh\(\)""").containsMatchIn(vm)).isTrue()
        // ...and the view model must never call it from its init block or a main-thread callback.
        assertThat(Regex("""fun onResume\(\)\s*\{[^}]*shizuku\.refresh""").containsMatchIn(vm)).isFalse()
    }

    @Test fun `recursive deletion never falls back to generic helpers`() {
        assumeTrue(moduleDir != null)
        val offenders = File(moduleDir, "src/main/java").walkTopDown()
            .filter { it.isFile && it.extension == "kt" }
            .filter { Regex("""deleteRecursively\s*\(""").containsMatchIn(it.readText()) }
            .map { it.name }.toList()
        assertThat(offenders).isEmpty()
    }
}
```

## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/core/PrivilegedExecutorTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core

import com.cleanforge.core.backend.FsResult
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsStat
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.CapabilityRegistry
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.CapabilityStatus
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.DefaultPrivilegedExecutor
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.ExecutionPolicy
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.ExternalArea
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.FailureKind
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.FileServiceCore
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.MaintenanceRequest
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.MaintenanceResult
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.PrivilegedOperation
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.SessionResult
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.TransportException
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.UnavailableReason
import com.cleanforge.core.shizuku.ShizukuState
import com.cleanforge.testutil.FakeInventory
import com.cleanforge.testutil.FakeSessionProvider
import com.cleanforge.testutil.FakeShizukuState
import com.cleanforge.testutil.FaultyFs
import com.cleanforge.testutil.InMemoryFs
import com.cleanforge.testutil.LocalPrivilegedFileApi
import com.cleanforge.testutil.ROOT
import com.cleanforge.testutil.ScriptedApi
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.async
import kotlinx.coroutines.awaitAll
import kotlinx.coroutines.cancelAndJoin
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeout
import org.junit.Test
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger

/**
 * The execution layer against the REAL service logic, with the service made to die, hang, refuse and race.
 * These use runBlocking (real time) on purpose: the deadlines are real, and runTest's virtual time would fire them early.
 * Binder, Shizuku and the AIDL stub are NOT covered here (device tests).
 */
class PrivilegedExecutorTest {

    private class Rig(
        policy: ExecutionPolicy = ExecutionPolicy(),
        withRegistry: Boolean = false,
        shizukuState: ShizukuState = ShizukuState.Authorized(2000, 13)
    ) {
        val mem = InMemoryFs()
        val faulty = FaultyFs(mem)
        val core = FileServiceCore(faulty, "com.cleanforge")
        val calls: MutableList<String> = CopyOnWriteArrayList()
        @Volatile var before: (String) -> Unit = {}
        @Volatile var after: (String) -> Unit = {}
        val bindings = AtomicInteger()

        /** Every (re)bind creates a NEW api object, like a new Binder, but shares the recorded calls and the hooks. */
        val provider = FakeSessionProvider {
            bindings.incrementAndGet()
            ScriptedApi(LocalPrivilegedFileApi(core), calls).also { api ->
                api.before = { name -> before(name) }
                api.after = { name -> after(name) }
            }
        }
        val shizuku = FakeShizukuState(shizukuState)
        val registry: CapabilityRegistry? =
            if (withRegistry) CapabilityRegistry(shizuku, provider, minProbeIntervalMs = 0L, probeCallTimeoutMs = 2_000L) else null
        val executor = DefaultPrivilegedExecutor(provider, registry, policy)

        val data = "$ROOT/Android/data"
        val cache = "$data/com.example/cache"

        fun fingerprint(path: String): FsStat = mem.lstat(path)!!
        fun clearCache(pkg: String = "com.example", fp: FsStat = fingerprint(cache)) =
            MaintenanceRequest.ClearExternalAppCache(pkg, fp)

        fun removeLeftover(pkg: String, known: Set<String> = FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.other"), area: ExternalArea = ExternalArea.DATA) =
            MaintenanceRequest.RemoveUninstalledAppData(
                area, pkg, fingerprint("$ROOT/Android/${area.folder}/$pkg"), known
            )
    }

    private fun killed(why: String = "The Shizuku service stopped") =
        TransportException(TransportException.Kind.SERVICE_DIED, why)

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ reads

    @Test fun `reads report found, missing and refused for what they are`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.mem.file("${rig.cache}/a.bin", 40)
        rig.mem.file("${rig.cache}/sub/b.bin", 60)

        val st = rig.executor.stat(rig.cache)
        assertThat(st).isInstanceOf(FsResult.Ok::class.java)

        val listing = rig.executor.list(rig.cache) as FsResult.Ok
        assertThat(listing.value.names).containsExactly("a.bin", "sub")
        assertThat(listing.value.truncated).isFalse()

        val size = rig.executor.measure(rig.cache) as FsResult.Ok
        assertThat(size.value.bytes).isEqualTo(100L)
        assertThat(size.value.isExact).isTrue()

        assertThat(rig.executor.stat("${rig.data}/com.nope")).isEqualTo(FsResult.NotFound)
        assertThat(rig.executor.stat("$ROOT/DCIM")).isInstanceOf(FsResult.Denied::class.java)
    }

    @Test fun `a folder the OS will not list is Denied, never an empty list`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.mem.mkdirs("${rig.data}/com.a")
        rig.faulty.denyList += "${rig.data}/com.a"
        val r = rig.executor.list("${rig.data}/com.a")
        assertThat(r).isInstanceOf(FsResult.Denied::class.java)
    }

    @Test fun `with no usable service every read says Unavailable and carries the reason`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.provider.notReady = SessionResult.NotReady(UnavailableReason.NOT_RUNNING, "Shizuku is not running")
        for (r in listOf(rig.executor.stat(rig.cache), rig.executor.list(rig.cache), rig.executor.measure(rig.cache))) {
            assertThat(r).isInstanceOf(FsResult.Unavailable::class.java)
            assertThat((r as FsResult.Unavailable).why).isEqualTo("Shizuku is not running")
        }
        assertThat(rig.calls).isEmpty()
    }

    @Test fun `a service that dies during a read is rebound and the read retried once`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.mem.file("${rig.cache}/a.bin")
        val deaths = AtomicInteger()
        rig.before = { name -> if (name == "stat" && deaths.getAndIncrement() == 0) throw killed() }
        val r = rig.executor.stat(rig.cache)
        assertThat(r).isInstanceOf(FsResult.Ok::class.java)
        assertThat(rig.provider.invalidations.get()).isEqualTo(1)
        assertThat(rig.bindings.get()).isEqualTo(2) // a fresh binding served the retry
    }

    @Test fun `a service that keeps dying is reported Unavailable after the retry budget`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.before = { name -> if (name == "list") throw killed("gone for good") }
        val r = rig.executor.list(rig.data)
        assertThat(r).isInstanceOf(FsResult.Unavailable::class.java)
        assertThat((r as FsResult.Unavailable).why).contains("gone for good")
        assertThat(rig.provider.invalidations.get()).isEqualTo(2) // first attempt + one retry
    }

    @Test fun `a failed call that is not a death is a Failed result and is not retried`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.before = { name ->
            if (name == "size") throw TransportException(TransportException.Kind.CALL_FAILED, "reply too large")
        }
        val r = rig.executor.measure(rig.data)
        assertThat(r).isInstanceOf(FsResult.Failed::class.java)
        assertThat(rig.calls.count { it == "size" }).isEqualTo(1)
        assertThat(rig.provider.invalidations.get()).isEqualTo(0)
    }

    @Test fun `a hung read times out, the service is restarted, and the caller gets an answer`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig(ExecutionPolicy(statTimeoutMs = 150L))
        val release = CountDownLatch(1)
        rig.provider.onRestart = { release.countDown() } // stopping the process frees the blocked thread
        rig.before = { name ->
            if (name == "stat") {
                release.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                throw killed("killed")
            }
        }
        val r = rig.executor.stat(rig.cache)
        assertThat(r).isInstanceOf(FsResult.Unavailable::class.java)
        assertThat((r as FsResult.Unavailable).why).contains("did not answer")
        assertThat(rig.provider.restarts.get()).isEqualTo(1)
    }

    @Test fun `reads never run more than the configured number at once`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig(ExecutionPolicy(maxConcurrentReads = 2))
        rig.mem.file("${rig.cache}/a.bin")
        val running = AtomicInteger()
        val peak = AtomicInteger()
        rig.before = { name ->
            if (name == "stat") {
                val now = running.incrementAndGet()
                peak.updateAndGet { maxOf(it, now) }
                Thread.sleep(40)
            }
        }
        rig.after = { name -> if (name == "stat") running.decrementAndGet() }
        withTimeout(20_000) {
            (1..8).map { async(Dispatchers.Default) { rig.executor.stat(rig.cache) } }.awaitAll()
        }
        assertThat(peak.get()).isAtMost(2)
        assertThat(peak.get()).isAtLeast(1)
    }

    @Test fun `cancelling the caller of a read returns promptly even though the service is still blocked`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        val entered = CountDownLatch(1)
        val release = CountDownLatch(1)
        rig.before = { name ->
            if (name == "stat") {
                entered.countDown()
                release.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            }
        }
        val job = launch(Dispatchers.Default) { rig.executor.stat(rig.cache) }
        assertThat(entered.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)).isTrue()
        withTimeout(2_000) { job.cancelAndJoin() }
        assertThat(job.isCancelled).isTrue()
        release.countDown()
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ maintenance: results

    @Test fun `clearing a cache succeeds, is verified, and the folder stays`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.mem.file("${rig.cache}/a.bin", 40)
        rig.mem.file("${rig.cache}/sub/b.bin", 60)
        val r = rig.executor.execute(rig.clearCache())
        assertThat(r).isInstanceOf(MaintenanceResult.Success::class.java)
        assertThat((r as MaintenanceResult.Success).bytesFreed).isEqualTo(100L)
        assertThat(rig.mem.exists(rig.cache)).isTrue()
        assertThat(rig.mem.list(rig.cache)).isEmpty()
    }

    @Test fun `removing a real leftover succeeds and the folder is gone`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.mem.file("${rig.data}/com.gone/files/save.dat", 30)
        val r = rig.executor.execute(rig.removeLeftover("com.gone"))
        assertThat(r).isInstanceOf(MaintenanceResult.Success::class.java)
        assertThat(rig.mem.exists("${rig.data}/com.gone")).isFalse()
    }

    @Test fun `invalid package identifiers are refused before anything reaches the service`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.mem.file("${rig.cache}/a.bin")
        val fp = rig.fingerprint(rig.cache)
        for (bad in listOf("../etc", "com.example; rm -rf /", "my app", "", "com.example/../../DCIM", "com.example\n", "\$(reboot).x.y")) {
            val r = rig.executor.execute(MaintenanceRequest.ClearExternalAppCache(bad, fp))
            assertThat(r).isInstanceOf(MaintenanceResult.Failure::class.java)
            assertThat((r as MaintenanceResult.Failure).kind).isEqualTo(FailureKind.REFUSED)
            val r2 = rig.executor.execute(
                MaintenanceRequest.RemoveUninstalledAppData(ExternalArea.DATA, bad, fp, FakeInventory.defaultPackages())
            )
            assertThat((r2 as MaintenanceResult.Failure).kind).isEqualTo(FailureKind.REFUSED)
        }
        assertThat(rig.calls).isEmpty()
        assertThat(rig.provider.acquires.get()).isEqualTo(0)
        assertThat(rig.mem.exists("${rig.cache}/a.bin")).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `a leftover removal with an untrustworthy package list is refused without calling the service`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.mem.file("${rig.data}/com.gone/files/save.dat")
        val r = rig.executor.execute(rig.removeLeftover("com.gone", known = setOf("only.one")))
        assertThat((r as MaintenanceResult.Failure).kind).isEqualTo(FailureKind.REFUSED)
        assertThat(rig.calls).isEmpty()
        assertThat(rig.mem.exists("${rig.data}/com.gone/files/save.dat")).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `the service guard stops a leftover removal for a package Android still knows`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.mem.file("${rig.data}/com.known/files/save.dat")
        val r = rig.executor.execute(rig.removeLeftover("com.known", known = FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.known")))
        assertThat(r).isInstanceOf(MaintenanceResult.Failure::class.java)
        assertThat((r as MaintenanceResult.Failure).kind).isEqualTo(FailureKind.REFUSED)
        assertThat(rig.mem.exists("${rig.data}/com.known/files/save.dat")).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `the guard is pushed once per binding and again after a rebind`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.mem.file("${rig.data}/com.gone1/f")
        rig.mem.file("${rig.data}/com.gone2/f")
        rig.mem.file("${rig.data}/com.gone3/f")
        rig.executor.execute(rig.removeLeftover("com.gone1"))
        rig.executor.execute(rig.removeLeftover("com.gone2"))
        assertThat(rig.calls.count { it == "setProtectedPackages" }).isEqualTo(1)
        rig.provider.invalidate() // a new binding: the new service process knows no guard
        rig.executor.execute(rig.removeLeftover("com.gone3"))
        assertThat(rig.calls.count { it == "setProtectedPackages" }).isEqualTo(2)
        assertThat(rig.mem.exists("${rig.data}/com.gone3")).isFalse()
    }

    @Test fun `a target that changed since the scan is a precondition failure and nothing is deleted`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.mem.file("${rig.cache}/a.bin")
        val stale = rig.fingerprint(rig.cache).copy(ino = 9_999L)
        val r = rig.executor.execute(rig.clearCache(fp = stale))
        assertThat((r as MaintenanceResult.Failure).kind).isEqualTo(FailureKind.PRECONDITION_CHANGED)
        assertThat(rig.mem.exists("${rig.cache}/a.bin")).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `files names with spaces and odd characters are cleared like any other`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.mem.file("${rig.cache}/my cache file (1).tmp", 10)
        rig.mem.file("${rig.cache}/dir with spaces/\u0394 data \u30c6.bin", 20)
        rig.mem.file("${rig.cache}/semi;colon && pipe | \$HOME.bin", 30)
        val r = rig.executor.execute(rig.clearCache())
        assertThat(r).isInstanceOf(MaintenanceResult.Success::class.java)
        assertThat((r as MaintenanceResult.Success).bytesFreed).isEqualTo(60L)
        assertThat(rig.mem.list(rig.cache)).isEmpty()
    }

    @Test fun `a partly failed cleanup is Partial with the bytes that really went`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.mem.file("${rig.cache}/a.bin", 10)
        rig.mem.file("${rig.cache}/b.bin", 20)
        rig.mem.file("${rig.cache}/c.bin", 30)
        rig.mem.denyRemove += "${rig.cache}/b.bin"
        val r = rig.executor.execute(rig.clearCache())
        assertThat(r).isInstanceOf(MaintenanceResult.Partial::class.java)
        assertThat((r as MaintenanceResult.Partial).bytesFreed).isEqualTo(40L)
        assertThat(rig.mem.exists("${rig.cache}/b.bin")).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `success that is contradicted by what is seen afterwards is Partial, not Success`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.mem.file("${rig.cache}/a.bin", 10)
        rig.after = { name -> if (name == "delete") rig.mem.file("${rig.cache}/new.bin", 5) } // the app writes again at once
        val r = rig.executor.execute(rig.clearCache())
        assertThat(r).isInstanceOf(MaintenanceResult.Partial::class.java)
        assertThat((r as MaintenanceResult.Partial).message).contains("files remain")
    }

    @Test fun `a success whose end state cannot be read is Unverified, with the bytes the service reported`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.mem.file("${rig.cache}/a.bin", 10)
        // The delete works, then the OS stops letting the shell look at the folder.
        rig.after = { name -> if (name == "delete") rig.faulty.errorProbe += rig.cache }
        val r = rig.executor.execute(rig.clearCache())
        assertThat(r).isInstanceOf(MaintenanceResult.Unverified::class.java)
        assertThat((r as MaintenanceResult.Unverified).bytesFreed).isEqualTo(10L)
        assertThat(r.message).contains("could not be confirmed")
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ maintenance: the service dies or hangs

    @Test fun `service death after the work was done is verified through a fresh binding`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.mem.file("${rig.data}/com.gone/files/save.dat", 30)
        rig.after = { name -> if (name == "delete") throw killed() } // the reply is lost, the deletion happened
        val r = rig.executor.execute(rig.removeLeftover("com.gone"))
        assertThat(r).isInstanceOf(MaintenanceResult.Success::class.java)
        assertThat((r as MaintenanceResult.Success).bytesFreed).isEqualTo(0L) // unknown, and not invented
        assertThat(r.message).contains("unknown")
        assertThat(rig.mem.exists("${rig.data}/com.gone")).isFalse()
        assertThat(rig.provider.invalidations.get()).isAtLeast(1)
    }

    @Test fun `service death before any work leaves the item Unverified, never Success`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.mem.file("${rig.data}/com.gone/files/save.dat", 30)
        rig.before = { name -> if (name == "delete") throw killed() }
        val r = rig.executor.execute(rig.removeLeftover("com.gone"))
        assertThat(r).isInstanceOf(MaintenanceResult.Unverified::class.java)
        assertThat(rig.mem.exists("${rig.data}/com.gone/files/save.dat")).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `service death with the end state unreachable is Unverified and says to scan again`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.mem.file("${rig.cache}/a.bin", 10)
        val dead = AtomicInteger(0)
        rig.before = { name -> if (name == "delete" || dead.get() == 1) { dead.set(1); throw killed("gone") } }
        val r = rig.executor.execute(rig.clearCache())
        assertThat(r).isInstanceOf(MaintenanceResult.Unverified::class.java)
        assertThat((r as MaintenanceResult.Unverified).message).contains("Scan again")
    }

    @Test fun `a deletion that never returns times out, restarts the service, and reports the observed state`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig(ExecutionPolicy(deleteTimeoutMs = 200L))
        rig.mem.file("${rig.cache}/a.bin", 10)
        val release = CountDownLatch(1)
        rig.provider.onRestart = { release.countDown() } // killing the process frees the blocked call, which then dies
        rig.before = { name ->
            if (name == "delete") {
                release.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                throw killed("killed")
            }
        }
        val r = rig.executor.execute(rig.clearCache())
        assertThat(r).isInstanceOf(MaintenanceResult.Unverified::class.java)
        assertThat((r as MaintenanceResult.Unverified).message).contains("did not answer")
        assertThat(rig.provider.restarts.get()).isEqualTo(1)
        assertThat(rig.mem.exists("${rig.cache}/a.bin")).isTrue() // the service was killed before it deleted anything
    }

    @Test fun `cancelling the caller during a deletion tells the service to stop`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        rig.mem.file("${rig.cache}/a.bin", 10)
        val entered = CountDownLatch(1)
        val release = CountDownLatch(1)
        rig.before = { name ->
            if (name == "delete") {
                entered.countDown()
                release.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            }
        }
        val job = launch(Dispatchers.Default) { rig.executor.execute(rig.clearCache()) }
        assertThat(entered.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)).isTrue()
        withTimeout(2_000) { job.cancelAndJoin() }
        assertThat(job.isCancelled).isTrue()
        // The stop request is sent in the background; give it a moment.
        var seen = false
        for (i in 1..40) {
            if ("cancelCurrent" in rig.calls) { seen = true; break }
            delay(50)
        }
        release.countDown()
        assertThat(seen).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `deletions are strictly one at a time`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig()
        for (i in 1..4) rig.mem.file("${rig.data}/com.app$i/cache/x.bin", 10)
        val running = AtomicInteger()
        val peak = AtomicInteger()
        rig.before = { name ->
            if (name == "delete") {
                val now = running.incrementAndGet()
                peak.updateAndGet { maxOf(it, now) }
                Thread.sleep(30)
            }
        }
        rig.after = { name -> if (name == "delete") running.decrementAndGet() }
        // Fingerprints are taken up front: the in-memory filesystem is not safe to read while another thread deletes.
        val requests = (1..4).map { i -> rig.clearCache("com.app$i", rig.fingerprint("${rig.data}/com.app$i/cache")) }
        withTimeout(20_000) {
            requests.map { request -> async(Dispatchers.Default) { rig.executor.execute(request) } }.awaitAll()
        }
        assertThat(peak.get()).isEqualTo(1)
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ capability gate

    @Test fun `an operation the registry says cannot run is Unsupported and never reaches the service`() = runBlocking {
        val states = listOf(
            ShizukuState.NotRunning to CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
            ShizukuState.PermissionDenied to CapabilityStatus.NEEDS_AUTHORIZATION,
            ShizukuState.PermissionPermanentlyDenied to CapabilityStatus.NEEDS_AUTHORIZATION,
            ShizukuState.ServerTooOld to CapabilityStatus.UNSUPPORTED
        )
        for ((state, expected) in states) {
            val rig = Rig(withRegistry = true, shizukuState = state)
            rig.mem.file("${rig.cache}/a.bin")
            val r = rig.executor.execute(rig.clearCache())
            assertThat(r).isInstanceOf(MaintenanceResult.Unsupported::class.java)
            assertThat((r as MaintenanceResult.Unsupported).capability).isEqualTo(expected)
            assertThat(r.message).isNotEmpty()
            assertThat(rig.calls).isEmpty()
            assertThat(rig.mem.exists("${rig.cache}/a.bin")).isTrue()
        }
    }

    @Test fun `a connected service is not enough when the OS will not let the shell read Android data`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig(withRegistry = true)
        rig.mem.file("${rig.cache}/a.bin")
        rig.faulty.denyList += rig.data
        rig.faulty.denyList += "$ROOT/Android/obb"
        val r = rig.executor.execute(rig.clearCache())
        assertThat(r).isInstanceOf(MaintenanceResult.Unsupported::class.java)
        assertThat((r as MaintenanceResult.Unsupported).capability).isEqualTo(CapabilityStatus.UNSUPPORTED)
        assertThat(rig.calls).doesNotContain("delete")
        assertThat(rig.mem.exists("${rig.cache}/a.bin")).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `a successful deletion upgrades the operation from ready to verified`() = runBlocking {
        val rig = Rig(withRegistry = true)
        rig.mem.file("${rig.cache}/a.bin", 10)
        val reg = rig.registry!!
        reg.probe(force = true)
        assertThat(reg.current(PrivilegedOperation.CLEAR_EXTERNAL_APP_CACHE).status).isEqualTo(CapabilityStatus.PREREQUISITES_MET)
        val r = rig.executor.execute(rig.clearCache())
        assertThat(r).isInstanceOf(MaintenanceResult.Success::class.java)
        assertThat(reg.current(PrivilegedOperation.CLEAR_EXTERNAL_APP_CACHE).status).isEqualTo(CapabilityStatus.VERIFIED)
    }
}
```

## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/core/ProcessMemoryTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core

import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.FileServiceCore
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.ProcSource
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.ProcessMemoryEntry
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.ProcessMemoryReader
import com.cleanforge.testutil.InMemoryFs
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import org.junit.Test

class ProcessMemoryTest {
    private class FakeProc(private val files: Map<Int, Map<String, String>>) : ProcSource {
        override fun processIds(): List<Int> = files.keys.toList()
        override fun read(pid: Int, name: String): String? = files[pid]?.get(name)
    }

    private fun status(uid: Int, rssKb: Long?) = buildString {
        append("Name:\tsomething\nUid:\t$uid\t$uid\t$uid\t$uid\n")
        if (rssKb != null) append("VmRSS:\t   $rssKb kB\n")
    }

    @Test fun `only app processes with a memory figure and a safe name are reported`() {
        val src = FakeProc(
            mapOf(
                1 to mapOf("status" to status(0, 100), "cmdline" to "init\u0000"), // root: never reported
                2 to mapOf("status" to status(10123, 2048), "cmdline" to "com.example.app\u0000"),
                3 to mapOf("status" to status(10124, 512), "cmdline" to "com.example.app:push\u0000"),
                4 to mapOf("status" to status(10125, null), "cmdline" to "com.example.nomem\u0000"), // no VmRSS
                5 to mapOf("status" to status(10126, 64), "cmdline" to ""), // no name
                6 to mapOf("status" to status(10127, 64), "cmdline" to "bad|name\u0000") // would break the wire format
            )
        )
        val r = ProcessMemoryReader.read(src)
        assertThat(r.map { it.processName }).containsExactly("com.example.app", "com.example.app:push").inOrder()
        assertThat(r.first().rssKb).isEqualTo(2048L)
    }

    @Test fun `the wire format round-trips and a damaged line is dropped instead of thrown`() {
        val entries = listOf(ProcessMemoryEntry(2, 10123, 2048, "com.example.app"))
        assertThat(ProcessMemoryReader.decode(ProcessMemoryReader.encode(entries))).isEqualTo(entries)
        assertThat(ProcessMemoryReader.decode(arrayOf("garbage", "1|2|x|y", "3|4|5|ok")))
            .containsExactly(ProcessMemoryEntry(3, 4, 5, "ok"))
        assertThat(ProcessMemoryReader.decode(null)).isEmpty()
    }

    @Test fun `the service core exposes the reader and takes no argument to steer it`() {
        val proc = FakeProc(mapOf(2 to mapOf("status" to status(10123, 1), "cmdline" to "a.b\u0000")))
        val core = FileServiceCore(InMemoryFs(), "com.cleanforge", proc = proc)
        assertThat(core.processMemory().toList()).containsExactly("2|10123|1|a.b")
    }
}
```

## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/core/SafeDeleterTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteStatus
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.SafeDeleter
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.WalkLimits
import com.cleanforge.testutil.HookedFs
import com.cleanforge.testutil.NioFsOps
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder
import java.io.File
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption

class SafeDeleterTest {
    @get:Rule val tmp = TemporaryFolder()

    private fun deleter(fs: com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsOps = NioFsOps, limits: WalkLimits = WalkLimits(48, 200_000)) =
        SafeDeleter(fs, limits)

    private fun dir(vararg parts: String): File = File(tmp.root, parts.joinToString("/")).also { it.mkdirs() }
    private fun write(f: File, text: String = "data") {
        f.parentFile?.mkdirs()
        Files.write(f.toPath(), text.toByteArray())
    }

    @Test fun `tree delete removes nested folders with spaces unicode and shell metacharacters`() {
        val root = dir("victim")
        write(File(root, "a b/ファイル/é.txt"))
        write(File(root, "\$(touch pwned);rm -rf x/`id`.txt"))
        write(File(root, "..hidden../x"))
        val r = deleter().delete(root.path, DeleteMode.TREE, null)
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.OK)
        assertThat(root.exists()).isFalse()
        assertThat(File("pwned").exists()).isFalse()
    }

    @Test fun `contents only keeps the folder itself`() {
        val root = dir("cache")
        write(File(root, "x/y.bin"), "1234")
        val r = deleter().delete(root.path, DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY, null)
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.OK)
        assertThat(root.isDirectory).isTrue()
        assertThat(root.list()!!.toList()).isEmpty()
        assertThat(r.bytesFreed).isEqualTo(4L)
    }

    @Test fun `symlink inside tree is unlinked but its target is never followed`() {
        val outside = dir("outside")
        val precious = File(outside, "precious.txt").also { write(it) }
        val root = dir("victim")
        write(File(root, "keep-me-not.txt"))
        Files.createSymbolicLink(File(root, "link-to-dir").toPath(), outside.toPath())
        Files.createSymbolicLink(File(root, "link-to-file").toPath(), precious.toPath())
        val r = deleter().delete(root.path, DeleteMode.TREE, null)
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.OK)
        assertThat(root.exists()).isFalse()
        assertThat(precious.exists()).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `symlink as the root is refused and target survives`() {
        val outside = dir("outside")
        val precious = File(outside, "precious.txt").also { write(it) }
        val link = File(tmp.root, "evil-link")
        Files.createSymbolicLink(link.toPath(), outside.toPath())
        for (mode in DeleteMode.entries) {
            val r = deleter().delete(link.path, mode, null)
            assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.WRONG_TYPE)
        }
        assertThat(precious.exists()).isTrue()
        assertThat(Files.isSymbolicLink(link.toPath())).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `missing path is reported not crashed`() {
        val r = deleter().delete(File(tmp.root, "nope").path, DeleteMode.TREE, null)
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.MISSING)
    }

    @Test fun `file mode refuses a directory and empty-dir mode refuses a non-empty one`() {
        val d = dir("d")
        write(File(d, "f"))
        assertThat(deleter().delete(d.path, DeleteMode.FILE, null).status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.WRONG_TYPE)
        assertThat(deleter().delete(d.path, DeleteMode.EMPTY_DIR, null).status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.FAILED)
        assertThat(File(d, "f").exists()).isTrue()
        File(d, "f").delete()
        assertThat(deleter().delete(d.path, DeleteMode.EMPTY_DIR, null).status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.OK)
    }

    @Test fun `file replaced after scan is detected by fingerprint`() {
        val f = File(tmp.root, "photo.jpg").also { write(it, "original") }
        val scanned = NioFsOps.lstat(f.path)!!
        f.delete()
        write(f, "something else entirely")
        val r = deleter().delete(f.path, DeleteMode.FILE, scanned)
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.IDENTITY_CHANGED)
        assertThat(f.exists()).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `directory that is not the one scanned is detected`() {
        // (Inode numbers can be reused after delete+recreate, so compare against a genuinely different directory.)
        val scannedElsewhere = NioFsOps.lstat(dir("other").path)!!
        val target = dir("cache").also { write(File(it, "x")) }
        val r = deleter().delete(target.path, DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY, scannedElsewhere)
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.IDENTITY_CHANGED)
        assertThat(File(target, "x").exists()).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `mount boundary is never crossed`() {
        val root = dir("root")
        val mount = dir("root", "mnt")
        val inside = File(mount, "other-filesystem.txt").also { write(it) }
        write(File(root, "normal.txt"))
        val fs = HookedFs().also { it.devOverride = { p -> if (p.startsWith(mount.path)) 4242L else null } }
        val r = deleter(fs).delete(root.path, DeleteMode.TREE, null)
        assertThat(r.status).isNotEqualTo(DeleteStatus.OK)
        assertThat(inside.exists()).isTrue()
        assertThat(File(root, "normal.txt").exists()).isFalse()
        assertThat(root.exists()).isTrue() // not removed because it still holds the mount point
    }

    @Test fun `depth limit stops runaway nesting`() {
        var d = dir("deep")
        repeat(10) { d = File(d, "n$it").also { f -> f.mkdirs() } }
        val r = deleter(limits = WalkLimits(maxDepth = 5, maxEntries = 1000)).delete(File(tmp.root, "deep").path, DeleteMode.TREE, null)
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.LIMIT_EXCEEDED)
        assertThat(File(tmp.root, "deep").exists()).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `entry limit stops huge folders`() {
        val root = dir("many")
        repeat(20) { write(File(root, "f$it")) }
        val r = deleter(limits = WalkLimits(maxDepth = 8, maxEntries = 5)).delete(root.path, DeleteMode.TREE, null)
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.LIMIT_EXCEEDED)
        assertThat(root.exists()).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `file appearing during deletion is never removed and is reported`() {
        val root = dir("racy")
        write(File(root, "a.txt"))
        val late = File(root, "late.txt")
        val fs = HookedFs().also {
            it.beforeRemove = { p -> if (p.endsWith("a.txt")) write(late) }
        }
        val r = deleter(fs).delete(root.path, DeleteMode.TREE, null)
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.PARTIAL)
        assertThat(late.exists()).isTrue()
        assertThat(root.exists()).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `long nested paths are handled`() {
        var d = dir("long")
        val name = "x".repeat(200)
        repeat(12) { d = File(d, name).also { f -> f.mkdirs() } }
        write(File(d, "leaf.txt"))
        val r = deleter().delete(File(tmp.root, "long").path, DeleteMode.TREE, null)
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.OK)
        assertThat(File(tmp.root, "long").exists()).isFalse()
    }

    @Test fun `single file deletion removes only that file`() {
        val a = File(tmp.root, "a.txt").also { write(it) }
        val b = File(tmp.root, "b.txt").also { write(it) }
        val r = deleter().delete(a.path, DeleteMode.FILE, NioFsOps.lstat(a.path))
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.OK)
        assertThat(a.exists()).isFalse()
        assertThat(b.exists()).isTrue()
    }

    // ---------- child-level race: swapped between inspection and removal (M3) ----------

    @Test fun `a child swapped for a different file after it was inspected is left alone`() {
        val root = dir("racy-file")
        val victim = File(root, "a.txt").also { write(it, "scanned original") }
        val other = File(root, "b.txt").also { write(it) }
        // Created while the victim still exists, so it is guaranteed to have a different inode.
        val replacement = File(tmp.root, "replacement.txt").also { write(it, "the user's new file") }
        var swapped = false
        val fs = HookedFs().also {
            it.afterLstat = { p ->
                if (!swapped && p == victim.path) {
                    swapped = true
                    Files.move(replacement.toPath(), victim.toPath(), StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING)
                }
            }
        }
        val r = deleter(fs).delete(root.path, DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY, null)
        assertThat(swapped).isTrue()
        assertThat(victim.readText()).isEqualTo("the user's new file")
        assertThat(r.status).isNotEqualTo(DeleteStatus.OK)
        assertThat(other.exists()).isFalse() // the untouched sibling is still cleaned
    }

    @Test fun `a sub-folder swapped for a symlink to elsewhere is never entered or emptied`() {
        val outside = dir("outside-race")
        val precious = File(outside, "precious.txt").also { write(it) }
        val root = dir("racy-dir")
        val sub = dir("racy-dir", "sub") // empty folder, replaced by a link right after it was inspected
        var swapped = false
        val fs = HookedFs().also {
            it.afterLstat = { p ->
                if (!swapped && p == sub.path) {
                    swapped = true
                    Files.delete(sub.toPath())
                    Files.createSymbolicLink(sub.toPath(), outside.toPath())
                }
            }
        }
        val r = deleter(fs).delete(root.path, DeleteMode.TREE, null)
        assertThat(swapped).isTrue()
        assertThat(precious.exists()).isTrue()
        assertThat(r.status).isNotEqualTo(DeleteStatus.OK)
        assertThat(root.exists()).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `a single file swapped just before removal is not removed`() {
        val f = File(tmp.root, "photo.jpg").also { write(it, "original") }
        val scanned = NioFsOps.lstat(f.path)!!
        val replacement = File(tmp.root, "other.jpg").also { write(it, "original") } // same size, different inode
        replacement.setLastModified(f.lastModified())
        var calls = 0
        val fs = HookedFs().also {
            it.afterLstat = { p ->
                // 1st lstat = SafeDeleter.delete(), 2nd = the re-check right before remove(): swap after the 1st.
                if (p == f.path && ++calls == 1) {
                    Files.move(replacement.toPath(), f.toPath(), StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING)
                }
            }
        }
        val r = deleter(fs).delete(f.path, DeleteMode.FILE, scanned)
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.IDENTITY_CHANGED)
        assertThat(f.exists()).isTrue()
    }

    // ---------- ancestors (regression: /storage is a tmpfs on a real phone, so every deletion was REFUSED) ----------

    @Test fun `folders above the target may live on another device`() {
        val target = dir("victim").also { write(File(it, "x.txt")) }
        val ancestors = generateSequence(target.parentFile) { it.parentFile }.map { it.path }.toSet()
        val fs = HookedFs().also { it.devOverride = { p -> if (p in ancestors) 777L else null } }
        val r = deleter(fs).delete(target.path, DeleteMode.TREE, null)
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.OK)
        assertThat(target.exists()).isFalse()
    }

    @Test fun `a symlinked parent folder is refused and nothing behind it is touched`() {
        val victim = dir("real", "cache")
        write(File(victim, "x.txt"))
        val link = File(tmp.root, "link")
        Files.createSymbolicLink(link.toPath(), File(tmp.root, "real").toPath())
        val r = deleter().delete(File(link, "cache").path, DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY, null)
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.REFUSED)
        assertThat(File(victim, "x.txt").exists()).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `only folders below the trusted root are inspected`() {
        val realRoot = dir("realroot")
        write(File(realRoot, "sub/x.txt"))
        val linkRoot = File(tmp.root, "linkroot")
        Files.createSymbolicLink(linkRoot.toPath(), realRoot.toPath())
        val r = SafeDeleter(NioFsOps, trustedRoot = linkRoot.path).delete(File(linkRoot, "sub").path, DeleteMode.TREE, null)
        assertThat(r.status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.OK)
        assertThat(File(realRoot, "sub").exists()).isFalse()
    }
}
```

## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/core/SafetyValidatorTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ConfidenceLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.RiskLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.safety.SafetyValidator
import com.cleanforge.testutil.ROOT
import com.cleanforge.testutil.scanItem
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import org.junit.Test

class SafetyValidatorTest {
    private val v = SafetyValidator()

    private fun refused(path: String, category: CleaningCategory = CleaningCategory.LARGE_FILE, pkg: String? = null) =
        v.rejectionReason(scanItem(path, category, pkg = pkg))

    // ---- lexical attacks ----

    @Test fun `parent traversal is rejected`() {
        assertThat(refused("$ROOT/Download/../../etc/passwd")).isNotNull()
        assertThat(refused("$ROOT/Download/a/../b.txt")).isNotNull()
    }

    @Test fun `relative empty NUL control trailing and doubled slashes are rejected`() {
        assertThat(refused("Download/a.txt")).isNotNull()
        assertThat(refused("")).isNotNull()
        assertThat(refused("$ROOT/Download/a\u0000.txt")).isNotNull()
        assertThat(refused("$ROOT/Download/a\n.txt")).isNotNull()
        assertThat(refused("$ROOT/Download/a.txt/")).isNotNull()
        assertThat(refused("$ROOT//Download/a.txt")).isNotNull()
        assertThat(refused("$ROOT/Download/./a.txt")).isNotNull()
    }

    @Test fun `over-long path is rejected`() {
        assertThat(refused("$ROOT/Download/" + "a".repeat(5000))).isNotNull()
    }

    @Test fun `sdcard and self-primary aliases are rejected (regression - they bypassed the DCIM protection)`() {
        assertThat(refused("/sdcard/DCIM/Camera/IMG_1.jpg")).isNotNull()
        assertThat(refused("/storage/self/primary/DCIM/Camera/IMG_1.jpg")).isNotNull()
    }

    @Test fun `system paths and the storage root are rejected`() {
        for (p in listOf("/", "/system/bin/sh", "/data/data/com.x", "/storage", "/storage/emulated", ROOT, "$ROOT/")) {
            assertThat(refused(p)).isNotNull()
        }
    }

    @Test fun `top-level storage folders themselves are rejected`() {
        for (d in listOf("DCIM", "Download", "Pictures", "Movies", "Music", "Documents", "Android", "SomeApp")) {
            assertThat(refused("$ROOT/$d")).isNotNull()
        }
    }

    @Test fun `dots inside a legitimate file name are fine`() {
        assertThat(refused("$ROOT/Download/my..file.zip")).isNull()
    }

    @Test fun `unicode spaces and symbols are accepted`() {
        assertThat(refused("$ROOT/Download/ファイル 名前 é #1 (copy).apk", CleaningCategory.APK_FILE)).isNull()
    }

    // ---- Android/ folder rules ----

    @Test fun `Android data obb and media folders cannot be deleted directly`() {
        for (p in listOf("$ROOT/Android/data", "$ROOT/Android/obb", "$ROOT/Android/media",
            "$ROOT/Android/data/com.x/files", "$ROOT/Android/media/com.whatsapp/WhatsApp/Media/a.jpg")) {
            assertThat(refused(p)).isNotNull()
        }
    }

    @Test fun `app cache is accepted only as contents-only of the exact cache folder`() {
        val ok = scanItem("$ROOT/Android/data/com.example/cache", CleaningCategory.APP_CACHE, pkg = "com.example")
        assertThat(v.rejectionReason(ok)).isNull()
        assertThat(v.rejectionReason(ok.copy(deleteMode = DeleteMode.TREE))).isNotNull()
        assertThat(v.rejectionReason(ok.copy(deleteMode = DeleteMode.FILE))).isNotNull()
        assertThat(v.rejectionReason(ok.copy(owningPackage = "com.other"))).isNotNull()
        assertThat(v.rejectionReason(ok.copy(path = "$ROOT/Android/data/com.example/files"))).isNotNull()
        assertThat(v.rejectionReason(ok.copy(path = "$ROOT/Android/data/com.example/cache/sub"))).isNotNull()
    }

    @Test fun `structural names are matched case-insensitively like the real filesystem`() {
        val item = scanItem("$ROOT/android/DATA/com.example/CACHE", CleaningCategory.APP_CACHE, pkg = "com.example")
        assertThat(v.rejectionReason(item)).isNull()
        // and the protected zones too:
        val personal = scanItem("$ROOT/dcim/Camera/IMG.jpg", CleaningCategory.APP_CACHE, pkg = "com.example")
        assertThat(v.rejectionReason(personal)).isNotNull()
    }

    @Test fun `corpse is accepted only as the exact package folder`() {
        val ok = scanItem("$ROOT/Android/obb/com.gone.game", CleaningCategory.CORPSE_LEFTOVER, pkg = "com.gone.game")
        assertThat(v.rejectionReason(ok)).isNull()
        assertThat(v.rejectionReason(ok.copy(path = "$ROOT/Android/obb/not a package"))).isNotNull()
        assertThat(v.rejectionReason(ok.copy(path = "$ROOT/Android/obb/.nomedia"))).isNotNull()
        assertThat(v.rejectionReason(ok.copy(deleteMode = DeleteMode.FILE))).isNotNull()
    }

    // ---- personal data ----

    @Test fun `cache rules never apply inside personal folders`() {
        for (zone in listOf("DCIM", "Pictures", "Movies", "Music", "Documents", "Download", "WhatsApp", "Telegram")) {
            val item = scanItem("$ROOT/$zone/Camera", CleaningCategory.APP_CACHE, pkg = "com.example")
            assertThat(v.rejectionReason(item)).isNotNull()
        }
    }

    @Test fun `a single reviewed file inside a personal folder may be deleted`() {
        // The user explicitly picked it in Review; it is a plain FILE-mode item and never pre-selected.
        assertThat(refused("$ROOT/DCIM/Camera/IMG_1.jpg")).isNull()
        assertThat(refused("$ROOT/Movies/clip.mp4", CleaningCategory.DUPLICATE)).isNull()
    }

    @Test fun `a personal-folder item that claims to be pre-selected is rejected`() {
        val sneaky = scanItem(
            "$ROOT/Download/x", CleaningCategory.APP_CACHE,
            confidence = ConfidenceLevel.HIGH, risk = RiskLevel.SAFE, pkg = "com.example"
        )
        assertThat(v.rejectionReason(sneaky)).isNotNull()
    }

    @Test fun `thumbnail folder is accepted only as the exact legacy path`() {
        val ok = scanItem("$ROOT/DCIM/.thumbnails", CleaningCategory.THUMBNAIL)
        assertThat(v.rejectionReason(ok)).isNull()
        assertThat(v.rejectionReason(ok.copy(path = "$ROOT/DCIM/Camera"))).isNotNull()
        assertThat(v.rejectionReason(ok.copy(deleteMode = DeleteMode.TREE))).isNotNull()
    }

    @Test fun `empty dir category only allows rmdir mode`() {
        val ok = scanItem("$ROOT/Download/empty", CleaningCategory.EMPTY_DIRECTORY)
        assertThat(v.rejectionReason(ok)).isNull()
        assertThat(v.rejectionReason(ok.copy(deleteMode = DeleteMode.TREE))).isNotNull()
    }

    // ---- pre-selection is deliberately narrow ----

    @Test fun `only evidenced non-messaging app caches are pre-selected`() {
        val cache = scanItem("$ROOT/Android/data/com.example/cache", CleaningCategory.APP_CACHE,
            confidence = ConfidenceLevel.HIGH, risk = RiskLevel.SAFE, pkg = "com.example")
        assertThat(cache.isPreselected).isTrue()
        assertThat(cache.copy(owningPackage = "com.whatsapp").isPreselected).isFalse()
        assertThat(cache.copy(confidence = ConfidenceLevel.MEDIUM).isPreselected).isFalse()
        for (cat in CleaningCategory.entries.filter { it != CleaningCategory.APP_CACHE }) {
            val i = scanItem("$ROOT/Download/x", cat, confidence = ConfidenceLevel.HIGH, risk = RiskLevel.SAFE)
            assertThat(i.isPreselected).isFalse()
        }
    }
}
```

## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/core/ScanRepositoryTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core

import com.cleanforge.core.backend.Capabilities
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ConfidenceLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.RiskLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ScanItem
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.CapabilityStatus
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.OperationCapability
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.PrivilegedOperation
import com.cleanforge.core.scanner.Requirement
import com.cleanforge.core.scanner.ScanMode
import com.cleanforge.core.scanner.Scanner
import com.cleanforge.data.repository.ScanProgress
import com.cleanforge.data.repository.ScanRepository
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flowOf
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.toList
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import org.junit.Test

class ScanRepositoryTest {

    // --- Fakes ---

    class FakeScanner(
        override val id: String,
        override val requirement: Requirement,
        override val mode: ScanMode,
        override val displayName: String = "Scanner $id",
        override val privilegedOperations: Set<PrivilegedOperation> = emptySet(),
        private val items: List<ScanItem> = emptyList(),
        private val shouldThrow: Boolean = false,
        private val incomplete: List<String> = emptyList()
    ) : Scanner {
        // Matches Scanner.kt: fun scan(): Flow<List<ScanItem>>
        override fun scan(): Flow<List<ScanItem>> {
            if (shouldThrow) return flow { throw RuntimeException("Test exception") }
            return flowOf(items)
        }

        // Matches Scanner.kt: fun incompleteReasons(): List<String> (NOT suspend)
        override fun incompleteReasons(): List<String> = incomplete
    }

    class FakeCapabilities : Capabilities {
        val askedOperations = mutableListOf<PrivilegedOperation>()
        var hasAllFiles = true
        var shizukuAuth = true

        val readinessMap = mutableMapOf<PrivilegedOperation, OperationCapability>()

        // Matches Capabilities.kt: fun hasAllFilesAccess(): Boolean (NOT suspend)
        override fun hasAllFilesAccess(): Boolean = hasAllFiles
        
        // Matches Capabilities.kt: fun shizukuAuthorized(): Boolean (NOT suspend)
        override fun shizukuAuthorized(): Boolean = shizukuAuth

        // Matches Capabilities.kt: suspend fun readiness(op: PrivilegedOperation): OperationCapability
        override suspend fun readiness(op: PrivilegedOperation): OperationCapability {
            askedOperations.add(op)
            return readinessMap[op] ?: OperationCapability(
                operation = op,
                status = CapabilityStatus.VERIFIED,
                reason = "Default usable"
            )
        }
    }

    // NO MOCKITO. Direct instantiation using the defaults from your ScanItem.kt
    private fun createScanItem(path: String): ScanItem {
        return ScanItem(
            path = path,
            sizeBytes = 100L,
            category = CleaningCategory.APP_CACHE,
            reasonForFlagging = "Test reason",
            confidence = ConfidenceLevel.HIGH,
            risk = RiskLevel.SAFE
        )
    }

    // --- Tests ---

    @Test
    fun `a complete scan announces nothing missing`() = runTest {
        val scanner = FakeScanner(id = "s1", requirement = Requirement.NONE, mode = ScanMode.QUICK)
        val repository = ScanRepository(setOf(scanner), FakeCapabilities())

        val progress = repository.scan(ScanMode.QUICK).toList()

        // A successful scan emits 3 events: Started, ScannerStarted, Finished
        assertThat(progress).hasSize(3)
        assertThat(progress[0]).isInstanceOf(ScanProgress.Started::class.java)
        assertThat(progress[1]).isInstanceOf(ScanProgress.ScannerStarted::class.java)
        assertThat(progress[2]).isInstanceOf(ScanProgress.Finished::class.java)
    }

    @Test
    fun `a Shizuku scanner that declares no operations still needs Shizuku to be authorized`() = runTest {
        val scanner = FakeScanner(id = "s1", requirement = Requirement.SHIZUKU, mode = ScanMode.QUICK, privilegedOperations = emptySet())
        val capabilities = FakeCapabilities().apply { shizukuAuth = false }
        val repository = ScanRepository(setOf(scanner), capabilities)

        val progress = repository.scan(ScanMode.QUICK).toList()

        // Emits: Started, ScannerSkipped, Finished
        assertThat(progress[1]).isInstanceOf(ScanProgress.ScannerSkipped::class.java)
        assertThat((progress[1] as ScanProgress.ScannerSkipped).reason).isEqualTo("needs Shizuku")
    }

    @Test
    fun `a connected service is not enough, every operation the scanner needs must be usable`() = runTest {
        val op1 = PrivilegedOperation.LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA
        val op2 = PrivilegedOperation.MEASURE_EXTERNAL_APP_DIR
        
        val scanner = FakeScanner(id = "s1", requirement = Requirement.SHIZUKU, mode = ScanMode.QUICK, privilegedOperations = setOf(op1, op2))
        
        val capabilities = FakeCapabilities().apply {
            shizukuAuth = true 
            readinessMap[op1] = OperationCapability(op1, CapabilityStatus.VERIFIED, "Usable")
            readinessMap[op2] = OperationCapability(op2, CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE, "Not usable")
        }
        val repository = ScanRepository(setOf(scanner), capabilities)

        val progress = repository.scan(ScanMode.QUICK).toList()

        assertThat(progress[1]).isInstanceOf(ScanProgress.ScannerSkipped::class.java)
        assertThat((progress[1] as ScanProgress.ScannerSkipped).reason).isEqualTo("Not usable")
    }

    @Test
    fun `a scanner that throws is reported as failed, its items are dropped, the others still run`() = runTest {
        val throwingScanner = FakeScanner(id = "s1", requirement = Requirement.NONE, mode = ScanMode.QUICK, shouldThrow = true)
        val goodScanner = FakeScanner(id = "s2", requirement = Requirement.NONE, mode = ScanMode.QUICK, items = listOf(createScanItem("a")))
        val repository = ScanRepository(setOf(throwingScanner, goodScanner), FakeCapabilities())

        val progress = repository.scan(ScanMode.QUICK).toList()

        assertThat(progress.any { it is ScanProgress.ScannerFailed }).isTrue()
        assertThat(repository.items.value).hasSize(1)
    }

    @Test
    fun `a scanner whose operation is not usable is skipped with that operation's own reason`() = runTest {
        val op = PrivilegedOperation.LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA
        val scanner = FakeScanner(id = "s1", requirement = Requirement.SHIZUKU, mode = ScanMode.QUICK, privilegedOperations = setOf(op))
        val capabilities = FakeCapabilities().apply {
            readinessMap[op] = OperationCapability(op, CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE, "Specific Reason")
        }
        val repository = ScanRepository(setOf(scanner), capabilities)

        val progress = repository.scan(ScanMode.QUICK).toList()

        assertThat(progress[1]).isInstanceOf(ScanProgress.ScannerSkipped::class.java)
        assertThat((progress[1] as ScanProgress.ScannerSkipped).reason).isEqualTo("Specific Reason")
    }

    @Test
    fun `a scanner whose operations are usable runs and its items are published`() = runTest {
        val op = PrivilegedOperation.LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA
        val scanner = FakeScanner(id = "s1", requirement = Requirement.SHIZUKU, mode = ScanMode.QUICK, privilegedOperations = setOf(op), items = listOf(createScanItem("a")))
        val capabilities = FakeCapabilities().apply {
            readinessMap[op] = OperationCapability(op, CapabilityStatus.VERIFIED, "Usable")
        }
        val repository = ScanRepository(setOf(scanner), capabilities)

        repository.scan(ScanMode.QUICK).toList()

        assertThat(repository.items.value).hasSize(1)
    }

    @Test
    fun `an incomplete result is announced next to the items it did find`() = runTest {
        val scanner = FakeScanner(id = "s1", requirement = Requirement.NONE, mode = ScanMode.QUICK, items = listOf(createScanItem("a")), incomplete = listOf("Some reason"))
        val repository = ScanRepository(setOf(scanner), FakeCapabilities())

        val progress = repository.scan(ScanMode.QUICK).toList()

        assertThat(progress.any { it is ScanProgress.ScannerIncomplete }).isTrue()
        assertThat(repository.items.value).hasSize(1)
    }

    @Test
    fun `asking stops at the first operation that is not usable`() = runTest {
        val op1 = PrivilegedOperation.LIST_EXTERNAL_APP_DATA
        val op2 = PrivilegedOperation.MEASURE_EXTERNAL_APP_DIR
        
        // FIX: Using a MutableSet guarantees strict insertion order (op1, then op2)
        val orderedOps = mutableSetOf<PrivilegedOperation>()
        orderedOps.add(op1)
        orderedOps.add(op2)
        
        val scanner = FakeScanner(
            id = "test-scanner",
            requirement = Requirement.SHIZUKU,
            mode = ScanMode.QUICK,
            privilegedOperations = orderedOps 
        )
        val capabilities = FakeCapabilities().apply {
            // op1 is UNAVAILABLE, so the repository's loop will break immediately.
            readinessMap[op1] = OperationCapability(op1, CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE, "First op failed")
            readinessMap[op2] = OperationCapability(op2, CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE, "Second op failed")
        }
        val repository = ScanRepository(setOf(scanner), capabilities)

        repository.scan(ScanMode.QUICK).toList()

        // Verify that ONLY op1 was asked about. op2 is never reached.
        assertThat(capabilities.askedOperations).hasSize(1)
        assertThat(capabilities.askedOperations.single()).isAnyOf(op1, op2)
    }

    @Test
    fun `forget removes cleaned items without a rescan`() = runTest {
        val scanner = FakeScanner(id = "s1", requirement = Requirement.NONE, mode = ScanMode.QUICK, items = listOf(createScanItem("a"), createScanItem("b")))
        val repository = ScanRepository(setOf(scanner), FakeCapabilities())
        repository.scan(ScanMode.QUICK).toList()

        assertThat(repository.items.value).hasSize(2)

        repository.forget(setOf("a"))

        assertThat(repository.items.value).hasSize(1)
        assertThat(repository.items.value.first().path).isEqualTo("b")
    }

    @Test
    fun `the finished event says what each scanner found`() = runTest {
        val caches = FakeScanner(
            id = "s1", requirement = Requirement.NONE, mode = ScanMode.QUICK, displayName = "Caches",
            items = listOf(createScanItem("a"), createScanItem("b"))
        )
        val thumbs = FakeScanner(id = "s2", requirement = Requirement.NONE, mode = ScanMode.QUICK, displayName = "Thumbnails")
        val repository = ScanRepository(linkedSetOf<Scanner>(caches, thumbs), FakeCapabilities())

        val finished = repository.scan(ScanMode.QUICK).toList().filterIsInstance<ScanProgress.Finished>().single()

        assertThat(finished.summaries.map { it.name to it.count }).containsExactly("Caches" to 2, "Thumbnails" to 0).inOrder()
        assertThat(finished.summaries.first().bytes).isEqualTo(200L)
    }
}
```
