## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/core/ScannerEvidenceTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core

import com.cleanforge.core.backend.ArchiveInfo
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.DirListing
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.FileReadBackend
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.FsResult
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.InstallState
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.PackageInventory
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.StandardFileBackend
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsStat
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.SizeResult
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ConfidenceLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.RiskLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ScanItem
import com.cleanforge.core.model.SizeQuality
import com.cleanforge.core.scanner.ApkScanner
import com.cleanforge.core.scanner.CacheScanner
import com.cleanforge.core.scanner.CorpseScanner
import com.cleanforge.core.scanner.DuplicateScanner
import com.cleanforge.core.scanner.EmptyDirectoryScanner
import com.cleanforge.core.scanner.LargeFileScanner
import com.cleanforge.core.scanner.LogScanner
import com.cleanforge.core.scanner.Scanner
import com.cleanforge.core.scanner.TempScanner
import com.cleanforge.core.scanner.ThumbnailScanner
import com.cleanforge.testutil.FakeInventory
import com.cleanforge.testutil.InMemoryFs
import com.cleanforge.testutil.NioFsOps
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.toList
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder
import java.io.File
import java.nio.file.Files

/** Every scanner must justify its findings with evidence beyond a name, and must stay quiet otherwise. */
class ScannerEvidenceTest {
    @get:Rule val tmp = TemporaryFolder()

    private val day = 24L * 60 * 60 * 1000
    private val now = System.currentTimeMillis()

    private suspend fun Scanner.found(): List<ScanItem> = scan().toList().flatten()

    private fun file(rel: String, bytes: ByteArray = "hello world\n".toByteArray(), ageDays: Long = 0): File {
        val f = File(tmp.root, rel)
        f.parentFile?.mkdirs()
        Files.write(f.toPath(), bytes)
        f.setLastModified(now - ageDays * day)
        return f
    }

    private val root get() = tmp.root.path

    // ---------- incomplete downloads ----------

    @Test fun `partial downloads need a partial-download extension AND age, while bak files and personal folders are ignored`() = runTest {
        val stale = file("Download/old.crdownload", ageDays = 30)
        file("Download/new.crdownload", ageDays = 1)
        file("Download/notes.bak", ageDays = 365)
        val weak = file("Download/x.tmp", ageDays = 30)
        file("DCIM/y.tmp", ageDays = 365)
        file("Pictures/z.part", ageDays = 365)

        val items = TempScanner(NioFsOps, root, { now }).found()

        assertThat(items.map { it.path }).containsExactly(stale.path, weak.path)
        assertThat(items.first { it.path == stale.path }.confidence).isEqualTo(ConfidenceLevel.MEDIUM)
        assertThat(items.first { it.path == weak.path }.confidence).isEqualTo(ConfidenceLevel.LOW)
        assertThat(items.none { it.isPreselected }).isTrue()
    }

    // ---------- logs ----------

    @Test fun `log files need text content AND age and stay in Downloads`() = runTest {
        val good = file("Download/app.log", "2024-01-01 start\n2024-01-01 stop\n".toByteArray(), ageDays = 60)
        file("Download/binary.log", ByteArray(500) { (it % 7).toByte() }, ageDays = 60)
        file("Download/fresh.log", ageDays = 1)
        file("Documents/notes.log", ageDays = 60)

        val items = LogScanner(NioFsOps, root, { now }).found()

        assertThat(items.map { it.path }).containsExactly(good.path)
        assertThat(items[0].confidence).isEqualTo(ConfidenceLevel.LOW)
        assertThat(items[0].isPreselected).isFalse()
    }

    @Test fun `text sniffing rejects NUL bytes, single-line blobs and mostly-binary data`() {
        assertThat(LogScanner.looksLikeText("line one\nline two\n".toByteArray())).isTrue()
        assertThat(LogScanner.looksLikeText("no newline at all".toByteArray())).isFalse()
        assertThat(LogScanner.looksLikeText(byteArrayOf(65, 10, 0, 66))).isFalse()
        assertThat(LogScanner.looksLikeText(ByteArray(0))).isFalse()
        assertThat(LogScanner.looksLikeText("é日本語\nok\n".toByteArray())).isTrue()
    }

    // ---------- thumbnails ----------

    @Test fun `thumbnail folder is flagged only when it really looks like a thumbnail cache`() = runTest {
        file("DCIM/.thumbnails/1001", ByteArray(2000))
        file("DCIM/.thumbnails/.thumbdata3--1967290299", ByteArray(5000))
        val items = ThumbnailScanner(NioFsOps, root).found()
        assertThat(items).hasSize(1)
        assertThat(items[0].category).isEqualTo(CleaningCategory.THUMBNAIL)
        assertThat(items[0].deleteMode).isEqualTo(DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY)
        assertThat(items[0].isPreselected).isFalse()
    }

    @Test fun `a thumbnails-named folder with sub-folders or big files is left alone`() = runTest {
        file("DCIM/.thumbnails/album/a.jpg", ByteArray(100))
        assertThat(ThumbnailScanner(NioFsOps, root).found()).isEmpty()

        File(tmp.root, "DCIM").deleteRecursively()
        file("DCIM/.thumbnails/huge.mp4", ByteArray(3 * 1024 * 1024))
        assertThat(ThumbnailScanner(NioFsOps, root).found()).isEmpty()
    }

    // ---------- empty folders ----------

    @Test fun `only verifiably empty nested visible folders are listed`() = runTest {
        File(tmp.root, "Download/a/empty").mkdirs()
        file("Download/b/.nomedia", ByteArray(0))
        File(tmp.root, "Download/.hidden").mkdirs()
        file("Download/c/real.txt")

        val items = EmptyDirectoryScanner(NioFsOps, root).found()

        assertThat(items.map { it.path }).containsExactly(File(tmp.root, "Download/a/empty").path)
        assertThat(items[0].deleteMode).isEqualTo(DeleteMode.EMPTY_DIR)
        assertThat(items[0].sizeBytes).isEqualTo(0L)
    }

    // ---------- large files ----------

    @Test fun `large files are suggestions for review, never recommendations`() = runTest {
        file("Download/a.bin", ByteArray(1500))
        val big = file("Download/b.bin", ByteArray(3000))
        val mid = file("Movies/c.bin", ByteArray(2000))
        file("Download/small.bin", ByteArray(500))

        val items = LargeFileScanner(NioFsOps, root, thresholdBytes = 1024, topN = 2).found()

        assertThat(items.map { it.path }).containsExactly(big.path, mid.path).inOrder()
        assertThat(items.all { it.confidence == ConfidenceLevel.UNKNOWN && it.risk == RiskLevel.DANGEROUS }).isTrue()
        assertThat(items.none { it.isPreselected }).isTrue()
    }

    // ---------- duplicates ----------

    @Test fun `every copy is listed, the scanner never picks a keeper, and nothing is pre-selected`() = runTest {
        val content = "identical-content-0123456789".toByteArray()
        val a = file("Download/a.bin", content).also { it.setLastModified(now - 100_000) }
        val b = file("Pictures/b.bin", content).also { it.setLastModified(now - 1_000) }
        file("Download/c.bin", "different-content-0123456789".toByteArray()) // same size, other bytes

        val items = DuplicateScanner(NioFsOps, root, minBytes = 10).found()

        // The OLDEST copy is a deletion candidate too: age does not prove which copy the user values.
        assertThat(items.map { it.path }).containsExactly(a.path, b.path)
        assertThat(items.map { it.groupId }.toSet()).hasSize(1)
        assertThat(items.all { it.category == CleaningCategory.DUPLICATE }).isTrue()
        assertThat(items.all { it.fingerprint != null }).isTrue()
        assertThat(items.all { it.keepPath == null && it.keepFingerprint == null }).isTrue()
        assertThat(items.none { it.isPreselected }).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `hard links to one inode are not duplicates`() = runTest {
        val a = file("Download/a.bin", "0123456789abcdef".toByteArray())
        Files.createLink(File(tmp.root, "Download/link.bin").toPath(), a.toPath())
        assertThat(DuplicateScanner(NioFsOps, root, minBytes = 10).found()).isEmpty()
    }

    // ---------- APKs ----------

    @Test fun `apk evidence comes from the platform parser and installed version`() = runTest {
        val installedNewer = file("Download/old.apk", ByteArray(100))
        val notInstalled = file("Download/new.apk", ByteArray(100))
        file("Download/broken.apk", ByteArray(100))
        val inv = FakeInventory(
            versions = mapOf("com.app" to 7L),
            archives = mapOf("old.apk" to ArchiveInfo("com.app", 5), "new.apk" to ArchiveInfo("com.new", 1))
        )

        val items = ApkScanner(NioFsOps, inv, root).found()

        assertThat(items.map { it.path }).containsExactly(installedNewer.path, notInstalled.path)
        assertThat(items.first { it.path == installedNewer.path }.confidence).isEqualTo(ConfidenceLevel.MEDIUM)
        assertThat(items.first { it.path == notInstalled.path }.confidence).isEqualTo(ConfidenceLevel.LOW)
        assertThat(items.none { it.isPreselected }).isTrue()
    }

    // ---------- Android/data scanners (in-memory filesystem standing in for the Shizuku view) ----------

    private val fs = InMemoryFs()
    private val backend = StandardFileBackend(fs)
    private val storage = "/storage/emulated/0"

    @Test fun `leftovers need an unknown package, a plausible package list, a real folder and age`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.gone.game/files/save.dat", 10)
        fs.file("$storage/Android/obb/com.gone.old/main.obb", 20)
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.recent.gone/x", 5)
        fs.touch("$storage/Android/data/com.recent.gone", now - day)
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.example/cache/x", 5)
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/files/y", 5)          // not a package name
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/.nomedia", 0)         // not a package name
        val inv = FakeInventory(FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.example"))

        val items = CorpseScanner(backend, inv, storage, { now }, minAgeDays = 14).found()

        assertThat(items.map { it.path }).containsExactly(
            "$storage/Android/data/com.gone.game", "$storage/Android/obb/com.gone.old"
        )
        assertThat(items.all { it.confidence == ConfidenceLevel.MEDIUM && it.risk == RiskLevel.ELEVATED }).isTrue()
        assertThat(items.all { it.deleteMode == DeleteMode.TREE && it.requiresShizuku }).isTrue()
        assertThat(items.none { it.isPreselected }).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `if the package list cannot be read or looks implausible nothing is flagged`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.gone.game/files/save.dat", 10)
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.example/cache/x", 10)
        for (broken in listOf<Set<String>?>(null, emptySet(), setOf("a.b", "c.d"))) {
            val inv = FakeInventory(broken)
            assertThat(CorpseScanner(backend, inv, storage, { now }).found()).isEmpty()
            assertThat(CacheScanner(backend, inv, storage).found()).isEmpty()
        }
    }

    @Test fun `caches are limited to installed apps' real cache folders`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.example/cache/a.bin", 50)
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.whatsapp/cache/w.bin", 70)
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.gone/cache/z.bin", 90)        // not installed
        fs.mkdirs("$storage/Android/data/com.empty/cache")               // nothing to free
        fs.symlink("$storage/Android/data/com.linky/cache")              // not a real directory
        val inv = FakeInventory(FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.example", "com.whatsapp", "com.empty", "com.linky"))

        val items = CacheScanner(backend, inv, storage).found()

        assertThat(items.map { it.path }).containsExactly(
            "$storage/Android/data/com.example/cache", "$storage/Android/data/com.whatsapp/cache"
        )
        val example = items.first { it.owningPackage == "com.example" }
        val whatsapp = items.first { it.owningPackage == "com.whatsapp" }
        assertThat(example.isPreselected).isTrue()
        assertThat(example.sizeBytes).isEqualTo(50L)
        assertThat(whatsapp.isPreselected).isFalse()
        assertThat(whatsapp.confidence).isEqualTo(ConfidenceLevel.MEDIUM)
        assertThat(items.all { it.deleteMode == DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY && it.requiresShizuku }).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `a package Android only remembers as uninstalled-with-data-kept is never an installed app cache`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.example.game/cache/file.bin", 50)
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.example/cache/a.bin", 50)
        val inv = FakeInventory(
            // What MATCH_UNINSTALLED_PACKAGES reports: the data-kept game is in the list...
            known = FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.example", "com.example.game"),
            // ...but it is NOT installed.
            installed = FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.example")
        )

        val items = CacheScanner(backend, inv, storage).found()

        assertThat(items.map { it.path }).containsExactly("$storage/Android/data/com.example/cache")
        assertThat(items.none { it.category == CleaningCategory.APP_CACHE && it.owningPackage == "com.example.game" }).isTrue()
        assertThat(items.none { it.owningPackage == "com.example.game" && it.isPreselected }).isTrue()
        // It is retained data of a package Android still knows, so it is not a "leftover" either.
        assertThat(CorpseScanner(backend, inv, storage, { now }).found()).isEmpty()
    }

    @Test fun `a package that is installed but missing from the known list is never called a leftover`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.odd.app/files/x", 10)
        val inv = FakeInventory(
            known = FakeInventory.defaultPackages(),
            installed = FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.odd.app")
        )
        assertThat(CorpseScanner(backend, inv, storage, { now }).found()).isEmpty()
    }

    // ---------- failures are reported, never read as "nothing there" (Part 2) ----------

    /** A backend that can be told to fail or to answer differently for chosen paths; everything else is real. */
    private class ScriptedBackend(private val inner: FileReadBackend) : FileReadBackend {
        override val name = "scripted"
        var listOverride: (String) -> FsResult<DirListing>? = { null }
        var statOverride: (String) -> FsResult<FsStat>? = { null }
        var sizeOverride: (String) -> FsResult<SizeResult>? = { null }
        override suspend fun lstat(path: String): FsResult<FsStat> = statOverride(path) ?: inner.lstat(path)
        override suspend fun list(path: String): FsResult<DirListing> = listOverride(path) ?: inner.list(path)
        override suspend fun directorySize(path: String): FsResult<SizeResult> = sizeOverride(path) ?: inner.directorySize(path)
    }

    @Test fun `a listing that fails is reported as incomplete, not as nothing to clean`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.example/cache/a.bin", 50)
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.gone.game/files/save.dat", 10)
        val inv = FakeInventory(FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.example"))
        val failures = listOf(
            FsResult.Unavailable("Shizuku is not running"), FsResult.Denied("refused"),
            FsResult.Failed("i/o error"), FsResult.NotFound
        )
        for (failure in failures) {
            val b = ScriptedBackend(backend).also { it.listOverride = { failure } }
            val cache = CacheScanner(b, inv, storage)
            assertThat(cache.found()).isEmpty()
            assertThat(cache.incompleteReasons().joinToString()).contains("Android/data could not be listed")
            val corpse = CorpseScanner(b, inv, storage, { now })
            assertThat(corpse.found()).isEmpty()
            assertThat(corpse.incompleteReasons()).hasSize(2) // data and obb
        }
        val unavailable = ScriptedBackend(backend).also { it.listOverride = { FsResult.Unavailable("Shizuku is not running") } }
        val c = CacheScanner(unavailable, inv, storage)
        c.found()
        assertThat(c.incompleteReasons().joinToString()).contains("Shizuku is not running")
    }

    @Test fun `a healthy scan reports nothing missing and a later healthy scan forgets an earlier failure`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.example/cache/a.bin", 50)
        val inv = FakeInventory(FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.example"))
        val b = ScriptedBackend(backend)
        val scanner = CacheScanner(b, inv, storage)
        b.listOverride = { FsResult.Unavailable("down") }
        scanner.found()
        assertThat(scanner.incompleteReasons()).isNotEmpty()
        b.listOverride = { null }
        assertThat(scanner.found()).hasSize(1)
        assertThat(scanner.incompleteReasons()).isEmpty()
    }

    @Test fun `an unreadable package list is reported too, not just ignored`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.example/cache/a.bin", 50)
        val scanner = CacheScanner(backend, FakeInventory(null), storage)
        assertThat(scanner.found()).isEmpty()
        assertThat(scanner.incompleteReasons().joinToString()).contains("installed apps")
    }

    @Test fun `losing the service halfway keeps what was found and says the scan stopped early`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.a/cache/a.bin", 50)
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.b/cache/b.bin", 70)
        val inv = FakeInventory(FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.a", "com.b"))
        val b = ScriptedBackend(backend).also {
            it.sizeOverride = { path -> if ("com.b" in path) FsResult.Unavailable("Shizuku service stopped") else null }
        }
        val scanner = CacheScanner(b, inv, storage)
        val items = scanner.found()
        assertThat(items.map { it.owningPackage }).containsExactly("com.a")
        assertThat(scanner.incompleteReasons().joinToString()).contains("stopped early")
    }

    @Test fun `caches that cannot be examined are counted and skipped`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.a/cache/a.bin", 50)
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.b/cache/b.bin", 70)
        val inv = FakeInventory(FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.a", "com.b"))
        val b = ScriptedBackend(backend).also {
            it.statOverride = { path -> if ("com.b" in path) FsResult.Denied("refused") else null }
        }
        val scanner = CacheScanner(b, inv, storage)
        assertThat(scanner.found().map { it.owningPackage }).containsExactly("com.a")
        assertThat(scanner.incompleteReasons().joinToString()).contains("could not be examined or measured")
    }

    @Test fun `sizes are measured or a lower bound, and the item says which`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.a/cache/a.bin", 50)
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.b/cache/b.bin", 70)
        val inv = FakeInventory(FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.a", "com.b"))
        val b = ScriptedBackend(backend).also {
            it.sizeOverride = { path -> if ("com.a" in path) FsResult.Ok(SizeResult(500L, false, 2)) else null }
        }
        val items = CacheScanner(b, inv, storage).found()
        val a = items.first { it.owningPackage == "com.a" }
        val bItem = items.first { it.owningPackage == "com.b" }
        assertThat(a.sizeBytes).isEqualTo(500L)
        assertThat(a.sizeQuality).isEqualTo(SizeQuality.LOWER_BOUND)
        assertThat(a.unreadableCount).isEqualTo(2)
        assertThat(a.reasonForFlagging).contains("lower bound")
        assertThat(bItem.sizeBytes).isEqualTo(70L)
        assertThat(bItem.sizeQuality).isEqualTo(SizeQuality.MEASURED)
        assertThat(bItem.unreadableCount).isEqualTo(0)
    }

    @Test fun `a cache that could not be looked into is neither listed as cleanable nor treated as empty`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.a/cache/a.bin", 50)
        val inv = FakeInventory(FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.a"))
        val b = ScriptedBackend(backend).also { it.sizeOverride = { FsResult.Ok(SizeResult(0L, true, 1)) } }
        val scanner = CacheScanner(b, inv, storage)
        assertThat(scanner.found()).isEmpty()
        assertThat(scanner.incompleteReasons().joinToString()).contains("could not be examined or measured")
    }

    @Test fun `a truncated Android data listing is flagged as incomplete`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.example/cache/a.bin", 50)
        val inv = FakeInventory(FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.example"))
        val b = ScriptedBackend(backend).also {
            it.listOverride = { path ->
                if (path.endsWith("/Android/data")) FsResult.Ok(DirListing(listOf("com.example"), truncated = true)) else null
            }
        }
        val scanner = CacheScanner(b, inv, storage)
        assertThat(scanner.found()).hasSize(1)
        assertThat(scanner.incompleteReasons().joinToString()).contains("more folders than could be listed")
    }

    @Test fun `a package whose install state cannot be determined is skipped and reported, in both scanners`() = runTest {
        val inner = FakeInventory(FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.example", "com.flaky.cache"))
        val inv = object : PackageInventory by inner {
            override fun installState(packageName: String): InstallState =
                if (packageName.startsWith("com.flaky")) InstallState.UNKNOWN else inner.installState(packageName)
        }
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.flaky.cache/cache/x.bin", 40)    // known to Android, state query fails
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.flaky.folder/files/x", 40)        // unknown to Android, state query fails
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/com.truly.gone/files/x", 40)          // authoritatively unknown: a leftover

        val cache = CacheScanner(backend, inv, storage)
        assertThat(cache.found()).isEmpty()
        assertThat(cache.incompleteReasons().joinToString()).contains("could not be classified")

        val corpse = CorpseScanner(backend, inv, storage, { now })
        assertThat(corpse.found().map { it.owningPackage }).containsExactly("com.truly.gone")
        assertThat(corpse.incompleteReasons().joinToString()).contains("could not be matched")
    }

    @Test fun `a folder spelled differently from a known package is still that package and never a leftover`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$storage/Android/data/COM.Known.Game/files/x", 40)
        val inv = FakeInventory(FakeInventory.defaultPackages("com.known.game"))
        assertThat(CorpseScanner(backend, inv, storage, { now }).found()).isEmpty()
    }
}
```

## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/core/StandardFileBackendTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core

import com.cleanforge.core.backend.StandardFileBackend
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.testutil.FaultyFs
import com.cleanforge.testutil.InMemoryFs
import com.cleanforge.testutil.ROOT
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineStart
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Test

class StandardFileBackendTest {
    @Test fun `cancelling the caller stops a big delete between entries`() = runBlocking {
        val mem = InMemoryFs()
        val fs = FaultyFs(mem)
        val dir = "$ROOT/Download/big"
        for (n in 1..20) mem.file("$dir/f$n.bin", size = 10)

        val job = launch(start = CoroutineStart.LAZY) {
            StandardFileBackend(fs).delete(dir, DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY, null)
        }
        fs.afterRemove = { job.cancel() } // the caller gives up right after the first entry is gone
        job.join()

        val left = mem.list(dir)!!.size
        assertThat(left).isGreaterThan(0)
        assertThat(left).isLessThan(20)
    }
}
```

## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/core/StorageWalkerTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsOps
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsProbe
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsStat
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.StorageWalker
import com.cleanforge.testutil.NioFsOps
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder
import java.io.File
import java.nio.file.Files

class StorageWalkerTest {
    @get:Rule val tmp = TemporaryFolder()

    private fun write(f: File, text: String) {
        f.parentFile?.mkdirs()
        Files.write(f.toPath(), text.toByteArray())
    }

    /**
     * The real filesystem, except: [denied] exists but cannot be examined, [vanished] is gone by the time it is
     * examined, and everything under [mount] reports another device.
     */
    private class QuirkyFs(
        private val denied: String? = null,
        private val vanished: String? = null,
        private val mount: String? = null
    ) : FsOps by NioFsOps {
        private fun tweak(path: String, s: FsStat) = if (mount != null && path.startsWith(mount)) s.copy(dev = 4242L) else s

        override fun lstat(path: String): FsStat? =
            if (path == denied || path == vanished) null else NioFsOps.lstat(path)?.let { tweak(path, it) }

        override fun probe(path: String): FsProbe = when (path) {
            denied -> FsProbe.Denied
            vanished -> FsProbe.Missing
            else -> when (val r = NioFsOps.probe(path)) {
                is FsProbe.Found -> FsProbe.Found(tweak(path, r.stat))
                else -> r
            }
        }
    }

    private fun root() = File(tmp.root, "root").also {
        write(File(it, "a.txt"), "1234")
        write(File(it, "b.bin"), "123456789")
    }

    @Test fun `an entry that cannot be examined makes the size a lower bound instead of counting zero`() {
        val root = root()
        val r = StorageWalker(QuirkyFs(denied = File(root, "b.bin").path)).sizeOf(root.path)!!
        assertThat(r.bytes).isEqualTo(4L)
        assertThat(r.unreadable).isEqualTo(1)
        assertThat(r.isExact).isFalse()
    }

    @Test fun `an entry that vanished between listing and examining is not counted as unreadable`() {
        val root = root()
        val r = StorageWalker(QuirkyFs(vanished = File(root, "b.bin").path)).sizeOf(root.path)!!
        assertThat(r.bytes).isEqualTo(4L)
        assertThat(r.unreadable).isEqualTo(0)
        assertThat(r.isExact).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `a mount point is not entered and the size is reported as a lower bound`() {
        val root = root()
        write(File(root, "mnt/other-filesystem.txt"), "123456")
        val r = StorageWalker(QuirkyFs(mount = File(root, "mnt").path)).sizeOf(root.path)!!
        assertThat(r.bytes).isEqualTo(13L) // a.txt + b.bin only
        assertThat(r.unreadable).isEqualTo(1)
        assertThat(r.isExact).isFalse()
    }

    @Test fun `a plain tree is measured exactly`() {
        val root = root()
        write(File(root, "sub/deep/c.txt"), "12")
        val r = StorageWalker(NioFsOps).sizeOf(root.path)!!
        assertThat(r.bytes).isEqualTo(15L)
        assertThat(r.isExact).isTrue()
    }
}
```

## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/core/WalkScannerReasonsTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsOps
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsProbe
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsStat
import com.cleanforge.core.scanner.LargeFileScanner
import com.cleanforge.core.scanner.ThumbnailScanner
import com.cleanforge.testutil.NioFsOps
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.toList
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder
import java.io.File
import java.nio.file.Files

/** Scanners that walk the filesystem say so when they could not look at everything. */
class WalkScannerReasonsTest {
    @get:Rule val tmp = TemporaryFolder()

    private fun write(f: File, bytes: Int) {
        f.parentFile?.mkdirs()
        Files.write(f.toPath(), ByteArray(bytes))
    }

    /** The real filesystem, except [denied] exists but cannot be examined. */
    private class DenyingFs(private val denied: String) : FsOps by NioFsOps {
        override fun lstat(path: String): FsStat? = if (path == denied) null else NioFsOps.lstat(path)
        override fun probe(path: String): FsProbe = if (path == denied) FsProbe.Denied else NioFsOps.probe(path)
    }

    @Test fun `a healthy walk reports nothing missing`() = runTest {
        val root = tmp.root.path
        write(File(root, "Download/big.bin"), 2048)
        val scanner = LargeFileScanner(NioFsOps, root, thresholdBytes = 1024)
        assertThat(scanner.scan().toList().flatten()).hasSize(1)
        assertThat(scanner.incompleteReasons()).isEmpty()
    }

    @Test fun `a file that cannot be examined is reported, not silently ignored`() = runTest {
        val root = tmp.root.path
        val big = File(root, "Download/big.bin").also { write(it, 2048) }
        val secret = File(root, "Download/secret.bin").also { write(it, 4096) }
        val scanner = LargeFileScanner(DenyingFs(secret.path), root, thresholdBytes = 1024)
        val found = scanner.scan().toList().flatten()
        assertThat(found.map { it.path }).containsExactly(big.path)
        assertThat(scanner.incompleteReasons().joinToString()).contains("could not be read")
    }

    @Test fun `a thumbnail folder with an entry that cannot be examined is not called a cache`() = runTest {
        val root = tmp.root.path
        write(File(root, "DCIM/.thumbnails/a.jpg"), 100)
        val hidden = File(root, "DCIM/.thumbnails/b").also { write(File(it, "x.jpg"), 100) }
        val scanner = ThumbnailScanner(DenyingFs(hidden.path), root)
        assertThat(scanner.scan().toList().flatten()).isEmpty()
        assertThat(scanner.incompleteReasons()).isNotEmpty()
    }

    @Test fun `a healthy thumbnail folder is still flagged and reports nothing missing`() = runTest {
        val root = tmp.root.path
        write(File(root, "DCIM/.thumbnails/a.jpg"), 100)
        write(File(root, "DCIM/.thumbnails/b.jpg"), 100)
        val scanner = ThumbnailScanner(NioFsOps, root)
        assertThat(scanner.scan().toList().flatten()).hasSize(1)
        assertThat(scanner.incompleteReasons()).isEmpty()
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteResult
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteStatus
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsStat
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsType
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.SizeResult
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.ListReply
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.ReplyStatus
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.SizeReply
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.StatReply
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.WireCodec
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import org.junit.Test

class WireCodecTest {
    @Test fun `stat survives the trip with every field`() {
        val st = FsStat(FsType.DIRECTORY, 4096L, 1_700_000_000_000L, 64769L, 123456789L)
        val back = WireCodec.decodeStat(WireCodec.encodeStat(StatReply(ReplyStatus.OK, st)))
        assertThat(back.status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.OK)
        assertThat(back.stat).isEqualTo(st)
    }

    @Test fun `every non-OK status survives the trip and carries no data`() {
        for (s in ReplyStatus.entries.filter { it != ReplyStatus.OK }) {
            assertThat(WireCodec.decodeStat(WireCodec.encodeStat(StatReply(s))).status).isEqualTo(s)
            assertThat(WireCodec.decodeSize(WireCodec.encodeSize(SizeReply(s))).status).isEqualTo(s)
            assertThat(WireCodec.decodeList(WireCodec.encodeList(ListReply(s, listOf("ignored")))).names).isEmpty()
            assertThat(WireCodec.decodeList(WireCodec.encodeList(ListReply(s))).status).isEqualTo(s)
        }
    }

    @Test fun `malformed or short replies decode to FAILED, never to missing or empty`() {
        assertThat(WireCodec.decodeStat(null).status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.FAILED)
        assertThat(WireCodec.decodeStat(longArrayOf()).status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.FAILED)
        assertThat(WireCodec.decodeStat(longArrayOf(0L, 1L, 2L)).status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.FAILED) // OK but truncated
        assertThat(WireCodec.decodeStat(longArrayOf(77L)).status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.FAILED) // unknown status code
        assertThat(WireCodec.decodeSize(null).status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.FAILED)
        assertThat(WireCodec.decodeSize(longArrayOf(0L, 5L)).status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.FAILED)
        assertThat(WireCodec.decodeList(null).status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.FAILED)
        assertThat(WireCodec.decodeList(arrayOf("0")).status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.FAILED)
        assertThat(WireCodec.decodeList(arrayOf("x", "0")).status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.FAILED)
        assertThat(WireCodec.decodeList(arrayOf("0", "2", "a")).status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.FAILED) // bad truncation flag
        assertThat(WireCodec.decodeDelete(null).status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.FAILED)
        assertThat(WireCodec.decodeDelete(arrayOf("0", "1")).status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.FAILED)
        assertThat(WireCodec.decodeDelete(arrayOf("0", "one", "2", "")).status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.FAILED)
        assertThat(WireCodec.decodeDelete(arrayOf("99", "1", "2", "")).status).isEqualTo(DeleteStatus.FAILED) // unknown code
    }

    @Test fun `size keeps the complete flag and the unreadable count`() {
        val exact = WireCodec.decodeSize(WireCodec.encodeSize(SizeReply(ReplyStatus.OK, SizeResult(1234L, true, 0))))
        assertThat(exact.size).isEqualTo(SizeResult(1234L, true, 0))
        assertThat(exact.size!!.isExact).isTrue()
        val cut = WireCodec.decodeSize(WireCodec.encodeSize(SizeReply(ReplyStatus.OK, SizeResult(9L, false, 3))))
        assertThat(cut.size).isEqualTo(SizeResult(9L, false, 3))
        assertThat(cut.size!!.isExact).isFalse()
    }

    @Test fun `names with spaces, unicode, quotes and newlines are carried byte for byte`() {
        val names = listOf("my app", "two  spaces", "\u0394 \u30c6\u30b9\u30c8", "quote\"s'", "semi;colon && pipe | dollar\$HOME", "line\nbreak", "tab\there")
        val back = WireCodec.decodeList(WireCodec.encodeList(ListReply(ReplyStatus.OK, names, truncated = true)))
        assertThat(back.status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.OK)
        assertThat(back.names).containsExactlyElementsIn(names).inOrder()
        assertThat(back.truncated).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `an empty listing is an empty OK listing and is not confused with a failure`() {
        val back = WireCodec.decodeList(WireCodec.encodeList(ListReply(ReplyStatus.OK, emptyList(), false)))
        assertThat(back.status).isEqualTo(ReplyStatus.OK)
        assertThat(back.names).isEmpty()
        assertThat(back.truncated).isFalse()
    }

    @Test fun `delete results keep status, counts and detail text`() {
        val r = DeleteResult(DeleteStatus.PARTIAL, 7, 4096L, "Could not remove an entry \u2014 \u00e9")
        assertThat(WireCodec.decodeDelete(WireCodec.encodeDelete(r))).isEqualTo(r)
        for (s in DeleteStatus.entries) {
            assertThat(WireCodec.decodeDelete(WireCodec.encodeDelete(DeleteResult(s))).status).isEqualTo(s)
        }
    }

    @Test fun `an over-long detail is cut so a reply can never grow without bound`() {
        val back = WireCodec.decodeDelete(WireCodec.encodeDelete(DeleteResult(DeleteStatus.FAILED, 0, 0, "x".repeat(5_000))))
        assertThat(back.detail.length).isAtMost(300)
    }

    @Test fun `wire codes of existing statuses never change`() {
        // These numbers are part of the app <-> service contract. New statuses may only be appended.
        assertThat(DeleteStatus.entries.map { it.name to it.code }).containsExactly(
            "OK" to 0, "MISSING" to 1, "REFUSED" to 2, "IDENTITY_CHANGED" to 3, "WRONG_TYPE" to 4,
            "FAILED" to 5, "PARTIAL" to 6, "LIMIT_EXCEEDED" to 7, "CANCELLED" to 8, "UNAVAILABLE" to 9, "TIMED_OUT" to 10
        ).inOrder()
        assertThat(ReplyStatus.entries.map { it.name to it.code }).containsExactly(
            "OK" to 0, "NOT_FOUND" to 1, "REFUSED" to 2, "OS_DENIED" to 3, "FAILED" to 4
        ).inOrder()
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.benchmark

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.WalkLimits
import com.cleanforge.testutil.InMemoryFs
import com.cleanforge.testutil.ROOT
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import org.junit.Test

class BenchmarkEngineTest {
    @Test fun `entries visited match the fixture and expected accuracy`() = runTest {
        val fs = InMemoryFs()
        for (i in 1..10) fs.file("$ROOT/Download/f$i.bin", 10)
        val r = BenchmarkEngine(fs).run("$ROOT/Download", expectedEntries = 10, sampleEveryMs = 50)
        assertThat(r.entriesVisited).isEqualTo(10L)
        assertThat(r.accuracy.match).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `truncated walk is reported, and the byte count reflects what was scanned`() = runTest {
        val fs = InMemoryFs()
        for (i in 1..5) fs.file("$ROOT/Download/f$i.bin", 10)
        val r = BenchmarkEngine(fs).run(
            "$ROOT/Download",
            limits = WalkLimits(maxDepth = 32, maxEntries = 2),
            sampleEveryMs = 50
        )
        assertThat(r.truncated).isTrue()
        assertThat(r.entriesVisited).isLessThan(5L)
    }
}
```

## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/core/cleaning/PermissionAnnotatorTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.cleaning

import com.cleanforge.core.backend.Capabilities
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningPlan
import com.cleanforge.core.model.PermissionNeed
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.CapabilityStatus
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.OperationCapability
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.PrivilegedOperation
import com.cleanforge.testutil.ROOT
import com.cleanforge.testutil.scanItem
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import org.junit.Test

class PermissionAnnotatorTest {

    private fun caps(allFiles: Boolean, shizuku: Boolean, ready: Boolean = true) = object : Capabilities {
        override fun hasAllFilesAccess() = allFiles
        override fun shizukuAuthorized() = shizuku
        override suspend fun readiness(op: PrivilegedOperation) =
            OperationCapability(op, if (ready) CapabilityStatus.PREREQUISITES_MET else CapabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
                if (ready) "ok" else "service stopped")
    }

    private val cache = scanItem("$ROOT/Android/data/com.x/cache", CleaningCategory.APP_CACHE, pkg = "com.x", shizuku = true)
    private val download = scanItem("$ROOT/Download/a.bin")

    @Test fun `standard items need all-files, shizuku items need their operation`() = runTest {
        val plan = CleaningPlan(listOf(cache, download), emptyList())
        val a = PermissionAnnotator(caps(allFiles = true, shizuku = true)).annotate(plan)
        assertThat(a.permissionNotes[download.path]!!.need).isEqualTo(PermissionNeed.ALL_FILES)
        assertThat(a.permissionNotes[download.path]!!.blocking).isFalse()
        assertThat(a.permissionNotes[cache.path]!!.need).isEqualTo(PermissionNeed.SHIZUKU_OPERATION)
        assertThat(a.permissionNotes[cache.path]!!.blocking).isFalse()
        assertThat(a.hasBlockingPermissions).isFalse()
    }

    @Test fun `missing all-files marks standard items as blocking`() = runTest {
        val plan = CleaningPlan(listOf(download), emptyList())
        val a = PermissionAnnotator(caps(allFiles = false, shizuku = true)).annotate(plan)
        assertThat(a.permissionNotes[download.path]!!.blocking).isTrue()
        assertThat(a.hasBlockingPermissions).isTrue()
        assertThat(a.allItemsBlocked).isTrue()
    }

    @Test fun `a shizuku operation that cannot run blocks only that item`() = runTest {
        val plan = CleaningPlan(listOf(cache, download), emptyList())
        val a = PermissionAnnotator(caps(allFiles = true, shizuku = true, ready = false)).annotate(plan)
        assertThat(a.permissionNotes[cache.path]!!.blocking).isTrue()
        assertThat(a.permissionNotes[download.path]!!.blocking).isFalse()
        assertThat(a.allItemsBlocked).isFalse()
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.history

import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import org.junit.Test

class GrowthAnalyzerTest {
    private fun snap(ts: Long, vararg dirs: Triple<String, Long, Long>, cats: Map<String, Long> = emptyMap(), incomplete: Boolean = false) =
        Snapshot(ts, "/storage/emulated/0", 0, 0,
            dirs.map { (p, b, c) -> SnapshotEntry(p, p.substringBeforeLast('/'), p.substringAfterLast('/'), 1, b, c.toInt()) },
            cats, incomplete)

    @Test fun `growth is delta between snapshots and is sorted by largest delta`() {
        val a = snap(1, Triple("/storage/emulated/0/DCIM", 100, 1), Triple("/storage/emulated/0/Download", 500, 5))
        val b = snap(2, Triple("/storage/emulated/0/DCIM", 900, 9), Triple("/storage/emulated/0/Download", 400, 4))
        val r = GrowthAnalyzer.compare(a, b)
        assertThat(r.directories.first().path).isEqualTo("/storage/emulated/0/DCIM")
        assertThat(r.directories.first().deltaBytes).isEqualTo(800L)
        assertThat(r.directories.first { it.path.endsWith("/Download") }.deltaBytes).isEqualTo(-100L)
    }

    @Test fun `percentChange is null when previous was zero`() {
        val a = snap(1)
        val b = snap(2, Triple("/storage/emulated/0/New", 42, 1))
        val r = GrowthAnalyzer.compare(a, b)
        assertThat(r.directories.first().percentChange).isNull()
    }

    @Test fun `incomplete snapshots make the whole report a lower bound`() {
        val a = snap(1, Triple("/storage/emulated/0/DCIM", 100, 1), incomplete = true)
        val b = snap(2, Triple("/storage/emulated/0/DCIM", 200, 2))
        assertThat(GrowthAnalyzer.compare(a, b).lowerBound).isTrue()
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.history

import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import org.junit.Test

class SnapshotCodecTest {
    private val snapshot = Snapshot(
        timestamp = 1_700_000_000_000L,
        rootPath = "/storage/emulated/0",
        totalBytes = 64L shl 30,
        freeBytes = 12L shl 30,
        dirs = listOf(SnapshotEntry("/storage/emulated/0/DCIM", "/storage/emulated/0", "DCIM", 1, 1234L, 5)),
        categoryBytes = mapOf("image" to 100L, "video" to 200L),
        incomplete = true
    )

    @Test fun `round-trips every field`() {
        assertThat(SnapshotCodec.decode(SnapshotCodec.encode(snapshot))).isEqualTo(snapshot)
    }

    @Test fun `a corrupt or hostile file decodes to null as a whole`() {
        assertThat(SnapshotCodec.decode("")).isNull()
        assertThat(SnapshotCodec.decode("not a snapshot")).isNull()
        assertThat(SnapshotCodec.decode("CleanForge-snapshot v1\nmeta\ttimestamp\tx")).isNull()
        assertThat(SnapshotCodec.decode("CleanForge-snapshot v1\ndir\tonly\tthree\tcols")).isNull()
    }

    @Test fun `tabs and newlines in paths are neutralised`() {
        val bad = snapshot.copy(dirs = listOf(SnapshotEntry("a\tb\nc", "p", "n", 1, 0, 0)))
        val decoded = SnapshotCodec.decode(SnapshotCodec.encode(bad))!!
        assertThat(decoded.dirs.single().path).isEqualTo("a b c")
    }
}
```

## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/core/inventory/StorageIndexerTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.core.inventory

import com.cleanforge.testutil.InMemoryFs
import com.cleanforge.testutil.ROOT
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import org.junit.Test

class StorageIndexerTest {
    private val fs = InMemoryFs()
    private val indexer = StorageIndexer(fs, maxDepth = 3, maxDirs = 100, topFiles = 5)

    @Test fun `directory aggregates roll up to depth and top files are bounded`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$ROOT/Download/a.bin", 100)
        fs.file("$ROOT/Download/sub/b.bin", 200)
        fs.file("$ROOT/Download/sub/c.bin", 300)
        fs.file("$ROOT/DCIM/d.jpg", 50)
        val idx = indexer.index(ROOT, listOf("Download", "DCIM"), totalBytes = 1_000, freeBytes = 400)

        assertThat(idx.byPath("$ROOT/Download")!!.bytes).isEqualTo(600L)
        assertThat(idx.byPath("$ROOT/Download")!!.fileCount).isEqualTo(3)
        assertThat(idx.byPath("$ROOT/Download/sub")!!.bytes).isEqualTo(500L)
        assertThat(idx.byPath("$ROOT/DCIM")!!.bytes).isEqualTo(50L)
        assertThat(idx.byPath("$ROOT/DCIM")!!.parentPath).isEqualTo(ROOT)
        assertThat(idx.largestFiles.map { it.name }).containsExactly("c.bin", "b.bin", "a.bin", "d.jpg")
        assertThat(idx.categoryTotals.first { it.key == "other" }.bytes).isEqualTo(600L)
        assertThat(idx.incomplete).isFalse()
    }

    @Test fun `a directory that does not exist is not seeded`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$ROOT/Download/a.bin", 10)
        val idx = indexer.index(ROOT, listOf("Download", "Movies"), 0, 0)
        assertThat(idx.byPath("$ROOT/Movies")).isNull()
        assertThat(idx.byPath("$ROOT/Download")).isNotNull()
    }

    @Test fun `depth cap makes the index incomplete and never invents deep nodes`() = runTest {
        fs.file("$ROOT/Download/a/b/c/d/e/file.bin", 100)
        val idx = indexer.index(ROOT, listOf("Download"), 0, 0)
        assertThat(idx.incomplete).isTrue()
        assertThat(idx.directories.none { it.depth > 3 }).isTrue()
        assertThat(idx.byPath("$ROOT/Download/a/b")!!.bytes).isEqualTo(100L)
    }
}
```

## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/testutil/Fixtures.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.testutil

import com.cleanforge.core.backend.ArchiveInfo
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.Capabilities
import com.cleanforge.core.backend.PackageInventory
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsOps
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsStat
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsType
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ConfidenceLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.Reversibility
import com.cleanforge.core.model.RiskLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ScanItem
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.LinkOption
import java.nio.file.Paths
import java.nio.file.attribute.FileTime

/** Real filesystem (temp dirs) accessed exactly like production: lstat, no symlink following. */
object NioFsOps : FsOps {
    override fun lstat(path: String): FsStat? {
        return try {
            val p = Paths.get(path)
            if (!Files.exists(p, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return null
            val a = Files.readAttributes(p, "unix:dev,ino,size,lastModifiedTime", LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)
            val type = when {
                Files.isSymbolicLink(p) -> FsType.SYMLINK
                Files.isDirectory(p, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS) -> FsType.DIRECTORY
                Files.isRegularFile(p, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS) -> FsType.FILE
                else -> FsType.OTHER
            }
            FsStat(
                type,
                (a["size"] as Number).toLong(),
                (a["lastModifiedTime"] as FileTime).toMillis(),
                (a["dev"] as Number).toLong(),
                (a["ino"] as Number).toLong()
            )
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    override fun list(path: String): List<String>? = try {
        Files.newDirectoryStream(Paths.get(path)).use { ds -> ds.map { it.fileName.toString() } }
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        null
    }

    override fun remove(path: String): Boolean = try {
        Files.delete(Paths.get(path))
        true
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        false
    }
}

/** Wraps a real FsOps to simulate mount points and races. */
class HookedFs(private val delegate: FsOps = NioFsOps) : FsOps {
    var devOverride: (String) -> Long? = { null }
    var beforeRemove: (String) -> Unit = {}

    /** Runs AFTER an lstat result was computed but BEFORE it is returned: models a swap right after inspection. */
    var afterLstat: (String) -> Unit = {}
    val removed = ArrayList<String>()

    override fun lstat(path: String): FsStat? {
        val s = delegate.lstat(path)
        val dev = devOverride(path)
        val result = when {
            s == null -> null
            dev != null -> s.copy(dev = dev)
            else -> s
        }
        afterLstat(path)
        return result
    }

    override fun list(path: String): List<String>? = delegate.list(path)

    override fun remove(path: String): Boolean {
        removed += path
        beforeRemove(path)
        return delegate.remove(path)
    }
}

/** Deterministic in-memory tree whose paths can live under /storage/emulated/0 (what the validator demands). */
class InMemoryFs : FsOps {
    private class Node(val type: FsType, var size: Long, var mtime: Long, val ino: Long)

    private val nodes = LinkedHashMap<String, Node>()
    private var nextIno = 1L
    val denyRemove = HashSet<String>()

    fun mkdirs(path: String) {
        var cur = ""
        for (part in path.substring(1).split('/')) {
            cur += "/$part"
            if (cur !in nodes) nodes[cur] = Node(FsType.DIRECTORY, 0, 1_000, nextIno++)
        }
    }

    fun file(path: String, size: Long = 100, mtime: Long = 1_000) {
        mkdirs(path.substringBeforeLast('/'))
        nodes[path] = Node(FsType.FILE, size, mtime, nextIno++)
    }

    fun symlink(path: String) {
        mkdirs(path.substringBeforeLast('/'))
        nodes[path] = Node(FsType.SYMLINK, 0, 1_000, nextIno++)
    }

    fun exists(path: String) = path in nodes

    fun touch(path: String, mtime: Long) {
        nodes[path]!!.mtime = mtime
    }

    fun replaceWithSymlink(path: String) {
        nodes.remove(path)
        symlink(path)
    }

    fun resize(path: String, size: Long) {
        nodes[path]!!.size = size
    }

    override fun lstat(path: String): FsStat? = nodes[path]?.let { FsStat(it.type, it.size, it.mtime, 1L, it.ino) }

    override fun list(path: String): List<String>? {
        val n = nodes[path] ?: return null
        if (n.type != FsType.DIRECTORY) return null
        val prefix = "$path/"
        return nodes.keys.filter { it.startsWith(prefix) && !it.substring(prefix.length).contains('/') }
            .map { it.substring(prefix.length) }
    }

    override fun remove(path: String): Boolean {
        val n = nodes[path] ?: return false
        if (path in denyRemove) return false
        if (n.type == FsType.DIRECTORY && list(path)!!.isNotEmpty()) return false
        nodes.remove(path)
        return true
    }
}

class FakeCapabilities(var allFiles: Boolean = true, var shizuku: Boolean = true) : Capabilities {
    override fun hasAllFilesAccess() = allFiles
    override fun shizukuAuthorized() = shizuku
}

class FakeInventory(
    /** The MATCH_UNINSTALLED_PACKAGES view: installed apps AND apps uninstalled with their data kept. */
    var known: Set<String>? = defaultPackages(),
    private val versions: Map<String, Long> = emptyMap(),
    private val archives: Map<String, ArchiveInfo> = emptyMap(),
    /** What is really installed right now. Null means "exactly [known]" (no data-kept uninstalls on this device). */
    var installed: Set<String>? = null
) : PackageInventory {
    override fun knownPackageNames(): Set<String>? = known
    override fun isCurrentlyInstalled(packageName: String): Boolean = (installed ?: known)?.contains(packageName) == true
    override fun installedVersionCode(packageName: String): Long? = versions[packageName]
    override fun archiveInfo(apkPath: String): ArchiveInfo? = archives[apkPath.substringAfterLast('/')]

    companion object {
        /** Plausible device: well over MIN_PLAUSIBLE_PACKAGES. */
        fun defaultPackages(vararg extra: String): Set<String> =
            (1..40).map { "com.system.pkg$it" }.toSet() + extra
    }
}

fun scanItem(
    path: String,
    category: CleaningCategory = CleaningCategory.LARGE_FILE,
    confidence: ConfidenceLevel = ConfidenceLevel.UNKNOWN,
    risk: RiskLevel = RiskLevel.DANGEROUS,
    pkg: String? = null,
    shizuku: Boolean = false,
    size: Long = 100,
    fingerprint: FsStat? = null,
    keepPath: String? = null,
    keepFingerprint: FsStat? = null,
    mode: DeleteMode? = null,
    groupId: String? = null
): ScanItem {
    val m = mode ?: when (category) {
        CleaningCategory.APP_CACHE, CleaningCategory.THUMBNAIL -> DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY
        CleaningCategory.CORPSE_LEFTOVER -> DeleteMode.TREE
        CleaningCategory.EMPTY_DIRECTORY -> DeleteMode.EMPTY_DIR
        else -> DeleteMode.FILE
    }
    return ScanItem(
        path = path,
        sizeBytes = size,
        category = category,
        reasonForFlagging = "test",
        confidence = confidence,
        risk = risk,
        owningPackage = pkg,
        requiresShizuku = shizuku,
        deleteMode = m,
        reversibility = Reversibility.NOT_REVERSIBLE,
        fingerprint = fingerprint,
        keepPath = keepPath,
        keepFingerprint = keepFingerprint,
        groupId = groupId
    )
}
```

## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/testutil/PrivilegedFakes.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.testutil

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteResult
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsOps
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsProbe
import com.cleanforge.core.fs.FsStat
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.FileServiceCore
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.ListReply
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.PrivilegedFileApi
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.PrivilegedProtocol
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.PrivilegedSessionProvider
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.SessionResult
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.SizeReply
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.StatReply
import com.cleanforge.core.privileged.WireCodec
import com.cleanforge.core.shizuku.ShizukuState
import com.cleanforge.core.shizuku.ShizukuStateSource
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger

/**
 * The REAL service logic ([FileServiceCore]) behind the [PrivilegedFileApi] seam, with every reply pushed through
 * [WireCodec] both ways exactly as the AIDL layer does. Only Binder, Shizuku and Android classes are missing.
 */
class LocalPrivilegedFileApi(
    val core: FileServiceCore,
    private val uidValue: Int = 2000,
    private val version: Int = PrivilegedProtocol.API_VERSION
) : PrivilegedFileApi {
    override fun apiVersion(): Int = version
    override fun uid(): Int = uidValue
    override fun stat(path: String): StatReply = WireCodec.decodeStat(WireCodec.encodeStat(core.stat(path)))
    override fun list(path: String): ListReply = WireCodec.decodeList(WireCodec.encodeList(core.list(path)))
    override fun size(path: String): SizeReply = WireCodec.decodeSize(WireCodec.encodeSize(core.size(path)))
    override fun delete(path: String, mode: DeleteMode, expected: FsStat?): DeleteResult =
        WireCodec.decodeDelete(
            WireCodec.encodeDelete(core.delete(path, mode.code, expected?.dev ?: 0L, expected?.ino ?: 0L, expected != null))
        )

    override fun cancelCurrent() = core.cancelCurrent()
    override fun setProtectedPackages(packages: Collection<String>): Int = core.setProtectedPackages(packages.toTypedArray())
}

/**
 * Records every call by name and lets a test run code before and after the real call: throw a TransportException to
 * kill the "service", block on a latch to hang it, or change the filesystem to model a race.
 * Call names: apiVersion, uid, stat, list, size, delete, cancelCurrent, setProtectedPackages.
 */
class ScriptedApi(
    private val delegate: PrivilegedFileApi,
    val calls: MutableList<String> = CopyOnWriteArrayList()
) : PrivilegedFileApi {
    @Volatile var before: (String) -> Unit = {}
    @Volatile var after: (String) -> Unit = {}

    private fun <T> traced(name: String, block: () -> T): T {
        calls += name
        before(name)
        val result = block()
        after(name)
        return result
    }

    override fun apiVersion(): Int = traced("apiVersion") { delegate.apiVersion() }
    override fun uid(): Int = traced("uid") { delegate.uid() }
    override fun stat(path: String): StatReply = traced("stat") { delegate.stat(path) }
    override fun list(path: String): ListReply = traced("list") { delegate.list(path) }
    override fun size(path: String): SizeReply = traced("size") { delegate.size(path) }
    override fun delete(path: String, mode: DeleteMode, expected: FsStat?): DeleteResult =
        traced("delete") { delegate.delete(path, mode, expected) }

    override fun cancelCurrent() = traced("cancelCurrent") { delegate.cancelCurrent() }
    override fun setProtectedPackages(packages: Collection<String>): Int =
        traced("setProtectedPackages") { delegate.setProtectedPackages(packages) }
}

/** Hands out a service, or the configured "not ready" answer, and counts what the executor asked of it. */
class FakeSessionProvider(private val make: () -> PrivilegedFileApi) : PrivilegedSessionProvider {
    @Volatile var notReady: SessionResult.NotReady? = null
    @Volatile var onRestart: () -> Unit = {}
    @Volatile private var live: PrivilegedFileApi? = null
    val acquires = AtomicInteger()
    val invalidations = AtomicInteger()
    val restarts = AtomicInteger()

    override suspend fun acquire(): SessionResult {
        acquires.incrementAndGet()
        notReady?.let { return it }
        val api = live ?: make().also { live = it }
        return SessionResult.Ready(api)
    }

    override fun invalidate() {
        invalidations.incrementAndGet()
        live = null
    }

    override suspend fun restart() {
        restarts.incrementAndGet()
        live = null
        onRestart()
    }
}

class FakeShizukuState(initial: ShizukuState = ShizukuState.Authorized(2000, 13)) : ShizukuStateSource {
    private val flow = MutableStateFlow(initial)
    override val state: StateFlow<ShizukuState> = flow
    val refreshes = AtomicInteger()
    override fun refresh() {
        refreshes.incrementAndGet()
    }

    fun set(state: ShizukuState) {
        flow.value = state
    }
}

/** A filesystem that can refuse to look at, list or fail on chosen paths, and tell the test about each removal. */
class FaultyFs(private val delegate: FsOps) : FsOps {
    val denyProbe = HashSet<String>()
    val errorProbe = HashSet<String>()
    val denyList = HashSet<String>()
    @Volatile var afterRemove: (String) -> Unit = {}

    override fun lstat(path: String): FsStat? = if (path in denyProbe || path in errorProbe) null else delegate.lstat(path)

    override fun probe(path: String): FsProbe = when (path) {
        in denyProbe -> FsProbe.Denied
        in errorProbe -> FsProbe.Error
        else -> delegate.probe(path)
    }

    override fun list(path: String): List<String>? = if (path in denyList) null else delegate.list(path)

    override fun remove(path: String): Boolean {
        val ok = delegate.remove(path)
        if (ok) afterRemove(path)
        return ok
    }
}
```

## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/ui/ConfirmationEvidenceTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.ui

import com.cleanforge.core.fs.DeleteMode
import com.cleanforge.core.model.CleaningCategory
import com.cleanforge.core.model.ConfidenceLevel
import com.cleanforge.core.model.RiskLevel
import com.cleanforge.testutil.ROOT
import com.cleanforge.testutil.scanItem
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import org.junit.Test

/**
 * The destructive confirmation dialog renders exactly [confirmationEvidence]; these tests pin down what it must contain.
 * (A Compose UI test would need an emulator; this checks the data the dialog is built from, on the JVM.)
 */
class ConfirmationEvidenceTest {

    private fun cache(pkg: String) =
        scanItem("$ROOT/Android/data/$pkg/cache", CleaningCategory.APP_CACHE, ConfidenceLevel.HIGH, RiskLevel.SAFE, pkg, shizuku = true)

    @Test fun `items that share a file name are still told apart by full path and owner`() {
        val a = cache("com.first.app")
        val b = cache("com.second.app")
        assertThat(a.displayName).isEqualTo(b.displayName) // the premise: a bare name ("cache") is ambiguous

        val ea = a.confirmationEvidence()
        val eb = b.confirmationEvidence()
        assertThat(ea.path).isEqualTo("$ROOT/Android/data/com.first.app/cache")
        assertThat(eb.path).isEqualTo("$ROOT/Android/data/com.second.app/cache")
        assertThat(ea.path).isNotEqualTo(eb.path)
        assertThat(ea.owningPackage).isEqualTo("com.first.app")
        assertThat(eb.owningPackage).isEqualTo("com.second.app")
    }

    @Test fun `every item shows why it was flagged, its confidence and its risk`() {
        val items = listOf(
            cache("com.example"),
            scanItem("$ROOT/Download/big.mkv", CleaningCategory.LARGE_FILE, ConfidenceLevel.UNKNOWN, RiskLevel.DANGEROUS),
            scanItem("$ROOT/Android/data/com.gone", CleaningCategory.CORPSE_LEFTOVER, ConfidenceLevel.MEDIUM, RiskLevel.ELEVATED)
        )
        for (item in items) {
            val e = item.confirmationEvidence()
            assertThat(e.path).isEqualTo(item.path)
            assertThat(e.whyFlagged).isEqualTo(item.reasonForFlagging)
            assertThat(e.whyFlagged).isNotEmpty()
            assertThat(e.confidence).isEqualTo(item.confidence.name)
            assertThat(e.risk).isEqualTo(item.risk.name)
            assertThat(e.category).isNotEmpty()
            assertThat(e.whatHappens).isNotEmpty()
        }
        val big = items[1].confirmationEvidence()
        assertThat(big.confidence).isEqualTo("UNKNOWN")
        assertThat(big.risk).isEqualTo("DANGEROUS")
        assertThat(big.flags).contains("No undo")
    }

    @Test fun `a duplicate names the copy that stays and the copy that goes`() {
        val keep = "$ROOT/Pictures/a.jpg"
        val dup = scanItem(
            "$ROOT/Download/a.jpg", CleaningCategory.DUPLICATE, ConfidenceLevel.MEDIUM, RiskLevel.ELEVATED, keepPath = keep
        ).confirmationEvidence()
        assertThat(dup.keepPath).isEqualTo(keep)
        assertThat(dup.path).isEqualTo("$ROOT/Download/a.jpg")
        assertThat(dup.path).isNotEqualTo(dup.keepPath)
    }

    @Test fun `only duplicates carry a keeper line`() {
        val large = scanItem("$ROOT/Download/x.bin", CleaningCategory.LARGE_FILE, keepPath = "$ROOT/Download/y.bin")
        assertThat(large.confirmationEvidence().keepPath).isNull()
    }

    @Test fun `what will happen is spelled out per delete mode`() {
        fun what(mode: DeleteMode) =
            scanItem("$ROOT/Download/x", CleaningCategory.LARGE_FILE, mode = mode).confirmationEvidence().whatHappens
        val all = DeleteMode.entries.map { what(it) }
        assertThat(all.toSet()).hasSize(DeleteMode.entries.size) // all four descriptions differ
        assertThat(what(DeleteMode.CONTENTS_ONLY)).contains("folder itself stays")
        assertThat(what(DeleteMode.TREE)).contains("everything inside it")
    }

    @Test fun `shizuku removal is disclosed`() {
        assertThat(cache("com.example").confirmationEvidence().flags).contains("Removed through Shizuku")
    }
}
```

## `app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/ui/treemap/SquarifiedTreemapTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.cleanforge.ui.treemap

import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import org.junit.Test

class SquarifiedTreemapTest {
    @Test fun `cell areas sum to the bounds area`() {
        val items = listOf(
            TreemapItem("a", "A", 5), TreemapItem("b", "B", 3),
            TreemapItem("c", "C", 1), TreemapItem("d", "D", 1)
        )
        val bounds = BoxSize(400f, 300f)
        val cells = SquarifiedTreemap.layout(items, bounds)
        val totalArea = cells.sumOf { (it.width * it.height).toDouble() }
        assertThat(totalArea).isWithin(0.5).of((400 * 300).toDouble())
        assertThat(cells.map { it.item.key }).containsExactly("a", "b", "c", "d")
    }

    @Test fun `larger items get larger cells and zero-byte items are dropped`() {
        val items = listOf(TreemapItem("big", "Big", 90), TreemapItem("small", "Small", 10), TreemapItem("zero", "Zero", 0))
        val cells = SquarifiedTreemap.layout(items, BoxSize(200f, 200f))
        val big = cells.first { it.item.key == "big" }
        val small = cells.first { it.item.key == "small" }
        assertThat(big.width * big.height).isGreaterThan(small.width * small.height)
        assertThat(cells.any { it.item.key == "zero" }).isFalse()
    }

    @Test fun `deterministic order for equal sizes`() {
        val items = listOf(TreemapItem("b", "B", 1), TreemapItem("a", "A", 1))
        val c1 = SquarifiedTreemap.layout(items, BoxSize(100f, 100f)).map { it.item.key }
        val c2 = SquarifiedTreemap.layout(items.reversed(), BoxSize(100f, 100f)).map { it.item.key }
        assertThat(c1).isEqualTo(c2)
    }

    @Test fun `empty and zero bounds return empty`() {
        assertThat(SquarifiedTreemap.layout(emptyList(), BoxSize(100f, 100f))).isEmpty()
        assertThat(SquarifiedTreemap.layout(listOf(TreemapItem("a", "A", 1)), BoxSize(0f, 100f))).isEmpty()
    }
}
```

```bash
#!/bin/sh
# Run from the repository root AFTER copying update2/ over it.
# Removes stray copies of main files that were placed in the TEST source set by mistake.
set -e
for f in Preferences ScanModels Verses; do
  p="app/src/test/java/com/cleanforge/data/$f.kt"
  if [ -f "$p" ]; then rm "$p"; echo "removed $p"; fi
done
```
